*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

catch.en: The glorious Prancing Horse that returned Ferrari to the top category and delivered victory at Le Mans after a 50-year absence.
catch.zh: 一匹承载荣耀的奔马，不仅带领品牌重返顶级赛事，更在阔别50年后，再次在勒芒赛场上夺得胜利。

long.en:
The 2023 edition of the 24 Hours of Le Mans was a special one, marking the 100th anniversary of the world’s premier endurance race. With glory waiting for the winner, teams brought their most cutting-edge technology and their best cars to the Circuit de la Sarthe.

It was a high-powered showdown, but even in this storied field, most eyes were on Ferrari. After all, Ferrari was returning to the top category for the first time in 50 years, following the 312 P’s appearance in the 1973 race. The car tasked with carrying that legacy was the prototype 499P. The 499P was a hypercar developed to Le Mans Hypercar regulations for the World Endurance Championship’s top category. The “499” in its name referred to the displacement per cylinder, while the “P” stood for “prototype.” Its hybrid system combined a twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 with a front-mounted MGU, producing up to 500 kilowatts.

Its styling was shaped by more than pure speed. It is futuristic, but also unmistakably Ferrari. That is a large part of the 499P’s charm.

The race itself was closely fought, but in the end, car No. 51 came out on top. The 100th edition of the 24 Hours of Le Mans saw Ferrari make a spectacular return to the Circuit de la Sarthe, claiming its first overall victory in 58 years.
long.zh:
2023年的勒芒24小时耐力赛意义非凡——这项举世瞩目的顶级耐力赛事迎来了一百周年。各参赛车队深知本年度冠军的荣耀非比寻常，纷纷倾其所有，将最尖端的技术与最顶尖的战车悉数送上了萨森赛道。

这是一场群雄逐鹿的高水平巅峰对决，但即便置身于如此星光熠熠的参赛阵容之中，法拉利依然是最多人关注的焦点。毕竟，这是法拉利时隔整整50年后首次重返最高级别赛场——上一次还要追溯到312 P征战1973年勒芒的岁月。肩负使命，用于续写传奇的，正是原型赛车499P。499P严格依照勒芒终极跑车规则开发，专为征战世界耐力锦标赛最高组别赛事而生。车名中的“499”代表单缸排量，而字母“P”则是“原型车”的首字母缩写。混合动力系统由一台3升V6双涡轮增压引擎与前置电机发电单元协同构成，系统综合最大功率高达500千瓦。

它的造型设计所承载的，远不止对极速的追求。它充满未来感，骨子里却又透着无可置疑的法拉利气质。而这，正是499P独特魅力的精髓所在。

比赛的进程可谓扣人心弦、激烈异常，但最终51号车笑到最后，夺得了冠军。就这样，在第100届勒芒24小时耐力赛历史性的时刻，法拉利以王者之姿强势回归萨森赛道，时隔58年再度登顶！

catch.en: A priceless unrestored example of a Gran Turismo Award winner.
catch.zh: Gran Turismo奖得主。一个无法再现的珍贵案例。

long.en:
For some years after its establishment in 1947, now-legendary Ferrari would only develop and produce the chassis and engines of its cars, while outsourcing production of the exterior bodies to other Carrozzerias. The 500 Mondial produced in 1953 is a car from that era, and the model's most famous body style is the Barchetta, designed by Pininfarina, who also produced two special coupe bodies for the model. These were called the 500 Mondial Pininfarina Coupe, built to participate in the 1954 Tour de France Automobile.

The 500 Mondial is an extreme sports car, as were many Ferraris of that era, powered by a detuned F2 race car engine that dominated the 1952 and 1953 Grands Prix. The '500' stands for the engine’s per-cylinder displacement within the lightweight DOHC 2.0-liter inline-4, designed by Aurelio Lampredi. Although detuned, it manages to squeeze out <170ps> from just <1985cc>.

The powerplant is mounted in a small, lightweight steel tube space frame and connected to an advanced de Dion axle. The name Mondial loosely translates to “World,” and it was given to the car in commemoration of the Grand Prix victory by Alberto Ascari. Unfortunately, the Pininfarina Coupe was unable to complete the Tour de France Automobile,

but one of these cars still exists in its pristine original condition, never once undergoing a restoration. It received the Gran Turismo Award at the 2012 Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.
long.zh:
法拉利成立于1947年。此后的一段时间内，法拉利只有底盘和引擎是自己研发并生产的，车体的其他部分都外包给其他车身制造厂。1953年生产的500 Mondial就是一款来自那个年代的车型。这些车型中最著名的是由宾尼法利纳设计的Barchetta，该厂商还生产了2款特殊的双门轿车车体。这就是为参加1954年环法汽车赛而制造的500 Mondial Pinin Farina Coupe。

500 Mondial是一款极端侧重于竞速的车型，那个年代许多法拉利汽车都是如此。它的引擎来自于称霸1952年和1953年大奖赛的F2赛车，但性能有所下调，安装在小而轻的钢管空间车架中。它还采用了先进的德·迪翁车轴。

它名字中的Mondial大意为“世界”，也是为了纪念阿尔贝托·阿斯卡里赢得大奖赛。“500”是指奥雷里奥·兰普瑞迪设计的轻量化双顶置凸轮轴2升直列4缸引擎的气缸排量。尽管性能有所下调，它仍然能用<1985cc>的排量输出<170ps>。

不幸的是，宾尼法利纳轿跑并未在环法汽车赛取得期待的成功。好在其中的一辆车以完好状态保存至今。这辆车还在2012年的加州卵石湾汽车巡展比赛中荣获“跑车浪漫旅大奖”。在本游戏中，它以完全未经历翻修的状态登场。

cars.nameZh: 法拉利500 Mondial Pinin Farina Coupe '54

catch.en: One of the cars that defined the supercar boom in the 1970s, this car was considered the world's fastest, along with the Lamborghini Countach.+
catch.zh: 引领20世纪70年代超跑潮流的标杆之一，与Countach争夺最高时速的桂冠。

long.en:
Ferrari launched its first mid-engine production car, the 365 GT4 BB, at the Turin Motor Show in 1971 as an answer to Lamborghini's now-legendary Muira model. The letters “BB” in the new car's title stood for “Berlinetta Boxer,” a reference to the car's coupe body style and its horizontally-opposed “boxer” engine; the pistons of each cylinder bank were positioned exactly opposite of each other on a flat plane.

The 365GT4/BB started delivery in 1973, but was not well received in the marketplace. So, just three years later, Ferrari produced an evolved version of the car called the 512 BB.

The major change was an engine that was enlarged by 600 cc, giving it 5.0 liters in displacement (the name 512 refers to the engine, a 5.0-liter, 12-cylinder). It pumped out <360ps>, which was actually <20ps> less than the 365 GT4 BB's power plant, while torque was <4kgm> higher at <46.0kgm>.

The 512 BB featured a steel tube space frame; the body was composed of steel, aluminum and reinforced fiberglass. The car's svelte shape was penned by both Pininfarina and Scaglietti. Ferrari claimed both the 365GT4/BB and 512 BB had an official top speed of <302km/h>, a response to the <300km/h> top speed of the Lamborghini Countach.

There was a major supercar boom in Japan at the time, and popularity was split roughly 50/50 between the 512 BB and the Countach; making them fierce rivals in the Japanese marketplace as well as the world stage.
long.zh:
1971年，法拉利的旗舰车型中首次加入了采用中置式引擎布局的车款。

这款车就是在都灵车展上发布的365GT4/BB。车名BB有两个含义。其一为“Berlinetta”，代表双门跑车车身，另一个为“Boxer”，代表水平对置引擎。之所以这样命名，是因为这款车采用了新开发的180度倾斜角V型引擎，也就是说，这款引擎中每个汽缸的活塞都是水平相对布置的。

365GT4/BB于1973年开始交付，但仅仅三年后的1976年，其进化版512BB就面世了。主要的改动集中在引擎上，排量提升了600立方厘米，成为了5升引擎。车名512意为5升12汽缸引擎。最大马力为<360ps>，比365GT4/BB要少<20ps>，但最大扭矩要高<4kgm>，提升到了<46.0kgm>。底盘为钢管框架，车身由宾尼法利纳设计公司和斯卡列帝共同设计。车身采用钢材、铝材和玻璃钢制成。

365GT4/BB和512 BB官方公布的最高速度均为<302km/h>，据说是以1971年发布的时速最高为<300km/h>的兰博基尼Countach为对手。

在这款车服役期间，日本爆发了大规模的超级跑车热潮，512 BB和Countach在受欢迎程度上平分秋色，关于哪款车在速度上更胜一筹引发了大量的讨论。

catch.en: Adopting the classic V-12 FR layout, this Ferrari possesses remarkable performance while retaining practicality.	h
catch.zh: 这款Ferrari采用了经典的V12前置后驱布局，在实现闪电般速度的同时保持实用性。

long.en:
Unveiled in 2017, the Ferrari 812 Superfast continued the marque’s proud lineage of front-engine V12 grand tourers. Its name—a combination of “800 PS, 12 cylinders”—paid tribute to the output of its naturally-aspirated 6.5-liter V12, while “Superfast” came from the legendary 500 Superfast of 1964.

The design was shaped by Ferrari’s in-house Styling Center. It exuded classical proportions with a long nose and short rear deck—hallmarks of a front-mid-engine V12 layout. Yet, its sculpted aerodynamics and refined detailing placed it in the realm of modern Ferrari elegance.

Producing <800ps> and 718Nm (<73.3kgm>) of torque, the V12 delivered its power to the rear wheels via a 7-speed dual-clutch transaxle. The 812 also marked a technological milestone as the first Ferrari to feature electric power steering.

Its dynamics were further enhanced by the Virtual Short Wheelbase 2.0 system—an evolution of the 4-wheel steering setup from the F12berlinetta. The prime benefit of this system was that it resulted in razor-sharp turn-in even on tight, hairpin corners, despite its <2720mm> wheelbase.

With usable cargo space behind the seats and a generously sized rear luggage area, the 812 Superfast offered grand touring capabilities wrapped in pure supercar body.
long.zh:
法拉利的前置12缸引擎车型拥有辉煌的历史，而2017年推出的812 Superfast就是这一传统的继承者。数字812来源于这款引擎的动力和布局，即“800 PS，12缸”，而Superfast这个名号则继承自1964年生产的传奇车型“500 Superfast”。

其车身造型是由法拉利内部的造型设计中心所构思。整体采用了长车鼻+短车尾风格，车身比例呈现出典型的12缸前中置布局，而优化改良的空气动力学外形和丰富的细节也为其晕染上一层现代法拉利设计的优雅感。

它的6.5升V12自然进气引擎拥有<800ps>和718牛·米（<73.3kgm>）的强大性能，并通过一套驱动桥布局7档双离合变速箱将动力传输到后轮。需要着重指出的是，812还是第一款采用了电动助力转向系统的法拉利车型。

此外，它还配备了前代F12berlinetta的4轮转向系统的升级版，被称为“虚拟短轴距2.0”技术。这套系统的主要优点在于，尽管轴距较长（<2720mm>），但在通过窄弯时仍能让车身跟随长车鼻进行急转弯。

与此同时，812 Superfast还在座椅后方和车身后部提供了宽敞的行李空间，可谓是最适合休旅出行的超级跑车。_

catch.en: This collector's car took the nickname of Enzo Ferrari's son, Alfredo "Dino," who passed away at the age of 24.
catch.zh: 以Enzo Ferrari的儿子Alfredo 'Dino' Ferrari命名的特殊公路车型。年轻的他不幸在24岁就去世了。

long.en:
Ferrari had experienced plenty of success in motorsports with its mid-engine layout machines, but in 1968, the company decided to finally release a road-going car incorporating this tried-and-true racing technology. The result was the Dino 206 GT, a beautiful Berlinetta with a flowing all-aluminum body and a <1987cc> aluminum V-6 under the hood, which marked a change from Ferrari's traditional use of V-12s. Another fact worth noting is the car was not marketed with the Ferrari name, being sold simply as the "Dino," as if it were a model from a different brand.

"Dino" was the nickname of founder Enzo Ferrari's eldest son, the engineer Alfredo Ferrari, who tragically died at the tender age of 24. The 65-degree DOHC V6 found in the car that bears his name was an idea he proposed while in the hospital. It proved successful in race cars from 1957 on, and part of the reason the Dino 206 GT was created was to homologate the F2 engine.

Receiving a makeover in 1969, the Dino GT became the 246 GT. Because of the high cost and difficulty to produce the aluminum body, the new one was made of steel, while the engine and block construction were now made of cast iron. To compensate for the increase in weight, displacement was increased to <2418cc>, with output and torque improved from <185ps>/<17.9kgm> to <195ps>/<23.0kgm>. Thus, the car achieved a top speed of <235km/h>. Another major improvement was a longer wheelbase that improved stability and handling performance.

In 1971, a Targa-top 246 GTS was added to the lineup. Along with the Berlinetta, a total of 3761 cars were produced until 1974.
long.zh:
随着法拉利的中置布局赛车在赛车领域取得成功，他们决定在1968年推出一款采用同样布局的公路车型。最终的成品Dino 206 GT是一款极其漂亮的双座，拥有流畅的全铝车身，并配以<1987cc>排量的铝制V6引擎，而非法拉利传统的V12引擎。有意思的是，Dino 206 GT并没有使用法拉利的品牌，而是直接以Dino的名字进行销售，就如同来自一个完全不同的品牌。

Dino一词来自法拉利的创始人恩佐·法拉利的长子。他的儿子兼工程师阿尔弗雷多·法拉利在24岁的年纪英年早逝，Dino正是他的小名。这款车所采用的65度角斜置双顶置凸轮轴V6引擎是他在住院期间提出的想法。这项设计理念在从1957年起打造的赛车上取得了成功。与此同时，206 GT也是为了通过F2引擎认证而生产的车型。

Dino GT在1969年进行了小改款，升级为246 GT。高成本、高难度的全铝车身被改为了钢制，引擎和缸体的材质也改为铸铁。为了抵消因此增加的重量，排量被提高到了<2418cc>，输出马力和扭矩也从<185ps>/<17.9kgm>提高到了<195ps>/<23.0kgm>，能够达到<235km/h>的最高时速。其他方面的改进还包括为了提高操控性而加长了轴距。直到今天，Dino的操控性能依然广受好评。

在1971年，一款可拆卸车顶的246 GTS加入到了产品线中。到1974年为止，加上Berlinetta，这款车型总共生产了3761辆。/

catch.en: The flagship model of Ferrari wasn't just fast, it was a technological marvel.
catch.zh: 采用了F1技术的Ferrari旗舰车型。

long.en:
Ferrari unveiled its mighty new flagship, the F12berlinetta, in 2012 at the Geneva Motor Show. The successor to the 599 GTB Fiorano featured a newly-designed base structure whose space frame and body shell combined 12 different types of aluminum alloys. The front mid-mounted engine came in the form of a naturally aspirated <6262cc> V-12 producing <740ps> and <70.5kgm> of peak torque, making it the most powerful Ferrari road car to date.

Impressive numbers, to be sure, but Ferrari spent a majority of its development effort on the car’s architecture. The F12berlinetta was <47mm> shorter, <20mm> narrower and <63mm> lower than its predecessor, with a wheelbase that measured <30mm> less. The engine sat <30mm> lower than the 599, and the dual clutch 7-speed F1-matic gearbox utilized a transaxle layout—both of these features helped to lower the center of gravity by <25mm> and established a nearly ideal front/rear weight ratio of 46:54.

On the road, the F12berlinetta, despite its elegant good looks, was an absolute beast. It ran from zero to <100km/h> in a phenomenal 3.1 seconds, getting to <200km/h> in just 8.5, and topping out at a blurring <340km/h>. With its improved handling balance, it set a new fastest road car lap around the Fiorano test track, besting the 599 GTO by a full second.

With refined aerodynamics, advanced electronic devices and a brake cooling system that trickled down from its Formula 1 race car, this prancing horse deserved to be the flagship for what is arguably the most revered and recognized company in automotive history.
long.zh:
F12berlinetta是法拉利于2012年公开的599 GTB Fiorano的后继旗舰车型。

其全新设计的空间车架和车壳总共使用了12种不同的铝合金。中置引擎为一台<6262cc>自然进气V12引擎，最大动力输出为<740ps>，最大扭矩<70.5kgm>，这也是法拉利有史以来性能最强的公路车款。

但法拉利并未将过多的精力投入到车架和引擎上，而是将研发重点放在了车身布局上。相比599，整车短了<47mm>，窄了<20mm>，车高也降低了<63mm>，轴距则缩短了<30mm>。引擎的安装位置也比599低了<30mm>。双离合7速F1-matic变速箱充分利用跨轴布局，使得整车重心降低了<25mm>，前后车重配比为46:54，是提升驾驶性能的最优配比。

也因此，F12berlinetta展现出了令人惊叹的性能，0-<100km/h>加速只需3.1秒，0-<200km/h>加速为8.5秒，最高时速可达<340km/h>。它将599 GTO保持的Fiorano测试赛道纪录缩短了整整一秒之多。这个纪录也证明了它在操控和弯道性能上的长足进步。

空气动力学套件进行了优化，并加入了F1使用的刹车冷却技术，这款法拉利跑车无愧于其旗舰车款的名号。#

catch.en: This special exotic machine was the last one produced under the guidance of company founder Enzo Ferrari.
catch.zh: Ferrari创始人Enzo Ferrari参与设计的最后一款公路车。

long.en:
A very special Ferrari was announced by company founder, Enzo Ferrari, in July 1987. Dubbed the F40, this car was to mark the company's 40th anniversary, billed as Ferrari's first "street legal racing car."

Signore Ferrari spared no costs when building this dream machine. The F40's structure utilized a steel tube-frame in the same manner as other Ferrari road cars of the 1980s, but various internal and external chassis components were composed of carbon-fiber and Kevlar, the newest lightest, high-tech composite material available at the time.

The car's body panels were a structural part of the chassis, and its tube frame foundation was constructed from Kevlar and aluminum honeycomb sections, the preferred manufacturing method for racing cars at the time.

Powering the lightweight car was a twin-turbocharged, 3.0-liter DOHC V8 with a 90 degree bank angle, based on the power plant for the Ferrari's Group B 288 GTO; however, the one in the F40 had a larger displacement and altered boost pressures. As a result, the F40 produced an amazing <485ps> and <58.8kgm> of torque. The <1100kg> car could run to <100km/h> in about 4 seconds and reach a top speed of <324km/h>, making it the fastest production car in the world at the time.@
long.zh:
1987年7月，法拉利的创始人恩佐·法拉利公布了一个特别车款。即他们的四十周年纪念车款，F40。这款车的理念是打造能够合法上路的赛车，具象化地体现了恩佐·法拉利创办公司时所秉持的理念。

其基本结构采用了与法拉利其他20世纪80年代的公路车型相同的钢管车架，但在各种内部和外部构件上采用了当时最轻的材料碳纤维凯夫拉。

与钢管车架共同构成底盘的板材也采用了复合凯夫拉和铝质蜂窝结构，这些都是当时制造赛车时才会采用的方案。

这款车的动力单元是一台3升双顶置式凸轮轴引擎，呈90度倾斜角放置。该引擎以1984年日内瓦车展上发布的组别B 288 GTO搭载的引擎为基础进行开发，经过进一步调校，增大了排量并调整了增压压力。这款引擎的马力比288 GTO引擎的马力<400ps>/<50.6kgm>更大，达到了<485ps>/<58.8kgm>。据称，这款车的最高时速可达<324km/h>，成为当时世界上最快的量产车。>

catch.en: The rolling piece of mechanical art was capable of reaching a top speed of <315km/h>.
catch.zh: 顶级的中置引擎跑车，最高速度可达315 公里/小时。

long.en:
When one utters the phrase "entry-level cars," it's usually meant to describe an inexpensive automobile whose sole purpose is to get people from Point A to Point B. But when you're talking about Ferrari, all conventional definitions go out the proverbial window.

Replacing Ferrari's "entry-level" 360 Modena in 2004 was the F430. The car's styling was mesmerizing, with flowing lines influenced by the company's legendary Formula 1 racers and Le Mans prototypes of the 1960s.

Mounted amidships was a sweet-sounding V8 powerplant. Unlike the 350 Modena's engine, which evolved from that of the 1973 Ferrari 308 GT4 in 1973, the F430's 4.3-liter naturally aspirated unit was completely new. Output was impressive, as it was rated at <490ps>/<8500rpm>, eclipsing the output of the legendary F40's turbocharged V8. It came mated to a high-tech new twin-clutch transmission that allowed the driver to manually select gears via paddles on the steering wheel.

The F430's chassis was a heavily reworked version of the 360 Modena's that featured a frame composed of extruded and forged aluminum. Part of the structure was altered to meet new, more stringent collision safety standards, and the floor board was made of an exceptionally strong aluminum alloy used in aerospace called extra super duralumin. With available carbon-ceramic brake rotors and a top speed of <315km/h>, the Ferrari F430, whose base price was about $180,000, was perhaps the most desirable "entry-level" car in the world.
long.zh:
F430是法拉利在2004推出，用于参加超级跑车联赛的最新中置引擎车型。为这款车提供动力的V8引擎并不是在1973年随308 GT4一同亮相的老款引擎，而是一款全新开发的4.3升新引擎。

其最大动力输出甚至超过了F40的引擎，达到了<8500rpm>时的<490ps>。传递这股动力的变速器使用一套双踏板离合，并提供6速手动以及F1 Matic双踏板6速手动离合器两种选择。

F430的底盘是1999年推出的360 Modena所采用的底盘的升级版，沿袭了以铸铝连接的挤压铝型材车架。在对F430的改造过程中，为了符合碰撞安全标准，法拉利对车体结构进行了改动，车辆底板由一种被称为“超高强度钢铝”的航空航天级超强铝合金制成，底盘下方扩散器的形状也有所调整。相比于360 Modena，其下压力提高了50%。

外观由宾尼法利纳按照法拉利的传统设计，并由当时的总设计师弗兰克·斯蒂芬森最终完善。

这款车不仅汲取了360 Modena的设计理念，还参考了1960年代的F1赛车和勒芒赛车的设计。值得一提是，其尾灯形状采用了2002年推出的Enzo Ferrari的设计。

官方公布的最高时速为<315km/h>。除此之外，F430还提供可选的碳化陶瓷碟刹。在这些强大配置的支持下，这辆车毫无疑问将跻身顶级超级跑车的行列。

catch.en: This Italian masterpiece, equipped with a naturally-aspirated V-12 and Formula 1 technology, celebrated Ferrari's 50th anniversary.
catch.zh: 装备了F1惯用的自然进气V12引擎，专为庆祝法拉利50周年而打造。

long.en:
As the successor to the amazing F40 sports car, the F50 represented the latest and greatest from renowned auto maker and race team, Ferrari. The car also commemorated the 50th anniversary of the company. The F50 became an instant classic, as only 349 units were built, following in the the tradition established by other limited-edition models, the 288 GTO and the aforementioned F40.

The basic philosophy behind the F50 was to produce a Formula One car for the road. And the sleek sports car was exactly that, realizing a long-standing dream of Piero Ferrari (the second son of Ferrari founder Enzo) of making a road car with an F1 engine.

Designed by Pininfarina, the F50 featured a carbon-fiber body and an open-air cockpit like that of an F1 race machine (although the F50 did come with a removable hard top for rainy days). Also mimicking F1 cars was the F50's chassis whose front suspension was mounted directly to the carbon monocoque tub, while the rear suspension connected directly to the gearbox. The V-12 engine was based on the power unit from the 641, Ferrari's 1990 F1 race car. For the F50, it was tuned for road use, such as increasing displacement from 3.5 to 4.7 liters for smoother power delivery and mating it to a 6-speed manual gearbox. Top speed for the F50 was rated at <325km/h> and its 0-<100km/h> time came in at 3.87 seconds, which far exceeded the best sports cars of its day.@
long.zh:
F50是一款纪念法拉利成立50周年的特殊型号，其初衷是要打造一款适合公路驾驶的F1赛车。为了实现这个理念，宾尼法利纳选择了碳纤维材料，并设计出独具超级跑车美感的外形。由于F1赛车全都采用开放式座舱，这款车也成为了法拉利第一款采用硬顶的特殊型号敞篷车。

在F50的车身里，最具F1特征的部分当属其基础结构。前悬挂直接安装在碳纤维单体车壳的前部。引擎也是直接用螺钉连接到车壳后部，然后再连接到变速箱。后悬挂就直接安装在了变速箱上。这辆车采用了与当时F1赛车相同的动力系统框架，这在公路车中属于首创。

其V12引擎也是直接对标F1赛车规格：基于1990年F1比赛使用的641动力单元，在开发过程中进行调整以适配公路驾驶。这些调整包括为了提高操控性而将排量从3.5升提高到4.7升，以及为了提高耐用性而增加了气缸之间的间隔。这款车配置了一台6速手动变速器，最高速度可达<325km/h>，从0到<100km/h>加速仅需3.87秒。这辆车的性能已经全面超越了在1987年亮相并盛行一时的F40。

catch.en: At the heart of this exotic, an update to the 488GTB, is a powerful V-8 that was also in the 488 Pista.
catch.zh: Ferrari的V8巅峰之作，拥有一颗488 Pista的心脏。

long.en:
Ferrari introduced the F8 Tribute in 2019 to succeed the 488GTB. While the silhouettes of the two cars were quite similar, they exuded a different ambience altogether.

The F8 Tribute was essentially an update of the 488GTB; therefore, the engine, which was mounted amidships, was carried over from the 488 Pista. This powerplant was a twin-turbocharged 3.9-liter V-8 that produced <720ps> and <78.5kgm> of torque. For the exterior, the body was slightly restyled to improve aerodynamics and redirect air flow to optimize engine cooling. Inside the cockpit, the dashboard, instrument cluster, and door panels were replaced to give the car a fresh look and feel for the driver.

The performance of the F8 Tribute was nominally better than its predecessor with a 0-<100km/h> time of 2.9 seconds, a 0-<200km/h> time of 7.8 and a top speed of <340km/h>.
long.zh:
F8 Tributo是法拉利于2019年推出作为488GTB后续车型的V8中置引擎车型。你可以将之视作一次重大的中期改款，就像328之于308，F430之于360 Modena一般。

虽然轮廓造型与488颇为相似，但给人留下的印象却截然不同。主要是因为围绕空气动力学的诸多细节设计发生了重大变化，例如空气如何在车身表面流动，如何被引导到车底并抽出，以及如何将引擎的热量从引擎室内引导出来。

动力单元方面继承了被视为488终极公路版的488皮斯特所搭载的引擎。输出功率为<720ps>和770牛·米（<78.5kgm>）的3.9升V8双涡轮增压引擎无论是在街道上还是在赛道上都表现得游刃有余。

这也是法拉利有史以来最快的V8车型。0-<100km/h>加速比488GTB快0.1秒，为2.9秒，最高时速也快了约<10km/h>，达到了<340km/h>。电子稳定系统的大幅应用在多方面提供了辅助，其优异的操控性能收获了广泛好评。

catch.en: The production run of this Ferrari was limited to only 32 units. v
catch.zh: 这款Ferrari进化版车型只限量生产了32辆。

long.en:
Only 32 examples of the Ferrari FXX K were produced, meaning that it became an instant collector's item when it was introduced in 2014. Developed for track use only by Corso Clienti, the FXX K was based on the LaFerrari super car with various improvements to .

The "K" on its name stood for "HY-KERS," Ferrari's Hybrid Kinetic Energy Recovery system, similar to the KERS systems used on Ferrari's Formula 1 cars. Under the FXX K's hood was LeFerrari's 6.3-liter V-12 tuned to produce <860ps> combined with a <190ps> HY-KERS electric motor, totaling an output of <1050ps>.

In 2017, Ferrari introduced the FXX K Evo, whose aerodynamics enhancements resulted in 23 percent more downforce than the standard FXX K and 75 percent more than the La Ferrari. It generated up to <640kg> of additional weight at 200 km/h, making it one of the most potent supercars ever created by the company.
long.zh:
FXX K是法拉利在2014年发布的一款赛道专用的超级跑车，限量生产了32辆。它是由法拉利的客户导向竞速部门基于限量生产的LaFerrari车型开发而成的。

“K”代表“HY-KERS”，即法拉利自己的混合动能回收系统，类似于F1赛车上使用的KERS系统。

LaFerrari搭载的6.3升V12引擎经过调校，可产生<860ps>动力，与<190ps>的HY-KERS电机结合，总功率输出达到<1050ps>。

车辆的空气动力学性能也得到了全面优化，在与2017年发布的EVO套件合体后，产生的下压力比LaFerrari多出75%。

在摆脱了赛事认证或锦标赛规则的限制后，无需做出任何妥协的FXX K成为了车手的终极之车。

catch.en: At first glance, this monster car appears to be an offshoot model, but it's 100% custom-built on the inside, and produces over 394 horsepower. %
catch.zh: 乍一看仿佛偏离了原旨，实则100%精心打造。一台怪物级的车，马力达到400 PS。

long.en:
With the introduction of the Group B category in 1982, a number of auto makers brought new limited-run super sports cars to the market. This was because in order to compete in the Group B class, 200 units of production cars based on the race car were required to be produced. One of these cars was the Ferrari GTO, which bowed at the 1984 Geneva Motor Show. Some people referred to this car as the 288 GTO, although it is not the car's official name.

The "O" in GTO stands for omologazione, the Italian word for homologation. Upon first glance, it is obvious that the GTO gets its styling cues from the classic 308 GTB, but despite their similar looks, the GTO was an entirely different beast altogether. Unlike the 308 GTB, it featured a longitudinally-mounted engine, a <110mm> longer wheelbase, and body panels made from carbon fiber and other lightweight materials.

Leonardo Fioravanti, who was with Pininfarina at the time, penned the exterior styling. Flared front and rear fenders, additional fog lights, passing lights in the nose, a rear duck tail reminiscent of the 250 GTO, and three-lined louvers gave the GTO a wonderful balance of aggressiveness and elegance. Power came from a revamped Lancia LC2 engine, which was turned from a naturally-aspirated 3.0-liter to a twin-turbocharged 2.6-liter, then later into a 2.8-liter, the maximum displacement allowed in Group B. With <400ps> and <50.6kgm> of torque on tap, the <1160kg> sports car was the fastest Ferrari in its day, with a top speed of <305km/h>.

Only 272 examples of the 288 GTO were manufactured, and it never actually ran a race. The GTO eventually led to the development of the 288 GTO Evoluzione test vehicle, which in turn became the foundation for the now-legendary F40.
long.zh:
1982年前后，B组别被增加到了赛车运动的规则当中。为了满足产量200台的赛事认证标准，各车厂不得不开足马力，生产出各种各样的赛车。在1984年日内瓦车展上亮相的GTO就是其中之一。由于大家在称呼这款车时经常加上288，所以它也叫做288 GTO，但这并非官方命名。

GTO中的O代表omologazione，即意大利语的“认证”。这款车型是在308GTB的基础上改装而成，造型与308GTB几乎别无二致，但引擎改为纵向安装，轴距增加<110mm>，外部车身板件换成了碳纤维和其他轻型材料。在这个过程中，这款车基本上从头到尾都经历了重新设计，几乎可以说是一款全新车型。

它的外观由当时正在宾尼法利纳工作的列奥纳多·菲奥拉万蒂设计。外扩的前后轮拱罩，外置的雾灯和前指示灯，仿250GTO的鸭尾尾翼，以及3块垂直百叶挡板——这些设计将这台战斗机器的激进外观和法拉利传统的优雅风格相融合，诞生出了优美的流线造型。

它的引擎是经过改造的蓝旗亚LC2引擎（在308所使用的3升引擎基础上改造而成的2.6升双涡轮引擎）。随后，为了追求B组别规格所允许的极限，它又被进一步改造为2.8升双涡轮引擎。<1160kg>的轻盈车身在<400ps>和<50.6kgm>扭矩的推动下，能够达到<305km/h>的最高速度。GTO籍此成为当时最快的法拉利。

288 GTO一共生产了272台，但尚未投入比赛就停产了。不过，它的基本理念被延续到了288 GTO进化版试验车型上，后来又被F40继承，因此并没有白费。

catch.en: Ferrari’s first hybrid car, built with the same materials and processes as an F1 racing machine.(
catch.zh: Ferrari的第一款混动车型，完全使用F1赛车的材料和工艺打造。

long.en:
When Ferrari creates a “limited edition” model, the result is often something historic. In the past, now-legendary models such as the 288, GTO, F40, F50, and the Enzo Ferrari have rocked the exotic-car world, but the latest special-edition car from the revered marque will definitely go down in the annals of automotive history as the most special of them all: the LaFerrari.

In the same manner as its predecessors, the LaFerrari, introduced in 2013, represents grace, glamor and unprecedented performance, but two things in particular make this machine special. One of them is its carbon monocoque structure that’s composed of the same materials as Ferrari’s F1 machines, and built using the same processes. In comparison to the Enzo Ferrari, torsional rigidity of the LaFerrari is better by 27 percent, while beam rigidity has been improved by 22 percent. The car's other special feature is its hybrid drivetrain, a first for Ferrari. The 6.3-liter V-12 is tuned to <800ps> and matched to Ferrari’s HY-KERS system from F1 racing. The total output with the added <163ps> provided by the electric motor is rated at a whopping <963ps>, the most from any Ferrari road car…ever.

Also, the LaFerrari features an aerodynamics system that produces optimum performance by actively moving the front/rear diffusers, spoilers, and underbody in relation to driving conditions.

The performance specs include a 0-<100km/h> acceleration of less than 3 seconds, 0-<200km/h> acceleration of under 7, and a top speed of more than <350km/h>. At the Fiorano test track, the LaFerrari’s 1-minute-19.9-second lap was 5 seconds faster than the Ferrari Enzo and 3.1 seconds faster than the F12.

The production run of the LaFerrari was a mere 499 cars, and naturally, all of them have been spoken for, not surprising when you consider that there were more than 1000 inquiries to buy the super exotic three days after it was introduced.
long.zh:
法拉利多年以来生产了为数不少的限量版车型，譬如288、GTO、F40、F50以及Enzo Ferrari。而2013年公布的LaFerrari车型，则是这个特殊系列的延续。

和过往的其他特殊车型一样，LaFerrari与法拉利的量产版车型相比具有更高的性能，但是还是有两个显著的区别。

其一是该车的碳纤维结构采用了法拉利F1赛车相同的制造工艺。和Enzo Ferrari相比，该车架的抗扭刚度提高了27%，同时它的梁刚度也提高了22%。

另一个特点是这是法拉利历史上首台配备了混合动力系统的车。它的6.3升V12引擎被调校至<800ps>，并可以和法拉利F1赛车的HY-KERS动能回收系统比肩。其动力输出，在获得电机的<163ps>额外动力的帮助下，将达到<963ps>的总动力；这也是法拉利历史上的另一个高峰。

在空气动力学方面，该车采用了主动式空气动力系统，它会根据行驶条件主动移动前后扰流翼、扰流板以及底板，从而获得最佳空气动力学性能。

官方宣称的性能指标包括小于3秒的0-<100km/h>加速时间、小于7秒的0到0-<200km/h>加速时间，以及超过<350km/h>的最高时速。在费奥那罗的测试赛道内，它的1分19.9秒的单圈记录比法拉利恩佐快5秒，也比F12快3.1秒。

官方宣布LaFerrari将全球限量499台，但是他们也同时宣布在它面世的3天内就已经有超过1000个申购者询价了。

catch.en: This historic Ferrari flagship impressed all with its vivid design.
catch.zh: 这款历史悠久的Ferrari旗舰车型以其出格而细致的设计令车迷们惊叹不已。

long.en:
The Ferrari Testarossa (Type F110) was introduced as the company's mid-engine flagship in 1984, replacing the popular 512BB in the lineup. Penned by Pininfarina, the car boasted a wild exterior design that was highlighted by its signature side strakes.

At first glance, the strakes may appear to be just a wild design element, but in reality, they directed air to the car's Formula 1-style radiators. The cooling air was necessary to keep the car's 5.0-liter 180-degree V-12 running smooth. This mid-mounted engine produced <390ps> and <50.0kgm> of torque, allowing the car to run from zero to <100km/h> in just 5.8 seconds and reach a top speed of <290km/h>.

Production of the Testarossa, which translated to "red head" in Italian, halted in 1992, making the way for the 512 TR.
long.zh:
1984年推出的特斯塔罗萨是法拉利的旗舰中置引擎车型。此车也是绵延了11年的Berlinetta Boxer系列的继任者。

这款车最令人过目不忘的地方便是外观了。从狭窄车身中段突然向外突起的后挡泥板与5个几乎如同雕塑般的侧边条翼创造出高度艺术化和充满活力的形象，为该车赢得了无数的粉丝。

虽然乍一看只是个外观设计上的亮点，实际却是为了纳入F1风格的侧边散热器。侧边散热器解决了车厢内热量过剩的问题，同时也创造出了前车身的行李空间，从而整体提升了作为高性能豪华旅行车型的舒适性。

引擎为180度放置的5升V12引擎，最大动力输出为<390ps>，最大扭矩为<50.0kgm>。该车的0-<100km/h>成绩为5.8秒，最高速度达到<290km/h>。

特斯塔罗萨直到1992年才被512 TR取而代之，而且一直是深受车迷欢迎的历史车型。

catch.en: A single-seat concept that pushes the boundaries of the hypercar genre.
catch.zh: 一辆突破终极跑车界限的单座概念车。

long.en:
The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo is the first Ferrari single-seater concept car dedicated to the world of virtual motor sport, with a spectacular and futuristic design founded in the Prancing Horse's unequalled racing heritage. The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo draws its inspiration from the fascinating world of Ferrari's hugely successful 1960s and '70s sports-prototypes. Below hyper-modern bodywork and dramatic proportions, the car hides the DNA of masterpieces such as the Ferrari 330 P3 and the 512S. It is a nod to the past, yet a powerful hint of the future of endurance racing.

The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo's architecture is crafted around an advanced aerodynamic design and is equipped with the same engine architecture that powers the Ferrari 499P. Here, though, the engine has been made more extreme to develop no less than 1,030 CV (<1030ps>) at <9000rpm>, with an additional 240 kW (<326ps>) available through three electric motors, one on the rear axle and one on each of the front wheels.
long.zh:
法拉利Vision Gran Turismo是首款专门为虚拟赛车运动世界设计的法拉利单座概念赛车，其美轮美奂的未来主义设计继承了法拉利“骏马”无与伦比的赛车传承风范。 Vision Gran Turismo的灵感来自于60年代和70年代大获成功的一众赛车原型车。在这辆车超现代的车身和超乎常理的比例之下，蕴含着法拉利330 P3和512S等杰作的DNA。它不仅是对过去的缅怀，同时也为未来的耐力赛指明了方向。

法拉利Vision Gran Turismo的架构围绕前沿的空气动力学设计而打造，并配备了为法拉利499P提供动力的同款引擎系统。但在游戏里，这台引擎的调校显然更加追求极致——它能在<9000rpm>下产生不少于1,030马力（<1030ps>）的出力，并可通过三个分别位于后轴和左右前轮的电机额外获得240千瓦（<326ps>）的动力。

catch.en: A WRC homologation special with a unique double-decker wing design.
catch.zh: 一款装有独特双层尾翼的世界汽车拉力锦标赛赛事认证车型。

long.en:
Ford began their 1990s World Rally Championship (WRC) campaign fighting in the Sierra RS Cosworth 4x4. Then, in 1992, came the Escort RS Cosworth, a homologation special developed for even higher performance.

The original Escort was a masterpiece in itself, having been widely used in rally races in the late 1960s and early 1970s. Years later, Ford Europe took the compact body of the fifth-generation Escort, installed a highly tuned version of the 4WD powertrain from the Sierra, and added a large dual level rear wing to create a fearsome race machine.

At the heart of the beast was a longitudinally mounted turbocharged 2.0-liter twin-cam engine built by Cosworth, as per the car's name. The bore-stroke ratio was tweaked, resulting in <1993cc> of displacement and an output of <227ps>/<30.4kgm> in stock form. For the 4WD system, the central differential utilized a combination of a viscous coupling and planetary gears for maximum reliability.

The Escort RS Cosworth began production in 1992 and gained homologation status the following year when it began competing in the WRC's Group A category.

The "Cossie," as fans called it, finished 1-2 in Round 3 of the Portugal Rally before going on to achieve two consecutive victories in Rounds 5 (Tour de Corse) and 6 (Acropolis). It won again in Rounds 11 and 12 (San Remo and Spain), solidifying Ford's reputation as a strong contender on the rally circuit.
long.zh:
福特在20世纪90年代初期以Sierra RS Cosworth 4x4参加世界拉力锦标赛（WRC）。随后在1992年推出了福睿斯RS Cosworth，这是一款为提升竞技性能而开发的特殊赛事认证车型。

其原型福睿斯是20世纪60年代末和70年代拉力赛场上的王者之作。针对福睿斯RS，福特欧洲选用第五代福睿斯的紧凑车身，搭载了经过高度调校的Sierra四轮驱动系统，并加装了大型双层尾翼，实现全面的性能升级。

这头猛兽的核心动力系统是一台由Cosworth打造的纵置2升涡轮增压双顶置凸轮轴引擎，这也是其命名的由来。通过优化缸径行程比，使引擎排量达到<1993cc>，在原厂调校状态下即可输出<227ps>/<30.4kgm>的动力。四轮驱动系统采用粘性耦合器与行星齿轮组合的中央差速器设计，以确保最佳的可靠性。

福睿斯RS Cosworth于1992年投产，并在次年通过认证后开始参加世界拉力锦标赛的A组赛事。

这款被车迷亲切称为“Cossie”的赛车在第3轮葡萄牙拉力赛中取得了一二名的成绩，并在第5轮（科西嘉岛拉力赛）和第6轮（雅典卫城拉力赛）中连续获胜，更是在第11轮和第12轮（圣雷莫拉力赛和西班牙拉力赛）中再度上演这一连冠壮举，重振了福特作为拉力赛强者的声誉。

catch.en: With <417ps> on tap, this was one of the most potent pickup trucks ever created, thanks to Ford's Special Vehicle Team.
catch.zh: 这款出自Ford的Special Vehicle团队之手的高性能皮卡有着417 PS的超强马力。

long.en:
The F series is a line of full size pickup trucks sold by Ford since 1948. This is a model that has stayed on top of the pickup truck segment for over 40 years, and has also been the best selling car across all car categories for over 30 years in the United States.

The F-150 has always been the core of the series since being introduced in 1975. It is a model that has been the backbone of Ford throughout the years.

The F-150 Raptor is a special off-road model based on the 12th generation F-150, which started sales in the fall of 2008. It was developed by Ford's special vehicle development team "SVT" to be fit for racing in the desert and was added to the lineup in 2010.

The body is <18cm> wider with its enlarged fenders that house considerably thicker aluminum suspension arms supported by Fox Racing dampers, which are known to be the first off-road competition dampers to come equipped on a production car. The suspension travel in the front has been extended to <284.5mm> and <307.3mm> in the rear. The clearance under the car is also large, with an approach angle of 30 degrees and a departure angle of 22.7 degrees.

The engine is a 6.2 litre supercharged V8 producing <417ps> and <60.9kgm> of torque, and is combined with a 6 speed automatic transmission.|
long.zh:
F系列是福特自1948年起销售至今的全尺寸皮卡系列车型。该车款已经雄踞皮卡类别销量榜达40余年，同时也是30年来美国所有汽车类别中最畅销的车款。

自1975年推出以来，F-150一直是该系列的核心，这个车款一直是福特的主力车款。

福特F-150猛禽是在第十二代F-150基础上开发的越野特别版车款，于2008年秋季开始销售。这款车是由福特的专用车辆开发团队“SVT”开发，作为一款适应沙漠地形的赛车上市，并加入了2010年的车款阵容中。

车身采用更大的挡泥板并加宽<18cm>，能够容纳更厚的铝制悬挂臂，悬挂臂由狐狸赛车避震支撑，这是量产车上首次装备越野赛车避震。车辆前悬挂的行程增大到了<284.5mm>，后悬挂则增大到了<307.3mm>。车辆离地高度也较高，接近角可达30度，离去角则为22.7度。

引擎采用了6.2升机械增压V8引擎，能够产生<417ps>的动力和<60.9kgm>的扭矩，并配备了6速自动变速箱。

catch.en: The chassis performance of the late third-generation model shines in this rally special.
catch.zh: 这款最新的第3代拉力特别款车型将底盘性能发挥得淋漓尽致。

long.en:
Ford saw performance potential in its affordable sedan, the Focus, so it created the Focus ST, a souped-up version that made its debut in 1998. The third-generation Focus ST (the ST stands for Sports Technology) debuted at the 2010 Paris Motor Show equipped with a brand new engine.

The previous Focus ST came powered by a Volvo-based turbocharged 2.5-liter inline-5, but the new car featured an “EcoBoost” turbocharged direct-injection 2.0-liter inline-4 that boasted better fuel economy and reduced emissions. Despite being smaller by <500cc>, the new engine delivered <25ps> more power, up to <250ps>. While many models had moved on to 2 pedal transmissions, this stoic model only came with a 6-speed manual.

The car thrilled enthusiasts for years, and in 2014, in addition to a mild facelift, Ford engineers made some drastic changes under the sheet metal. They completely revamped the suspension system, changed the variable ratio of the power steering, updated the stability program, and installed a torque vectoring system. As a result, the new Focus ST’s boasted class-leading handling, impressing even hardened race car drivers with its quick reactions and road-holding ability. And with a price that undercut its rivals in the competitive C segment, the Ford ST is still the talk of performance-car aficionados, even at the tail-end of its model run.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.B regulations by Gran Turismo./
long.zh:
FoxST是Fox系列中备受推崇的运动车型，从1998年Fox面世的时候开始它就出现在该系的阵营中。ST是“运动科技”的英文缩写。

第三代FoxST在2010年巴黎车展中首次被宣布推出。该款车型设计的最大改变当属它的引擎从沿袭自沃尔沃的2.5升涡轮增压直列式5缸引擎降格至带有“节动”的2.0升涡轮增压直喷4缸引擎。这个改动当然是为了减少二氧化碳排放并提高燃油效率，但是在减少了<500cc>排量之后，它的动力却获得了<25ps>的提升，达到了<250ps>。尽管很多新款车型已经开始采用双离合变速箱，这款经典车型却依然只提供6档手动变速箱。

该车在2014年进行了一次车型翻新，成为了最新的款式。与此同时，悬挂设置也被完全改造，动力转向的可变比率经过调整，稳定系统被更新，同时还加入了扭矩控制系统。尽管从一开始就获得了不俗的评价，福特还是花时间对底盘进行了整体更新。

正因如此，它的操控性在车手中评价很高，同时还由于其低于竞争对手的亲民价格，使其在C级小型跑车中名列前茅。尽管该车型临近停产，但是依然最后一次吸引了许多欧洲车迷的关注。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别B规则进行过特殊调校。

cars.nameZh: 福特福克斯组别B拉力车a

catch.en: The RS model of the third-generation Ford Focus was the first to get 4-wheel drive.
catch.zh: 这款第三代Focus的RS车型是首款使用四轮驱动的车型，已获得更高的比赛性能。

long.en:
While the Focus is mostly known as a friendly everyday commuter, Ford has traditionally mixed in a high-performance version called the RS that catered directly to enthusiasts.

The fourth-generation model, which made its debut in 2018, was no different, but this time, the Focus RS was offered with AWD. With the new RS, drivers could adjust the torque distribution between the front and rear wheels, from 0:100 to 100:0, meaning it could be driven in pure front-drive or rear-drive form. Thanks to the rear axle's twin-clutch system that functions as an LSD, the driver could choose from several driving modes, including "Track" and "Drift."

Under the hood was the company's EcoBoost 2.3-liter inline-4 tuned to produce an impressive <350ps> and <44.8kgm>, thanks to new turbocharger and larger intercooler. This allowed the car to run to <100km/h> in 4.7s and reach a top speed of <266km/h>, making this Ford one of the hottest American hatches of all time.
long.zh:
福特福克斯的型号种类繁多，但每次都会推出一款运动版本。第四代福克斯也延续了这一传统，在2018年推出了高性能的RS车型。

在此前几代中，RS代表运动型的前轮驱动款式，而2015款的RS则变更为四轮驱动。扭矩分配可在前轮100%和后轮100%之间进行调节，后轴为双离合设计，同时也起到限滑差速器的作用。除了赛道模式之外，福特还在驾驶模式中增加了漂移模式。悬挂系统也得到了重点关照，配备了双模式避震器。

动力单元采用Mustang同款的2.3升直列4缸智能动力引擎，通过引入全新的涡轮增压器和大号中冷器，调校为可输出<350ps>和<44.8kgm>。0-<100km/h>加速仅需4.7秒，极速为<266km/h>的福克斯RS可不只是一台“小钢炮”而已。

catch.en: Ford's Sport Technology was on full display in this late-model, compact performance car. \
catch.zh: 这款新型高性能紧凑车型充分展示了Ford的跑车技术。

long.en:
Ford saw performance potential in its affordable sedan, the Focus, so it created the Focus ST, a souped-up version that made its debut in 1998. The third-generation Focus ST (the ST stands for Sports Technology) debuted at the 2010 Paris Motor Show equipped with a brand new engine.

The previous Focus ST came powered by a Volvo-based turbocharged 2.5-liter inline-5, but the new car featured an “EcoBoost” turbocharged direct-injection 2.0-liter inline-4 that boasted better fuel economy and reduced emissions. Despite being smaller by <500cc>, the new engine delivered <25ps> more power, up to <250ps>. While many models had moved on to 2 pedal transmissions, this stoic model only came with a 6-speed manual.

The car thrilled enthusiasts for years, and in 2014, in addition to a mild facelift, Ford engineers made some drastic changes under the sheet metal. They completely revamped the suspension system, changed the variable ratio of the power steering, updated the stability program, and installed a torque vectoring system. As a result, the new Focus ST’s boasted class-leading handling, impressing even hardened race car drivers with its quick reactions and road-holding ability. And with a price that undercut its rivals in the competitive C segment, the Ford ST is still the talk of performance-car aficionados, even at the tail-end of its model run.
long.zh:
FoxST是Fox系列中备受推崇的运动车型，从1998年Fox面世的时候开始它就出现在该系的阵营中。ST是“运动科技”的英文缩写。

第三代FoxST在2010年巴黎车展中首次被宣布推出。该款车型设计的最大改变当属它的引擎从沿袭自沃尔沃的2.5升涡轮增压直列式5缸引擎降格至带有“节动”的2.0升涡轮增压直喷4缸引擎。这个改动当然是为了减少二氧化碳排放并提高燃油效率，但是在减少了<500cc>排量之后，它的动力却获得了<25ps>的提升，达到了<250ps>。尽管很多新款车型已经开始采用双离合变速箱，这款经典车型却依然只提供6档手动变速箱。

该车在2014年进行了一次车型翻新，成为了最新的款式。与此同时，悬挂设置也被完全改造，动力转向的可变比率经过调整，稳定系统被更新，同时还加入了扭矩控制系统。尽管从一开始就获得了不俗的评价，福特还是花时间对底盘进行了整体更新。

正因如此，它的操控性在车手中评价很高，同时还由于其低于竞争对手的亲民价格，使其在C级小型跑车中名列前茅。尽管该车型临近停产，但是依然最后一次吸引了许多欧洲车迷的关注。

catch.en: The final-year model of this potent supercar came right after the company's 100th anniversary.
catch.zh: 这款接受了精心调校的百年纪念版车型于该年度停产。

long.en:
The Ford GT40 became an instant icon in the GT racing world by dominating the famous 24 Hours of Le Mans endurance race, taking the top three spots on the podium in 1966 and winning the next four in a row. In celebration of Ford's 100th anniversary in 2002, the company elected to recreate the legend by producing the spiritual successor to the classic race car of the sixties, the Ford GT.

The concept model was presented at the 2002 North American International Auto Show, followed by the unveiling of the production car at the same show in 2004. Its beautiful styling closely resembled that of the original GT40, but the new machine came armed with the latest technological features. The car measured <457mm> longer and <102mm> taller than the original, but its larger size was effectively veiled by the stunning exterior styling.

Placed amidships, immediately behind the cabin, was a longitudinally-mounted supercharged 5.4-liter DOHC V8 that pumped out <558ps>/<6500rpm> with <69.13kgm> of torque at <3750rpm>. It came with a 6-speed gearbox. The new GT boasted remarkable performance, running from 0 to 60 mph (about 100km/h) in 3.3 seconds, while reaching a top speed of <330km/h>.

A total of 4038 Ford GTs were unleashed onto the streets during its three-year production run, and, by all accounts, this revived version of the GT40 will be just as collectable as the original.
long.zh:
福特GT40是一款传奇跑车，在1966年勒芒24小时耐力赛上包揽了前三名，并在此后直至1969年的连续四年间蝉联冠军。为庆祝公司成立一百周年，福特开发了新款福特GT，试图重现当年的传奇形象与精神。其概念赛车型公布于2002年北美国际车展，正式发布则是在2004年的同一车展上。

此车优美的造型与六十年代的GT40十分相似，但包裹铝制空间框架的车身完全按照现代标准和规范重新设计。车身长<457mm>，高<102mm>，所有部件都运用了表面冲洗技术以提高制造质量。富有艺术气息的内饰兼顾了旧日形象与现代风格，使得两名乘客能够以放松的心情来乘坐。

纵向放置的中置引擎为一款5.4升双顶置式凸轮轴V8机械增压引擎，最大马力为<558ps> /，最大扭矩为<69.13kgm> / <3750rpm>。变速箱没有采用当时逐渐成为流行的双踏板半自动变速箱，而是采用了传统的三踏板6速手动变速。0-60英里/小时的加速只需3.3秒，最高速度为<330km/h>。

从这些规格参数中可以看出，福特不仅关注造型，同时也努力重现与GT40相当的性能，并使其能够合法上路行驶。

福特GT一直服役到2006年，三年间一共生产了4,038辆。其中大多数有两条从车身前部一直延伸至后部的赛车条纹，但也有少量车辆上没有。

catch.en: The second-generation Ford GT came complete with reengineered aerodynamics."
catch.zh: Ford GT的回归，空气动力学性能经过了大幅改善。

long.en:
The original Ford GT, which was produced from 2005 to 2006, brought back the glory of the renowned GT40, whose exploits in the 24 Hours of Le Mans in the 1960s are now legendary. At the 2015 North American International Auto Show, Ford introduced the second-generation GT that boasted even more performance and technical savagery than its predecessor.

While the first Ford GT's styling strongly resembled that of the GT40, the new 2016 car featured a number of aerodynamic improvements that included an active rear spoiler and a large underbody tunnel that directed air from the side through to the rear. Underneath the sheet metal, there were aluminum front and rear subframes that provided a remarkably rigid body structure, while the body panels themselves were composed of lightweight carbon fiber.

Mounted aft of the cockpit was not the V8 of yore, but a twin-turbocharged 3.5-liter V6 that produced a whopping <656ps> and <76kgm>. It came with a 7-speed DCT transmission that sent the power to the rear wheels. This combination enabled the new Ford GT to run from 0 to 60 mph in a scant 3.2 seconds, while reaching a top speed of <348km/h>.
long.zh:
在2005至2006年间，福特以在1960年代在勒芒24小时耐力赛中大放异彩的车型GT 40为基础，重新打造了一台福特GT。到了2015年的底特律车展上，福特宣布推出经过大幅改进的第二代车型。

在造型方面，第一代福特GT几乎与原版GT 40别无二致，而9年之后的第二代虽然依旧继承了GT 40的风貌，但大量空气动力学方面的提升使得车身设计概念已大相径庭。新车款包括了主动式的后扰流板，从车顶下延到后轮拱的隐藏挡板形成巨大的进气风道，从侧面一直深入到车尾。

车身的主要结构由铝合金材质的前车架和后副车架组合而成，车身板件则考虑到减重因素，使用碳纤维板制成。

动力单元不再是传统的V8引擎，而是换上了一台3.5升双涡轮增压V6引擎，可以输出<656ps>和<76kgm>的扭矩，再搭配上7速双离合变速箱，最高时速可达<348km/h>。

catch.en: Gran Turismo commemorates the return of the legendary Le Mans-winning machine by offering its own interpretation.
catch.zh: Gran Turismo打造的梦幻车型，代表着勒芒传奇的回归！

long.en:
As a stunning new take on a legendary racing car, the new Ford GT supercar was launched in the summer of 2004 to commemorate the company's 100th anniversary. As a reinterpretation of the classic 1960s GT40 that won four straight 24 Hours of Le Mans races, this new version featured the latest and greatest automotive technology. With that in mind, Grand Turismo decided to make a good thing even better by creating its own Ford GT to contemporary Le Mans specs, we call it the Ford GT LM Race Car.

The powertrain remains the same as that found in the production Ford GT, a supercharged 5.4-liter DOHC V8 mounted amidships behind the seats. But the <558ps> output from the stock version has been boosted to a whopping <600ps> in this race car model. A 6-speed manual race-spec gearbox has also been added.

The LM Race Car has the identical proportions as that of the stock Ford GT, measuring <4.61m> from bumper to bumper and <1.95m> wide. The chassis is an aluminum space frame design incorporating all of the latest automotive technologies, and the body is composed entirely of carbon-fiber. A large rear wing for increased downforce has also been added. The suspension system consists of a double-wishbone configuration fore and aft. Total curb weight: just <1150kg>.'
long.zh:
2004年夏发布的福特GT是为了纪念福特一百周年而打造的超级跑车。此车被认为是采用最新的汽车技术重新诠释了福特六十年代的经典车型GT40。因此我们抱着将福特GT调试到勒芒比赛规格的想法，创造了这款LM赛车，看看会有怎样的成果。

原版GT40是为夺取勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军而开发的，这也是福特长久以来的梦想。在60年代，勒芒耐力赛的鼎盛时期，当法拉利和保时捷这样的顶级欧洲车厂针锋相对，争夺冠军的时候，这款奇迹般的赛车横空出世，自1966起连续四年蝉联冠军，展现了福特的实力。所以，我们认为福特GT作为“重生版”的GT40，自然要在勒芒赛场上一显身手。考虑到这一点，此车是按照现已停止使用的勒芒GTS级别规则设计的，这个级别曾是科尔维特C5-R和Viper GTS-R等车型的舞台。

引擎仍然是福特标志性的5.4升双顶置式凸轮轴机械增压V8引擎，采用中置式安装在座位后方，和普通的福特GT一样只使用后轮驱动，但赛车款将公路车型的<558ps>提高到了惊人的<600ps>。前后均采用双叉臂式悬挂，变速箱为赛车规格的6档变速。

catch.en: This race car claimed numerous World Endurance Championship titles.
catch.zh: 赢得世界耐力锦标赛的Ford车厂车队专属赛车。

long.en:
The second-generation Ford GT, introduced in 2015, came equipped with compact twin-turbo V-6 that allowed the car to spring to 60 mph in about 3.0 seconds and reach a top speed of <348km/h>, making it a legitimate super car and a worthy successor to the classic GT40 of yesteryear.

Like the GT40, the GT shined on the race track. Under the Chip Ganassi Racing and Ford factory team banner, it scored several victories in the World Endurance Championship (WEC) that included the 2016 24 Hours of Le Mans, as well as winning in IMSA, taking three race wins in 2016, two in 2017, five in 2018 and three in 2019. In 2018, after winning the 24 Hours of Daytona, the GT's strong performance that season handed Ford the manufacturers title in the GT-LM class.
long.zh:
新生的福特GT第二代于2015年推出，比前代车型更加强调速度。

新的车身设计在空气动力学效能上有了更长足的进步，并配备了一款紧凑型的V6双涡轮增压引擎，使这一切成为可能。0-60英里/小时的加速时间为3.0秒，最高速度为<348km/h>，性能远胜过欧洲同类车型。

毫无意外，福特也将它投入到了赛车界的拼杀中。著名的美国赛车队纳斯卡甘纳西车队从2016年起作为福特车厂车队参加了多项系列赛事，包括国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛和美国的国际汽车运动协会赛事。

虽然从勒芒24小时耐力赛开始，该车队在世界耐力锦标赛赛事中的胜场寥寥，但在国际汽车运动协会中却奉上了绝佳的表现。2016年赢得了3场比赛，2017年2场，2018年5场，2019年3场。2019年也是车厂赞助车队的最后一年。

此外，在2018年赛季的戴通纳24小时耐力赛中，以赛季首胜作为开端，福特GT又在赛季中多次登上领奖台，最终帮助福特获得了GT-LM级别的车厂冠军。

catch.en: This historic machine achieved a much-desired Le Mans victory with an incredible 1-2-3 finish.
catch.zh: 众望所归地在勒芒大赛中夺得胜利，包揽全部领奖台，为传奇拉开帷幕，极具历史意义。

long.en:
In 1963, Ford attempted to buy Ferrari in order to improve its brand image through racing. The talks did not go well, to say the least. The deal didn't happen, and Henry Ford II went on a mission to beat Ferrari at its own game, expanding a collaboration with British race car constructor Lola Cars (to whom Ford was already providing engines) to develop a brand-new racing car.

In 1964, based on a race chassis designed by Lola, the Mark I was completed and the Ford GT was born. The commonly known name "GT40" was originally a nickname given by a reporter who was surprised by the low 40-inch height of the car.

A lightweight aerodynamic body of fiberglass was mounted on a steel monocoque chassis, powered by an all-aluminum 4.7-liter OHV V8 mounted amidships. The car made its debut at a 1964 Nürburgring race. Later that year, three Mark I's began the assault on Ferrari. The cars showed incredible speed at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, breaking the lap record and achieving the first run in Le Mans history over <186mph>, but the Fords failed to win due to reliability issues.

From 1965, Ford commissioned race activities to Carroll Shelby, and though the GTs again set new top speed and lap records at Le Mans, all of the cars were again forced to retire from the race. At the 1966 Le Mans race, 8 out of 13 Ford GTs in the race were advanced Mark IIs, with improved chassis and Shelby-made 7-liter OHV V8s. In addition to many other refinements, the power of the engines skyrocketed from <350ps> to <475ps>.

Mr. Ford himself came to the circuit to watch this race, and Ford not only achieved a much-sought victory, they dominated the podium with an incredible 1-2-3 finish. From 1966 through 1969, the Ford GT devastated the competition, winning the 24 Hours of Le Mans four years in a row.
long.zh:
1963年，福特曾经希望收购法拉利，并通过赛车活动来提高他们的品牌形象。然而谈判并不顺利，收购未能成功。于是，福特决定与英国赛车车厂罗拉赛车合作，他们曾向这家车厂供应过引擎。两家共同启动了全新赛车开发计划。

1964年，以罗拉设计的比赛用跑车为基础开发的Mark I车型完成，并被命名为福特GT。广为人知的名称“GT40”其实是一位记者起的昵称，后者因为总车身高度仅有40英寸而惊讶万分。

玻璃纤维制成的空气动力学轻量化车身安装在钢制单体底盘上，同时配备了中置式安装、全铝制的4.7升顶置式气门V8引擎。此车在1964年的纽博格林1000 km耐力赛上亮相，同年参加了勒芒24小时耐力赛，共有三辆Mark I车型参加角逐。在勒芒耐力赛上，这款车展现出了惊人的速度，创下了单圈纪录，并在勒芒历史上首次跑出<300km/h>以上的速度，但由于车辆可靠性原因，最终所有车辆颗粒无收。

自1965年起，他们将赛车活动委托给著名的Shelby美国公司，虽然他们再次在勒芒24小时耐力赛上创下了最快单圈纪录和最高速度纪录，但依然没有车辆完赛。

在1966年勒芒耐力赛上，参赛的13辆福特GT中有8辆是经过改进的Mark II车型，拥有改进后的底盘和由Shelby制造的7升顶置式气门V8引擎。在众多改进之外，引擎的马力也由<350ps>提高到了<475ps>。

亨利·福特二世本人也亲临赛场观看比赛。最终，福特不仅获得了他们追求已久的胜利，而且还取得了包揽前三名的压倒性胜利。从这一年起直到1969年，福特GT连续4年蝉联勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军 @

catch.en: This race car represented Ford's last effort to challenge for the 24 Hours of Le Mans title.
catch.zh: Ford最后一次参加勒芒锦标赛的车型。

long.en:
The year was 1966, and Ford was on a roll, especially at the world's most famous endurance race, the 24 Hours of Le Mans. The company realized its goal of winning the historic contest on its third try, dominating the competition with the Ford GT Mark II. With their eyes set on winning future Le Mans races, the engineers from Ford began work developing a new race car in 1965, one that would eclipse the prowess of the GT Mark II. The GT Mark IV was built according to changes in Article J of the FIA vehicle regulation.

The new car possessed an aluminum honeycomb chassis, which replaced the previous car's steel monocoque one. The profile of the car was characterized by its long, low body that curved from the center section to the rear end. The side air intakes utilized NACA ducts for less drag. The car was subjected to intense wind tunnel testing, and as a result, the Mark IV was one of the most aerodynamically-proficient vehicles in the world.

Although the Mark IV's engine was carried over from the Mark II, its power was increased to <530ps>. The chassis was also updated. The result was a race car with an improved top speed of <347km/h> and a better overall stability than its predecessor. In 1967, the Mark IV won the 12 Hours of Sebring and claimed the checkered flag at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, beating its rival, Ferrari, by five laps. This victory marked the last time the Ford works team participated at Le Mans. The main reason for its departure was the adoption of a new rule in 1968 that restricted maximum displacement, which seemed directly aimed at the Ford GT because, simply put, the car was too fast for the competition.
long.zh:
福特的GT Mark II统治了1966年的勒芒24小时耐力赛，在参赛的第三年终于达成了梦寐以求的目标。但这也意味着该车的基础设计已经是3年前的了，他们需要尽快研发出该车的后继者。

这正是福特如此关注国际汽联车辆技术规范J条款，并在1965年开始全力研发的主要原因。在对他们的测试原型车“J款赛车”进行了多处最终调整后，福特GT Mark IV就此诞生。

全钢一体式车身被废弃，取而代之的是铝制蜂窝结构车架。前车身加长并压低高度，中部到尾端设计为弧形，两侧的进气口使用了NACA式设计来降低阻力。这是一款经过大量的风洞测试而设计出的高度符合空气动力学的车辆。

动力单元基本继承自Mark II，但经过精心调校，动力输出提升到了<530ps>。底盘的基础结构没有变化，但同样接受了精心调整。

这款车的极速提高到了<347.2km/h>，并有着更加出色的稳定性，Mark IV在1967赛季的赛百灵12小时耐力赛上夺魁，在勒芒24小时耐力赛中更是以5圈的优势领先死敌法拉利完赛。不幸的是，这也是福特最后一个以厂队身份夺得的冠军。原因之一便是1968年起增加的对车辆最大排量的限制，可以说是专门针对在当时看来速度太快的福特GT的。

catch.en: This special high-performance Mustang was produced for only two years.
catch.zh: 这是符合NASCAR赛事认证的Mustang，仅仅只生产了两年。

long.en:
The Ford Mustang has always included high-performance versions in its lineup with many examples created especially for racing.

One of the first special Mustang versions to be specifically used in motorsports was the GT350, developed by Shelby American for SCCA races. Then, there was the BOSS series, produced in 1969 and 1970, a high-performance Mustang for the street that also possessed a racing heart because it was primarily created for NASCAR homologation purposes. Among these, the BOSS 429 stands out as perhaps the most impressive Mustang ever.

Under its hood was a 7.0-liter V-8, the largest engine to ever grace a Mustang. While officially rated at <375ps>, its true output was said to be closer to <600ps>. And the car's signature hood scoop came only on the Boss 429.
long.zh:
每一代的福特Mustang都会推出高性能的跑车款。而在其悠久的历史中，还有专门为了赛车运动而设计的型号。

其中最为人所熟知的一款赛车就出自品牌的第一代，准确说就是GT350。这款车由Shelby美国专门为了美国赛车俱乐部赛事而打造，创下了辉煌的赛车运动生涯记录，并因此举世闻名。

除此之外，仅在1969至1970年间生产的Boss系列也具有相当的历史价值。Boss 429这款车是为了符合纳斯卡赛车赛事认证规则中的引擎生产数量要求而推出的产品，并被许多车迷评价为是Mustang历史上最伟大的车款。

其7升V8 429引擎是Mustang使用过的全部引擎中排量最大的一款。其官方标称功率为<375ps>，不过有鉴于当时公布的赛车引擎功率通常都会比实际情况要低得多，坊间传闻说这款引擎的实际输出功率基本达到了<600ps>上下。

其标志性的超大型引擎盖进气口也仅在Boss429上可以得见。

catch.en: The 50th Anniversary sixth-generation Ford Mustang GT goes international.
catch.zh: 在该车型50周年亮相的第6代Mustang，这款备受期待的产品在全球120个国家销售。

long.en:
America’s premier pony car celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2014, and Ford celebrated this occasion by introducing the all-new sixth-generation model. Unlike previous versions of the Mustang that were only available in limited markets, Ford decided to share the wealth and marketed the new car to more than 120 countries.

The designers at Dearborn took extreme care in styling the new Mustang, making it appear more aggressive than any model before it, but making sure that it would still be instantly recognizable as a Mustang upon first glance. The engineers took the same tack, giving the car a great balance of efficiency and power. They brought back the inline-4 of Mustangs past, but after bolting on a turbocharger, the base 2.3-liter engine pumped out a hearty <314ps>/<32.6kgm> to the delight of sports car fans worldwide. However, the star of the show was the thundering Mustang GT's 5.0-liter V-8, which people expected from a powerful American muscle car. It didn’t disappoint, delivering a whopping <441ps>/<40.8kgm>, making it among the most powerful Mustangs ever.

The new pony car also featured a fine-tuned fully independent suspension system (previous models came with a rear beam axle). It was clear to see from this rebirth of the modern-day pony car that the Mustang was no longer only an American icon, but an international one.
long.zh:
福特Mustang于2014年改款成为了第六代车型，这一年也是它首次面世的50周年纪念。尽管这台车过去仅仅在美国以及其他有限的几个国家中销售，但它现在已在120个国家/地区的市场中销售。

为了准备好这次扩张，该车型的改造也受到了非常大的重视。

车辆外形经过了大幅改造，比此前任何一款都更有冲击力，但是它著名的前格栅和大灯及其强烈的流线型设计均得以沿用，从而让任何看见它的人都能立刻认出这是一台Mustang。

该车的工学设计也经历了重大的变动。老式的刚性车桥终于被彻底抛弃，所有4个轮子都换上了独立的悬挂系统。

在引擎方面，第二及第三代中出现过的直列式四缸引擎则卷土重来。尽管为了保护环境而选择了此款降档的直喷引擎，它依然是能提供<314ps>功率与<32.6kgm>扭矩的2.3升涡轮增压引擎，并依然在世界各地大受欢迎。

不过，对于该系列的粉丝来说，人们聚焦的依然是Mustang GT，配备其标志性的V8引擎。这台5升的V8引擎能提供<441ps>功率与<40.8kgm>扭矩的动力，无论低速还是高速均能提供稳定的动力来源，但是V8系列的顶配车型还数Mustang GT豪华版。该豪华车型配备了丰富的配套产品，包括语音识别车载导航系统以及Recaro真皮座椅。

catch.en: With more muscle than others in its class, this pony car set a new standard for aggressiveness.
catch.zh: 全球的跑车都追随着这款车型掀起的激进风格潮流。

long.en:
In the postwar era, American cars were widely seen as large and expensive, but that perception shifted dramatically in the early 1960s with the debut of the Ford Mustang in 1964. With its sporty attitude and impressive performance—offered at an affordable price—the Mustang immediately won over the American public. It became a financial triumph for Ford Motor Co., and its popularity only grew in the years that followed.

In 1969, Ford gave the Mustang a major redesign, but it retained its signature long nose and short rear deck. Otherwise, nearly everything else about the car changed so dramatically that many saw it as a completely new machine. The updated Mustang was larger but kept its core structure and layout.

It was during this refresh that the formidable Mach 1 arrived in 1969. Launched as part of the Mustang’s fastback lineup known as the "SportsRoof," its sweeping roofline didn’t just enhance aerodynamics, it inspired sports-car designers around the world.

Ford offered a wide range of engines under the Mustang’s hood, from high-powered big-block V-8s capable of matching race cars in performance to more accessible options. The most common was the small-block 351-cubic-inch V8. In its 1970–1971 Ram Air configuration. It produced an impressive <304ps>, making the 351 Mustang one of the quickest and most thrilling street cars of its time.
long.zh:
战后美国车给人的印象是大而昂贵，但二十世纪六十年代早期，随着1964年福特Mustang的上市，这种潮流发生了剧烈的变化。这款车主打动感的风格和高性能，同时价格又相对低廉，很快受到了美国大众的青睐。原版的Mustang立刻令福特汽车公司赚得盆满钵满，这款车在之后的几年内仍然长盛不衰。

1969年，福特对其小马车进行了重大改款，仅仅保留了标志性的车型特征，即长车头和短车尾。除此之外，其他的一切都进行了改进，事实上，改动如此之大，以至于许多人认为改款后的Mustang是一款全新的汽车。新车款更大，但基本的配置和构成仍然没有变。

这次改款后，“不祥”的Mach 1于1969年登场。这款跑车级汽车属于Mustang名为Sports Roof的溜背车产品线，动感的车顶设计给全世界的跑车制造商带来了启示。

Mustang包含多种引擎版本，包括和许多跑车不相上下的大排量V8引擎，但最常见的是小缸的351-cu.-in.V8引擎。1970至1971年推出的351 Mustang采用冲压空气引擎，马力为<304ps>，是当时合法上路的轿车中最具运动感和速度最快的类型。

catch.en: This high-performance model of the seventh-generation Mustang takes its name from a legend.
catch.zh: 这款7代Mustang的高性能车型被赋予了一位传奇的名字。

long.en:
The roots of the Shelby GT350R date back to 1965, when Ford commissioned Carol Shelby to build a car to compete in the SCCA (Sports Car Club of America). Based on the first-generation Mustang, the GT350R was sold as a road car because the SCCA allowed only minor modifications for its competition cars. Still, the car dominated its class, gaining instant recognition.

Fast forward to 2016, when the Shelby 350R based on the seventh-generation Mustang, made its debut as road car that was race ready, like the original model. Its naturally-aspirated 5.2-liter V-8 was tuned to produce <533ps> and <59.3kgm> and was mated to a 6-speed manual transmission.

The reinforced chassis featured Ford's MagneRide suspension system, which detected road conditions and adjusted damping strength using magnetorheological fluid. Also, to reduce weight, the 2+2 layout of the stock Mustang was converted into that of a two-seater.

The GT350R enjoyed a loyal following and great success, thanks in part to it exclusivity. It was sold as a special model available through a limited number of dealers.
long.zh:
Shelby GT350R的起源可以追溯到1965年，当时的福特委托卡罗尔·谢尔比为参加美国赛车俱乐部的赛车活动而打造一辆赛车。GT350R的开发基于初代Mustang，但由于美国赛车俱乐部的赛事规则只允许最低限度的改装，例如对原厂车进行减重，所以它最终作为一款可以直接参加比赛的公路车上市。这款车在比赛中大放异彩，很快便成就了传奇。

2016款的Shelby 350R基于第7代Mustang开发，同样是一款可以直接开上赛道，享受风驰电掣感觉的公路车。

其5.2升自然进气V8引擎经过调校，可以输出<533ps>和<59.3kgm>扭矩，并搭配了一部6速手动档变速箱。其底盘为了支持引擎的强大性能，也经过了加固处理。悬挂系统方面应用了福特的磁驾系统，可以主动检测路面状况，并使用磁流变液来调整减震器应力强度。除此之外，这款两座车还下了很大功夫来减轻车身重量。

GT350R的销售基于标准型GT350，不过由于接受了各种特殊调校，仅作为特殊车型在少数几家经销商处限量销售。

catch.en: A Cosworth tuned masterpiece that dominated touring car racing.
catch.zh: 一辆称霸房车赛的Cosworth杰作。

long.en:
The Sierra was a relatively standard family car with an aerodynamic hatchback body produced by Ford Europe from 1982.

But in 1985, the impression of car enthusiasts regarding the Sierra took a big turn. This was because the famed Cosworth added the Sierra RS Cosworth to the selection, known affectionately as the "Cossie" among enthusiasts. The Sierra RS Cosworth was powered by a 2.0-liter inline 4 tuned to <206ps> with DOHC and a turbocharger. The chassis was reinforced, and the exterior was upgraded with fender extensions and a large rear spoiler.

A year later, power was further increased to <227ps>, and a 500-unit limited Sierra RS 500 Cosworth was added to the lineup, with an engine reinforced for race use and better aerodynamic details.

And, of course, all of these improvements were developed for touring car racing. From 1988 to 1990, the Sierra won a number of series championship titles in the international Group A category in countries such as Germany, UK, Australia, Japan and New Zealand.
long.zh:
Sierra是一款具有空气动力学掀背式车身、相对标准的家庭用车，由福特欧洲公司从1982年开始生产。

1985年，汽车爱好者对Sierra的印象发生了很大转变。这是因为著名的考斯沃斯公司将Sierra RS Cosworth加入了阵容，车迷亲切地将它称作“Cossie”。Sierra RS Cosworth由一台2升的直列4缸发动机驱动，并采用双顶置凸轮轴和涡轮增压器，令马力提升至<206ps>。底盘得到了加强，而外部也装上了挡泥板和大号后扰流板。

一年后，它的马力被进一步提升至<227ps>，只生产500台的限量版Sierra RS 500 Cosworth也加入了阵容，这个版本拥有经过强化的赛事专用发动机，以及更好的空气动力学设计。

这所有的改进自然是为了房车赛而开发。从1988年到1990年，Sierra在德国、英国、澳大利亚、日本和新西兰等国家的国际A组别赛事中赢得了许多系列赛冠军头衔。

catch.en: This "poisonous" 240Z, which won the 2015 GT Award, packed a naturally-aspirated RB26 engine.
catch.zh: 2015年GT大奖获胜者，这款“有毒的”240Z使用的是自然进气的RB26引擎。

long.en:
The big winner of the 2015 Gran Turismo Awards at SEMA was this S30 Datsun Z, nicknamed the “Fugu Z.” The car was built by actor Sung Kang, known for his role in "The Fast and the Furious” movie franchise. When he purchased the car, it was a stock 1973 240Z, but it soon became something quite different and very special.

The "Rocket Bunny" body kit gives the reborn Z aggressive good looks, consisting of wide fender flares and stylish front and rear spoilers. Not just for show, the car comes equipped with a naturally-aspirated version of the RB26DETT engine, pulled from a Skyline GT-R. Thanks to some fine tuning, the inline-6 produces <220ps>, but feed it E85 IndyCar fuel, and that total jumps to more than <300ps>.

To handle this newfound power, a roll cage was installed to strengthen the body. Weight-saving measures were implemented to the car's dashboard and console, which were custom made by CarbonSignal.

The name of the car, “Fugu,” refers to the Japanese poisonous blow fish. Its organs are so toxic that anyone not taking proper precautions when handling the fish may die... and, we suppose, the same can be said about this car.
long.zh:
在2015年美国汽车用品改装车展览会上，跑车浪漫旅大奖的获胜者是一辆S30 Datsun Z，昵称为“Fugu Z”。这辆车是由《速度与激情》系列电影中的知名演员姜成镐一手打造。这辆车的原型是他以原厂状态购入的一辆1973年款240Z，并按照他指定的规格进行了定制改装。

外观方面最引入注目的特征自然是一套包含超宽挡泥板和前后扰流板的“火箭兔”宽体套件。当然了，这款车并不只有外表。它的内在核心是一台久负盛名的Skyline GT-R RB26DETT引擎，改成自然进气后通过机械调校将动力提高到了<220ps>。当使用E85印地赛车燃油时，这台引擎可以输出约<300ps>。

为了承受庞大的动力，车身内部不得不焊接上防滚架。而为了减轻车身重量，这辆车的仪表板和控制面板都由CarbonSignal进行了定制。

这辆车的名字“Fugu”在日语里是河豚的意思。这种鱼毒性极强，如果不经过妥善处理就食用的话，可能会致死。对于这台车来说，也是如此。

catch.en: This concept car for the virtual world was developed in collaboration with Citroën.
catch.zh: 跑车浪漫旅与Citroën联合研发的一辆虚拟概念赛车。

long.en:
The GT by Citroën announced at the 2008 Paris Motor Show was the first sports concept car created from a collaboration between Citroën and Gran Turismo. This approach succeeded in establishing an image of a new concept car that does not just end at the show floor. This is because a 21st century sports car imagined by Citroën is accurately expressed in both real and virtual forms.

Based on the GT by Citroën, the GT by Citroën Gr.4 is a race spec car modified for racing in the Gr.4 category.

To meet the Gr.4 regulations in which the range of modifications is limited, the exterior changes are minimal. However, because the original car is already very unique, its sense of presence is overwhelming. The armor-like front and rear fenders and the sharp visage of the fascia that remind the viewer of a medieval Japanese warrior’s mask, are maintained in this model.

The unique aspect of this car is that the modifications to make it a Gr.4 car were performed by none other than Takumi Yamamoto himself, who created the original design for the base car. The 6 variations of the livery and newly added rear wing express the intent of Yamamoto. The addition of required racing equipment such as hood pins, towing hooks, and air jack valves give the car the look of a serious circuit fighting machine.

The interior has also been modified for weight reduction, and the steering wheel and HUD are made in a functional design befitting of a race car. The dashboard material has been changed from copper to carbon, and the HUD displays speed, engine RPM, steering angle, and horizontal Gs to assist the assessment of the car’s state by the drivers on the track.

With its avant-garde styling and performance of a competition machine, the GT by Citroën Gr.4 is a groundbreaking combination of these aspects.
long.zh:
在2008年巴黎车展上公布的雪铁龙 GT是雪铁龙与跑车浪漫旅合作开发的首款概念跑车。雪铁龙创想的这种同时以真实与虚拟形式表现21世纪跑车的方法，成功地树立了一个并不仅仅止步于展台的新概念赛车形象。

GT by 雪铁龙组别4是一款以雪铁龙 GT为原型的专用赛车，为参与组别4比赛而进行了改装。

为满足组别4对改装范围的限制，外观改变被限制在了最小程度。然而由于原车本身就已经非常独特，它依旧拥有压倒性的存在感。这一车型拥有盔甲般的正面和后挡板以及外观刚毅的前脸，令人联想到中世纪的日本武士面具。

这款车型的独特之处在于，其改装由原型车的设计者山本卓一亲自操刀。六种不同的涂装和新增的后翼充分表达了山本设计师的意图。此外，由于添加了引擎盖和拖钩以及气阀这样的必需赛车设备，该车型看上去如同一名严肃的赛道杀手。

为减轻重量，该车型的内饰同样进行了改装。方向盘和抬头显示都进行了适用于赛车的功能性设计。仪表盘的材料从铜变更为碳。抬头显示能够显示速度、发动机转速、转向角度和横向重力加速度，以帮助赛道上的车手对赛车状态进行评估。

GT by 雪铁龙组别4将前卫的外观和竞速赛车的出色性能突破性地结合在了一起。

catch.en: This concept car for the virtual world was developed in collaboration with Citroën.
catch.zh: 跑车浪漫旅与Citroën联合研发的一辆虚拟概念赛车。

long.en:
The GT by Citroën announced at the 2008 Paris Motor Show, is a sports concept car in which Citroën and Gran Turismo collaborated for the first time.

The car attracted much attention as a new type of concept car, an expression of real and virtual. And it was in the spring of 2009, that a decision was made to run a racing spec version of this machine in the world of GT.

The exterior was designed by Takumi Yamamoto, the designer who created the original. Many sketches were sent to Polyphony Digital (PDI) day after day, and as a result, the original fenders were widened, and with the addition of air ducts and other aerodynamic parts, the design took an extremely aggressive turn.

Based on this, the details to make it more racing-car like was left to PDI. Details like the hood pins and tow hooks you would normally see on race cars, the valves for the air jacks, and the layout of sponsor stickers, were all set by PDI.

The other major piece of work left to PDI was the design of the interior. The motif was a modern jet fighter, and while being extremely high tech, it is balanced with the gritty feel of a real racing car.

All parts aside from the dashboard have been replaced, and the steering wheel and HUD (heads-up display) are functional in design as befitting a racing car, while still being as eccentric as the exterior. Though not changed in design, the dashboard is made of carbon, instead of copper.

The HUD displays things like speed, engine rpm, steering angle, and horizontal Gs.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.
long.zh:
在2008年巴黎车展上公布的雪铁龙GT是雪铁龙与跑车浪漫旅合作开发的首款概念跑车。

作为融合真实和虚拟世界的新型概念赛车，这一车型吸引了各界的关注。并于2009年春季决定在GT的数字世界中制作该车型的赛车车型。

外观设计依旧由原型设计师山本卓一操刀。日复一日，无数的草图被送往Polyphony Digital。结果，原有的翼片被拓宽，并增加了空气导管和其他空气动力组件，使得该车的外观设计变得极具攻击性。

适应赛车比赛需要的细节问题交由Polyphony Digital处理。像是引擎盖和拖钩这样的细节和赛车上常见的东西——比如气阀及赞助商标签的布局等设计工作都由Polyphony Digital设计师来完成。

其余由Polyphony Digital负责的工作主要是内饰设计。车内环境和整体感觉令人联想到现代的喷气式战斗机，既有着极致的高科技感，也与真实赛车的质感进行了平衡。

除仪表盘外所有的部件都进行了更换。尽管在设计上并无改动，仪表盘的材料由铜换成了碳。方向盘和抬头显示在功能设计上更适合赛车，同时保有和外观同样的风格。抬头显示能够显示速度、发动机转速、转向角度和横向重力加速度。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。

catch.en: From dream to reality, the supercar concept developed by Citroën and Gran Turismo becomes a V8-powered mid-engine sports car.
catch.zh: 化作公路赛车的梦幻概念车型，采用中置V8引擎。

long.en:
The GT by Citroën was a concept car created through a collaboration between Citroën and Gran Turismo. It was the hit of the 2008 Paris Motor Show, with many impressed by its avant-garde styling, penned by Citroën designer Takumi Yamamoto.

This super sports car came to life after numerous travels between Japan and France. It went from a show model to a running model, which we called the GT by Citroën Road Car. The major difference between the show car and road car was the former was an electric vehicle with a high-power motor, while the latter came powered by a mid-mounted V-8 engine.

The elegant exterior of the car was largely left intact. The slits between the rounded inner body and outer cowling effectively dissipate heat from the engine, keeping it cool.

Also, the replacement of the heavy, high-capacity drive battery with a smaller gasoline tank made the car much lighter.

A sturdy rear cowl completely covered the engine bay, but it provided extra rigidity, which made the GT by Citroën an awesome handling machine. ~
long.zh:
2008年巴黎车展上公布的雪铁龙GT是雪铁龙与跑车浪漫旅合作开发的首款概念跑车。在2008年巴黎车展上公布后，该车立刻吸引了各界关注。由雪铁龙设计师山本卓一设计的前卫外观更是大受好评。

这台超级跑车在制作中几经波折，在日本和法国之间往返数次。此次在跑车浪漫旅进行复刻，并将其由展览车型改为公路车型，算是彻底完成了这台雪铁龙GT公路赛车。最大的不同之处是概念赛车采用了大功率电机设计，而在公路赛车款式中则改为使用中置V8引擎的跑车式配置。

如同盔甲般的外形几乎未进行改动，而车体内的圆弧形线条和直线式的整流罩搭配所形成的沟槽，还具有引入空气以便进行冷却与散热的功能。该车在设计上就考虑到了加装高马力大排量引擎的可能性。

不仅如此，装载在概念赛车中的大容量驱动电池被移除，改为容量小得多的小型油箱，以便大幅减轻重量。

这种引擎室被后罩完全遮蔽的做法简单地确保了车身后半部的刚性，打造出超级跑车的操驾感。

catch.en: A time attack Civic customized in the classic JDM style.
catch.zh: 以经典JDM风格改装的计时赛专用Civic。

long.en:
The overwhelming popularity of Japanese performance cars on the international circuit led to the creation of the JDM (Japanese Domestic Market) category. Among these machines was a Honda Civic, a JDM-inspired creation that took home the Gran Turismo Award in 2017—an accolade bestowed upon the best custom vehicles at the SEMA Show.

In 2006, Philip Robles acquired a largely unmodified 1992 EG Civic, and together with his son Jesse, transformed it into a formidable track machine. Their goal was to compete in Time Attack and Time Trial events across circuits in the American Southwest. Over the course of a decade, marked by countless weekends at the track, their Civic secured multiple championships in both disciplines. In 2017, Robles was invited to showcase his creation at SEMA, under the banner of Mackin Industries, a leading importer of tuning parts. In preparation for the event, the Civic underwent an extensive aesthetic transformation for the show.

The most striking visual enhancement was the aggressive wide-body kit from Japanese aero specialists PANDEM, complemented by a front splitter and a rear wing. Adding even more pop to the car's appearance was a carbon-fiber hood, inspired by a signature design from J’s Racing of Japan. Inside, the cockpit was stripped to its bare essentials—only a full roll cage and a single racing bucket seat remained.

The original engine was replaced with a Honda K24 inline-4 powerplant. When the car appeared at SEMA in 2017, the engine was still naturally aspirated. However, in pursuit of greater performance, it was later turbocharged, unleashing a significant increase in power. It came mated to a Quaife 5-speed sequential gearbox, purpose-built for Honda's revered K-series engines.

High-capacity brake systems with Brembo calipers were installed at both front and rear. Also, the suspensions system was enhanced to circuit-tuned specs to further sharpen its handling characteristics.
long.zh:
日本高性能跑车在各大国际赛道上一炮走红后，“JDM”（日本国内市场）这一类别也应运而生。这辆JDM风格的改装版本田思域在2017年一举拿下了当年的Gran Turismo大奖，这一奖项专门颁发给美国改装车协会车展上的最佳改装车辆。

在2006年，飞利浦·罗伯斯购买了这辆保持出厂状态，接近全新的1992年“EG”思域，随后便与儿子杰西一起开始改装他们的爱车。父子二人的目标是开着这台座驾在西南地区的赛道上参加地区计时赛和计时挑战赛。连续10年驰骋在周末比赛的赛道上，他们夺得了多个计时赛和计时挑战赛冠军。2017年，飞利浦受邀出席美国汽车用品改装车展览会，在美国改装零部件进口商Mackin Industries的展位上展示这台思域。为了这次车展，他们进一步改装和翻新了这台车。

这台车上最显眼的改装便是来自日本空气动力学品牌“PANDEM”的宽体套件，以及前扰流器和尾翼。另一个引人注目的改动则是大胆换用了碳纤维引擎盖，后者的灵感来源于日本改装车厂“J's Racing”的作品。这辆车的内饰已被拆得一干二净，仅保留了一个桶椅，同时加装了防滚架以提供额外的稳固性。

原厂引擎被换成了一台本田K24直列四缸引擎。这辆车在2017年美国改装车协会车展亮相时，引擎还是自然进气设计，但在之后的大量改装过程中加装了能够极大提升引擎功率的涡轮增压器。该车搭载了一台由Quaife专为K系列引擎而设计的5速序列变速箱。

原本的前后刹车则升级成带布雷博卡钳的高性能制动系统。当然，悬挂系统也被升级为了赛道专用扈本。

catch.en: An AWD Genesis sports sedan powered by a potent twin-turbo V-6.
catch.zh: 一辆Genesis运动型轿车，四轮驱动，均由双涡轮增压V6引擎提供动力。

long.en:
The G70 is a sports sedan developed as part of Hyundai's high-performance Genesis brand. A standard D-segment vehicle, it was released in 2017 and intended as an entry-level model.

Despite sharing most of its features, including the platform, with the KIA Stinger (KIA are also part of the Hyundai group), the G70 was designed from the ground up as a luxury sedan.

Three engines were made available for the G70: a twin-turbocharged 3.3-liter V-6, a turbocharged 2.0-liter gasoline turbo, and a 2.2-liter diesel turbo. The twin-turbo V-6 was capable of <370ps>. Like the other cars in the Genesis lineup, rear-wheel drive and AWD versions of the G70 were offered.

The G70's styling was an instant hit, widely praised for its elegant outline. In 2020, however, the car underwent a major redesign, intended to make it more similar to the luxurious G90 and G80. As a result, the G70 looked more polished and even more striking.

In 2021, a shooting brake model, based on the sedan was produced for the European market. Its stunning style made it an instant hit.
long.zh:
G70是一款运动型轿车，作为现代的高性能品牌捷尼赛思旗下的车型而开发。这是一款标准的D级车。它于2017年首次发布，定位为入门级的捷尼赛思车型。

尽管与起亚斯汀格（起亚也是现代集团的一部分）共享了包括平台在内的大部分功能，但G70从一开始就是按照豪华轿车的标准设计的。

G70有三种引擎可选：3.3升V6双涡轮增压引擎、2升汽油涡轮增压引擎和2.2升柴油涡轮增压引擎。其中V6双涡轮增压发动机能够输出<370ps>的动力。与捷尼赛思产品线的其他车型一样，G70会同时生产后轮驱动和全轮驱动版本。

G70的造型一经问世，就因其优雅的车身轮廓而广受赞誉。然而，在2020年，该车又经历了一次重大的改款设计，目的是让造型与同为豪华车型的G90和G80更加相似。改款之后，G70显得愈发耀眼、引人注目了。

2021年，捷尼赛思在轿车的基础上向欧洲市场推出了猎装车型，其令人惊叹的外观风格使之立即成为热门车款。

catch.en: A Gr.3 machine that combines luxury with competition performance.
catch.zh: 一台将奢华气质与竞赛级性能结合在一起的Gr.3赛道机器。

long.en:
In April 2021, Hyundai's new premium brand, Genesis, unveiled its Genesis X concept, the brand's interpretation of how GT cars could look in the future.

The front fascia features the shield-shaped crest grille that has become the brand's signature design element. Two lines stretch from the grille to past the front wheel arches and reappear again at the rear of the car to form the taillights. This new-generation example of car styling is part of Genesis calls its "Athletic Elegance" design language.

This car was more than a concept, as Genesis also created a racing edition for Gran Turismo that was inspired by the Genesis X. The Genesis X Gr.3 is a serious Gr.3-spec machine designed to compete in Gran Turismo's fierce championship competition.

The X concept was originally designed as an electric vehicle, but the Genesis X Gr.3 is equipped with a conventional gasoline engine. Thanks in part to forced induction, it produces <550ps>. To house the race car's larger tires, the body was widened to <1992mm>, while aerodynamic improvements were added to the underside. Also, a larger rear wing helps make this machine look race-ready.

A combination of luxury and performance, the Genesis X Gr.3 is a radical new type of Gr.3 machine, the likes of which have never been seen before.
long.zh:
2021年4月，现代的高端品牌捷尼赛思发布了捷尼赛思X concept，作为对近未来GT跑车形态的探索。

前脸采用了已经品牌家族化设计的盾形徽章格栅，两侧伸出的两条线勾勒出头灯，并延伸过前轮拱，然后在车尾再次出现，构成尾灯的轮廓。新一代的外观设计风格是对捷尼赛思的“运动优雅”设计语言的创新诠释。

不过，这款概念赛车型的使命并未就此止步。捷尼赛思还为跑车浪漫旅专门设计了一款赛道版，它采用了捷尼赛思X的相同概念和设计精髓。捷尼赛思X组别3是一款顶级的组别3规格赛道机器，专为在激烈的锦标赛中杀出重围而生。

虽然捷尼赛思X concept最初被设计为电动车，但这台捷尼赛思X组别3依然采用传统的内燃机提供动力。加装增压装置以后，最大输出功率可达<550ps>。为了适配加宽后的轮胎，车体也相应加宽至<1992mm>，同时在车底、车尾都安装了空气动力学优化部件。尾部的大型扰流板使得整辆赛车气势非凡。

捷尼赛思X组别3是奢华气质与竞赛级性能的结合，也是组别3组别前所未见的新生代竞争者。

catch.en: A sports coupe that embodies the athletic elegance sought by Genesis.
catch.zh: 体现出Genesis所追求的运动优雅理念的运动型双门跑车。

long.en:
The Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept embodied Genesis’ “Athletic Elegance” design philosophy. The design combined cab-rearward proportions with the brand’s signature anti-wedge stance, structured around a virtual parabolic tension theory seen across the Genesis lineup.

Its form was both pure and muscular, with volumes centered around the wheels. It introduced a new front fascia that abstracted the crest grille and integrated it with the quad lights, while the brand’s signature two-line lighting motif visually connected the car from front to rear. The fuselage extended rearward into an elliptical concave volume, a theme shared with other Genesis models. It was framed by a rear spoiler and lateral trailing edges to enhance high-speed stability.

The interior followed Genesis’ “Beauty of White Space” philosophy, creating a minimalist, driver-focused environment. Essential functions were prioritized to support track performance. A digital panoramic interface served as the central information hub, linked to a surround digital monitoring system. Steer-by-wire controls enabled precise inputs. The quilted, padded bolsters provided protection for the driver during high-speed driving and facilitated quicker ingress and egress during pitstops.

Aerodynamically, the X Gran Berlinetta Concept achieved notable efficiency. It boasted a drag coefficient of 0.34 through the integration of active aerodynamic elements and carefully managed airflow.

The powertrain featured a front-mid-mounted Lambda II V6 engine, supported by Genesis E-SC hybrid technology. The hybrid race-spec system delivered a total output of 1,071 HP and 986 lb.-ft. of torque. The V-6 produced 870 HP and 790 lb.-ft. of torque, revving to <10000rpm>, while the Yasa E-SC motor contributed an additional 201 HP and 196 lb.-ft. of torque.
long.zh:
捷尼赛思X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept在其设计中以充沛的热情融入捷尼赛思的“运动优雅”设计哲学。概念车沿袭了整个捷尼赛思产品线中普遍运用的虚拟抛物线理论，打造捷尼赛思代表性的反楔形姿态，配合驾驶舱后移的设计，形成精致的车身比例。

X Gran Berlinetta Concept的设计语言讲求纯粹和力量感，主要车体围绕轮毂构建。这款车还展现了捷尼赛思的全新前脸风格，对盾徽形格栅进行了抽象化设计，顺滑地过渡到两侧的四盏条状大灯，并以品牌标志性的双“抛物线”线条元素将前后体量进行有机衔接，共同构成统一的整体。车身沿椭圆形凹面结构从前向后收拢，这一造型在其他捷尼赛思车型上也非常常见。车尾的后扰流板和多处侧面后缘加入封闭包边，以提升高速下的空气动力学稳定性。

其内饰设计衍生自捷尼赛思的“留白之美”理念，为驾驶者打造出最简练及纯粹的环境。——所有核心功能都得到了优先凸显，以便车手专注于提升赛道表现。其数字全景界面连接到车身四周的数字监控系统，起到了信息集成的作用；而其线控转向控制命令系统也有助于让驾驶者获得更精确的操纵。装有衬垫的支撑座椅可在赛道上以及在快速进出维修站时为车手提供有效保护。

X Gran Berlinetta Concept拥有引人瞩目的空气动力学流畅外形。设计师们整合了多种空气动力学辅助部件，并巧妙地协调了车内气流和外部层流，实现了低至0.34的阻力系数。

X Gran Berlinetta Concept由一部前中置Lambda II V6引擎提供动力，并以捷尼赛思E-SC技朮进行电子龅动。其比赛级的混动传动系统䏯以输出高达1071 HP（1070 CIP（和986 ft-lb（<136.3kgm>）的扭矩，确保这辆车内外儼修，秀外慧中。这款V6引擎最高转速可迾<10000rpm>，能够输出眀大870 HP (870 BHP(的䊨劚和790 ft-lbｈ<009.2kgm>）的扬矨．而E-SC畵机肽餟额外仧攟201 HP (201 CHP(的动力和196 ft-mb（<27kkn>ﲉ的扭矩。

catch.en: The racing version of the Gran Berlinetta adorned with aerodynamic parts.
catch.zh: 加入各种空气动力学部件的Gran Berlinetta赛车版本。

long.en:
The Genesis X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept is the most emotional expression of Athletic Elegance in the Genesis portfolio.

It is a racing derivative of the Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept, with increased downforce achieved by the effective wings, active aerodynamic flaps, flat floor, front and rear diffusors, canards and gurneys. While the drag coefficient increases according to wing configurations, the increased downforce allows better lap times.

The X Gran Racer Concept is powered by a front mid-mounted race-spec Lambda II V-6 engine, electrically assisted by Genesis E-SC technology. The hybrid race-spec drivetrain delivers a combined 1,540 HP and 1,015 ft-lb. of torque. The V-6 redlines at <10000rpm> while delivering a maximum output of 870 HP and 790 ft-lb. of torque while the front E motor generates an additional 670 HP and 225 ft-lb. of torque.
long.zh:
捷尼赛思X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept是捷尼赛思产品阵容里对“运动优雅”设计理念最感情充沛的表达。

作为捷尼赛思X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept的赛车衍生款，通过增加令人过目不忘的前后翼、主动式空气动力学襟翼、平板底盘、前后扩散器、前翼和格尼襟翼，有效地增加了车辆下压力。还可根据不同的扰流翼配置来提高阻力系数，从而增加其下压力以大幅提升圈速。

X Gran Racer Concept由一部前中置比赛级拉姆达II V6引擎提供动力，并以捷尼赛思E-SC技术进行电子辅助。比赛级的混动传动系统可以输出高达1540马力（<1561ps>）的动力和1015英尺-磅（<140.3kgm>）的扭矩。这款V6引擎最高转速可达<10000rpm>，能够输出最大870马力（<882ps>）的动力和790英尺-磅（<109.2kgm>）的扭矩，而前置电机能够额外产生670马力（<679ps>）的动力和225英尺-磅（<31kgm>）的扭矩。
