catch.en: This mid-engine sports car made quite the impression on the rally world with its sharp wedge-shaped body.
catch.zh: 这辆中置引擎跑车以其轮廓鲜明的楔形车身在拉力赛中崭露锋芒。

long.en:
At the 1970 Turin Motor Show, Bertone unveiled a striking concept car called the Stratos Zero. With its radical wedge-shaped profile and a front windshield that doubled as the door, the vehicle was conceived purely as a design study. But even then, Bertone described it as a mid-engine concept. Following the show, development began in collaboration with Lancia, which was in search of a new rally car to succeed the Fulvia.

Marcello Gandini was tasked with refining the concept into a production-ready model. Drawing inspiration from the shape of the Stratos Zero, he created an angular body that echoed its otherworldly name: Stratosphere. Thus, the legendary Lancia Stratos was born.

The Stratos featured a robust welded steel monocoque chassis clad in lightweight fiberglass panels. Mounted behind the seats was the same 2.4-liter DOHC V-6 engine found in the Ferrari Dino 246 GT.

Its performance potential was evident in its dimensions: an exceptionally short wheelbase of just <2180 mm> and a wide rear tread of <1457 mm>. This configuration delivered razor-sharp handling and extremely sensitive response. For those who could master its traits, the Stratos offered extraordinary performance that translated into rally dominance, ushering in a golden era for Lancia on the world stage.
long.zh:
在1970年的都灵车展上，博通推出了概念车“Stratos Zero”。车身轮廓完全呈楔形，前档风玻璃化身为车门。这款设计原本只是试水，但博通却表示已经在考虑使用中置引擎布局进行开发了。展会一结束，蓝旗亚就紧锣密鼓地投入到开发中，他们当时正在寻求代替Fulvia参加拉力赛的车型。

马塞罗·甘迪尼出手改进了设计，创造出了可供批量生产的Stratos Zero。充分利用楔形轮廓，为其打造出了与“至尊”称号相称的硬朗外观，蓝旗亚Stratos就此诞生。

Stratos的车体由坚固的焊接钢单体框架和玻璃纤维外板组成。座椅后方的引擎则是一台法拉利Dino 246GT同款的2.4升双顶置凸轮轴V6引擎。

从轴距和胎宽上，就足以体现出这款车卓越的性能：仅有<2180mm>的短轴距和宽达<1457mm>的后胎，带来了极致的过弯能力和难以驾驭的灵敏度。只有拥有极高驾驶技巧的车手才能驾驭得了蓝旗亚Stratos，另一方面，其完美适配拉力赛的优异性能也成就了蓝旗亚在拉力赛中的一段辉煌时刻。

catch.en: This stylish sports coupe attracted plenty of attention with its low nose and short overhang design.~
catch.zh: 这款时尚的双门跑车以其较低的车鼻和紧凑的前后悬间距吸睛无数。

long.en:
Introduced at the 2016 Geneva Auto Show, the LC500 luxury sports coupe represented the first F-segment model for Lexus.

The styling is nearly unchanged from the LF-FC concept vehicle revealed in 2012, which was penned at Lexus’ design studio in California. Its flowing lines and low hood give the LC500 a wind-cutting shape, and it features short front and rear overhangs that allow the engine to be placed aft of the front wheels, giving it a front mid-engine layout.

The LC500 was built on the newly developed GA-L platform. The body is composed of a combination of materials that include carbon fiber, aluminum and steel, which gives the sports coupe a highly-rigid yet lightweight character.

Under the hood is the same 5.0-liter naturally-aspirated V-8 found in the RC F and GS F that produces <477ps> and <55.1kgm> of torque. The engine comes mated to the first direct-shift 10-speed automatic transmission to be equipped on a passenger car.

The LC500 race car dominated its debut appearance in the GT500 class of the Super GT series in 2017, taking 1st to 6th place.
long.zh:
LC500是在2016年日内瓦车展上亮相的豪华跑车。这款车是雷克萨斯的首款F级双门跑车。

LC500的样式几乎与2012年发布的LF-FC概念赛车相同，是雷克萨斯位于加利福利亚的设计工作室的内部开发成果。虽然其流线形双门车身的前鼻很低，但前部和后部的悬垂非常短，得以容纳中置引擎和2+2的座位布局。

这款车的底盘结构是基于丰田新全球架构概念全新开发的GA-L平台。车身是碳纤维、铝材和钢材等多种材料的组合，这些材料被用于多种零件，从而在低重量和高刚度之间取得平衡。

引擎和RC F及GS F所使用的相同，仍采用5升V8自然吸气引擎，可产生<477ps>/<55.1kgm>的动力。搭配此引擎的是首次装备在乘用车上的直接换档式10档自动变速箱。

LC500从2017年开始参加Super GT系列赛的GT500组比赛，并在首次比赛中包揽了一到六名。

catch.en: This ultra high-tech sports car achieved ultimate performance with mass-production quality.
catch.zh: 一辆以量产品质实现了终极性能的极致高科技水平跑车。

long.en:
Twenty years before Japan’s automotive industry was truly recognized by the world, Toyota created a sports car called the 2000GT, which combined the latest technology of the 1960s with a truly revolutionary body design. In the 21st century, Lexus created another cutting-edge sports car that would continue that legacy. It was called the LFA.

Creating such a car was not easy. The goal was to provide stable and consistent quality while incorporating emerging technologies, which included a lightweight carbon-fiber body. For the engineers, it was not enough to simply make another sports car for the masses; they staked the company's reputation to create a car that balanced cutting-edge technology with consistent product quality.

One of the most important factors of a sports car remains the front-to-rear weight distribution ratio; the LFA's was 48 to 52. To achieve this figure, they implemented a transaxle layout and mounted the radiator at the rear. Also, curb weight was kept at <1480kg>. Emphasis was also put on lowering the car's center of gravity, utilizing a dry-sump lubrication system so that the powertrain could be mounted lower.

The LFA's 4.8-liter V-10 had bank angles of 72 degrees with a factory redline of <9500rpm>. Its <560ps> output equated to <117ps> per liter, but what's most impressive was that despite this incredibly high-performance level, the LFA was still relatively environmentally friendly. The transmission came in the form of a 6-speed single-clutch 2-pedal manual that could perform shifts in just 0.2 seconds, a figure on par with the world's top race cars.

Carbon ceramic brake discs were standard fare, with 6-pot calipers in front and 4-pot calipers at rear, all with varying piston sizes.

The LFA ran from zero to <100km/h> in just 3.7 seconds and reached a top speed of <325km/h>. But what really sweetened the car's collectivity factor was that it was produced in a limited run of only 500 cars worldwide.
long.zh:
在日本的汽车行业真正得到全世界认可的20年前，丰田就打造了一款结合了1960年代最尖端科技的跑车，名为2000GT。时间来到21世纪，雷克萨斯接过品牌传承，打造出另一款技术领先的跑车——LFA。

既要整合碳纤维车身等最新研发的技术，又要保证品牌一以贯之的稳定品质，这台车的开发难度不可谓不高。对于雷克萨斯来说，光是将各种部件安装组合在一起是远远不够的，这台新车还需要在尖端科技和一贯的产品品质之间找到平衡点。它代表着雷克萨斯作为一家量产车制造商的门面和荣耀。

配重比是跑车最重要的因素之一，这款车的前后配重比被设计为48比52。为了实现这个参数，雷克萨斯采用了一套驱动桥布局，并将散热器布置在车身后部。车重也被降低到<1480kg>。另外一项设计重点放在降低重心上——通过采用一套干式油底壳润滑系统，得以实现更低的动力系统安装位。

它的4.8升V10引擎采用72度的V型夹角设计，原厂转速红线设在<9500rpm>，而<560ps>总动力输出相当于每升输出<117ps>。不过即便达到这样高的性能水准，这辆车依然比大多数车辆更加环保。其传动装置采用一部双踏板单离合的6速手动变速箱，可以在仅仅0.2秒内完成换挡，这个数据足以与世界最顶级的比赛机器相媲美。

碳化陶瓷刹车碟是LFA的标配，前轮采用6活塞卡钳，而后轮采用4活塞卡钳，而且前后活塞的尺寸略有不同。

LFA能够实现在3.7秒内完成0-<100km/h>加速，极速更是高达<325km/h>。由于这台高性能车全球仅限量生产了500辆，所以相当的罕见。

catch.en: Even beginners can experience dynamic driving performance with a range of electronic aids.
catch.zh: 即便是新手也可以在多种电子辅助设备的帮助下体验到动态的驾驶表现。

long.en:
While German luxury carmakers have traditionally defined the luxury sports coupe market, Lexus decided to join the fray with a svelte version all its own called the RC F. Introduced at the 2014 North American International Auto Show, the RC F is the sportiest entry of the RC line—the letter “F,” which references Fuji Speedway, is added to all of the brand’s high-performance models.

Under the hood is a 5.0-liter V-8, the same powerplant found in the IS F, with new titanium valves, forged connecting rods, newly designed cylinder heads and custom exhaust system. They combine to help the engine produce <456ps>/<53.0kgm>, which is <33ps> and <1.5kgm> more than the IS F. It comes mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission that performs lightning-quick shifts via paddles near the steering wheel.

The Sports Mode of the VDIM, which centrally controls vehicle dynamics, has been refined for the racetrack, and most of the electronic devices have been updated. The RC F features the first torque-vectoring system in the world to be incorporated into a front-engine/rear-wheel drive car. This system allows drivers of all levels to enjoy the RC F’s excellent handling balance and overall performance.

With the exception of the limited-edition LFA supercar, the RC F is the sportiest model to ever come from Lexus.\
long.zh:
RC F是雷克萨斯品牌的高性能双门跑车，发布于2014年的底特律车展。雷克萨斯在他们的高性能车型名称中使用字母“F”进行标识，代表富士赛道。RC F是对2013年东京车展上发布的RC系列双门跑车大幅度升级后的版本。

引擎基于IS F所采用的5升V8引擎，采用新的钛合金气门、锻造连杆和新设计的气缸盖和排气系统。这款车的输出动力可达到<456ps>/<53.0kgm>，相比原款引擎，马力提高了<33ps>，扭矩提高了<1.5kgm>。同时还配备了带换档拨片的8档自动变速箱。

针对赛道驾驶，该车对控制车辆动力的车辆动态综合管理系统的跑车模式进行了进一步优化。这款车的电子设备得到再次更新，配备了世界首个用于前置引擎、后轮驱动车型的扭矩矢量分配系统。这是因为RC F的一个核心设计理念——让车手和新车手都能享受澎湃的跑车驾驶性能所带来的乐趣。

除了LFA之外，RC F是雷克萨斯史上最动感的车型。

catch.en: Emil Frey Racing was one of the first teams to compete with a GT3 version of the Lexus RC F.
catch.zh: Emil Frey Racing车队使用的GT3车型。Emil Frey Racing是最早使用Lexus RC F的车队之一。

long.en:
While Lexus ran an RC F-based race car for the VLN and Super GT Series in 2015, it was allowed to compete with this particular car without

having to adhere to homologation requirements. The RC F GT3 Prototype made its debut in Round 9 of the VLN series and won the SPX class, which allowed specially permitted entries.

This prototype race car was developed with the intent of eventually providing a GT3 machine to race teams around the world. Starting out as an RC F, the entire car was altered dramatically to ensure competitiveness and reliability in GT3 races. Weight was significantly reduced and the body drastically stiffened; the front and rear fenders were swapped to improve aerodynamics; and power from the 5.0-liter V-8 engine was increased to <540ps>. Ultimately, the car was homologated and introduced as the Lexus RC F GT3 in 2017.

The following year, the new race car was delivered to Emil Frey Racing in Switzerland, which took part in the development of the RC F GT3. Participating in the GT Open Championship of Europe, the team won four of 14 races and placed 3rd for the season.
long.zh:
自2015年起，雷克萨斯使用一台基于RC F改装的赛车参加了VLN系列赛和超级跑车系列赛，但这辆车是没有经过认证的特许车辆。凭借这些经验，雷克萨斯继续研发了RC F GT3原型车，并将其用于2016年秋季VLN系列赛的第9轮比赛。在这场比赛中，他们成功赢得了特许车辆的SPX类别冠军。

原型车的最终开发目标是为GT3车队提供一款超级跑车，并以此参加世界各地的比赛。因此，这款车需要让业余车手也能驾驭，并能通过强化部件来提供可靠的性能。在对每一个组件的耐久性进行彻底的计算后，车辆设计进行了全面改动，在保证刚度的前提下减轻了重量，包括前后挡泥板等设计修改则进一步提升了车辆的空气动力学性能。量产版的5升双顶置凸轮轴V8引擎经过调试后，马力超过了<540ps>。这款车最终在2017年通过认证并以雷克萨斯RC F GT3的名称登场。

同年晚些时候，同属于RC F GT3开发团队的瑞士埃米尔弗雷车队也使用此车参加了欧洲GT公开锦标赛，在14场比赛中夺得4场冠军，在赛季车队排行榜上位列第三名。/

catch.en: This highly refined Lexus RC F coupe competed in the 2016 VLN as a GT3 race car.+
catch.zh: 参与过2016 VLN赛事的Lexus RC F GT3。

long.en:
When Lexus introduced the RC luxury sports coupe in 2014, it also included a high-performance version in the lineup called the RC F, which served as the foundation for the RC F GT3 race car.

Created to compete in GT3 races around the world, the RC F GT3 was developed at the same time as the production RC F. The original V-8 engine was converted to have a dry sump lubrication system, and displacement was increased to 5.4 liters. Mated to a 6-speed sequential gearbox, the race engine produced <500ps>. Although it looks larger than the production car because of its wider fenders, the RC F GT3 tipped the scales at a lean <1300kg>.

Starting in the 2017 season, the RC F GT3 waged battle in the American IMSA series (GTD category), the European International GT Open series, and the Japanese Super GT series (GT300 class), where it performed admirably.

In the International GT race at Silverstone, the RC F GT3 grabbed its first victory. Then in Japan, it won for the first time in the Super GT series, taking the checkered flag in the second-round race at the Fuji Speedway.

The RC F GT3 prototype represented here is a car that was built for performance evaluation before the RC F GT3 acquired homologation. This car won the ninth race of the VLN (Nürburgring Endurance Series) on October 8, 2016, running without a paint job and its carbon-fiber body fully exposed. The car here, though, wears the livery of Emil Frey Racing, a top Swiss team that competes in the International GT Open.
long.zh:
RC F是雷克萨斯2014年发布的RC豪华双门跑车产品线中的高性能车型。雷克萨斯根据这一车型开发了竞赛车型RC F GT3，用于参加在世界各地所举行的GT3类别的知名赛事。

RC F GT3的立项在这款公路量产车型的开发阶段就已经开始，并与这款公路跑车同步进行开发。竞赛车型将标准款RC F的V8引擎驱动改为了干式油底壳润滑系统，排量也增加到了5.4升，同时采用了6档序列变速箱，最大输出功率达到<500ps>。由于使用了大直径的光面轮胎，所以这辆车还配备了挡泥板，并且尽可能地减轻重量，将整车重量降至<1300kg>。

从2017赛季开始，RC F GT3参加了美国国际汽车运动协会系列赛（GTD类别）、欧洲国际GT公开系列赛以及日本超级跑车（GT300组）赛事，并取得了不俗的成绩。

在国际GT公开系列赛中，这辆车参加的第二场比赛就在银石赛道斩获首胜；在日本，这辆车首次在超级跑车于富士赛道举行的第二轮比赛中获胜。

这里展示的RC F GT3原型车是RC F GT3在获得认证之前，为了评估性能而制造的车型。这辆车于2016年10月8日赢得了纽博格林耐力系列赛的第九轮比赛。当时参赛时，这辆车尚未涂装完毕，碳纤维的表面完全暴露在外。但在这里，车身使用了埃米尔弗雷车队的涂装，埃米尔弗雷车队是一支在国际GT公开赛中参赛的顶尖瑞士车队。

cars.nameZh: 雷克萨斯RC F GT3原型'16

catch.en: This Toyota/Lexus race car competed under joint regulations between the Super GT Series and DTM.
catch.zh: 这款Toyota/Lexus Super GT赛车同样参加了德国房车大师赛。

long.en:
Toyota's weapon of choice for the GT500 class of the Super GT Series from 2014 to 2016 was the race version of the Lexus RC F production car, which was released in October 2014.

Because of new regulations from 2014, the car underwent a several changes to conform to the new rules. The weight and rigidity of the monocoque and center of gravity were altered, while new dampers, brakes and a rear wing were added, making it look like a true DTM machine. Powering the car was a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 with direct injection (called the RI4AG), which also saw use in Super Formula cars. Because of of a new regulation that limited fuel flow from <100kg/h> to <95kg/h>, improvements were made elsewhere so the car could produce more power with less fuel.

The 2016 model was the final version of this RC F race car, with the au TOM’S RC F wearing the ace car number 36. It placed 3rd in the third race of the season and 2nd in Round 6, ultimately finishing 5th overall out of 15 cars.
long.zh:
代表丰田/雷克萨斯在2014至2016赛季的Super GT系列赛中赢得GT500级别冠军的是雷克萨斯RC F，原型来自2014年上市的量产车。

由于2014年颁布新规定，车辆的单体车壳重量、刚度及重心都接受了调整，以符合德国房车大师赛的规定。避震器、刹车和尾翼也改为符合德国房车大师赛规定的版本。受到新规定的限制，RC F外廓的车身上半部分无法改动，因此只能对下半部分进行重新设计以提高下压力。动力单元是一款2升涡轮增压直列式4缸直喷引擎：RI4AG引擎。这款与Super方程式完全共享的引擎已针对Super GT赛事的使用进行了专项调校。

2016的车型是这款车的最终版本。由于规则限制日益增多，燃油限制器的流量由<100kg/h>降低到了<95kg/h>，车辆接受了进一步改装，以便利用更少的燃料来产生更大的马力。同时还进行了多项其他改进。

雷克萨斯TOM’S车队的36号au TOM’S RC F在第6轮中取得了第2名，在第3轮中则取得了第3名，总成绩位列15辆参赛车辆中的第5位。

catch.en: This version of the highly refined Lexus RC F production coupe was modified for Gr.4.
catch.zh: 一款广受好评的Lexus RC F，专为Gr.4而改装。

long.en:
While German luxury carmakers have traditionally defined the luxury sports coupe market, Lexus decided to join the fray with a svelte version all its own called the RC F. Introduced at the 2014 North American International Auto Show, the RC F is the sportiest entry of the RC line—the letter “F,” which references Fuji Speedway, is added to all of the brand’s high-performance models.

Under the hood is a 5.0-liter V-8, the same powerplant found in the IS F, with new titanium valves, forged connecting rods, newly designed cylinder heads and custom exhaust system. They combine to help the engine produce <456ps>/<53.0kgm>, which is <33ps> and <1.5kgm> more than the IS F. It comes mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission that performs lightning-quick shifts via paddles near the steering wheel.

The Sports Mode of the VDIM, which centrally controls vehicle dynamics, has been refined for the racetrack, and most of the electronic devices have been updated. The RC F features the first torque-vectoring system in the world to be incorporated into a front-engine/rear-wheel drive car. This system allows drivers of all levels to enjoy the RC F’s excellent handling balance and overall performance.

While the RC F’s appearance is similar to that of the base model, Lexus designers incorporated subtle-yet-functional details that help improve performance. These include air outlets on the engine hood and at the rear end of the front fenders. On the trunk is a variable rear spoiler that changes angles automatically according to speed.

With the exception of the limited-edition LFA supercar, the RC F is the sportiest model to ever come from Lexus.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
long.zh:
RC F是雷克萨斯品牌的高性能双门跑车，发布于2014年的底特律车展。

雷克萨斯在他们的高性能车型名称中使用字母“F”进行标识，代表富士赛道。RC F是对2013年东京车展上发布的RC系列双门跑车大幅度升级后的版本。

引擎基于IS F所采用的5升V8引擎，采用新的钛合金气门、锻造连杆和新设计的气缸盖和排气系统。这款车的输出动力可达到<456ps>/<53.0kgm>，相比原款引擎，马力提高了<33ps>，扭矩提高了<1.5kgm>。同时还配备了带换档拨片的8档自动变速箱。

针对赛道驾驶，该车对控制车辆动力的车辆动态综合管理系统的跑车模式进行了进一步优化。这款车的电子设备得到再次更新，配备了世界首个用于前置引擎、后轮驱动车型的扭矩矢量分配系统。这是因为RC F的一个核心设计理念——让车手和新车手都能享受澎湃的跑车驾驶性能所带来的乐趣。

在外形方面，RC F的轮廓与标准的RC车型相同，但在某些细节上更具视觉冲击力，例如引擎盖和前挡泥板后端的排气口。在车身主体上有一个可调节的后扰流板，能够根据车速自动改变角度。

除了LFA之外，RC F是雷克萨斯史上最动感的车型。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

catch.en: Won the Super GT team title with its stable performance on high-speed circuits.
catch.zh: 在高速赛道上的稳定发挥帮助车队赢下了Super GT组别的桂冠。

long.en:
In 2008, the Nissan GT-R made its heralded return to the Super GT Series in Japan. As the GT-R made the headlines, Lexus was quietly making significant improvements to its entry in Japan's most popular racing series, the SC430.

The SC430 did not fare well in the Super GT series the previous year, as it was aerodynamically inferior to the competition, the result of a compact body with front and rear overhangs that were too short to provide acceptable levels of downforce. However for 2008, Lexus lengthened the overhangs, giving the car much improved aerodynamics than the previous year. The result was a sleek, fast race car that flourished on high-speed race tracks.

Despite winning only one race during the entire season (at the Fuji International Speedway) by the ZENT CERUMO team, the Lexus SC430 GT machine took home the overall championship, thanks to the consistency of the Petronas TOM's team. The combination of a good long-term strategy and a reliable, fast car proved to be the right formula in winning the series title that year.!
long.zh:
2008年是日本Super GT赛事的一场盛会，日产赶在公开赛事首轮前，帮助日产GT-R全面回归，重返赛场。赛事期间，雷克萨斯仍在继续钻研如何提升SC430。

相比其他参赛车辆，最初的SC430存在一项巨大的缺陷。在超级跑车车辆中，安装于车身底板前后轴的空气动力学套件需要有效产生足够的下压力，而原版SC430相对较短的前后悬间距不足以提供足够的空力效果。

在前几个赛季，SC430的速度表现都不尽如人意。到了2008赛季，在加大了前后悬间距，获得了与对手相当的下压力后，紧凑车身的更小风阻成为了他们的优势。整个赛季当中，他们在多条高速赛道上展现出非凡的速度。

尽管只由森特塞鲁莫车队在富士赛道上取得一胜，但同样使用SC430的马石油汤姆车队最终赢得了当年的车队冠军，并将这台车的高水准研发和稳定的速度留在了赛车历史的史册中。

catch.en: Mazda's dream rotary race car.
catch.zh: Mazda的梦幻转子引擎赛车。

long.en:
The MAZDA RX-VISION is a concept car introduced at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show. Based on Mazda’s "KODO - Soul of Motion" design theme, the car represented Mazda's attempt to create the most beautiful FR sports car in the company's history. It came powered by the next-generation rotary engine called "SKYACTIV-R."

Back in 1967, Mazda overcame numerous obstacles to produce the first commercial rotary engine in history. It powered the Cosmo Sport and then was fitted to a number of other Mazda cars, including the RX-7, and even those that raced. In 1991, the four-rotor Mazda 787B became the first Japanese car to win the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The MAZDA RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT expresses the design beauty of form following function in a race machine. To meet the performance requirements of the Gr.3 category, the design was inspired by the 787B, specifically the 4-rotor powerplant, now equipped with SKYACTIV technology. This new rotary engine was mounted in a lightweight body to achieve unprecedented performance.
long.zh:
马自达RX-VISION在2015东京车展上以概念车的身份亮相。这台基于马自达的“魂动”设计主题打造的新车旨在挑战自我，创造出最美前置后驱跑车。它还搭载了下一代的转子引擎“创驰蓝天-R”——代表马自达对未来的憧憬。

时间回到1967年，马自达克服了重重技术难关，推出搭载了商用转子引擎的Cosmo Sport。在那之后，作为唯一能够批量生产转子引擎的制造商，他们持之以恒地改进引擎的动力、燃油消耗和耐久性，甚至凭借787B引擎拿下了1991年勒芒24小时耐力赛的最终胜利。

马自达RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT在维持原型车设计美学的基础上，展现了更加凶悍的赛车外观。为了配合组别3级别赛事的性能标准，该车借鉴了787B引擎的设计理念，并采用了经创驰蓝天技术改良的四转子引擎。这款全新的转子引擎搭配轻量化车身，带来空前的性能体验。"

catch.en: With only 200 units ever produced, this is the ultimate works-tuned roadster.!
catch.zh: 这是一台经过官方调校的终极敞篷跑车，全球限量仅200台。

long.en:
“MAZDA SPIRIT RACING” was an initiative launched by Mazda to cement the company’s place in motorsports and to cultivate new talent through racing. Competing in events such as the Super Endurance Series with a large crew made up of Mazda employees, it grew into a formidable presence in the sport.

From this foundation, the team created a car that embodied the skills and knowledge it had gained through years of competition. That car was unveiled as the “MAZDA SPIRIT RACING ROADSTER 12R” in early 2025 at the Tokyo Auto Salon.

As its name suggested, it was based on the ND Mazda Roadster. But beneath the familiar silhouette, it was packed with works-grade components.

The centerpiece was its engine, built on a 2.0-liter block not normally offered in the domestic soft-top model, enhanced with a specially tuned head, pistons, and exhaust manifold among other components, each unit painstakingly assembled by hand. The power had been pushed close to the very limit of what was achievable in a production car that also demanded durability, ultimately delivering <200ps>.

Its chassis reflected the lessons learned from the Super Endurance Series. Among them was the suspension that used height-adjustable Bilstein dampers, while the brakes were equipped with 4-piston calipers from Brembo. It featured forged Rays wheels, identical to those used on race cars.

Other special parts included Recaro seats and a Fujitsubo exhaust system. With production capped at just 200 units, the ROADSTER 12R stood as perhaps the ultimate works-tuned roadster._
long.zh:
“马自达灵魂车队”是马自达为确立品牌在赛车领域的地位，并通过赛车培养新兴人才的一个项目。通过组织公司员工组成庞大的团队参加如超级耐力锦标赛等赛事，马自达灵魂车队逐渐成长为赛车界不容忽视的存在。

团队将把在赛车中积累的所有技能与知识，融入到一款全新车型的设计之中。这款“马自达灵魂车队ROADSTER 12R”于2025年初在东京汽车沙龙迎来首秀。

顾名思义，这台车基于ND Mazda Roadster打造而成。可以说，这辆车满载了官方车队使用的各类部件的精华。

其核心亮点在于引擎：采用了日本国内市场敞篷版车型鲜少配备的2升缸体，并增配了专门调校的气缸盖、活塞及排气歧管等部件，且每台引擎均采用手工组装。在确保部件耐受性的前提下，这款量产车的功率输出已逼近理论极限，最终达到<200ps>。

底盘设计充分参考了车队在超级耐力锦标赛中汲取的丰富经验。例如，悬挂采用了倍适登特别调校的可调高度减震器，刹车则是一套布雷博四活塞卡钳。莱耶斯锻造轮毂与赛车同款。

其他特殊零部件更是不胜枚举，如瑞卡罗桶椅和藤壶排气。该车限量生产200台，堪称是一台经过官方调校的终极敞篷跑车。

catch.en: Exploring the potential of internal combustion, a next-generation bio-diesel-powered race car.
catch.zh: 下一代生物燃料赛车，继续发掘内燃机的潜力。

long.en:
This MAZDA3 Gr. 4, featured here, is a Gran Turismo original model, aesthetically based on the Super Taikyu spec. MAZDA3 Bio concept.

The MAZDA3 Bio concept car is a next-generation, bio-diesel-powered race car, created for real-world testing in the 2023 Super Taikyu endurance race series.

It is the spiritual successor to Mazda’s Bio concept Demio, also known as the MAZDA2 Bio concept, which was created in 2021 with the dual pursuit of achieving carbon neutrality and preserving the joy of driving. Both vehicles participated in the ST-Q class, a category almost exclusively reserved for manufacturer development prototypes.

The car ran on 100-percent next-generation bio-diesel fuel refined from used cooking oil. Under the hood was a 2.2-liter SkyActiv-D diesel engine.

The car itself went through extensive modifications. To reduce weight, components such as the engine hood and roof were crafted from hybrid materials that combine carbon fiber reinforced plastic (CFRP) with natural fibers. Aerodynamic efficiency was enhanced through wider front and rear fenders, while new aero components, including a front spoiler, rear wing, and side skirts, were added to further optimize performance.
long.zh:
这款马自达3组别4赛车，如图所示，是跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，其外观借鉴了日本超级耐力赛规格的马自达3 Bio赛车。

其原型车马自达3 Bio concept是新一代采用生物柴油供能的赛车，该项目的立项与开发是为了实际参与2023年的日本超级耐力赛。

它也是马自达Bio concept Demio/马自达2 Bio concept概念车的后继者。两台生物柴油概念车自2021年起便开始参加超级耐力赛ST-Q组别（专为各家厂商的技术开发中车型设置）的比赛，意图在“碳中和”以及“提升娱乐性”中寻找到恰到好处的平衡点。

该车使用的生物柴油完全由废弃食用油制备。车型搭载的是一台2.2L 创驰蓝天-D引擎。

作为赛车，改装自然必不可少。为了减重，引擎盖和车顶等部位均应用了由碳纤维复合材料和天然纤维打造的复合型材料。而为了提高空气动力学性能，车身的前后轮挡泥板都相应加宽，并装上了前扰流板、尾翼和侧裙。

catch.en: An elegant fastback with a revolutionary combustion system.
catch.zh: 采用了革命性的新引擎、外观优雅的斜背车。

long.en:
This MAZDA3 represents the fourth-generation model of Mazda's C-segment passenger car first released in November 2018. Back then, it was called the Axela in Japan, but with this model, it went by the moniker "MAZDA3" all around the world.

Like its predecessor, this MAZDA3 came in both fastback and sedan versions, but thanks to the company's "KODO" design language, the character of the car became more refined. The shape of the fastback was especially impressive, with the delicate form of the body panels beautifully expressing the subtle transition of light.

Powering the car was a new SKYACTIV engine. The base MAZDA3 models came with a 1.5-liter and 2.0-liter direct injection gasoline engines. There was a 1.8-liter turbo diesel powerplant and a 2.0-liter "Mild-Hybrid" (M-Hybrid) version that came a little later. The M-Hybrid was powered by the SKYACTIV-X engine that introduced proprietary spark-controlled compression ignition, a revolutionary technology that suppressed carbon emissions without relying on expensive solutions like the Urea-SCR.

The X Burgundy Selection was a special model with a burgundy interior on the Grade X model. Equipped with wine-colored leather seats and dashboard, this special model exuded a classy, uniquely mature aura.
long.zh:
马自达3于2018年11月上市，是马自达推出的第四代C级乘用车，其前代型号在日本也被称为昂克赛拉。这辆第四代型号是马自达全新一代产品中的第一款车，因此在全球范围内统一使用了“马自达3”的名字。

如之前型号一样，它也提供斜背和轿车两种车型，不过在马自达“魂动”设计语言的加持下，每种车型的特征都更加鲜明。它的斜背车型尤为引人注目，车身板件的精妙轮廓反映出了美轮美奂的光线变幻。

为这辆车提供动力的引擎源自马自达的新一代创驰蓝天引擎。主力型号包括1.5升和2升直喷汽油引擎款和1.8升柴油涡轮增压引擎款，之后又推出了一款2升“轻度混合动力”（M-Hybrid）型号，由一台创驰蓝天-X引擎供能。这款引擎引入了独家专利的火花控制压缩点火技术，而且这款革命性的引擎无需采用像Urea-SCR那样昂贵的解决方案便能够抑制氮氧化合物（NOx）输出。

这辆X Burgundy Selection是一款基于Grade X型号、采用了勃艮第红配色内饰的特殊型号。它的酒红色真皮座椅和仪表板彰显出了优雅的格调和成熟的韵味。

catch.en: A race spec Clubman able to reach 0-<100km/h> in just 3.5 seconds, with a top speed of <290km/h>.
catch.zh: 竞赛配置的Clubman，从0到100 公里/小时加速仅需3.5秒，最高时速可达290 公里/小时。

long.en:
The MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo, created from the inspiration of the MINI's success in motorsports, was designed strictly for the track. It's powered by a <395ps> engine that sends this <1050kg> vehicle from zero to <100km/h> in a mere 3.5 seconds. Top speed is rated at <290km/h>, with the right gear ratios. Power is transferred to all four wheels via a 6-speed sequential race gearbox. The suspension system consists of McPherson struts in the front and HA3 dampers at the rear, all of which are fully adjustable and ensure excellent cornering ability.

The MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo sits low to the ground, with the wheels positioned outside the body, resulting in go-kart-like agility. Adjustable carbon diffusers are placed in the front and rear, while large vents behind the wheel arches regulate air flow to cool the engine and brakes. The split rear spoiler and fully enclosed underbody enhance the sophisticated aerodynamics.

The car MINI design has familiar touches, such as the hexagonal front grille, elliptical headlights with implied racing-design stickers, and rally stripes on the hood and roof. Quick release hinges on the hood and tank and the small sliding window on the side reveal that this is not your oridinary performance car.
long.zh:
在MINI的传奇赛车运动历史的启发下，MINI的设计团队打造了全新的MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo：一款为竞赛而生的MINI精品。MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo的轻量级车身仅重<1050kg>，高达<395ps>的动力可以在3.5秒内完成0到<100km/h>加速。全时四驱和竞赛级6档序列式变速箱确保该车的最佳动力传动。前轮的麦弗逊减震器和后轮的HA3减震器有多档可调，能完美适应任何路况。根据齿轮传动比（根据每条赛道特别调校）而定，Clubman最高可以达到<290km/h>的时速。

MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo那充满个性的轮廓在路面上驰骋，四个车轮置于车身外远端，让车辆的操控像卡丁车一般。车身前部和后部的可调式碳纤维扰流翼和轮拱后方的大型通风口可以控制气流，为引擎和制动器提供冷却。而其后扰流板和全封闭的底部也加强了车身的空气动力学性能。

这款MINI的设计特点，例如扁平六边形的前进气格栅，装饰有含蓄赛车风格贴纸的椭圆形大灯，以及引擎盖上的拉力条纹都清晰地表现了MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo的赛车运动设计思路。引擎盖、油箱和侧窗上的快开铰链更是为MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo的经典外形加上了画龙点睛的一笔。

catch.en: This hopped-up MINI Cooper S featured a supercharged engine.
catch.zh: MINI的热门车型，配备了机械增压引擎。

long.en:
In the latter half of the 1990s, famed sports car manufacturer BMW purchased the branding and manufacturing rights to the MINI brand and resurrected the MINI Cooper in 2001.

This new MINI was a bit larger than the classic model of yesteryear, measuring <3655mm>, <1690mm> and <1455mm>, overall length, width and height, respectively. But BMW kept the car's spirit intact, thanks to quirky styling cues that were reminiscent of the original 1959 model. These included a "cute" face, highlighted by large round headlights and a square front grille and boxy silhouette.

The performance-oriented version in the new MINI lineup was the Cooper S. The power plant in the standard MINI was the "Pentagon," a 1.6-liter SOHC inline-4 developed in cooperation between BMW and Chrysler, while the Cooper S got an intercooled supercharger bolted on to its power plant—the large air intake on the model's hood being a dead giveaway of forced induction.

The supercharger accounted for an additional <54ps> and <7.26kgm> of torque over the stock engine, for a grand total of <170ps> and <22.45kgm>. It came mated to a slick-shifting 6-speed manual gearbox. This made the Cooper S one of the most fun to drive FF (Front drive, Front engine) compact cars in the marketplace.

It was a testament to the German company that effectively instilled the car's British heritage into the new MINI Cooper.
long.zh:
在90年代后半段，宝马收购了MINI的品牌使用权和制造权。待到2001年，一款全新的MINI诞生了。

归入宝马旗下的新MINI长<3655mm>、宽<1690mm>、高<1495mm>，车身比原来的MINI足足大了两倍。无论是更大尺寸的头灯、特色鲜明的前格栅，还是拱起的车轮罩等元素，无不体现出对1959年原型车款的致敬和传承，一眼便能认出是MINI的正统继承者。

新MINI系列最热销的车型当属Cooper S。MINI的动力核心是一台1.6升顶置单凸轮轴Pentagon直列4缸引擎，由宝马和克莱斯勒共同研发。而Cooper S车型还加装了中冷机械增压，看到它引擎盖上巨大的进气口便不难猜到。机械增压为Cooper S额外带来了<54ps>和<7.26kgm>扭矩，总计可输出<170ps>和<22.45kgm>扭矩，再搭配上特制的6速手动变速箱，这台小车满载着驾驶的乐趣。

catch.en: A beautiful streamlined 2-seat sports car that won the Gran Turismo Trophy
catch.zh: 一辆绝美的流线型双座跑车，曾赢得过Gran Turismo奖杯

long.en:
Every August in the U.S., the world’s most stunning automobiles from across automotive history gather for the prestigious Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance. In 2014, the Gran Turismo Trophy—just one of the many coveted awards—was claimed by this Maserati A6GCS/53 Spyder, chassis No. 2078.

The A6 nameplate referred to a series of 6-cylinder race cars Maserati developed between 1947 and 1956. The GCS variant was built for sports car championship competition and initially took the form of a two-seat version of the classic cigar-shaped Grand Prix racers. But in 1953, following a shift in regulations, coachbuilders began to craft their own bodies for the car’s tubular frame.

Chassis No. 2078 was one such creation, graced with an elegant Spyder body penned by Carrozzeria Fantuzzi. Its <170ps> engine came from none other than Gioachino Colombo. During the 1954 season, this car competed as part of the Maserati works team, racking up five class wins and three overall victories.
long.zh:
每年八月，世界汽车史上最优美的车辆都会齐聚美国，参加举世闻名的圆石滩经典车展。车展中会颁出诸多奖项，超级跑车奖杯就是其中之一。2014年的获奖者就是这辆玛莎拉蒂A6GCS/53 Spyder，底盘号2078。

A6是玛莎拉蒂在1947到1956年期间开发的6缸赛车系列的代号。这款GCS原本是用于参加运动赛车赛事的，所以最初的外形设计类似于大奖赛赛车的经典雪茄型，但改成了双座版本。不过由于1953年的赛事规则变化，各家车厂纷纷开始改用管式框架打造赛车。

这辆底盘号2078的玛莎拉蒂采用了由凡图奇车身制造公司打造的优雅敞篷车身。其<170ps>的引擎则由乔亚基诺·科伦坡打造。这辆车代表玛莎拉蒂厂队出战了1954赛季，总共拿下了6个组别冠军和3次总成绩第一。

catch.en: True to its Italian heritage, this grand tourer was defined by class, performance and elegance.
catch.zh: 传统杰作，强大的赛车性能隐藏在并不明显的外观之下。

long.en:
Maserati's GranTurismo S, not to be confused with this driving simulator of the same name, was unveiled at the 2008 Geneva Motor Show as the high-performance version of Maserati's handsome GranTurismo Coupe.

Although there wasn't much that visually separated the two cars, there were significant differences under the sheet metal; the most noteworthy of which being the drivetrain. For starters, the displacement of the DOHC V8 in the GranTurismo S was increased to <4691cc>, <500cc> more than in the base car. Combined with this revitalized engine was a state-of-the-art semi-automatic gearbox dubbed "MC Shift." MC Shift allowed drivers the choice between a smooth-shifting automatic transmission befitting a pure luxury car and a quick-shifting sequential manual where shifting is performed via paddles on the steering wheel.

And because it was a transaxle (with the gearbox mounted on the rear differential), the front/rear weight distribution was drastically improved, making the GranTurismo S a better handling machine.

Despite the two cars looking virtually identical, the GranTurismo S possessed a more athletic nature than the base car, while still delivering the luxury and elegance that has made the marque famous for nearly 100 years.
long.zh:
在2008年日内瓦车展官宣的跑车浪漫旅S是玛莎拉蒂伟大旅行的高性能版本。与标准版本相比，最大的两处差异在于专属引擎的引入和传动系统的改变。

跑车浪漫旅S的双顶置凸轮轴V8引擎排量高达<4691cc>，比标准车款高出<500cc>之多。双踏板半自动变速箱“MC Shift”也是首次用于该系列。相较而言，最让人动容的当属传动系统的改变，驱动桥的布局改头换面，变速箱后移与后限滑差速器整合在了一起。除此之外，这款车型以赛车为标准打造，因此前后车身配重也与标准版本截然不同。

外观方面，跑车浪漫旅S的唯二不同落在大一寸的轮毂和熏黑头灯上，内饰方面则延续了玛莎拉蒂品牌一贯的优良传统。当超高品质的GT车型遇上极致赛车性能，跑车浪漫旅S让全世界的爱车人士都对它心驰神往。

catch.en: A special super car that embodies the tradition and passion of Maserati.
catch.zh: 一台承载了Maserati决心与激情的极致超级跑车。

long.en:
The MC20 is a mid-engine supercar introduced by Maserati in 2020. The Italian company is widely known for its elegant and masterfully constructed high-performance GT cars. The MC20 is the first mid-engine model in the company's road car lineup since the discontinuation of the MC12 in 2005.

With its scissor-type doors, the body is elegant and clean. It's seemingly devoid of aggressive aerodynamic add-ons, such as a large rear wing or a radical front splitter, but that is because this car doesn't need them. Developed by race-car constructor Dallara, this Maserati body underwent rigorous wind-tunnel testing from the beginning, so the use of overt downforce-induing parts was not necessary.

At its foundation is a carbon monocoque that apparently weighs as little as <100kg>. Keeping the car lightweight was a priority for Maserati, and the engineers were able to keep curb weight down to less than <1500kg>.

The newly developed twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 engine features the first F1-style pre-chamber combustion system used in a production car. It produces <630ps> and 730 Nm (<74.5kgm>) torque. Combined with an 8-speed DCT transmission, the MC20 can accelerate from 0 to <100km/h> in under 2.9 seconds and reach a top speed of more than <325km/h>.
long.zh:
MC20是玛莎拉蒂在2020年宣布推出的一款中置引擎超级跑车。提起玛莎拉蒂，首先让人想起的便是其在前置及后置引擎高性能GT跑车上炉火纯青且不失优雅的工艺。而MC20则是该厂自2005年MC12停产后15年来推出的第一辆中置引擎公路跑车。

乍一看，这辆有着蝶翼门的跑车似乎并没有任何明显的空气动力学套件，这是因为它那由跑车制造商达拉拉借助严谨的风洞测试设计制造出的外壳，巧妙的造型已经能够在不借助任何诸如扰流板的空气动力学组件的情况下，就产生足够的下压力。

该车采用了碳纤维单体车壳结构，外壳自重仅<100kg>。另外，在整车的各个区域都应用了轻量化措施，将整车总重降到了<1500kg>以下。

玛莎拉蒂最新研发的3升、V6双涡轮增压引擎使得MC20成为了第一台应用了F1式预燃室技术的量产车型。这台引擎可以提供最高<630ps>的动力与730 牛·米（<74.5kgm>）的扭矩。结合其8速双离合变速箱，MC20可以在短短2.9秒内完成0-<100km/h>加速，且据称最高速度可达超过<325km/h>。

catch.en: This high-output model of the Merak has been tuned for even sharper performance.+
catch.zh: Merak的这款高动力车型经过调校后，性能更加犀利。

long.en:
The Maserati Merak, a mid-engine sports car introduced in 1972, was developed as a sister model to the Bora that came out the previous year. Both vehicles shared the same basic exterior styling, penned by renown designer Giugiaro; however, the rear ends were noticeably different, as the Bora was a fastback, while the Merak was a notchback with a fastback-style pillar.

The engines of the two cars were also different. Where the Bora had a rumbling V-8 in its engine bay, the Merak featured a <190ps> 3.0-liter V-6 borrowed from the Citroën SM, thus allowing the Merak to adopt a 2+2 layout and boast more luggage space.

In 1975, a high-performance version of the Merak was offered, called the Merak SS, which came equipped with a <220ps> engine that increased the car's top speed from <225km/h> to <250km/h>.
long.zh:
玛莎拉蒂Merak是1972年推出的一款中置引擎跑车。此车是作为一年前亮相的博拉的姐妹车型而开发的。

该车的车身也是由乔治亚罗设计的。所以外观风格与博拉一脉相承。不过，博拉是一款溜背车，而Merak却是一款带有溜背车后柱的掀背车款。这也使得此车能够在保留相同外轮廓的同时，给人以更轻盈的感受。引擎冷却有所改善。

博拉采用的是一台V8引擎，而为Merak配备的是来自雪铁龙SM的3升V6引擎，可以带来<190ps>。搭载了这台更紧凑的引擎，座位布局也相应变为2+2，从而为行李厢腾出了空间。

在1975年，高性能版本的Merak SS面世了。压缩比优化及其他调整将引擎的动力输出提高到了<220ps>，而极速也从<225km/h>提高到<250km/h>。

catch.en: The legendary Mazda 787B was the first Japanese-manufactured race car to win the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
catch.zh: 帮助Mazda成为首家赢得勒芒大赛的日本生产商，成就一代传奇。

long.en:
Mazda's rotary-engine race cars were a familiar sight at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in the mid-seventies and throughout the eighties, but it would be 18 years after its first race at the Sarthe Circuit when the car company from Hiroshima would make history.

It all began with the development of the 787, which was powered by the R26B, a 4-rotor Wankel engine that produced <700ps>. To match this power, the car's frame was changed from a conventional aluminum honeycomb composite to a carbon-fiber, which resulted in a light, rigid body structure. The 787 made its debut at the 1990 24 Hours of Le Mans, but mechanical problems forced it to retire from the race early. Mazda came back the following year with an improved version of the race car called the 787B.

The 1991 24 Hours of Le Mans fielded one of the most competitive grids in the history of the event with an all-out effort by Peugeot, as well as strong entries from Mercedes-Benz, Jaguar and Porsche. Two Mazda 787Bs were entered, with the No. 55 car, driven by Bertrand Gachot, Johnny Herbert and Volker Weidler, starting in the 19th position. Once the contest started, the Mazda race car gradually worked its way up the leader board, taking the overall lead just three hours before the end of the race. It managed to hang on to claim the checker, completing 362 laps, which beat the previous year's record. The win marked the first and still the only Japanese race team to win the overall title at Le Mans.
long.zh:
马自达自1974年起开始参加勒芒24小时耐力赛，并凭借他们的转子发动机获得了相当出色的战绩。但由于禁止使用转子发动机的技术规范即将到来，留给马自达的时间便不多了。这便是787投入研发的时代背景。

787配备了一台型号为R26B的四转子发动机，最大动力输出为<700ps>。为了承受如此强大的动力，车身框架从传统的铝制蜂窝结构变为了碳纤维复合材质，在降低重量的同时提高了刚性。车身的宽度被缩减以降低空气阻力，前鼻处安装了一个尺寸较大的散热装置。

787于1990年的勒芒24小时耐力赛首次登场，但由于遇到多个技术问题，而遭到了出人意料的失败。马自达很快从这令人失望的结果中走出，全面改进了787，将新款787B带到了下一年的勒芒。

这一年，标致携倾尽全力开发的905加入赛事，老牌劲旅梅赛德斯·奔驰、捷豹与保时捷的存在也意味着这将是一场艰苦的比赛。在参赛的两辆787中，由伯特兰·加丘、乔尼·赫伯特和沃克尔·魏德勒驾驶的55号车从19位出发，不断超越，在距离比赛结束仅有三小时的时候攀至第一。

这辆787B最终顺利完赛，在飞驰了362圈之后成功冲线，并且打破了上一年的纪录。马自达在参赛的第18个年头终于赢得了这场伟大的胜利，这是日本车厂在勒芒史上首次获胜。

catch.en: The third-generation Mazda6 featured a curvaceous body style and SkyActiv technology.
catch.zh: 这款第3代Atenza赛车因其优美的车身线条和SkyActiv科技脱颖而出。

long.en:
Called the Atenza in various markets, the Mazda 6 sports sedan offered European-like style and performance in a less expensive package. In 2012, the third-generation model was unveiled, sporting an exterior body that resembled the dashing Takeri concept car shown at the 2011 Tokyo Motor Show. However, the biggest surprise came under the sheet metal as the new Mazda 6 came equipped with an optional diesel engine called the SKYACTIV-D for select markets.

This diesel was in fact an improved version of the turbocharged direct-injection 2.2-liter inline-4 of the CX-5. It produced <175ps> and <42.8kgm> of torque, supplying the driver with gobs of low-end power that enabled the Mazda 6 to jump off the line like a lightweight sports car. Power was transferred via a 6-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual to either the front wheels or all four. In select markets, the “i-stop” idle-stop feature and a capacitor-based regenerative braking system called “i-ELOOP” were incorporated, helping the SKYACTIV-D-equipped Mazda 6s boast a high JC08 mode fuel economy of <22.4km/L>.

The diesel-engine powered cars were labeled “XD,” with Standard, Proactive, and L trim levels. The highest version, the L, came with luxury features including leather seats and accounted for an astounding 76 percent of all Mazda 6 sales in the first month of availability.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.
long.zh:
作为马自达的旗舰，阿特兹（马自达6）于2012年演化为第三代车型。这款车型受到了广泛的关注，因其外观酷似一年前在东京车展上所发布的“雄”概念车，其优美的轿跑车身流线极受青睐。但还有其他的因素令这款车型在发售时受到更多关注。第三代车型已全部采用马自达的次世代创驰蓝天技术（在CX-5车型中首次应用），配置了柴油驱动的创驰蓝天D型引擎。

相比CX-5使用的缸内直喷2.2升直列式4缸涡轮增压引擎，阿特兹采用的柴油引擎是该引擎的升级版。升级后的引擎能够产生<175ps>/<42.8kgm>的动力，仅需达到略高于怠速状态下的转速就能产生强劲的动力，足以使车手精神一振。该引擎不仅可以匹配6档自动变速箱，同时也能匹配6档手动变速箱，并且有前轮驱动和全轮驱动两种模式。在环保方面，除了“i-stop”怠速自动启停功能外，所有车型都配备了被称为“i-ELOOP”的基于电容的制动动能回收系统；配备了创驰蓝天D系引擎的车型能够实现油耗仅为<22.4km/L>的JC08高燃油经济性模式。

配备柴油引擎的车型被命名为XD，包括标准款、主动款和L包款三个等级。L包款为豪华车型，配备有真皮座椅等豪华配饰。这款柴油版的阿特兹极受欢迎，在发售首月便占到了销售总数的76%。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。

catch.zh: 第三代Atenza（Mazda 6），车身线条流畅，还拥有SKYACTIV技术。

It produced <175ps> and <42.8kgm> of torque, supplying the driver with gobs of low-end power that enabled the Mazda 6 to jump off the line like a lightweight sports car. Power was transferred via a 6-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual to either the front wheels or all four. In select markets, the “i-stop” idle-stop feature and a capacitor-based regenerative braking system called “i-ELOOP” were incorporated, helping the SKYACTIV-D-equipped Mazda 6s boast a high JC08 mode fuel economy of <22.4km/L>.

The diesel-engine powered cars were labeled “XD,” with Standard, Proactive, and L trim levels. The highest version, the L, came with luxury features including leather seats and accounted for an astounding 76 percent of all Mazda 6 sales in the first month of availability.
long.zh:
作为马自达的旗舰，阿特兹（马自达6）于2012年演化为第三代车型。这款车型受到了广泛的关注，因其外观酷似一年前在东京车展上所发布的“雄”概念车，其优美的轿跑车身流线极受青睐。但还有其他的因素令这款车型在发售时受到更多关注。第三代车型已全部采用马自达的次世代创驰蓝天技术（在CX-5车型中首次应用），配置了柴油驱动的创驰蓝天D型引擎。

相比CX-5使用的缸内直喷2.2升直列式4缸涡轮增压引擎，阿特兹采用的柴油引擎是该引擎的升级版。升级后的引擎能够产生<175ps>/<42.8kgm>的动力，仅需达到略高于怠速状态下的转速就能产生强劲的动力，足以使车手精神一振。该引擎不仅可以匹配6档自动变速箱，同时也能匹配6档手动变速箱，并且有前轮驱动和全轮驱动两种模式。在环保方面，除了“i-stop”怠速自动启停功能外，所有车型都配备了被称为“i-ELOOP”的基于电容的制动动能回收系统；配备了创驰蓝天D系引擎的车型能够实现油耗仅为<22.4km/L>的JC08高燃油经济性模式。

配备柴油引擎的车型被命名为XD，包括标准款、主动款和L包款三个等级。L包款为豪华车型，配备有真皮座椅等豪华配饰。这款柴油版的阿特兹极受欢迎，在发售首月便占到了销售总数的76%。

catch.en: This crossover SUV from Mazda featured a revolutionary engine design.
catch.zh: 这是一款搭载革命性引擎设计的Mazda跨界SUV。

long.en:
During the global sport utility vehicle (SUV) boom of the 2010s, Mazda introduced the CX-3 and CX-5, although a notable gap in size existed between the two. The C30 was conceived to bridge that divide, offering a well-balanced compact crossover SUV.

Measuring <4395mm> from front to rear, <1795mm> in width, and standing <1540mm> high, the CX-30's exterior was relatively compact while showcasing Mazda’s signature "KODO Design" philosophy. The signature wing on the front fascia seamlessly linked the grille to the headlights, while the undulations along the body's side panels artfully reflected shifting light.

Under the hood was a choice of three powertrains: the 2.0-liter gasoline direct-injection SKYACTIV-G, the 1.8-liter direct-injection diesel SKYACTIV-D, or the 2.0-liter SKYACTIV-X, which employed a groundbreaking Spark-Controlled Compression Ignition (SPCCI) system.

The CX-30 X Smart Edition, shown here, was introduced in 2021, based on the SKYACTIV-X model. This model grade emphasized comprehensive driver assistance features as standard, including the Active Driving Display, which projects key information onto the windshield, and the Smart Brake Support automatic emergency braking system. Also, the introduction of this model coincided with refinements to the SKYACTIV-X system, with automatic transmission models receiving enhanced throttle pedal resistance that improved driving response.

Combining versatile dimensions with a dynamic driving character, the CX-30 stands out as an appealing option in Mazda's lineup.
long.zh:
在2010年代全球SUV热潮中，马自达推出了CX-3和CX-5车型。不过，这两款车型之间存在明显的尺寸差距。CX-30作为一款跨界SUV，正是为了填补CX-3和CX-5之间的产品线空缺。

在相对紧凑的尺寸下（长<4395mm>、宽<1795mm>、高<1540mm>），CX-30的外观依然展现出了马自达推崇的“魂动”设计理念——动态且流畅。在前脸设计上，标志性的展翼造型向两侧延伸连接左右大灯，而车身侧面的腰线则巧妙地反映出动态的光影效果。

该车提供三种动力总成选项：2升汽油直喷引擎“创驰蓝天-G”、1.8升柴油直喷引擎“创驰蓝天-D”，以及采用革命性火花控制压缩点火（SPCCI）系统的2升汽油直喷引擎“创驰蓝天-X”。

这里展示的“CX-30 X Smart Edition”版本于2021年推出，在“创驰蓝天-X”车款上更进一步。该车型的主要卖点之一是标配丰富的驾驶辅助设备，包括将信息投影到挡风玻璃上的Active Driving Display抬头显示系统，还有Smart Brake Support智能行车制动系统。这个版本的车型同时也对创驰蓝天-X系统进行了优化，自动挡车型增强了油门踏板反馈力度，提升驾驶质感。

CX-30凭借实用的车身尺寸和充满活力的驾驶体验，成为一款极具吸引力的车型。

catch.en: This compact diesel model from Mazda offered more luxury than you would expect from a car in its class.
catch.zh: Mazda的紧凑车型，使用柴油引擎，带来远胜于同级别车型的豪华体验。

long.en:
The fourth-generation Mazda2, known as the Demio in its home market, was introduced in 2014.

It featured the company's "KODO" design philosophy, which implemented many traditional Japanese styling cues along with a sleek overall profile. The car came powered by the usual gasoline-engine options, but for this model, a 1.5-liter turbodiesel that Mazda dubbed "SKYACTIV-D" was added. This engine boasted the performance equivalent to a 2.5-liter gasoline engine, with <25.5kgm> of torque on tap for the 6-speed automatic model and <22.4kgm> for the 6-speed manual. The latter returned an impressive <30.0km/L> on the Japanese JC08 mode fuel economy test. Customers were so enthralled with the new diesel that more than 60 percent of the initial orders were for the SKYACTIV-D models.

There were three grades available for the diesel-powered cars. This included the base XD model, the XD Touring that included practical options such as LED lights and cruise control, and the XD Touring L Package, which included luxury options such as white leather seats and a leather bound steering wheel.
long.zh:
马自达2（Demio）在2014年进行了大改款，升级到了第4代。

它的外观延续了马自达在高端车型上推行的“魂动”设计理念，为它赋予了与理智知性的欧系车比肩的设计风格。另一个值得一提的特点是它不仅提供汽油引擎，还提供由马自达全新开发的1.5升“创驰蓝天-D”涡轮增压柴油引擎。这款引擎的性能可以和2.5升汽油引擎媲美。在经过调校后，6速自动档车型可以输出<25.5kgm>的扭矩，而6速手动档车型也可以输出<22.4kgm>的扭矩，并且在日本的JC08模式燃油经济性测试中取得了<30.0km/L>的惊人成果。事实证明，马自达2的柴油款车型非常受欢迎，初期收到的订单中有60%都是订购柴油版本。

柴油车共有三种型号配置，包括基础款的XD，提供LED大灯和定速巡航等实用功能的XD Touring，以及提供白色真皮座椅和真皮方向盘等奢华选项的XD Touring L Package。但每个车型都能为您提供超越其级别的品质。

catch.en: Mazda's Eunos Roadster is credited with reviving the small fun-to-drive rear-drive convertible sports car.
catch.zh: 这款广受欢迎的畅销车型在全球带起了一阵紧凑型跑车的风潮。

long.en:
*The Eunos Roadster was sold as the Mazda MX-5 in Europe and as the Mazda MX-5 Miata in the U.S.

The Eunos Roadster captured the imagination of the world as soon as it made its appearance in September 1989. We know it better as the Miata, and it revived the category of the lightweight convertible sports car, bringing the classic genre back into the limelight. With a compact body, rear-wheel-drive and a simple, and yet straightforward 1.6-liter DOHC inline-4, the Eunos Roadster was as fun to drive as it was good-looking.

It came powered by the 1.6-liter Type B6-ZE that produced <120 ps> and <14.0 kgm> of torque. The suspension system consisted of double wishbones at all four corners, while the brakes were discs at both the front and rear.

Mazda wanted to make sure that its new creation acted like part of the driver's body, going wherever the driver wanted in an effortless way. Thus, the phrase "rider, horse, one body" was adopted as its guiding principle.

In August 1993, a new engine, the 1.8-liter DOHC Type BP-ZE, was placed under the hood, with the output increased to <130 ps> and <16.0 kgm> of torque. The next round of changes came in August 1995 when the final gear ratio and flywheel were modified, thus creating the 1800 Series 2. Mazda produced 531,890 units through the end of 1997, setting a world record for production of a 2-passenger open vehicle, an achievement recorded by the Guinness Book of World Records.
long.zh:
*Eunos Roadster在欧洲和美国分别以马自达MX-5和马自达MX-5 Miata的名字发售。

在20世纪末，Eunos Roadster以一己之力复兴了轻量级跑车品类。这是一台传统的两座轻型敞篷跑车，拥有紧凑而轻巧的车身，1.6升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸引擎和后驱布局。

1989年9月在日本地区上市时，采用的还是1.6升的B6-ZE引擎，可以输出<120ps>和<14.0kgm>扭矩。铝制的动力框架连接传动系统和后差速器，带给驾驶者直接、硬派的换挡感受。该车型还应用了全新设计的双叉臂悬挂和四轮碟刹。据说，只要是与驾驶相关的零件，马自达在设计时都不计代价。这也是为什么人们常将驾驶Eunos Roadster与骑马的美妙体验相提并论了。更何况，这还是一台敞篷跑车。最原始的驾驶乐趣和上佳的操控体验成功抓住了全世界车迷的心，无论是新手，还是资深玩家都对它心驰神往。

1993年8月，新一代的Eunos带来了小改款和一台全新的1.8升BP-ZE引擎，动力输出提高到了<130ps>和<16.0kgm>扭矩。

1995年的第二次改款中，最终齿比和飞轮也接受了改装，进化为Eunos Roadster 1800系列2。

马自达共为这款车型推出过无数个限量版本，截至1997年年底，总共生产出531890台，创下了两座敞篷车的生产世界纪录，甚至被收录进了吉尼斯世界纪录。

catch.en: A fusion of speed and elegance, born from the spirit of an unrelenting challenger.
catch.zh: 速度和优雅的融合，源自挑战者百折不挠的精神。

long.en:
The Vision Gran Turismo project is the setting for the world's best automakers to develop concept cars for motorsports fanatics. The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo pushes the boundaries at the intersection of technology and design. This is not your traditional Mazda but a vision of the future with a healthy dose of respect for the past. It’s the result of an unwavering pursuit of glory at the world’s most grueling endurance event, the legendary 24 Hours of Le Mans.

In crafting the Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo, the Mazda Design team masterfully fused agility with elegance. Its dynamic silhouette is drawn with sensual forms inspired by Mazda’s KODO design philosophy. Even the shape of the grille is an interpretation of the Mazda signature front end developed for its production vehicles. The stance of the Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo, reminiscent of the famed 787B that took overall victory at the 1991 24 Hours of Le Mans, is powerful yet graceful.

The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo is engineered to be lightweight, featuring extensive use of carbon fiber, including a monocoque chassis, all wrapped in atmospheric white paint. Pair this with advanced drivetrain technology that delivers the pinnacle of power, efficiency, and durability, and the result is a remarkable power-to-weight ratio that surpasses most vehicles in its class.

The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo embodies Mazda’s vision for the future and its unwavering spirit to embrace challenges.
long.zh:
跑车浪漫旅愿景项目是世界上最好的车厂为赛车狂热分子打造概念车的平台。马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo推动了技术与设计之间的交汇。这不是一台传统的马自达，而是对未来的愿景，同时又适当兼顾传统。这款车是能在世界上要求最苛刻的耐力赛——著名的“勒芒24小时耐力赛”中取得卓越胜利，吸引万千瞩目的产品。

在马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo的设计中，马自达的设计团队将敏捷与优雅合二为一。感性的造型风格构造了这款车动感的轮廓，其灵感则来自于马自达的“魂动”设计理念。甚至前格栅的形状也源自马自达量产车的标志性前脸设计。马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo的风格让人想起在1991年勒芒24小时耐力赛中大获全胜的名车787B，强劲而不失优雅。

马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo车体极为轻盈，采用了轻巧的碳纤维组件，醒目亮白色涂装之下是轻盈的单体底盘。这款车采用了集大马力、高效率和耐久性于一体的高级动力传动技术，因而获得了极高的马力重量比，超过其同级别的大多数车型。

马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo是马自达对未来的设想，是他们不屈不挠的挑战者精神的产物。

catch.en: This version of the second-generation RX-7 offered better driver feedback and agility.
catch.zh: 第2代RX-7的完整形态，性能与操控回馈都有提升。

long.en:
By the time the second-generation RX-7, the FC3S, arrived in October 1985, Mazda had firmly established the model as a competent rotary-powered sports machine. Although the new model was shorter than the previous car, it was wider and slightly taller, resulting in a 200-kg weight increase. The newly designed 13B Wankel did more than compensate for the extra mass, as the turbocharged 654-cc powerplant produced <185ps> and <25.0kgm> of torque. To keep the rear end more secure, Mazda incorporated semi-trailing arms and lateral rods for the rear suspension that featured a toe control hub.

An even purer sports version of the car was introduced in August 1986, called the Infini. This limited-edition model was a two-seater, and featured, among other things, BBS alloy wheels, firmer shocks and an aluminum hood. The Infini name would make an appearance seven times, each time representing the sportiest version of the model, before production of the FC3S ceased in 1991.

Mazda made significant tweaks to the RX-7 in 1989, when it matched a new independent twin-scroll turbocharger to the 13B as well as raising the engine's compression ratio. The result was a power increase to <205 ps> and <27.5kgm>. The final Infini model saw the power of the 13B raised to <215 ps> and <28.0kgm>. A convertible model was added to the lineup in 1987, which proved popular in the U.S., especially with women.
long.zh:
RX-7于1985年10月进化为第二代“FC3S”。

未来主义风格的第二代相比第一代RX-7，长度更短，但更宽也更高，车身重量增加了大约200公斤。不过全新设计的13B引擎抵消了增加的重量。每个转子的排量扩展到了<654cc>，配合涡轮增压器后性能提升到了<185ps>和<25.0kgm>扭矩。

后部悬挂改为多连杆布局，同时采用了半拖曳臂和侧边杆。这个后悬挂的特点是采用了特殊的前束控制轮轴，能够提升车辆在转弯时后轮的稳定性。

FC3S系列同样推出了偏向于持久驾驶风格的限量版车型——英菲妮版本。英菲妮是一款高性能2座车型，省略了后排座位，装备了BBS合金轮毂、特殊减震器以及铝制引擎罩。第一款英菲妮亮相于1986年8月，但在1991年FC3S停产前，这款车一共限量发售了七批，是RX-7的标志性版本。

1989年，RX-7进行了几处小的改动。13B引擎应用了新型双涡流涡轮增压器，随着压缩比的提高，马力提高到<205ps>，扭矩则提高到<27.5kgm>。英菲妮的最后一款马力达到<215ps>，扭矩为<28.0kgm>。在外部配件方面，在小幅调整之后，三个圆形的尾灯成为了这几款车型的显著特征。

1987年，RX-7系列中新增了一款敞篷车型，与以往的耐久型赛车的印象不同。此车在美国获得成功，尤其在女性驾驶者中受到欢迎。

catch.en: This final version of the Mazda RX-7 marked the end of an excellent 25-year run for the model.
catch.zh: RX-7的最后一款纪念车型，25年的历史告一段落。

long.en:
Arguably, one of the purest sports cars to come from Japan is the third-generation RX-7 (FD3S) that was introduced in 1991. Gone was the name "Savanna" that graced previous models, replaced by the moniker, ɛ̃fini RX-7. The FD3S was wider than the FC, and significantly lighter at <1200kg>, thanks to the aluminum used for the hood, double wishbone suspension, and spare-tire jack.

New life was breathed into the 13B Wankel via new twin sequential turbochargers. The rotary engine produced <255ps> and <30.0kgm> of torque. With each passing year, the FD improved, with dramatic improvements in body rigidity and ABS. The weight-to-power ratio of the lighter Type S was <4.90kg/ps>, making it the fastest RX-7 to date.

The FD3S continued to evolve. Body rigidity, the computer, and ABS were upgraded. The Type I, created in 1991, led to the Type II, Type III, and the Type VI in 2000. Available only in the Japan market was the limited-edition Type RZ, the first Japanese car equipped with 40/45 low-profile tires. This was followed by the Type R Bathurst R in 2001 that came equipped with self-leveling shocks.

The 13B got an upgrade in 1996 and produced <265ps>. In 1998, after Mazda refined the engine's cooling system, the two-rotor Wankel was able to produce the maximum <280ps> allowed for JDM cars at the time. This allowed the Type R to boast a weight-to-power ratio of <4.50kg/ps>, which put it in the same league as the exotics. In August 2002, the RX-7 Spirit R was introduced as an anniversary model and became the last one in the series. After 25 years of delighting sports car fans around the world, the RX-7 was discontinued.
long.zh:
FD3S作为第三代的RX-7，发布于1991年12月。先前版本的名称“Savanna”被弃用，更名为ɛ̃fini RX-7。

为了适应更宽的轮胎，FD3S被明显加宽，但其引擎盖、备胎、千斤顶和前后双叉臂悬挂均采用铝制，使车身重量在车身加大的同时奇迹般地降到了1200公斤。

和FC3S一样，FD3S采用了13B涡轮增压引擎。但借助全新的序列式双涡轮系统，让输出提高到了<255ps>和<30.0kgm>的扭矩。重量更轻的Type S的动力重量比达到<4.90kg/ps>，此车在所有已发布的RX-7车款中速度最快，并且仍有极大的升级潜力。

FD3S在随后不断进化。车身刚度、车载电脑和防抱死刹车系统的规格也逐年升级。1991年制造的Type I车型进化为Type II和III，并在2000年最终成为Type VI。

在升级过程中的亮点之一是限量版的Type RZ，这是第一辆采用40/45小尺寸轮胎的日本车。在此后的2001年，Type R Bathurst R发布，采用高度可调式悬挂，这在标准量产车中也十分罕见。

当然，引擎也在不断更新。1996年，对电子控制单元的进气和排气系统进行了改进，将马力提高到了<265ps>。1998年，对冷却系统和引擎的优化使马力最终达到了<280ps>。Type R的重量马力比已达到了<4.50kg/ps>，性能上已经和超级跑车不相上下。

然而，RX-7无法满足21世纪的环保标准。2002年8月，RX-7 Spirit R作为周年纪念版推出，同时也是该系列的最后一款，结束了其为期25年的生产。
