catch.en: The final version of the RX-8, Mazda's rotary engine sports car with a unique 4-door layout.
catch.zh: Mazda的转子引擎跑车RX-8的最后限量版车型，具有独特的4门设计。

long.en:
Introduced in 2011, the Mazda RX-8 Spirit R was the final special edition model of the RX-8 that was first released in 2003.

The RX-8 had two distinct personalities, depending on the gearbox you chose. Cars equipped with the 6-speed manual drove like a pure sport car, with brisk acceleration and more driver control, while those with the 6-speed automatic essentially behaved like luxury grand tourers. The Spirit R equipped with the 6-speed manual was based on the sporty Type RS, and featured extra aero parts and a sporty suspension setup, complete with Bilstein dampers. The automatic Spirit R was based on the Type E and included luxury accoutrements, such as leather seats. The car's Renesis rotary engine produced 235HP and 159 ft.-lb. of torque.

The lifespan of the Spirit R was short-lived, as Mazda discontinued the RX-8 in June 2012. Because of that, initial orders for the Spirit R exceeded the intended batch of 1000 units, so Mazda produced another 1000 to meet demand.[
long.zh:
马自达RX-8 Spirit R在2011年首次推出，是2003年亮相的RX-8的最终特别版。

RX-8共可提供两种略有差异的体验。6速手动档款偏向跑车，而6速自动档的感觉更像是豪华旅行车。这款Spirit R车型也同样提供了手动档和自动档选项，都代表了符合其定位的最高档配置。

其手动型号基于跑车型的Type RS，包含额外的空气动力学套件和采用倍适登避震器的强化悬挂。自动档型号基于豪华旅行车风格的Type E，拥有高档内饰和皮革座椅。和旧型号相比，差异仅仅在于外观和内饰的诸多细节变化，引擎规格和机械系统完全没有改变。尽管如此，随着官方公布将于2012年6月停产RX-8，订单量飞快地超过了原计划的1000台。为了满足需求，最后又额外生产了1000台RX-8。

catch.en: This stunning concept provided a glimpse of a next-generation rotary-engine-powered car.
catch.zh: 一辆采用了次时代转子引擎的优雅概念车。

long.en:
The Mazda RX-VISION was first shown at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show. Billed then as the company's Rotary Sports Concept.

Based on Mazda's KODO design philosophy, the car was a visual tour de force, with smooth flowing lines and proportions befitting a spiritual successor of the RX-7 and Eunos Cosmo. A bit of mystery surrounded what was under its hood.

All that was disclosed was that it was Mazda's next-generation Skyactiv-R rotary engine.

The catchphrase included the words, "a dream to hopefully achieve one day." That the company still had plans for a future rotary engine was made clear with this machine.

Gran Turismo Sport players had an exclusive chance to sample its prowess in the virtual world in the form of the RX-VISION GT3 Concept.
long.zh:
2015年的东京车展上，马自达在他们的展位上展出了一辆跑车，并赢得了观众极高的关注度。这款车称为RX-VISION，副标题则是“转子运动概念车”。

这款车基于马自达的“魂动”设计理念开发，采用流畅的长车头、短驾驶舱外形，摒弃了一切不必要的线条或平面，追求前置后驱跑车的终极美感。它的外形也清楚地昭示了其双座前中置引擎的布局。

尽管规格详情没有公开，但据描述，这款车采用了下一代的转子引擎“创驰蓝天-R”。

其宣传口号中包含这样一句话，“希望有朝一日可以实现的梦想”。这款车也是全世界广泛转子引擎迷们翘首以盼、希望能够亲眼目睹的梦想。

而在这款车的公路型号公布之前，你已经可以在《跑车浪漫旅 竞速》中驾驶到RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT了。

catch.en: This ultra-exotic concept featured a rotary engine and cutting-edge technology.
catch.zh: 搭载了转子引擎和尖端科技的超跑概念车。

long.en:
Created to commemorate the 50th anniversary of Toyo Kogyo (Mazda), the RX500 concept car was introduced to the world in 1970. It featured the company's revolutionary rotary engine, which made its debut in the Cosmo Sport three years prior, and an unforgettable bullet-shaped body that focused on aerodynamics.

The designers of the car experimented with several different versions of the RX500, including a coupe with a beautiful rear section and a race car with a rear wing, but opted to go for the car you see here because of its superior Cd (drag coefficient) value of 0.31. In terms of styling, the car was truly before its time; for example, its upswing doors were introduced before those of the Lamborghini Countach.

The powerplant, mounted amidships in a steel-tube space frame, was a 10A rotary engine built for the company's Spa 24 Hours race car and produced more than <250ps>. It came mated to a 4-speed manual gearbox from the RX87 Luce Rotary Coupe. Top speed was expected to exceed <250km/h>, and the brake system featured 4-piston calipers and 4-wheel ventilated discs, which represented cutting-edge technology for that time, as only a very few racing cars boasted a similar set-up.
long.zh:
马自达RX500是为了纪念马自达的前身，东洋工业株式会社成立50周年而打造的概念跑车，也是对马自达转子引擎的绝佳展示。全球首台商用的转子引擎就装在马自达1967年款的Cosmo Sport身上。

RX500令人印象深刻的子弹造型是在综合考虑空气动力学效果后做出的决定。在车身制模阶段，公司内的设计师们曾制作过一款双门版本，拥有美妙的车尾，另外还有加装了尾翼的竞赛版本。但最后，马自达选择了这个在风洞测试中获得优秀成绩（风阻值0.31）的造型。不仅如此，在兰博基尼Countach问世之前，RX500就已经用了上开式剪刀门。

装在空间钢管车架上的中置引擎是一台为斯帕24小时耐力赛打造的10A转子引擎，可以输出超过<250ps>。传动系统则是一款RX87 Luce Rotary Coupe上使用的4速手动变速箱。这台车的预期最高时速是<250km/h>。刹车系统则包括了四活塞卡钳和四轮通风碟刹，以应对极速下的制动需求。这是一台集当时先进科技于大成的车型，恐怕只有少数赛车的配置能与之媲美。

catch.en: This motorsports-based model epitomizes the core concepts of the Roadster.
catch.zh: 这款赛车向的基础车型成为了展现Roadster核心理念的典范。

long.en:
Released in 2015, the fourth-generation ND MX-5 received worldwide praise for its return to the original concept of "Jinba Ittai," which translates to "rider and horse, one body." This essence was especially apparent in the NR-A trim level, which was intended for track use.

The NR-A first made its appearance on the second-generation NB MX-5, catering to those who enjoyed driving their sports cars on the track. The concept proved popular enough for Mazda to include an NR-A in the ND lineup.

The section of the frame that connects the transmission to the rear differential was upgraded for the ND NR-A, along with the driveshaft, LSD and differential case. The size of the radiator and brake rotors were increased, and the suspension adopted height-adjustable dampers made by Bilstein. Another useful feature was the Multi-Information Display that allowed the driver to get vital stats through switches on the steering wheel.

This 2022 model has further improvements, including a new Kinematic Posture Control system that stabilizes the rear end of the car. The options list also features racing equipment such as roll bars and bucket seats, which come especially useful for hot-lapping sessions.

The NR-A is the ideal track car for weekend warriors because of its excellent and predictable handling, with power delivery that's just enough to make things fun and exciting.
long.zh:
这台2015年发售的第四代“ND” Roadster回归最初的“人马一体”理念，受到了全世界的赞誉。ND的精髓在NR-A这款比赛专用的基础车型上得到了纯粹而淋漓尽致的表达。

NR-A最初是在第二代“NB”车型时加入了系列，它推出时的理念是为所有人提供一个轻松体验赛道乐趣的机会。这些理念在ND版本的NR-A中得到了继承，并特别针对竞速驾驶作出了对应改动。

将传动系统与后轮差速器连接的动力装置得到了升级，同期强化的还有传动轴、限滑差速器和差速器箱等相关配件。散热器和刹车盘都变大了一码，悬挂采用了由倍适登制造的高度可调减震器。另外新增的一项实用功能是驾驶者现在可以通过方向盘上的声控开关来命令多功能显示器显示油耗等统计数据了。

这台2022年的车款还拥有进一步的改进，全新的运动姿态控制系统大幅提高了车尾的稳定度。选配清单中还包括了防倾杆和桶型座椅等赛车装备，可以轻松将此车变为一辆彻头彻尾的赛车。

NR-A可能是许多人梦寐以求的车型，在城市街道和赛道上都能提供同样的驾驶乐趣。

catch.en: The MX-5 Miata returns to its roots with a lightweight <990kg> body and dashing looks.
catch.zh: 第四代Roadster，车体加宽，车重更是低至990 公斤。

long.en:
One look and almost anyone in the world can recognize Mazda’s sporty convertible sports car that's proved so popular that it made its way into the Guinness Book of World Records. While it goes by different names throughout the world, the Roadster in Japan, the MX-5 in Europe and the MX-5 Miata in the US, we’ll refer to it simply as the MX-5 here.

The fourth-generation MX-5, codenamed “ND,” was introduced at the New York Auto Show in April 2014. It was obvious from this “display only” model that the car possessed all the attributes to make it great, returning to the formula that made the first-generation model so successful. It was going to be lighter than the outgoing model, with most of the heavy components, including the driver, focused at the center of the chassis.

When the final exterior and interior design of the MX-5 was revealed simultaneously in the US, Japan and Europe in September of the same year, driving fans were excited. The new MX-5 looked sleek and sexy, sitting low to the ground with a wide stance. The car, slightly smaller than the previous model, was more in line with the first generation car. It measured <3915mm> long, <1735mm> wide and <1235mm> high, and rode on a <2310mm>-wheelbase. It tipped the scales from <990kg> to <1060kg>, depending on the grade model.

Powering the compact roadster was a <1496cc> DOHC inline-4 that delivered <131ps> and <15.3kgm> of torque. It came mated to a 6-speed manual gearbox or an automatic transmission with a torque converter. The combination of the lightweight package, peppy engine and manual gearbox made the “ND” one of the most rewarding cars to drive on the planet, and it reminded everyone of how enjoyable top-down motoring can truly be.

*The Mazda Roadster was sold as the Mazda MX-5 in Europe and the Mazda MX-5 Miata in the US.
long.zh:
代号“ND”的第四代马自达敞蓬跑车于2014年4月在纽约车展上首次以实物形态亮相。虽然当时仅仅展示了底盘、引擎、传动系统和悬挂系统，但可以看到较重的元件被安置在较低、靠近底盘中心的位置，设计者为了减轻重量付出了大量的努力，车手坐在车辆中部略微靠后的位置。这次亮相成功地引起了全世界车迷的期望。

在同年9月的另一次重大更新中，车辆的造型于日本、美国和欧洲同步亮相，并宣布将于2015年开始发售。

这款车的前鼻和肩线较低，车身整体偏宽偏低。其优雅的线条十分迷人，但车身的尺寸比前辈型号NC要小。这款车在尺寸和设计方面受到了全世界的好评。

2015年，关于这款车的更多信息被透露出来。车的尺寸为<3915mm>×<1735mm>×<1235mm>，轴距为<2310mm>。车身重量在<990kg>与<1060kg>之间，根据车型等级而有所不同。引擎使用的是<1496cc>双顶置凸轮轴直4引擎，马力为<131ps>/<15.3kgm>。变速箱可提供6档手动变速箱和带有变矩器的自动变速箱。

预订开始于2015年3月，共有几个级别可选：基本S款、驾驶性能提升的S特别款和豪华版S真皮款。S款的配置十分简单，并未配备限滑差速器和后稳定杆。然而，此级别车型的重量低于1吨，只有<990kg>，适合驾驶者体验新款“ND”双座敞蓬跑车的本色。

*此款马自达双座敞蓬跑车在欧洲销售的型号为MX-5，在美国销售的型号为马自达MX-5 Miata。

catch.en: A first-generation Mazda Roadster, tuned to perfection by Gran Turismo.
catch.zh: 第一代Roadster，由跑车浪漫旅完成调校。

long.en:
*The Eunos Roadster was sold as the Mazda MX-5 in Europe and as the Mazda MX-5 Miata in the U.S.

This original car created by "Gran Turismo" is based on the 1989 Mazda Eunos Roadster (NA Special Package). The following is the description of the base model:

The Eunos Roadster captured the imagination of the world as soon as it made its appearance in September 1989. We know it better as the Miata, and it revived the category of the lightweight convertible sports car, bringing the classic genre back into the limelight. With a light and compact body, rear-wheel-drive and a simple-yet-straightforward 1.6-liter DOHC inline-4, the Roadster was as fun to drive as it was good-looking.

It came powered by the 1.6-liter Type B6-ZE that produced <120ps> and <14.0kgm> of torque. The suspension system consisted of double wishbones at all four corners, while the brakes were discs at both the front and rear.

Mazda produced 531,890 units through the end of 1997, setting a world record for production of a 2-passenger open vehicle, a fact recorded by the Guinness Book of World Records.
long.zh:
*Eunos Roadster在欧洲和美国分别以马自达MX-5和马自达MX-5 Miata的名字发售。

这是跑车浪漫旅以马自达Eunos Roadster'89（自然进气特别版）为基础，调校制作的原创车型。以下是针对原始车型的介绍：

在20世纪末，Eunos Roadster以一己之力复兴了轻量级跑车品类。这是一台传统的两座轻型敞篷跑车，拥有紧凑而轻巧的车身，1.6升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸引擎和后驱布局。

1989年9月在日本地区上市时，采用的还是1.6升的B6-ZE引擎，可以输出<120ps>和<14.0kgm>扭矩。铝制的动力框架连接传动系统和后差速器，带给驾驶者直接、硬派的换挡感受。该车型还应用了全新设计的双叉臂悬挂和四轮碟刹。据说，只要是与驾驶相关的零件，马自达在设计时都不计代价。

马自达共为这款车型推出过无数个限量版本，截至1997年年底，总共生产出531890台，创下了两座敞篷车的生产世界纪录，甚至被收录进了吉尼斯世界纪录。

catch.en: The debut model of the third-generation RX-7, a car developed to be the ultimate sports car.
catch.zh: 第三代RX-7车型首发，旨在成为一款终极跑车。

long.en:
The FD3S, the third-generation RX-7, made its debut in December 1991. The “Savanna” name used on earlier versions was retired, and the model was rebadged as the ɛ̃fini RX-7.

To accommodate wider tires, the FD3S was significantly widened. Even so, extensive use of aluminum for the hood, spare wheel, jack, and front and rear double-wishbone suspension kept curb weight to a remarkable <1260kg>, despite the increase in size.

Power came from the 13B Turbo carried over from the FC3S. But the addition of a new sequential twin-turbo system raised output to <255ps> and <30.0kgm> of torque. In its lighter Type S form, the power-to-weight ratio reached <4.90kg/ps>, making it the fastest RX-7 ever released and a platform with enormous potential.

The FD3S continued to evolve throughout its lifecycle. Body rigidity, engine management, and ABS specifications were refined year after year. The original Type I introduced in 1991 progressed through Type II and Type III, culminating in the Type VI released in 2000.

Ultimately, the RX-7 could not meet the tightening environmental standards of the 21st century. In August 2002, the RX-7 Spirit R was released as a final commemorative model, closing the book on 25 years of RX-7 production.
long.zh:
FD3S，即第三代RX-7，于1991年12月首次亮相。先前版本的名称“Savanna”不再沿用，而是重新命名为ɛ̃fini RX-7。

为了适应更宽的轮胎，FD3S的车身被大幅加宽，但其引擎盖、备胎、千斤顶以及前后双叉臂悬挂均为铝制，所以尽管尺寸增加，但车身重量却奇迹般地降至<1260kg>。

和FC3S一样，FD3S采用了13B涡轮引擎。但得益于新引入的串列式双涡轮增压器，让输出提高到了<255ps>和<30.0kgm>的扭矩。而车身更轻的Type S的马力重量比更是达到了<4.90kg/ps>，是有史以来最快的RX-7，而且升级潜力巨大。

FD3S持续进化车身刚性、车载电脑和ABS的规格年复一年地获得升级。从1991年诞生的Type I，发展到Type II和Type III，最后演化为2000年的Type VI。

遗憾的是，RX-7无法应对21世纪日趋收紧的环境排放标准。2002年8月，RX-7 Spirit R作为该系列的最后一款周年纪念车型发布，标志着其25年生产的终结。

catch.en: The 650S supercar came loaded with F1 technology.
catch.zh: 当MP4-12C进化成了豪华超跑。

long.en:
McLaren introduced the 650S at the 2014 Geneva Motor Show as the successor to its amazing MP4-12C, which signaled the company’s willingness to duke it out with Ferrari in the exotic production-car market, as wells at in Formula 1.

The 650S was designed to be the high performance version of the MP4-12C, as it shared the basic structure with its predecessor. It sported an extremely light-yet-rigid carbon-fiber monocoque body that helped keep its curb weight down to <1360kg>. The styling was updated from the MP4-12C, with a freshened face and improved aerodynamics.

The Proactive Chassis Control suspension was also based on the one in the MP4-12C, but revised to provide sharper responses and a smoother ride quality. Also making its way from the MP4-12C into the 650S was the torque vectoring brake steering and variable rear wing.

The car’s name came from the power derived from its twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8 that produced <650ps> and <69.1kgm> of torque. The fire-breathing engine came mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox that exhibited smoother shifts than that of its predecessor, and allowed the driver to choose three different shift maps: normal, sports, and tracks.

The 650S’s performance was certainly world-class with a zero-to-<100km/h> time of 3.0 seconds, a zero-to-<400m> time of 10.5 and a top speed of <333km/h>.
long.zh:
迈凯伦的超级跑车650S发布于2014年的日内瓦车展，接力迈凯伦首次全力进军超跑领域的车型MP4-12C。

该车型在策划之初是MP4-12C的高性能版，沿用相同的基本结构——至轻至坚固的碳纤维“单体车壳”，重量也与前者基本相当，为<1360kg>。

在造型方面，这款车的正面给人的印象与旗舰车型P1相似，但这其实是为了改善空气动力学性能而作的改进。从后面看，这款车几乎和MP4-12C一模一样，将其看作是改进车款也不无道理。

正如车名所示，650S使用的3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎被调整为<650ps>/<69.1kgm>的动力输出。所配备的7档双离合变速箱在改进后换挡更加顺滑。搭载的驾驶模式选择器可以在普通、跑车和赛道三个模式之间切换。

主动式底盘控制悬挂在机械结构方面保持不变，但经过调整，使响应更加灵敏的同时保持迈凯伦超跑知名的舒适度。

当然，这款车也保留了扭矩矢量分配制动转向和提供空气制动的可变式尾翼。

0-<100km/h>的加速时间为3.0秒；0-400米所需时间为10.5秒，最高时速可达到<333km/h>。

catch.en: The GT3 successor to the remarkable MP4-12C race car.
catch.zh: 在凶猛而性感的野兽的排气共鸣声中沉迷。

long.en:
McLaren introduced the 650S at the 2014 Geneva Motor Show as the successor to its amazing MP4-12C, which signaled the company’s willingness to duke it out with Ferrari in the exotic production-car market, as wells at in Formula 1.

The car’s name came from the power derived from its twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8 that produced <650ps> and <69.1kgm> of torque. The fire-breathing engine came mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox that exhibited smoother shifts than that of its predecessor, and allowed the driver to choose three different shift maps: normal, sports, and tracks.

The 650S’s performance was certainly world-class with a zero-to-<100km/h> time of 3.0 seconds, a zero-to-<400m> time of 10.5 and a top speed of <333km/h>.

The race spec version of the 650S, introduced three months after the road car, was called the 650S GT3. As its name implied, it was developed in line with FIA-GT3 regulations. The 650S GT3 was the successor to the the MP4-12C GT3, the race car McLaren introduced in 2011. The MP4-12C GT3 contested in GT races all over the world, including the Blancpain endurance series and SCCA World Challenge.

Like the MP4-12C, the basic structure of the 650S GT3 consisted of a carbon mono cell taken from the road car; however, the suspension system was completely revised. The car came equipped with exterior carbon parts that further improved upon the MP4-12C GT3's excellent aerodynamics, thanks to a larger splitter and redesigned door mirrors.

The twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8's power was restricted down to <500ps> in line with GT3 regulations, but McLaren announced that there were additional improvements made to increase durability of various parts.

The 2015 650S GT3 won the 2015 GT Asia and the Bathurst 12-hour race in the beginning of 2016.
long.zh:
迈凯伦的超级跑车650S发布于2014年的日内瓦车展，接力迈凯伦首次全力进军超跑领域的车型MP4-12C。

其基本结构沿袭自MP4-12C，正面外观与旗舰车型P1相似。和P1一样，这款车也采用了轻质高强度的碳纤维单体车壳作为车体骨架，同时配备了动力调高至<650ps>/<69.1kgm>的3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎。重量和MP4-12C相当，为1360公斤，但性能更高，0-<100km/h>加速时间仅需3秒，最高时速可达<333km/h>。

650S的竞速版车型为650S GT3。顾名思义，这款车是根据国际汽联-GT3规则设计的，并在650S公路版跑车发布3个月后发布。650S GT3将取代2011年亮相的迈凯伦GT跑车：MP4-12C GT3。MP4-12C GT3活跃在世界各地的GT赛场上，包括宝珀耐力系列赛和美国赛车俱乐部世界挑战赛等。

和MP4-12C一样，650S GT3的基本结构也采用了和公路版相同的碳纤维单体车壳，但悬挂却被完全修改，胎面也比MP4-12C宽<52mm>。650S GT3还配备了MP4-12C同款碳纤维空气动气学组件，并且安装了更大的分流器，对后视镜也进行了重新设计，空气动力学性能得到进一步提高。

引擎仍为3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎，和MP4-12C的GT版本一样，为了符合GT3规则，这款车的马力被限制为<500ps>。据称，迈凯伦对各种零件的耐久性进行了额外的改善。

2015款650S GT3在2015年亚洲GT系列赛和2016年初的巴瑟斯特12小时耐力赛屡获殊荣。)

catch.en: Here is the Gran Turismo original Gr.4 spec-version of the McLaren 650S super sports car.\
catch.zh: 跑车浪漫旅原创Gr.4规格的McLaren 650S超级跑车。

long.en:
McLaren introduced the 650S at the 2014 Geneva Motor Show as the successor to its amazing MP4-12C, which signaled the company’s willingness to duke it out with Ferrari in the exotic production-car market, as wells at in Formula 1.

The 650S was designed to be the high performance version of the MP4-12C, as it shared the basic structure with its predecessor. It sported an extremely light-yet-rigid carbon-fiber monocoque body that helped keep its curb weight down to <1360kg>. The styling was updated from the MP4-12C, with a freshened face and improved aerodynamics.

The Proactive Chassis Control suspension was also based on the one in the MP4-12C, but revised to provide sharper responses and a smoother ride quality. Also making its way from the MP4-12C into the 650S was the torque vectoring brake steering and variable rear wing.

The car’s name came from the power derived from its twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8 that produced <650ps> and <69.1kgm> of torque. The fire-breathing engine came mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox that exhibited smoother shifts than that of its predecessor, and allowed the driver to choose three different shift maps: normal, sports, and tracks.

The 650S’s performance was certainly world-class with a zero-to-<100km/h> time of 3.0 seconds, a zero-to-<400m> time of 10.5 and a top speed of <333km/h>.
long.zh:
迈凯伦的超级跑车650S发布于2014年的日内瓦车展，接力迈凯伦首次全力进军超跑领域的车型MP4-12C。

该车型在策划之初是MP4-12C的高性能版，沿用相同的基本结构——至轻至坚固的碳纤维“单体车壳”，重量也与前者基本相当，为<1360kg>。

在造型方面，这款车的正面给人的印象与旗舰车型P1相似，但这其实是为了改善空气动力学性能而作的改进。从后面看，这款车几乎和MP4-12C一模一样，将其看作是改进车款也不无道理。

正如车名所示，650S使用的3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎被调整为<650ps>/<69.1kgm>的动力输出。所配备的7档双离合变速箱在改进后换挡更加顺滑。搭载的驾驶模式选择器可以在普通、跑车和赛道三个模式之间切换。

主动式底盘控制悬挂在机械结构方面保持不变，但经过调整，使响应更加灵敏的同时保持迈凯伦超跑知名的舒适度。

当然，这款车也保留了扭矩矢量分配制动转向和提供空气制动的可变式尾翼。

0-<100km/h>的加速时间为3.0秒；0-400米所需时间为10.5秒，最高时速可达到<333km/h>。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

catch.en: The ultra-exotic McLaren F1 exemplified the genius of its designer, Gordon Murray.
catch.zh: 跑车的终极，汲取了天才戈登·穆雷的理念。

long.en:
The McLaren F1 production car first made its appearance in 1991 as the king of all super sports exotics. The car was built by Formula 1 constructor McLaren and styled by lead designer Gordon Murray, who was assigned the arduous task of bringing to life company founder Bruce McLaren's dream of building a road-going automobile with the McLaren name.

The F1 sports car had scissor-type doors not unlike those of a Lamborghini Diablo. Its monocoque structure was extremely light, contributing to the car's weight of <1140kg>. The car was laden with so many special features that they are too many to list here, but one trait worth noting is the car's passenger seating arrangement. By positioning the driver's seat at the center of the interior and the two passengers on opposing sides behind the driver, an ideal lateral and vertical weight balance was realized. Even the trunk was positioned within the wheelbase to ensure optimal weight distribution. Mounted amidships was BMW's 6.1-liter V12 that pumped out <627ps>. Although other exotics of the day used forced induction, McLaren opted to keep its powerplant naturally aspirated for better overall response and driving ease.

Upon its release to the public, the McLaren F1 was hailed as the fastest road-going sports car in the world, one that was also quite practical as an everyday driver. Needless to say, many McLaren F1 owners wanted to race the car because of its incredibly high level of performance, prompting the company to produce the F1 GTR, a race version of the road car. The F1 GTR went on to enjoy a successful racing career that included wins in races such as the 24 Hours of Le Mans._
long.zh:
迈凯伦F1是由一级方程式车厂迈凯伦研发的超级跑车，发布于1991年。

此车由一级方程式设计师戈登·穆雷设计，是为了实现已故公司创始人布鲁斯·迈凯伦未完成的梦想——制造一款在公路上行驶的迈凯伦。

这款车采用鸥翼式车门和单体车壳结构，极度轻盈的车身仅重<1140kg>，并拥有数不清的特殊特性，成就革命性的车款。其中最值得注意一点的是，为了提高驾驶性能，设计者对重量配比的优化极其重视。

驾驶座被安置在车辆中部，两个乘客座位分别布置在后方左右两侧，形成了独特的三角形3座布局。甚至连行李箱也设置在前后轴之间，以使重心位于中央。中置安装的6.1升宝马V12引擎能够产生<627ps>。虽然当时超跑的主流是涡轮增压，设计者还是采用了自然吸气引擎，以便在整体上获得更好的反应能力和驾驶灵活性。

通过上述努力，迈凯伦F1得以享誉全球，被誉为全世界最快的公路超跑，且仍兼具日常实用性。由于其惊人的速度和驾驶性能，许多客户想将这款车用于赛车比赛，有鉴于此，迈凯伦又生产了此车的赛车规格版F1 GTR。迈凯伦F1在勒芒24小时耐力赛等比赛中大获成功，开创了自己的时代。*

catch.en: The ultimate automobile by McLaren would go on to win both the BPR series and the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
catch.zh: 终极机器，BRP GT系列赛和勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军。

long.en:
In 1991, McLaren unveiled its first true road car. It was conceived by Gordon Murray, who designed the company’s Formula 1 machines at the time, and the exterior of the car styling was penned by Peter Stevens, who designed the new shape of the Lotus Esprit. The collaboration resulted in a true masterpiece called the “F1.”

The monocoque body was formed from carbon composites, so it was extremely light, weighing just <180kg>, thus enabling the F1 to tip the scales at a lean <1140kg>. A 6.1-liter V12, made by BMW motorsports (the famous “M” division) produces <636ps> and <66.4kgm> torque. It helped power the car to an official record top speed of <391.0km/h> in 1998.

With the high demands of the racing world, McLaren developed a model with even more refined aerodynamics: the McLaren F1 GTR. Delivery started in 1994. From 1995, the McLaren F1 GTR entered the BPR Global GT Endurance series and won the championship, but they also had another significant victory that year taking the checker at the 24 Hours of Le Mans. In wet conditions that lasted nearly the entire day, the McLaren staved off the open prototype racers that were then said to have the advantage. In the end, car No. 59 (which was practically a McLaren works car) driven by Yannick Dalmas, JJ Lehto and Masanori Sekiya took the overall win.
long.zh:
1991年，迈凯伦官宣将推出其首台公路车型。这台名为“F1”的车型出自当时为迈凯伦车队设计一级方程式赛车的设计师戈登·穆雷的设想，外观设计则来自为莲花跑车Esprit设计了新外形的彼得·史蒂文斯。

全部由碳纤维复合材料打造的单体车身极致轻盈，仅重<180kg>，整车重量也仅有<1140kg>。6.1L的V12引擎来自宝马的运动赛车部门，可以输出<636ps>和<66.4kgm>的扭矩。这台车在1998年创下了官方速度纪录：<391.0km/h>。

为了满足赛事规则更严苛的标准，迈凯伦又研发出了一款空气动力学更优秀的车型：迈凯伦F1 GTR。这款车型1994年驶下生产线，1995年初次参加BRP GT系列赛事就勇夺当年的赛季冠军。另一项值得迈凯伦大书特书的胜利，则是赢下了当年的勒芒24小时耐力赛：在连天阴雨的赛场上，迈凯伦F1 GTR与其他公认更具有优势的原型车展开了争夺，由雅尼克-达尔马斯、J.J.莱赫托和关谷正德驾驶的59号赛车（相当于迈凯伦卫星车队赛车）在开赛后不断超越，夺取了最终的胜利。~

catch.en: The MP4-12C was the first McLaren production car since the McLaren F1 road car.
catch.zh: McLaren的第三代超跑，拥有新的轻盈车身。

long.en:
Following in the footsteps of the McLaren F1 with its ultimate performance, and the SLR McLaren with Mercedes Benz, the third McLaren supercar was given the name MP4, as if to remind one of its relationship with F1 machines. As with the revolutionary MP4 F1 car that introduced carbon composite bodies to F1 racing back in 1981, the major point of note in this car is the one-piece carbon composite "mono-cell" tub utilized in its structure. The weight of the mono-cell alone is just <80kg> and contributes greatly to weight reduction. In the front and rear of the mono-cell is an aluminum frame to which the engine and suspension are assembled.

The midship-mounted engine is a 3.8-liter V8 twin turbo, with a maximum output of <600ps>. The displacement and power specifications may perhaps appear to be surprisingly modest for a McLaren road car. However its performance is nothing short of incredible, as its boasts a top speed of over <320km/h>, 0-<400m> (400m) acceleration of approximately 11 seconds, and a 0-<200km/h> acceleration of less than 10 seconds, giving it a performance level equal to or greater than the Ferrari 458 Italia.

The 7-speed dual clutch system is given the name "Seamless Shift Gearbox," much like F1 machines, and incorporates six preset driving modes. The electronically controlled suspension is set up as a 4-wheel double wishbone configuration, and it is also notable that the front-rear-left-right dampers are connected hydraulically for ride comfort.
long.zh:
在推出性能卓越的迈凯伦F1，以及与梅赛德斯-奔驰合作打造SLR迈凯伦后，迈凯轮发布了第三辆超级跑车，并将其命名为MP4，仿佛在提示这款车与F1赛车之间的关联。正如1981年革命性的MP4 F1赛车将碳纤维复合车壳引入了一级方程式比赛，这辆车的主要亮点也是其车身结构中使用的一体式碳纤维复合“单体车壳”。该“单体车壳”的重量仅为<80kg>，对减轻车身重量极有帮助。车壳前后均为铝材车架，用于安装引擎和悬挂。

中置引擎为一款3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎，最大输出功率为<600ps>。作为一款迈凯轮的公路跑车，这样的排量和马力规格乍看似乎有点太过平庸，然而其性能实际上却是令人难以置信地出色。其最高时速超过<320km/h>，0-<#400m>的加速仅需11秒，0-<200km/h>加速的时间小于10秒，性能水平与法拉利458 Italia相比可以说是有过之而无不及。

变速箱采用了名为“无缝式换档变速箱”的7档双离合器系统，与一级方程式车型十分相似，并带有六种预设的驾驶模式。电子控制悬挂系统采用4轮双叉股式配置，同时值得注意的是，前后左右的减震器均采用液压连接，以提高驾乘的舒适度。

catch.en: This legendary machine marked the end of the turbocharged era in Formula 1."
catch.zh: 标志着涡轮增压时代终结的传奇F1赛车。

long.en:
Many motorsports historians consider the McLaren MP4/4 as the most successful race cars ever built. This machine, designed by Gordon Murray and Steve Nichols and powered by the Honda RA168E engine, dominated the 1988 Formula 1 World Championship season, winning all but one race (15 out of 16 races) and taking all but one pole position.

Much of the credit was attributed to the Honda engine that effectively balanced fuel consumption and raw power, but the chassis was also superior to the rest of the field. Another big factor was the driving team of Ayrton Senna and Alain Prost, who helped score McLaren-Honda a then-record 199 points in the Constructors Championship. Senna took the drivers' title that year although Prost scored more points. The reason was that only the eleven best results counted, and Senna had more first-place finishes than Prost (eight to seven).
long.zh:
1988年，迈凯伦派出MP4/4征战F1世界锦标赛新赛季。这是一台由戈登·穆雷和史蒂夫·尼克斯联手设计的低高度、低阻力的机器，由本田RA168E引擎驱动。

这一年也是方程式赛事中允许使用涡轮增压机的最后一年。根据规则要求，涡轮的最大增压压力从4巴降到了2.5巴，车载燃料容量也遭到了削减，总计只能携带150升，比原来减少了45升。对于采用涡轮增压的赛车来说，这本应该是一个非常艰难的赛季。

但最终结果却是迈凯伦本田MP4/4彻底占据了主导地位，在16场比赛中豪取15胜。诚然，车辆底盘的研发非常优秀，但大家普遍认为在油耗和有效动力之间取得极致平衡的本田引擎才是他们获胜的主要因素。

车身涂装有12号的MP4/4是由阿伊尔顿·塞纳驾驶的赛车。在那一年里，塞纳以令人咋舌的13个杆位和8个冠军领奖台的优异成绩拿下了车手总冠军。

catch.en: This track-only model further defines the potential of the P1 hybrid supercar.
catch.zh: 专为赛道而设计的车型，进一步提升了P1混合动力超级跑车的潜力。

long.en:
The P1 GTR, introduced in 2014 to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the McLaren F1 GTR that dominated sports-car racing in the 1990s, was based on the "P1" hybrid super car that went on sale the year before. The main difference between the two was that the "GTR" version was created exclusively for the racetrack.

Although it may look like the road-going car at first glance, the aerodynamic efficiency of the P1 GTR is on an entirely different level, thanks to a larger front splitter, aggressive side skirts, and a massive rear wing.

Mounted amidships for both the P1 road car and the P1 GTR is a twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter V-8 that produces <737ps>. Also powering the vehicle are <179ps> electric motors, which enable the P1 road car to boast an output of <916ps> and the P1 GTR to pump out <1000ps>.

In order to purchase a P1 GTR, you must first have a P1 road car in your garage. Production for the race car was reported to be 30 to 35 units. Those lucky few who got their hands on the P1 GTR were invited to participate in a circuit driving program hosted by McLaren. Well, it's a nice offer, considering you need to shell out a staggering 1.9 million GBP (about US $2.4 million) to buy the car.
long.zh:
P1 GTR是基于2013年公布的混合动力超跑P1打造的赛道版本车型，不能上路驾驶。这款庆祝F1 GTR问世20周年的车型在2014年正式亮相。它的前辈F1 GTR曾在20世纪末的赛事当中屡次斩获冠军。

基础车架方面，P1 GTR沿用了P1的碳纤维单体车壳和设计造型，但在空气动力学部分带来了极大的提升：宽大的前定风翼和侧边包围，以及夸张的大尾翼。对底盘的设定也是专门针对赛道配置的。

P1车架中部搭载的3.8升双涡轮增压V8引擎和电机组合可以共同输出<916ps>，或分别输出<737ps>+<179ps>的动力。而在GTR版本中，总动力输出被再次提升到了<1000ps>。

在Mclaren对外的公告中，购买P1 GTR的前置条件是拥有一台公路版本P1，且这款车型的总产量将限定在30到35台之间。所有P1 GTR的车主都将受邀参加一项由迈凯伦举办的赛道驾驶计划，该计划的运输和维护成本也包含在了190万英镑的售价里。

catch.en: Putting the driver before all else, this car is the ultimate realization of the McLaren philosophy.
catch.zh: 这辆跑车实现了McLaren以车手为中心的终极设计哲学。

long.en:
McLaren established their road car department “McLaren Automotive” in 2010, continuing to release high performance cars into the world ever since. The McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo is a car developed by McLaren Automotive with an eye for 2030 and beyond.

Gran Turismo series producer Kazunori Yamauchi was also involved in development of this car. It brings to life the future of McLaren, while staying true to the design pillars and principles that were established, by being committed to putting the driver first. Within the main structure of the cabin, the driver resides in a motorcycle-like driving position. This enables an extreme cabin-forward design, by giving the driver an ability to clearly identify the apex of the corners as they turn. The teardrop shaped canopy covering the driver carries on the tradition of McLaren roadcars, helping to provide this excellent field of vision.

Mounted behind the cabin is McLaren's 4-Liter V8 Twin Turbo engine. This drives the rear wheels, while the “pods” housing the front wheels contain high output electric motors which drive the front wheels. The overall combined output of the car reaches <1150ps>.

The aerodynamics of the car is also very innovative. The body of the McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo is optimized so that the body itself generates peak aerodynamic performance, by minimizing individual components that would adversely affect aerodynamics. Rather than actuating surface panels in its active aerodynamics system, tiny aperture covers around the air inlets on key surfaces will open, producing drag and downforce. As a result, the number of moving parts in the system was reduced to help keep weight to a minimum. With McLaren being the pioneer who first implemented carbon fiber into F1 racing, this machine also utilizes carbon fiber components throughout the car, which achieves a curb weight of just <1000kg>.

The McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo will be available in three liveries: Performance, Ulterior, and Noir. We hope you will take the opportunity to experience this sensory overload, combining incredible sound with awe-inspiring acceleration.
long.zh:
迈凯伦在2010年设立了他们的公路车部门“迈凯伦汽车”，并持续推出高性能车型。而迈凯伦Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo就是一款迈凯伦汽车着眼于2030年乃至更久以后未来而开发的汽车。

跑车浪漫旅系列游戏的制作人山内一典也参与到这辆车的开发之中。该车型着眼未来，同时恪守迈凯伦树立的设计理念和原则，坚持以车手为本。在座舱的主框架下，车手的坐姿类似于驾驶摩托车。这种设计可以将驾驶舱极度前置，使得车手在过弯时可以清楚地辨识弯心。车手上方的水滴形车顶沿袭了迈凯伦公路车的传统，也提供了极佳的视野。

座舱后安装了迈凯伦4升V8双涡轮增压引擎，用于驱动后轮；而在包裹前轮的座舱处安装有一台大功率电机，用于驱动前轮。两台引擎相结合，可使这款车的整体功率达到<1150ps>。

这款车在空气动力学方面同样充满了创新。通过将每一个可能会对空气动力学造成负面影响的部件进行小型化设计，迈凯伦Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo的车身得到了大量优化，从而可以发挥出最佳的空气动力学性能。该车并没有利用主动式空气动力系统来控制表面挡板，而是开启主要表面上进气口周围的小孔，进而产生流气拉力和下压力。因此，整辆车的可活动部件数量得到了大幅削减，将整车重量控制在最低水平。迈凯伦是在F1比赛中率先使用碳纤维的先行者，这辆车同样大量使用了碳纤维零件，使得车辆自重仅仅只有<1000kg>。

迈凯伦Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo一共推出了三种涂装：Performance、Ulterior和Noir。这辆车有着难以置信的引瓎声浪和交人烊叹的加速度，我们希望你厯以借此机会体验一下宂幧给彠的感官冲击。

catch.en: This version of McLaren's future is realized in Gr.1 form with Vision Gran Turismo.
catch.zh: McLaren的近未来设计Vision Gran Turismo的Gr.1版本。

long.en:
McLaren established their road car department “McLaren Automotive” in 2010, continuing to release high performance cars into the world ever since. And the McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo is a car developed by McLaren Automotive with an eye for 2030 and beyond.

Gran Turismo series producer Kazunori Yamauchi was also involved in development of this car. It brings to life the future of McLaren, while staying true to the design pillars and principles established by McLaren; committed to putting the driver first. Within the main structure of the cabin, the driver resides in a motorcycle like driving position. This enabled an extreme cabin-forward design, giving the driver an ability to clearly identify the apex of the corners as they turn. The teardrop shaped canopy covering the driver carries on the tradition of McLaren roadcars, in helping to provide this excellent field of vision.

Mounted behind the cabin is McLaren's 4-Liter V8 Twin Turbo engine. This drives the rear wheels, while the “pods” housing the front wheels contain high output electric motors which drive the front wheels. The overall combined output of the car reaches <1150ps>.

The aerodynamics of the car is also filled with innovation. The body of the McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo is optimized so that the body itself generates optimum aerodynamic performance, by minimizing individual components that would adversely affect aerodynamics. Rather than actuating surface panels in its active aerodynamics system, tiny aperture covers around the air inlets on key surfaces will open, producing drag and downforce. As a result, the number of moving parts in the system was reduced and helped to keep weight to a minimum. And with McLaren being the pioneer who first implemented carbon fiber into F1 racing, This machine also utilizes carbon fiber components throughout the car, thereby achieving a curb weight of just <1000kg>.

The McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo will be available in three liveries: Performance, Ulterior, and Noir. We hope you will take the opportunity to experience this sensory overload, combining incredible sound with awe-inspiring acceleration.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.1 regulations by Gran Turismo.

catch.en: The most powerful model of the fourth-generation C-Class boasts a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8.
catch.zh: 第四代C-Class阵容中的最强音，采用4升双涡轮增压V8引擎。

long.en:
Mercedes-Benz introduced an AMG version of the fourth-generation C-Class a year after the base model was introduced in 2014. And although it wore the same C63 badge as its predecessor, the 2015 AMG C63 featured an all-new powerplant. Gone was the naturally aspirated 6.2-liter V-8, replaced by a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8 known as the M177, which used the same basic configuration as the M178 in the AMG GT.

The new C63 delivered <476ps> and <66.3kgm> in base form, and the C63 S provided a whopping <510ps> and <71.4kgm>. While horsepower was the same as the AMG GT models, the C63 engine featured better torque delivery that came lower in the rpm spectrum. Because of this, the C63 behaved in a smooth, civil manner on public roads. Only after the sedan and station wagon body styles were introduced did Mercedes-Benz offer the C63 and C63 S as a coupe in 2016.
long.zh:
第四代梅赛德斯-奔驰C级是在2014年推出的。和之前一样，梅赛德斯在2015年又追加推出了一款AMG车型。

虽然同样采用C63车标，但内里换上了一颗新的心脏。6.2升V8自然进气引擎换成了4升V8双涡轮增压M177引擎，采用与AMG GT上的M178引擎相同的基本配置。

在最大动力输出和扭矩方面，基础版C63可提供<476ps>和650牛·米（<66.3kgm>），而高性能C63 S则可输出<510ps>和700牛·米（<71.4kgm>）。这两款车型在马力上可与同级别的AMG GT相媲美，并且能够输出更大的扭矩。除此之外，经过调校后的动力带起点降低，拓宽了有效转速的发力范围。这些改进也让AMG版本的C63车重较一般跑车要更重些，可以作为日常用车使用。

C63和C63 S车型原本只供应轿车或旅行车，但在2016年时又引入了两门轿跑车型。

catch.en: This ultimate version of the AMG GT is laden with Formula 1 technology.
catch.zh: 注入了无数赛车运动的经验和知识，这就是AMG GT的终极版本。

long.en:
Since its debut in 2014, the Mercedes-AMG GT came in various forms, including a roadster and a 4-door coupe. There were high-performance versions offered, including the potent AMG GT Black Series that was introduced in 2020.

The Black Series represented the pinnacle of the AMG performance brand, thus, the AMG GT Black Series possessed true race car technology. Under its hood was a specially tuned twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8 that produced <730ps> and 800 Nm (<81.57kgm>) of torque. It came mated to a strengthen 7-speed DCT transmission whose gear ratios were revised. The end result was a car that ran from zero to <100km/h> in 3.2 seconds, to <200km/h> within 9 seconds and reach a top speed of <325km/h>.

Not all about going fast in the straight line, AMG tuned the chassis to capably handle the extra power, while the body was reshaped in various places to provide adequate downforce. In short, the AMG GT Black Series is a race car for the street, tuned to the nth degree by the most prominent luxury and motorsports brand in the world.
long.zh:
自从2014年首次亮相以来，梅赛德斯AMG GT已经推出了若干不同的版本，包括敞篷双座跑车、双开门跑车和高性能版本等。在2020年，梅赛德斯又推出了AMG GT的终极车型。这就是AMG GT Black Series。

Black Series的名号仅限用于限量款车型，在设计时力求尽可能多地将梅赛德斯AMG在赛车运动事业上开发出的科技运用于量产车平台上。

AMG GT Black Series是Black Series中的第六弹，采用了一部特殊调校过的4升V8 双涡轮引擎，将功率和扭矩分别提升到了<730ps>和800 牛·米（<81.57kgm>）。为了有效地传输这种超强动力，这款车配备的7速双离合变速箱也接受了强化，并重新设计了齿轮比。其结果就是这辆车可以在3.2秒内完成0-<100km/h>的加速，9秒内完成0-<200km/h>的加速，并且可以达到<325km/h>的极速。

车辆的悬挂系统也得到了相应的调整。此外，全车各个部件都获得了材料和工艺上的改进，提高了操控性和过弯能力。

车身方面也毫不例外，加入了各种赛车风格的改动调整，但没有一处改动是多余的。}

cars.nameZh: 梅赛德斯-AMG GT Black Series '20

catch.en: This 'road-legal race car' evokes the image of the much-celebrated 300SL sports car.
catch.zh: 这款“能合法上路的赛车”唤起了对曾备受瞩目的300SL跑车形象的追思。

long.en:
The Mercedes AMG GT R made its debut in 2016 as a high performance version of the AMG GT introduced in 2014. While it was officially designated as a road car, it was in fact a race car in street-car clothing.

The first thing to catch the eye on the AMG GT R were the vertical accents on the grille, reminiscent of those of the 300SL that won the 1952 Carrera Panamericana Mexico. Other notable features of the exterior included the adjustable rear wing and the flared fenders.

Under the sheet metal, many of the car's components were swapped for carbon-fiber pieces, including the roof, front fenders and torque tube. This car was also the first Mercedes AMG model with 4-wheel steering. Under the hood, the car's twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter
V-8 was retuned to produce <585ps> and <71.3kgm>, allowing the AMG GT R to run from 0-<100km/h> in a lightning quick 3.6 seconds and reach a top speed of <318km/h>.
`
long.zh:
梅赛德斯AMG GT R于2016年首次亮相，是2014年亮相的AMG GT的高性能版本。虽然以公路车的身份进行销售，但从性能角度来说，这辆车更接近于一款能够合规上路的赛车。

首先抓住你视线的便是前格栅上那凶猛的垂直板条，让你回想起1952年赢得墨西哥泛美越野大赛的那辆300SL赛车。其他夺人眼球的外观特色还包括可调整的尾翼以及宽体上的外扩挡泥板。

不过和原本车型相比，最大的改变还是它的内在。车顶、前挡泥板和扭矩管等多处换上了碳纤维部件以减轻重量，4升V8双涡轮引擎也经过调校，可以输出<585ps>的动力和<71.3kgm>的扭矩。这也是首款采用四轮转向的梅赛德斯AMG车型，车身前部还加入了主动式空气动力系统。

它可以在3.6秒内完成从0-<100km/h>的加速，并拥有<318km/h>的最大速度。

catch.en: With a <310km/h> top speed, this Mercedes-Benz is a race car in street-car clothes.
catch.zh: 最高时速310 公里/小时。尽显Mercedes精神的超跑。

long.en:
After the exotic Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG was discontinued in 2013, the AMG GT was created to fill the void. But calling the AMG GT the direct successor of the SLS AMG wouldn’t entirely be accurate as the GT was slotted slightly lower than the SLS, and it didn’t feature the car’s trademark gull wing doors.

However that isn’t to say that the cars were not alike. The new AMG GT featured a long nose and stout rear deck like its predecessor, and its body was constructed over a rigid aluminum space frame. The engine was mounted just aft of the front axle, and a 7-speed semi-automatic transaxle was placed at the rear, helping the AMG GT achieve an ideal 47:53 front/rear weight distribution.

Under that long hood resided the compact M178, a twin turbocharged <3982cc> V-8 developed specifically for this car. Customers had the choice of going with the standard engine tune that provided <460ps> and <61.2kgm> of torque, while those with insatiable performance appetites could opt for the upgraded version that delivered <510ps> and <66.3kgm> of torque. The high output engine came in the AMG GT S, and it allowed the super sports car to run to <100km/h> in a scant 3.8 seconds and reach a top speed of <310km/h>. The standard AMG GT was by no means a slouch, as it reached <100km/h> in 4.0 seconds and hit <304 km/h> in full stride.

The rear-wheel-drive sports car came equipped with an LSD, along with electronically controlled variable dampers and a drive select system that featured a race mode, which was appropriate because the AMG GT was pretty much a race car in street-car clothes.
long.zh:
AMG GT是梅赛德斯-奔驰于2014年开始售卖的超级跑车。

这款车是于2013年停产的SLS AMG的后继型号，不过这辆新车比SLS低一个等级，车身更加紧凑。而且缺少了SLS标志性的鸥翼式车门。

不过，这款车的制造工艺依然精密准确。采用硬质铝制框架的车身具备标志性的长车鼻和极短的车尾风格。引擎放置在前轴后方，采用标准的前中置引擎布局，而后轮处则安装有变速驱动桥式传动系统。前后配重比为47:53，是针对公路驾驶的最佳平衡比例。

这款车的引擎是一具专门开发的紧凑型M178V8双涡轮增压引擎，变速箱则继承了SLS的7档双离合设计。所有车型都配有限滑差速器，以及带有电子控制的可变式减震器，并连接到包括赛车模式的驾驶模式选择系统。这套系统和其他系统整合后，可以提供激进的驾驶性能。

这款车提供两种引擎调校，标准型号可以提供<460ps>/<61.2kgm>的动力输出，而高性能版则可以提供<510ps>/<66.3kgm>的动力。

配备有高性能版引擎的型号被命名为AMG GT S。这是一款纯粹的跑车，悬挂更加坚韧，而且为了配合更高的引擎功率使用了宽胎。标准款GT的0-<100km/h>加速和最高速度分别是4.0秒和<304km/h>，而GT S当然会更快，分别是3.8秒和<310km/h>。

catch.zh: 最高时速310 公里/小时。尽显Mercedes精神的超跑。

catch.en: This race car dominated the 24 Hours of Nürburgring in its very first outing.
catch.zh: 第一年参赛就称霸纽博格林赛道24小时耐力赛的领奖台。

long.en:
The AMG-GT3, which made its debut at the 2015 Geneva Motor Show, was based on the AMG GT road car. It served as the replacement to the SLS AMG GT3 that had competed in races all over the world since 2011.

The AMG-GT3, built to FIA-GT3 specifications, looked meaner than its road-going counterpart, thanks to a special vertical-latticed grille, wide front and rear fenders, a low front splitter, large canard wings, and a rear wing carried over from the SLS AMG GT3. Also, the rear diffuser was much larger than that of the previous GT3.

The engine was swapped from the twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8 of the road car to a naturally-aspirated 6.3-liter V-8 that powered the SLS AMG GT3. This powerplant was mounted low on the car's aluminum space frame, which was a tad smaller than that of the SLS AMG GT3. This meant that the new race car was lighter, with a curb weight under <1300kg>, and more nimble, thanks in part to a shorter wheel base.

The car took to the track in 2016 in various GT3 races around the world. At the 24 Hours of Nürburgring, it took the top four spots in its very first year of competition.

HTP motorsports of Germany, one of the top teams running the AMG GT3, found itself consistently in the championship hunt with the Mercedes race car in the Blancpain GT series. It won the Budapest and Silverstone rounds in 2016, as well as having finished 2nd place overall in the Nürburgring endurance race.
long.zh:
AMG-GT3是梅赛德斯-奔驰在2015年日内瓦车展上公布的一款竞赛车型。这辆车的设计基于公路版AMG GT，用以接替自2011年起就活跃在全世界各大赛场上的SLS AMG-GT3。

这款车严格依照国际汽联-GT3规范进行开发，包括加宽前后挡泥板和许多引人瞩目的空气动力学套件。车身前部的低处装有分流器，保险杆左右两侧各有一片大前翼，并且继承了SLS AMG GT3那与车顶高度相同的尾翼，以及比前款GT3大得多的尾部扰流翼。特殊的纵向进气格栅似乎也在展示这款车与普通公路款的截然不同。

鉴于SLS AMG GT3极其优异的比赛成绩，我们自然也将公路款的4升V8双涡轮增压引擎众望所归地换成了6.3升的V8引擎，并安装在铝制框架车身当中。这款车的车身比SLS AMG GT3小了一个尺寸，而重量则控制在<1300kg>以下。较短的轴距也使其在敏捷性方面更具优势。

这款车于2016年开始在全世界多项GT3赛事中亮相。在纽博格林24小时耐力赛中，这款车在参赛的第一年里就霸占了第一到第四顺位。

德国HTP汽车运动车队就是使用AMG GT3的顶级车队之一，并且始终占据宝珀GT系列赛的领先地位。他们在2016年赢下了布达佩斯站和银石站的冠军，也在纽博格林24小时耐力赛中获得总排名第二。|

catch.en: An improved and more cost effective GT3 machinej
catch.zh: 一辆性能更强、更经济的GT3赛车。

long.en:
The Mercedes-AMG GT3 was based on the Mercedes-AMG GT sports car that was unveiled to the public at the Paris Motor Show in 2014. This FIA (Federation Internationale de l'Automobile) homologated GT3 race car appeared on the international motorsports scene in 2016.

This updated 2020 model was introduced in 2019 with a focus on further reducing running costs as a customer race car. Improvements like a more durable engine and better protection for the radiator through a redesigned front end helped keep the costs of running a GT3 car more affordable for privateers.

The car's aerodynamics were improved through the addition of a front splitter and winglets, as well as a large wing and diffuser at the rear. The engineers also reduced the car's weight by using carbon fiber anywhere and everywhere possible.

The lower portion of the front grille was significantly widened, and the front and rear lights were updated. Although it retained the distinctive design of the previous model, many details on the car were updated to match the refreshed production model. Y
long.zh:
梅赛德斯AMG GT3基于梅赛德斯AMG GT跑车所打造，后者首次亮相于2014年的巴黎车展，而这款国际汽联赛事认证的GT3赛车则于2016年首次登上国际赛车舞台。

这辆2020升级款发布于2019年，作为一款面向客户车队出售的赛车，其开发重心是进一步降低维护费用。其改进包括延长了引擎的使用寿命，并通过重新设计车头部分为散热器提供更好的保护，进而降低维护一辆GT3赛车的高昂成本，减轻私人车队的经济压力。

此外，这款车的车身添加了前定风翼和侧翼片，以及在车尾加上了大尺寸尾翼和扩散器，以强化空气动力学效果。设计师还在许多部件上采用了碳纤维材料，尝试进一步减轻车重。

这款车的前格栅下半部分得到了大幅拓宽，前后车灯也进行了更新换代。尽管依然保留了前代型号的独特设计，但诸多细节之处已经根据量产型号的改款而进行了全面更新。

catch.en: Born from touring racing, the ultimate evolution of the 190E.)
catch.zh: 自房车赛而生的190 E终极进化型号。

long.en:
In the early 1980s, Mercedes-Benz decided to return to motorsports after a long absence. The car it developed then was the 190E 2.3-16, based on the compact 190 sedan series, which was unveiled in 1983.

The biggest highlight of the 190E 2.3-16 was its engine, a tuned version of the 2.3-liter SOHC inline-4 that Mercedes-Benz already had in production. A 16-valve DOHC head was added, and the rest of the powerplant was tuned by Cosworth, a company famous for F1 engines. The result was <185ps> maximum output and <23.1kgm> of peak torque.

The 190E 2.3-16 began racing in the Deutsche Tourenwagen Meisterschaft (DTM) in 1986, but in only a matter of a few years, the personality of the car changed dramatically. By 1988, it had evolved into the 190E 2.5-16, equipped with a larger engine to keep pace with its arch-rival, the BMW M3. With displacement increased to 2.5 liters, the engine produced up to <200ps>. The DTM homologation model, known as the 190E 2.5-16 Evolution, began its limited production in 1989.

Then, in 1990, Mercedes-Benz released the 190E 2.5-16 Evolution II, the king of all 190E race machines. Thanks to its menacing appearance, the Evolution II impressed all who laid eyes on it. Large wheel arch extensions were added at the front and rear to accommodate the wide 245/40ZR17 tires, and the trunk sported a spoiler so big that it hung over the rear end.

The engine was further tuned, boosting output up to <235ps> (power was said to exceed <330ps> in the DTM racing version.) A mere 500 of these Evolution IIs were produced during its limited production run. It took the DTM by storm in 1992 where it defeated many of its rivals, proving to all that it was the ultimate 190E, created in the competitive world of touring car racing.
long.zh:
在二十世纪八十年代早期，梅赛德斯-奔驰决定在长期缺席之后重返赛车运动领域。为此，他们基于紧凑型190系列开发了一款跑车型号，也就是190 E 2.3-16，并于1983年正式向外界公布。
2.3-16最大的亮点就是专为它配备的引擎。这款全新引擎基于梅赛德斯已经量产的2.3升顶置单凸轮轴直列四缸引擎所开发，添加了16阀门双凸轮轴，并交由以调校F1引擎而闻名的考斯沃斯公司调校，其动力总成可以达到<185ps>的最大输出和<23.1kgm>的最大扭矩。
搭载着这部引擎，190 E 2.3-16从1986年起开始参加德国房车大师赛，但很快也被动陷入了无限升级迭代的命运中。到了1988年，这款车已经升级到了190 E 2.5-16，并且为了击败宿敌宝马M3而换上了更大排量的引擎。在排量提升到2.5升之后，新款引擎现在可以输出<200ps>的动力。另外一款德国房车大师赛赛事认证型号190 E 2.5-16 Evolution于1989年开始限量生产。
到了1990年，梅赛德斯又推出了2.5-16的终极车型：190 E 2.5-16 Evolution II。仅凭外观，Evolution II就惊艳了所有人。为了容纳宽大的245/40 ZR17轮胎，前后轮的轮拱都进行了大量外扩，架在后备箱上的巨大尾翼甚至探出了车身。
这款引擎经过了进一步调校，将动力输出拉高到了<235ps>（其德国房车大师赛赛车版本的动力据说超过了<330ps>）。限量生产的Evolution II总共只制造了500辆，却在1992年如暴风骤雨一般席卷了德国房车大师赛的赛场。在与强大对手的对决中，它以优异的表现证明自己不愧终极之名，是在房车赛中千锤百炼铸造出的传奇。

cars.nameZh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰190 E 2.5-16 Evolution II '91

catch.en: This legendary race car put AMG on the map after its class victory at the 1971 24 Hours of Spa.
catch.zh: 这辆传奇赛车在1971年斯帕24小时耐力赛中赢得了所在组别的冠军，打响了AMG的名声。

long.en:
AMG began as a company that designed and tested race engines, founded by two engineers from Daimler-Benz’s development department. The company created this Mercedes-Benz 300 SEL 6.8 AMG for touring car races.

The stock 300 SEL 6.3 was powered by a 6.3-liter V-8. The car was plenty fast, but AMG decided to push the envelope even further by increasing the engine's displacement to 6.8 liters, adding special cams and other dedicated parts developed in-house to raise output from <250ps> to <428ps>. In 1971, the car won its class in the 1971 Spa Francorchamps 24 Hour race, and came in 2nd place overall.

It is said that only a total of three race cars and two test cars were ever produced.
long.zh:
梅赛德斯-奔驰300 SEL 6.8 AMG是AMG早年生产的一款竞速房车。

这是一家由两名来自戴姆勒-奔驰研发部的工程师在1967年创立的机械工程公司。这款车采用一台W100 Type 600的6.3升V8引擎，被装进了W109 Type 300 SEL原本搭载3升直列6缸引擎的引擎舱。它在1971年的斯帕弗朗科尔尚24小时耐力赛赢得分组冠军，总成绩排名第2。它优异的表现抓住了梅赛德斯车迷的心，也让这家公司走上正轨，日后更是成为梅赛德斯的厂队和竞速赛事官方合作伙伴。

它的基础车型梅赛德斯-奔驰300 SEL 6.3本身就以速度见长，而AMG把排量又进一步提高到了6.8升，还增加了特制的凸轮和其他自制零件，马力从<250ps>提升至了<428ps>。

据说，这款车总共只生产了3台赛车和2台测试车。

cars.nameZh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰300 SEL 6.8 AMG '71

catch.en: The car that brought Mercedes-Benz its first victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.+
catch.zh: 这款车为Mercedes-Benz带来了勒芒24小时耐力赛有史以来的首胜。

long.en:
To many, the 300 SL name represents Mercedes-Benz's classic sports coupe that first appeared in 1954, but the 300 SL moniker actually originated with a prototype race car built by the company for its factory team.

Codenamed W194, the 300 SL race car featured an aluminum tube frame and improved versions of the engine and suspension from the W186 300. It weighed just <870kg>, and the inline-6 was tuned to produce <172.4ps>.

This very car, chassis number 194007/52, went out and won the 1952 24 Hours of Le Mans on its debut race, then two months later, after having its roof removed to cut <100kg> from its racing weight, took the checkered flag at the 24 Hours of Nürburgring.

Naturally, its success on the race track convinced the execs at Mercedes-Benz to create a production version, which we now know as the "Gullwing 300 SL."
long.zh:
虽然对许多人来说，300SL令人想起的是梅赛德斯在1954年首次亮相的历史悠久、优雅的量产跑车形象，但这个名字最初属于为车厂车队制造的原型赛车。

300SL赛车的开发代号为W194，它采用了铝管框架和铝制车身板件，搭配来自W186 300的改进版引擎和悬挂。这台车的重量仅有<870kg>，直列6缸引擎经过调校后可产生<172.4ps>，用于参加勒芒24小时耐力赛。

这辆底盘编号为194007/52的汽车在1952年勒芒24小时耐力赛上首次亮相便为梅赛德斯-奔驰取得了惊人的胜利。2个月后，这辆车在纽博格林赛道上再获成功。在参赛前，该车的车身再次修改，切掉了车顶，形成了蜘蛛状的车身，将重量又减轻了<100kg>。

赛场上的成功因为促成了对量产车型的大量需求，公路版车款的开发就此启动。

catch.en: With its gullwing doors and other advanced technologies, the 1954 Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupe was a car way ahead of its time.
catch.zh: 一台领先时代的鸥翼双门轿车，许多现代跑车的鼻祖。

long.en:
At the 1955 New York International Auto Show, Daimler-Benz unveiled an innovative new sports car—the Mercedes-Benz 300 SL. Its engine was mounted longitudinally within a lightweight multi-tubular space frame crafted from slender steel pipes, and tilted at a 50-degree angle to allow for the lowest possible hood line. Equipped with a 4-speed transmission, this high-performance machine was capable of reaching speeds of up to <260km/h>.

The car’s most distinctive features were its unique side doors. They opened upward and were hinged at the center of the roof. When both doors were raised, the car’s silhouette resembled a seagull in flight—earning the 300 SL’s doors the famous moniker, "gullwing."

Power came from a <2996cc> SOHC inline-6 engine, the first production engine to employ the same mechanical fuel injection system used in the W196 Formula 1 racer. This setup produced an impressive <215ps> at <5800rpm>. Although its 4-wheel drum brakes and <1295kg> curb weight were considerable for the time, the car’s exceptional engine performance made it one of the preeminent sports cars of its era. The production 300 SL proved its worth on the track as well, securing numerous victories in sports-car racing.

Between 1955 and 1957, 1,400 300 SL gullwing coupes were built. In 1957, production of the coupe ended, passing the torch to the 300 SL Roadster, an open-top successor that continued the legacy of one of Mercedes-Benz’s most iconic creations.
long.zh:
在1954年的纽约国际车展上，戴姆勒-奔驰公布了一款创新跑车梅赛德斯-奔驰300 SL。它的引擎纵向安装在细钢管制成的多管式空间车架中，为了尽可能降低引擎盖高度，安装角度被调整为了斜向50度。它采用4速变速箱，是一款极速能够达到<260km/h>的高性能车型。

这款车最标志性的特色是向上开启到车顶的侧门。两侧门打开后，从正面看像极了一只海鸥，因此300 SL的车门又被叫做鸥翼门。

这辆车采用<2996cc>顶置单凸轮轴直列6缸引擎，并且首次把W 196赛车的机械式燃油喷射系统下放到量产车型上。得益于这些技术，它的最大输出达到了<5800rpm>时的<215ps>马力。它的刹车系统采用了四轮鼓式刹车。整车重量为<1295kg>，与同时代车型相比并不算轻，但由于搭载了最高级别的引擎，它依然是那个年代最顶级的跑车之一。量产版的300 SL在汽车赛事中的表现同样可圈可点，多次为梅赛德斯赢得胜利。

从1955年到1957年，300 SL鸥翼双门跑车一共生产了1400台。1957年起，这款双门跑车停止生产，交棒300 SL Roadster。后者是一款中规中矩的敞篷车。

cars.nameZh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰300 SL Coupé '54

catch.en: The ultimate hot hatch based on the third-generation A Class.)
catch.zh: 第三代A-Class中的终极高性能小钢炮。

long.en:
Completely rebuilt and redesigned from the ground up, the third-generation Mercedes-Benz A Class bowed at the 2012 Geneva Motor Show, possessing a low, wide stance that made it look much sportier than the somewhat tame previous-generation model.

To go along with its dashing exterior, Mercedes-Benz upgraded the new A Class’ on-road performance. It came powered by a peppy turbocharged 1.6-liter inline-4 that delivered <122ps>/<20.4kgm>, but the choice for driving enthusiasts was the upgrade turbocharged 2.0-liter engine that pumped out an impressive <210ps>/<35.7kgm>. The new A Class also boasted an enhanced chassis, featuring a much more rigid body structure and stiffer suspension system.

A year after the introduction of the new A Class, Mercedes-Benz unveiled the A45 AMG, a creation that brought out the true sporty potential of the small passenger vehicle. AMG went straight to work on the upgrade 2.0-liter inline-4, and without increasing displacement, was able to squeeze an amazing <360ps>/<45.9kgm> out of it. They also mated it to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. This allowed the new A45 AMG to run to <100km/h> in a scant 4.6 seconds and reach a top speed of <250km/h> (restricted by a speed limiter).

AMG also did their magic on the vehicle’s suspension and brakes, giving it sports car-like handling, while also installing the newest version of the “4Matic” Mercedes 4WD system, which can distribute power from 50:0 front/rear (full front-wheel-drive) to 50/50.

It was clear that the A Class, especially the AMG version, was no longer a daily people hauler, it was now essentially a 5-door sports car.
long.zh:
梅赛德斯-奔驰A级在2012年日内瓦车展上进行了全面更新，升级到第三代车型。新款车没有沿袭其前代的家用式高掀背设计，而是改成了更宽、更低、具有跑车外形的5门掀背式设计，以符合年轻人的品味。

让这款车具有跑车感的不仅仅是其外观：结实的车身可以和更高一级别的车款相媲美，同时还配备有1.6升或2升的直4涡轮增压引擎。其基本款车型可以提供<122ps>/<20.4kgm>的动力，而高级别车型可以输出更高的<210ps>/<35.7kgm>动力。所有车型的悬挂都进行了加硬，使其更适合运动驾驶的体验。

在日内瓦车展首次亮相的一年之后，第三代A级迎来了一款更能够彰显运动风范的车型，那就是A45 AMG。这款车的引擎同样采用高级别的2升涡轮增压引擎，并由AMG进行调校。在排量不变的情况下，引擎可以输出高达<360ps>/<45.9kgm>的强悍动力。0-<100km/h>的加速时间仅需4.6秒，而最高时速可达<250km/h>（超过后，限速器将介入），显示出远超其级别的性能。

当然，这款车的悬挂和刹车也得到了进一步的加强，不过更可圈可点的是其在驱动系统上的升级。这辆车采用最新版本的“4Matic”梅赛德斯四轮驱动系统，与7档双离合变速箱配合，并安装在后轴上，可将前轮驱动系统的驱动力进行线性调整，最多可分配为前后比50：50。

在这款终极的高性能小钢炮身上，没有任何缺陷。

catch.en: The start of something very special: The very first "Vision Gran Turismo."
catch.zh: 体验精致的概念跑车。Vision Gran Turismo的头号车型。

long.en:
Vision Gran Turismo is a project in which the world's auto makers and global brands develop a concept car for the fans of "Gran Turismo". The car that crowns the opening of this innovative collaboration is the Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo.

The design team of Mercedes-Benz incorporated the image of a large cat on the hunt, incorporating both agility and graceful elegance in the design. The characteristic body with its sensual contours is reminiscent of traditional Mercedes-Benz sports car proportions. Even the shape of the front grille is a reinterpretation of the wide Mercedes-Benz sports car grille with central star. Its shape is reminiscent of the legendary 300 SL racing car which won the third Panamericana race, known for being one of the toughest long distance races in the world.

With an aluminum spaceframe body and components in carbon fiber, the material of choice in motor racing, the Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo tips the scales at only <1385kg>. The AMG V8 biturbo engine delivers an exceptionally agile response to even the smallest movements of the accelerator. It develops 430 kW (<585ps>) and a maximum torque of 800 Nm (590.4 ft-lb). With its ultra lightweight body, the weight-to-power ratio calculates to an amazing <2.4kg/ps>. In addition, anyone can experience its breathtaking performance thanks to its AMG SPEEDSHIFT DCT 7-speed sports transmission, which is systematically configured for outstandingly dynamic performance.

The sound of the car is another point to be noted. The powerful howl emitted by this engine was composed by sound specialists at AMG. The sonorous exhaust note and engine sounds are tuned perfectly to awaken the excitement of a racetrack wherever you are.

The double wishbone suspension on the front and rear axles reflects a long-standing racing experience at Mercedes-Benz. The electronic differential lock ensures the ideal traction for the powered rear wheels. The AMG ceramic high-performance compound brake system guarantees excellent deceleration.

Experience for yourself the exquisite concept sports car presented by Mercedes-Benz.
long.zh:
跑车浪漫旅愿景是一个联合全世界汽车制造商和品牌为跑车浪漫旅的玩家群体共同打造一款概念赛车的计划。为这次创举般的合作打响第一炮的就是梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo。

梅赛德斯-奔驰的设计团队在这辆车的形象中注入了狩猎中的猫科动物所表现出的敏捷性和优雅姿态。极富性格的车身和流畅的轮廓会让人回想起梅赛德斯-奔驰经典的跑车比例。中央嵌入三角星车标的前进气格栅同样是对梅赛德斯-奔驰跑车宽大进气格栅风格的重新演绎。这款车的外形让人回忆起一代传奇赛车300 SL。在1952年，这辆车曾经在世界上最困难的长距离比赛之一的第三届Carrera泛美公路拉力赛上夺冠。

梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo使用了赛车专属的铝制框架车身和大量碳纤维部件，因此重量仅为<1385kg>。其使用的AMG V8双涡轮增压引擎输出430千瓦（<585ps>）的功率，拥有82公斤力米的最大扭矩，可以对油门任何轻微的动作做出极其灵敏的反应。超轻量车身使得重量马力比达到了惊人的<2.4kg/ps>。此外，AMG SPEEDSHIFT DCT 7档运动变速箱可以让每一个人都能轻松体验它的超强性能，这套变速箱经过了系统化的配置，可以提供非常优秀的动力性能。

这款车的声音是它的另一大特色。引擎发出的强有力的咆哮声由AMG的声音专家专门打造。排气声和发动机的轰鸣声也同样经过精心调校，不论身在何处，都可以带给你身处赛道的兴奋感。

前后轴处安装的双横臂悬挂系统反映出梅赛德斯-奔驰对极致赛车体验的不懈追求。电子差速锁确保提供动力驱助的后轮可廥莶得理想的牵引力。AMG的高性都陶瓷复合刹车系统可亥徝诀完美的减速。

说了这么多，你还是亲身体验乀下梅赛德斯-奔驰推出的这款精美概念跐车吧。_

cars.nameZh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo

catch.en: This race-focused Vision Gran Turismo machine was developed by Mercedes-Benz.!
catch.zh: 又一款可以立即投入比赛的Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo车型。

long.en:
”Vision Gran Turismo” is a special project where leading international brands develop concept cars for Gran Turismo and its fans. And the car which kicked everything off with was the “Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo," that first made its appearance in November 2013.

The Mercedes-Benz design team created a sensual gull-winged sports car designed in the image of a hunting feline. The car is elegance personified, infusing elements that reflect the 130-year legacy of Mercedes-Benz with futuristic sports design cues such as the LED front grille, an ultra lightweight body and an exhaust system that is integrated with the taillights.

There is also a separate version that is optimized for the competitive racing in Gran Turismo called the “Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo LH Edition," which is distinguished by a fixed rear wing that provides gobs of downforce on fast straights. The CCD camera side mirrors were returned to conventional mirrors, while the brake lights are adorned with the “Gran Turismo” logo.

For the race car, output for AMG's twin-turbocharged 5.5-liter V-8 was raised to <600ps>, and the 7-speed dual-clutch transmission was optimized for fast gear changes, featuring sequential shifting with dog links. And while the road car tips the scales at a lean <1385kg>, the race car comes in at a fighting <1300kg>, thanks to the removal of all creature comforts. Also, thanks to a lower seating position, the car's center of gravity was improved for superior circuit performance.

Whichever version you happen to choose, one thing for certain is that the “Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo" represents a balance of ultimate elegance and competitive performance.
long.zh:
跑车浪漫旅愿景是各家国际顶级汽车品牌为跑车浪漫旅及其粉丝开发概念赛车型的梦幻计划。这项计划以2013年11月闪亮登场的梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo拉开序幕。

这款奔驰团队的杰作是一台充满感官刺激的鸥翼跑车，灵感来自狩猎的猫科动物。它是优雅的化身，完美融合了各种元素，既体现出了梅赛德斯奔驰百年历史的厚重，又有LED前格栅、超轻型车身以及与尾灯集成一体的排气系统等未来风超跑设计。

该型号还有一个优化版本，单独针对跑车浪漫旅的竞赛场景进行了优化，这就是梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo LH版。

后视镜是该版本与原始版本的外观区别之一。原始版本采用了CCD摄像机，而优化版本则使用了常规的后视镜。在刹车灯设计当中还俏皮地加入了跑车浪漫旅的徽标。

优化版本的特性包括极限的比例、性感的轮廓和更精确的图形，共同形成了激动人心的车身造型。AMG出品的5.5升双涡轮V8电机的动力输出被提高至<600ps>，针对传动性能优化，放弃了部分驾驶舒适性的7速双离合器变速箱被换成了使用止转杆的序列式变速箱。虽然原版的车重已经降到了<1385kg>，但优化版本在舍弃了实用性和舒适性配置后，将重量进一步减轻至<1300kg>。离地间隙和重心再一次降低，以提高赛道表现。

在呈现极致优雅与竞技性能的完美平衡的同时，这款梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo时刻准备着扑向猎物。

catch.en: Another "Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo" ready for competitive racing.!
catch.zh: 又一款可以立即投入比赛的Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo车型。

long.en:
”Vision Gran Turismo” is a dream project in which leading international brands develop concept cars for Gran Turismo and its fans. And the car which kicked off the project with its stunning debut in November 2013, was the “Mercedes Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo”.

The creation by the Mercedes-Benz design team is a sensual gull-winged sports car designed in the image of a hunting feline. The car is elegance personified, infusing elements that show the 130-year legacy of Mercedes Benz perfectly with futuristic sports designs such as the LED front grille, an ultra lightweight body and an exhaust system that is integrated with the tail lights.

And for the “Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo”, there is also a separate version that is optimized for the competitive racing scene of Gran Turismo. This is the “Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo Racing Series”.

The immediately noticeable difference with the original version is the fixed rear wing. Despite the increase in drag this creates, the aerodynamic device was utilized in favor of more downforce on high speed circuits. The side mirrors using CCD cameras were returned to conventional mirrors, and the rear brake light is decorated with the “Gran Turismo” logo for a touch of racing flavor.

And of course the non-visible elements have also been stepped up. The AMG 5.5 liter V8 Twin Turbo has been raised to <600ps>, and the 7 speed dual clutch transmission has been optimized for transmission performance rather than ride comfort; now changed to a sequential transmission with dog links. Though the original is already extremely light at <1385kg>, equipment for utility and comfort have been omitted to reduce the weight down to <1300kg>. Lowering the ride height even further, the center of gravity has also been lowered for better circuit performance.

The balance of ultimate elegance and competitive performance. This is another breed of the “Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo”, waiting to pounce on its prey.
long.zh:
”跑车浪漫旅愿景“是一项由全球顶级汽车制造商为跑车浪漫旅和其粉丝开发概念赛车的梦幻计划。在2013年11月惊艳亮相，为这个计划揭开大幕的便是梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo。

这件来自梅赛德斯-奔驰设计团队的杰出作品是一辆充满感官刺激的、带有鸥翼式车门的跑车，其外形仿佛是一只正在捕猎的猫科动物。这辆车就是优雅的代名词，将梅赛德斯-奔驰百年历史的元素和未来跑车设计完美融合在一起，包括LED前进气格栅、超轻量车身，以及与尾灯一体的排气系统。

除了此型号之外，这辆车还有另外一个专为跑车浪漫旅的赛车竞技目的而优化的版本。那就是“梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo赛车系列”。

其与原始版本最为显著的区别在于固定尾翼。虽然这个设计会增加风阻，但是该空气动力学装置却可以用来在高速赛道上获得更大的下压力。外后视镜也有别于传统后视镜，使用了CCD摄像机，而后刹车灯也加上了跑车浪漫旅标志装饰，平添了一份赛车风味。

对这辆车的强化并不止于此，还有极限设计的比例、充满感官冲击的外廓以及精致的图案，这一切结合起来，形成了一套独特的车身，让人一眼就能看出这辆车的卓越性能。这辆车的AMG 5.5升V8双涡轮增压引擎的输出功率被提升到了<600ps>，之前针对传动性能优化的7档双离合变速箱忽略了驾驶舒适度，因此这次也被替换成了带有止转杆的序列变速箱。虽然原始版本已经非常轻了，仅有<1385kg>，但该款车在移除众多功能性和舒适性设备后，将重量进一步缩减至仆<1300kg>。䏦夗，由于驾驶座的高度得到进帀步降低，重心也相应阍弎令实现更卓越的赛道性能。

这辆车简直就是极膴优雅和竞技性能的完美平衡。它是另一槍类型的梅赛德斯-奕驰AMG Vision Gran Ttrislo，筤刻正虎觇眉眈，准备猛我呑嬃的猎爩。
