catch.en: Making the switch from a heavy V12 engine to a lighter V8 helped this Mercedes-Benz dominate the FIA GT championship.
catch.zh: 用V8引擎取代了沉重的V12引擎，这是一辆在FIA GT比赛中获得压倒性优势的赛车。

long.en:
The Mercedes-Benz CLK-GTR was created to compete in the ITC (International Touring Car Championship) after it replaced the FIA GT Championships in 1997. Developed in just 128 days by the company's motorsports and tuning division, AMG, the CLK-GTR got off to a somewhat rocky start in its race career, but rebounded quickly, winning six out of its first 11 races, claiming both the drivers' title and the constructor's championship in its first season.

The following year saw a new, evolved version of the car called the CLK-LM. The most noticeable change was the engine. Replacing the V-12 was a new V-8 that made the car lighter and enhanced its longitudinal balance. The radiator was moved from the front of the car to the sides so a lower hood could be implemented, thus improving the car's aerodynamics, while a new pushrod-type suspension gave it superior handling performance.

The CLK-LM made its debut at the 1998 Le Mans 24-hour race. While it failed to win that race, it did dominate every race of the FIA GT series, claiming the series championships with Klaus Ludwig and Ricardo Zonta at the wheel.
long.zh:
为了参加1997年创立的国际汽联-GT锦标赛，戴姆勒克莱斯勒和AMG联手在短短128天里就打造出了一台比赛机器。这便是梅赛德斯-奔驰CLK GTR。除了前格栅取自CLK外，其他部分都变成了纯粹的比赛机器。车架由碳纤维复合单体车壳和钢制防滚架组成，车身顶部加入了巨大的进气口。

居中放置在驾驶座后部的是一台<5000cc>V12引擎，马力输出达到<600ps>。尽管缺乏足够的测试，CLK GTR依然在参赛的首个赛季里拿下了11场比赛中的6次胜利，帮助贝恩德·施奈德摘得赛事冠军。

但保时捷很快就在1998赛季推出了911 GT1，两款车型的龙争虎斗就此展开。为了应对强大的对手，除了派出两台厂队赛车之外，梅赛德斯还为私人车队提供了两辆CLK GTR，以此提高赛道竞争力。

在勒芒24小时耐力赛中，他们则派出CLK GTR的后继车型CLK LM参赛。LM和GTR的最大区别在于引擎：后者的V12引擎被重量更轻的V8引擎所取代。此外，散热器被移动到了侧面，车身经过重新设计，悬挂也改为了连杆式，使其操控特性更接近方程式赛车。

虽然CLK LM最终未能在勒芒完赛，却摇身一变成为了国际汽联GT锦标赛的厂队用车。GTR和LM联手在98赛季取得了10战10胜的完美表现。其中克劳斯·路德维希和里卡多·宗塔的组合拿下5胜。

catch.en: This very unqiue sports car was the first from Mercedes-Benz and is known for its characteristic boat tail styling.
catch.zh: 最古早的Mercedes跑车，拥有优美的收敛式车尾。

long.en:
Produced from 1927 to 1933, the Model S is considered the first sports car produced by Mercedes Benz. Designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche, the Model S chassis boasted much improved performance than that of its predecessor, the Model K. Powering the car was a supercharged 7.0-liter inline-6 that produced <180ps>, which was quite high in its day.

This Model S shown here won the Best of Show and the Gran Turismo Trophy at the 2017 Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance. Nicknamed the "Barker Tourer," this car was a one-off and remains very valuable. It was first owned by Earl Howe, a decorated racing driver who won both the Mille Miglia and the 24 Hours of Le Mans and was a co-founder of the British Racing Driver’s Club. He commissioned Barker, a British coachbuilder founded in 1710, to build him a lightweight tourer body with a boat-tail design, and the company delivered him the beauty you see here.
long.zh:
在1927年到1933年期间投产的Type S可以说是梅赛德斯奔驰的第一款跑车。

由费迪南德·保时捷博士设计的底盘表现出卓越的驾驶性能。与可以算是前辈的Modell K相比，它在重心和重量平衡方面都有着更优异的表现。Type S搭载的是一台7升直列6缸机械增压引擎，可输出180ps的动力，就当时而言性能相当强劲。

在2017年的加州卵石湾汽车巡展上，一台拥有标志性车身的梅赛德斯奔驰 Type S不仅荣获了最佳巡展奖，还赢得了GT奖杯。这辆车便是“Barker Tourer”。

Barker Tourer的第一任车主是豪威伯爵，一位功勋卓著的赛车手，曾获得一千英里拉力赛和勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军，他也是英国赛车手俱乐部的创始人之一。他委托成立于1710年的英国车身制造商“Barker”为他的Type S打造了一款采用收敛式车尾设计的轻型旅行车车身。

这是一台极其珍贵的车型，全球仅此一辆。

cars.nameZh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰S Barker Tourer '29

catch.en: The already aggressive-looking SLR McLaren looked even more ominous with optional 19-inch wheels.
catch.zh: 造型更具攻击性的SLR车型，可选19寸轮毂。

long.en:
The concept version of the Mercedes-Benz Vision SLR was unveiled at the North American International Auto Show in Detroit in 1999. It was the talk of the town, and everyone wondered if Mercedes-Benz was indeed going to build this supercar. The answer came at the 2003 Frankfurt Motor Show when a production version of the car was displayed. As the name suggests, the Mercedes-Benz SLR McLaren was built alongside McLaren Automotive of Formula 1 fame.

The SLR McLaren was a supercar of the highest order. It featured a carbon-fiber unitized body, ensuring low weight, which, by the way, was a lean <1768kg>, more than <200kg> lighter than the SL 55 AMG. Under its hood sat a supercharged 5.5-liter V8 with dry-sump lubrication that produced a whopping <625ps> at <6500 rpm> and <79.6kgm> of torque from <3250 rpm> to <5000 rpm>. The SLR had the same 5-speed automatic that the SL used, but added sport, comfort and manual settings.

The brakes featured SBC (Sensotronic Brake Control), a brake-by-wire system, with carbon-ceramic discs at all four corners. The front calipers were 8-pot Brembos while the rears, also Brembo, had 4 pots. The suspension system consisted of double wishbones at all four corners.

The SLR boasted an amazing weight-to-power ratio of <2.8kg/ps>, which allowed the car to accelerate from zero to <100km/h> in 3.8 seconds. Top speed: a cool <334 km/h>.
long.zh:
梅赛德斯-奔驰愿景SLR的首次亮相是在1999年的北美国际车展上，立即攫取了所有人的目光。但直到2003年的法兰克福车展，它的量产版本才姗姗来迟。

这款车的官方名称是梅赛德斯-奔驰SLR迈凯伦，由著名的英国F1车厂迈凯伦负责打造。SLR最令人瞩目的特色是一套全碳材质的单体车壳，其他部位也都尽可能地用上了碳纤维，只有引擎舱室用了铝材质，最终将车重降到了<1768kg>，比SL55AMG足足轻了<200kg>。

SLR的动力单元是一台接受过AMG部门调校的5.5升顶置单凸轮轴双涡轮增压V8引擎，最大动力输出为<6500rpm>下的<625ps>，最大扭矩为<3250rpm>到<5000rpm>之间的<79.6kgm>。传动系统方面，SLR配置了SL同款5速自动变速箱，但拥有运动、舒适和手动模式。在手动模式下还能够自定换挡速度。

刹车系统毫无疑问是来自戴姆勒的电子感应制动控制系统，刹车盘全部是纤维增强陶瓷材质。前后刹车分别为布雷博的8活塞卡钳和4活塞卡钳，前后悬挂则采用了传统的双叉臂机械悬挂。

SLR的重量马力比达到了令人难以想象的<2.8kg/ps>。据官方数据宣称，这台车从0加速到<100km/h>仅需要3.8秒，最高时速可达<334km/h>。另一方面，这台SLR迈凯伦的价格也同样令人咋舌。德国本土售价高达43.5万欧元，在英国的售价则为33万英镑。

catch.en: With the SLS AMG, Mercedes-Benz recreates the 300 SL for the modern era.
catch.zh: 体现Mercedes历史和驾驶天赋的超跑。

long.en:
The SLS AMG, with gull wing doors that paid homage to the classic 300 SL, bowed at the 2009 Frankfurt Motor Show. This exotic sports car, built from the ground up by AMG, made its debut in Japan in September of the same year, but not at an auto show or a Mercedes-Benz dealership; rather, it was featured in the "Gran Turismo" booth at the Tokyo Game Show.

Many considered the SLS AMG to be the successor of the SLR McLaren, but the body structure of the two cars were quite different. The SLS AMG did away with the costly carbon monocoque body of the SLR McLaren and instead came with an all-aluminum platform. The sacrifice in weight savings was nominal as the aluminum monocoque frame weighed only <241kg>, allowing the SLS AMG to tip the scales at a lean <1600kg>. This is quite impressive for a car that stretches more than <4600mm> from front to rear.

Mounted just aft of the front axle was a new 6.3-liter V8 with dry-sump lubrication, dubbed internally as the M159. It produced <571ps>/<6800rpm> with a peak torque of <66.3kgm>/<4750rpm>, and came mated to a newly developed 7-speed DCT (dual clutch transmission) in a trans-axle layout. Of note, the driveshaft and torque tube were composed of carbon fiber.

The car featured five driving modes: "Comfort," "Sports," "Sports Plus," "Manual," and "Launch Start." Mercedes-Benz claimed that the SLS AMG could sprint from zero to <100km/h> in 3.8 seconds, and reach a top speed of <317km/h>. Thanks to a front/rear weight distribution of 47:53 and a sport-tuned suspension, the SLS AMG could handle with the best of them. Fifty years after the first 300 SL rolled off the line, the SLS AMG marks the rebirth of M-B's ultimate sports car, one graced with elegant styling and great performance.
long.zh:
SLS AMG是在2009年法兰克福车展上粉墨登场的超级跑车，保留了300 SL那令人怀念的经典鸥翼式车门，并由AMG全新设计。这款车于同年9月首次在日本进行了展示，但并不是在车展上，而是在东京电玩展的跑车浪漫旅展位上。

大多数人以为这款车是SLR迈凯伦的后继车型，但其实两款车的车身结构有着很大的差异。在SLS AMG上，高成本的碳纤维单体壳车身遭到了弃用，而是改用全新的全铝车身；单体壳的重量仅为<241kg>。这款车总重量仅仅略超过<1600kg>，对于一款长度超过<4600mm>、使用V8引擎的车来说，这真的是非常轻了。

该车使用全新的6.3升V8干式油底壳润滑前置引擎，这具引擎在公司内部被命名为M159。其在<6800rpm>转速下的最大输出为<571ps>，在<4750rpm>转速下的最大扭矩为<66.3kgm>，变速箱则采用新开发的驱动桥布局7档双离合变速箱，传动轴和扭矩管均使用碳纤维制成。

驾驶模式可分为舒适、运动、运动+、手动起步、或弹射起步。制造商公布的0-<100km/h>加速时间仅需3.8秒，最大时速为<317km/h>。静态配重比优化为47:53，使其拥有极佳的操控性能，不负超跑之名。在第一款300 SL诞生的50年后，SLS AMG将梅赛德斯跑车的历史和AMG的基因完美地融合在一起。|

catch.en: This race car version of Mercedes-Benz's supercar was tailored to FIA GT3 regulations.
catch.zh: Mercedes专为FIA GT3规则打造的超跑。

long.en:
In 2009, the Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG was introduced at the Frankfurt Motor Show.

This supercar was developed independently by AMG, the high-performance development arm of Mercedes-Benz also responsible for the company's motorsports activities. The car sparked a worldwide sensation, thanks to its incredible high performance and gull winged doors that were reminiscent of the historic 300SL.

Mounted front amidships within the all-aluminum space frame was the M159, a tuned 6.2-liter V8 based on the AMG 63 series engine. Producing <571ps>/<66.3kgm> of torque, and combined with a Getrag 7-speed DCT, it went 0-<100km/h> in 3.8 seconds and hit a top speed of <317km/h>.

The SLS AMG GT3 was a racing car based on this SLS AMG, modified to comply with FIA-GT3 regulations. The front and rear bumpers and side sills have been modified and an adjustable wing was added in the rear. The front/rear fenders were widened, and a cooling duct was incorporated to the hood. Aside from being fully functional, the styling is notably more aggressive. Its engine is shared with the production SLS, but although there are no official figures, it is said to have been massaged to exceed <600ps>.

The transmission was swapped for a racing-style 6-speed sequential gearbox with paddle shifters. Composite brakes were fitted with a competition-level ABS, the steering was made direct ratio, and the car was given a special adjustable suspension.

This machine competed from the beginning of 2011, and out of the 101 races it contested, it won 25 times.
long.zh:
在2009年法兰克福车展上首次亮相的梅赛德斯-奔驰SLS AMG是一款由梅赛德斯-奔驰的高性能车及赛车运动部门AMG独立开发的超级跑车。

这款车一经亮相，立刻受到了全球瞩目。它的鸥翼式车门让人立即回忆起声名显赫的300 SL。此外，其性能也能媲美其意大利竞争对手。

这款车采用中前置引擎布局，将一具基于AMG 63系列引擎全新开发的6.2升V8引擎M159置于全铝车架上。这具引擎可以输出<571ps>和<66.3kgm>的扭矩，搭配格特拉克 7档双离合变速箱，可以在3.8秒内完成0-<100km/h>的加速，最高时速可达<317km/h>。

SLS AMG GT3是基于这款SLS AMG开发的竞速版，并根据国际汽联GT3规范进行了调整。

其前后保险杆和侧梁被修改为更符合空气动力学的设计，并在后部加上了一副可调尾翼。前后翼也都进行了加宽，并在引擎盖上增加了一条冷却道。除了功能上的优化之外，这款车的造型看上去也明显更加凌厉。这辆车和量产车款采用相同的引擎，虽然官方并未发布任何参数，但据传此引擎经过调校，输出功率超过了<600ps>。

而变速箱则改用带换挡拨片的竞技级6档序列式变速箱。其复合式刹车系统也搭配了竞技级的防抱死刹车系统，而转向则采用1:1转向比，另外还配备了经过特别调校的悬挂系统。

这辆车从2011年开始参加比赛，在当年参加的总共101场比赛中赢得了25场胜利。

cars.nameZh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰SLS AMG GT3 '11

catch.en: With the SLS AMG, Mercedes-Benz recreates the 300 SL for the modern era.
catch.zh: 体现Mercedes历史和驾驶天赋的超跑。

long.en:
The SLS AMG, with gull wing doors that paid homage to the classic 300 SL, bowed at the 2009 Frankfurt Motor Show. This exotic sports car, built from the ground up by AMG, made its debut in Japan in September of the same year, but not at an auto show or a Mercedes-Benz dealership; rather, it was featured in the "Gran Turismo" booth at the Tokyo Game Show.

Many considered the SLS AMG to be the successor of the SLR McLaren, but the body structure of the two cars were quite different. The SLS AMG did away with the costly carbon monocoque body of the SLR McLaren and instead came with an all-aluminum platform. The sacrifice in weight savings was nominal as the aluminum monocoque frame weighed only <241kg>, allowing the SLS AMG to tip the scales at a lean <1600kg>. This is quite impressive for a car that stretches more than <4600mm> from front to rear.

Mounted just aft of the front axle was a new 6.3-liter V8 with dry-sump lubrication, dubbed internally as the M159. It produced <571ps>/<6800rpm> with a peak torque of <66.3kgm>/<4750rpm>, and came mated to a newly developed 7-speed DCT (dual clutch transmission) in a trans-axle layout. Of note, the driveshaft and torque tube were composed of carbon fiber.

The car featured five driving modes: "Comfort," "Sports," "Sports Plus," "Manual," and "Launch Start." Mercedes-Benz claimed that the SLS AMG could sprint from zero to <100km/h> in 3.8 seconds, and reach a top speed of <317km/h>. Thanks to a front/rear weight distribution of 47:53 and a sport-tuned suspension, the SLS AMG could handle with the best of them. Fifty years after the first 300 SL rolled off the line, the SLS AMG marks the rebirth of M-B's ultimate sports car, one graced with elegant styling and great performance.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
long.zh:
SLS AMG是在2009年法兰克福车展上粉墨登场的超级跑车，保留了300 SL那令人怀念的经典鸥翼式车门，并由AMG全新设计。这款车于同年9月首次在日本进行了展示，但并不是在车展上，而是在东京电玩展的跑车浪漫旅展位上。

大多数人以为这款车是SLR迈凯伦的后继车型，但其实两款车的车身结构有着很大的差异。在SLS AMG上，高成本的碳纤维单体壳车身遭到了弃用，而是改用全新的全铝车身；单体壳的重量仅为<241kg>。这款车总重量仅仅略超过<1600kg>，对于一款长度超过<4600mm>、使用V8引擎的车来说，这真的是非常轻了。

该车使用全新的6.3升V8干式油底壳润滑前置引擎，这具引擎在公司内部被命名为M159。其在<6800rpm>转速下的最大输出为<571ps>，在<4750rpm>转速下的最大扭矩为<66.3kgm>，变速箱则采用新开发的驱动桥布局7档双离合变速箱，传动轴和扭矩管均使用碳纤维制成。

驾驶模式可分为舒适、运动、运动+、手动起步、或弹射起步。制造商公布的0-<100km/h>加速时间仅需3.8秒，最大时速为<317km/h>。静态配重比优化为47:53，使其拥有极佳的操控性能，不负超跑之名。在第一款300 SL诞生的50年后，SLS AMG将梅赛德斯跑车的历史和AMG的基因完美地融合在一起。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

cars.nameZh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰SLS AMG组别4

catch.en: The benchmark for versatile, high-mobility vehicles.
catch.zh: 多用途高机动性作业车辆的代名词。

long.en:
The Unimog was a commercial truck produced and sold by Daimler Truck. With its ladder frame construction and rugged all-wheel-drive system, the Unimog has become a preferred vehicle in a wide array of industries, such as agriculture, slow ploughing, cleaning, high altitude work, disaster response, logistics, railways, airports, mining, construction and many others. Its long-standing performance record has solidified its status as the ultimate multi-purpose truck.

The Unimog’s story began in 1945, when Albert Friedrich, a former head of Daimler-Benz’s aircraft engine production, conceived the idea for a "universally applicable motorized machine for agriculture." Even from its earliest design stages, the Unimog was envisioned as a vehicle that could perform a wide range of tasks by simply swapping attachments. This versatile, practical approach has led to more than 70 years of loyalty from customers across various fields.

Full-scale production began in 1948. It was originally built by machine tool manufacturer Boehringer, but all production moved over to Daimler-Benz in 1950 where it was modified for mass-production. In 1953, the new 401/402 series core models arrived.

The 411 series, the model that followed the 401/402, was introduced in 1956. It was a developmental upgrade featuring a more powerful engine and reinforced chassis. The lineup offered three distinct wheelbases and multiple body styles, resulting in a total of 12 different models. These could be further customized for specific purposes with various attachments.

This model was available with two cab options: a cabriolet-style cap, designed for added convenience in work environments, or a closed cab crafted by Westfalia. The closed cab was available in two variations: the Type B, which shared design elements with the cabriolet version, and the DvF, which was inspired by Mercedes-Benz truck designs of the 1950s and 1960s. The DvF model could also be equipped with a heater upon request.

Today, the 411 is considered by enthusiasts as the last of the "classic" Unimog models. It continues to enjoy a cult following for its powerful performance, distinctive design, and enduring legacy.
long.zh:
Unimog是由戴姆勒卡车生产和销售的商用卡车。凭借其边梁式车架和强劲、可靠的全时四驱系统，Unimog在农业、慢速犁耕、清洁、高空作业、灾难响应、物流、铁路、航空、矿业、建筑等广泛领域中深受喜爱。其悠久的历史和性能表现巩固了其作为多用途卡车首选的声誉。

Unimog的历史始于1945年，当时戴姆勒-奔驰航空引擎生产部门的前负责人阿尔伯特·弗雷德里希开始构思一款“适用于农业的通用动力机械”。在设计最初阶段，它就已经被设想成一款多用途车辆，可以通过简单更换附件来完成不同的任务。这种理性和经济的创新理念，为其赢得了长达70多年的用户青睐和支持。

这款车的全面生产始于1948年，最初由机床制造商勃林格制造。但在1950年，所有生产转移到戴姆勒-奔驰，并为适应大规模生产进行了持续改进。1953年，401/402新系列的核心车型问世。

经过开发升级的下一代411系列发布于1956年，搭载更强劲的引擎，底盘得到了加强。该系列包含3种不同的轴距和多种车身类型，能组合出共计12种不同的车型，还可通过各种附件进一步定制以适应特定工作需求。

该车型可选择敞篷式驾驶室，方便不同工作环境下使用，也可选择由韦斯伐利亚制造的封闭式驾驶室。封闭式驾驶室也有两种版本：一种是与敞篷式设计相似的Type B，另一种是仿照50年代和60年代梅赛德斯-奔驰卡车设计的DvF型，后者还可以按需装配加热器。

411被车迷奉为“经典”Unimog的绝响，至今仍因其强大的性能和独特的外观而受到追捧。

catch.en: A legendary F1 car that made motorsports history.
catch.zh: 一款在赛车运动上名留青史的传奇F1赛车。

long.en:
The W 196, produced by Mercedes-Benz following its return to motorsports in 1951, was developed in response to the new 2.5-liter engine regulations introduced by Formula 1 in 1954. This groundbreaking car was crafted alongside a sports-car racer that shared many of the same core components. Both cars went on to achieve significant success in their respective fields, with the W 196 R dominating Formula 1 and the W 196 S excelling in sports-car racing.

The W 196 featured a tubular steel space frame chassis and made its debut at the 1954 French Grand Prix, equipped with a streamlined body that enclosed both the front and rear wheels in an aerodynamic shell. While the design provided successful on fast circuits, it became evident after the British Grand Prix that it obstructed the driver’s visibility and required frequent maintenance. As a result, from the German Grand Prix onwards, the car ran with an open-wheel body style, reserving the streamlined version for high-speed tracks.

In total, the W 196 was available in seven distinct configurations, featuring three different wheelbase lengths, two types of brakes, and two engine positions.

Powering the W 196 was an inline-8, constructed as two banks of four cylinders aligned longitudinally. This powerplant produced an impressive <290ps> from its <2496cc> displacement, enabling the car to reach a top speed of <290km/h>.

The W 196 cemented its place in racing history by dominating the 1954 and 1955 Formula 1 World Championships, securing back-to-back Drivers' Championships for the legendary Juan Manuel Fangio.
long.zh:
梅赛德斯-奔驰在1951年重返赛车界后，基于世界一级方程式在1954年规定的2.5升引擎开发出W 196。它与另一款竞速跑车车型同步开发，二者使用相同的基本组件： W 196 R参加世界一级方程式，而W 196 S则负责参加跑车比赛，两款车在各自领域都取得了成功。

这款赛车拥有基于钢制管状空间架构的底盘以及覆盖前后轮的空气动力学流线型车身，并于1954年在法国大奖赛首次亮相。然而，在之后的英国大奖赛中，人们发现这种车身设计会阻碍车手的视线，且需要频繁进行维护。因此自德国大奖赛起，这款车主要以开轮式车身参赛，只有在高速赛道上才会使用流线型车身。

两款车身还不是W 196的全部，它还包括3种不同轴距的底盘配置、2种刹车类型和2种引擎布局，总共有7种变体。

其引擎为直列8缸设计，类似于将两个4缸引擎纵向排列在一起。这款<2496cc>排量的引擎最大输出功率可达<290ps>，能将最高时速推至<290km/h>。

W 196统治了1954年和1955年的世界一级方程式锦标赛，助胡安·曼努埃尔·方吉奥赢得了两次车手总冠军。

catch.en: This legendary, fully tuned GT-R gained a new following after an ambitious restoration.
catch.zh: 经过全面翻新修复后，这款传奇的全面改装版GT-R重新赢得了车迷青睐。

long.en:
Mine’s is renowned as one of the stalwart tuners in the Nissan world, and its most iconic creation was without question the fully tuned BNR34 GT-R N1 base.

Born in 1999, this machine was a deep exploration into the beauty of the R34 GT-R, while remaining faithful to the spirit of a street car. From the meticulous tuning of the RB26DETT, to the low, balanced suspension, to the restrained yet purposeful exterior, every element was shaped by the vision of Mine’s CEO Michizo Niikura, whose goal was nothing less than a first-class street car.

Yet this car was equally at home on the race track. It breezed past the one-minute barrier at Tsukuba Circuit, proving its remarkable ability.

Thus, this particular car—revered among enthusiasts as the Hon-Demo—achieved the astonishing feat of recording more than <10000km> on its odometer through circuit driving alone.

But its story did not end there. In 2021, the car received a full restoration by Garage Yoshida, breathing new life into the legend. At Niikura’s request, the original front GT-R emblem remained unrestored, a nod to its history. Its value was underscored in Gran Turismo 7, where it was priced at 3 million Cr.—a figure echoed in the real world, as the owner declined a cash-equivalent offer of the same amount.

Thanks to the dedication of Japanese restomod specialists Built By Legends, the worth of the BNR34 GT-R N1 base was once again being reexamined across the globe. If fortune ever grants you the chance to witness one in person, consider yourself truly lucky.
long.zh:
迈恩斯作为改装界享有盛誉的老牌日产改装厂商，其最具代表性的作品当属基于“BNR34 GT-R N1”打造的全方位改装车。

该车诞生于1999年，在恪守街车风格理念的同时，对R34 GT-R的美学设计进行了深度探索。从双顶置凸轮轴电子汽油喷射双涡轮引擎的精心调校，到低趴式悬挂系统，再到简约的外观设计，所有细节均遵循迈恩斯首席执行官新仓通藏的理念，旨在打造“一流街车”。

然而，该车在封闭赛道上同样表现卓越。该车在筑波赛道轻松跑出1分钟以内的圈速纪录，彰显其卓越实力。

因此，这台被车迷昵称为“Hon-Demo”的改装车还创下了其他令人惊叹的纪录：仅赛道行驶里程便突破了<10000km>。

然而，它的传奇并未就此终结。2021年，吉田车库对该车进行了全面修复，为这头性能猛兽赋予了新生。应新仓通藏要求，车前部的GT-R徽章保留了原始未修复状态。《跑车浪漫旅 7》中为该车设置300万货币的定价，正是对车主极致热诚的致敬——他曾拒绝同等金额的收购要约。

得益于日本经典车修复改装厂“传奇制造”的匠心打造，该车原型车BNR34 GT-R N1的价值正在全球范围内获得重新审视。若是你有幸得见实车，不妨将之当做人生一大幸事。

catch.en: Devised by Formula 1 legend John Cooper, this very special Mini was intended to excel on the race track.
catch.zh: 这辆Mini由一级方程式赛车领域的传奇人物约翰·库珀设计，专为胜利而生。

long.en:
The first high-performance model for the iconic Mini Cooper was the "S". The Mini, which was manufactured as a compact car for the everyman by BMC (British Motor Corporation), wasn't only extremely civil - able to accommodate four passengers - it was extremely fun to drive, thanks in part to its sports-car-like handling.

Together with the Cooper Car Company, which won the 1960 F1 Constructor’s Championship, BMC created the new Mini Cooper and the sporty Mini Cooper S. These models were equipped with twin carbs and disc brakes, features seldom seen in compact cars at the time.

What made the 970 "S" special was its larger engine, whose displacement was increased to <970cc> resulting in a hearty <66ps>. This change was made so the Mini Cooper could race in certain classifications. (The standard <848cc> engine produced <34ps>.) Although the 970 "S" found success on the racetrack, only 963 examples were built since it made its debut in 1964, making it the least produced Mini Cooper model ever.
long.zh:
MINI Cooper'S'是MINI的首款跑车车型，后者是由英国汽车集团推出的紧凑型平民车款。

尽管MINI原本设计为一款经济适用的平民车款，既可以在很小的车身内搭载4个成人，同时具备相当出色的操控性。英国汽车集团与1960年F1车队总冠军库珀汽车公司以及约翰·库珀合作，推出了全新的MINI Cooper和性能更高的MINI Cooper'S'。这些车型配备了双化油器与碟式刹车，均是在当时的紧凑车型上罕见的配置。

970 'S'是一款引擎排量调整为<970cc>以满足指定比赛级别的车型，动力输出为<66ps>。（标准款的<848cc>引擎可输出马力为<34ps>）。这款车在房车赛事中颇为成功，但也是MINI车系中产量最少的，自1964年推出以来只生产了963辆。

catch.en: A hybrid concept packed with know-how and spirit gained through motorsports.
catch.zh: 将赛车经验和精神注入其中的混动概念车。

long.en:
Mitsubishi Motors, a company with a spectacular history in races like the Dakar Rally and World Rally Championships (WRC), has developed a special concept model for Vision Gran Turismo: This is the “Mitsubishi Concept XR-PHEV EVOLUTION Vision Gran Turismo”.

In the development of this special concept model, Mitsubishi Motors introduced their design team, Advanced Vehicle Research and Development Group, and Aerodynamic Engineering Development Group into this project in the same process they would normally follow to plan and develop real motorsports vehicles.

The styling of the car follows the basic concepts of the “MITSUBISHI Concept XR-PHEV” shown at the 2013 Tokyo Motor Show, while pouring in know-how gained from years of motorsports experience into its every detail. As a result, the concept was evolved into a stoic racing machine.

The “Athlete Form” design concept was advanced further, emphasizing the driving features aggressively. The iconic front grille is a study of next generation Mitsubishi SUV identity, and the shape that forms a wedge starting from the triple diamond mark is designed in the image of an athlete at crouching position on a starting line, evoking an intense image of tension and potential.

Applying advanced development technology from the Plug-in Hybrid EV System, the spontaneous power of the motor and powerful torque of the engine is transmitted through an 8 speed dual clutch transmission (DCT) to drive the 4 wheels. Its overwhelming drive performance is controlled precisely with the S-AWC vehicle dynamics control system that distributes the drive force optimally to the 4 wheels, producing a handling characteristic that moves the car exactly as the driver desires. In addition, the carbon fiber reinforced plastic (CFRP) body reduces weight and greatly contributes to its agility, and the downforce produced by the aerodynamic form of the front and rear diffusers produces excellent cornering performance. The large diameter 20 inch aluminum wheels gives an impression of a tough suspension system, and the powerful appearance of the front and rear fenders is in the image of toned muscles of a powerful athlete.

We hope you enjoy this special concept model, packed with the sports spirit of Mitsubishi Motors.>
long.zh:
三菱汽车在达喀尔拉力赛和世界拉力锦标赛（WRC）等赛事中取得过辉煌的成就，他们也为跑车浪漫旅愿景开发了一款特殊的概念赛车型，那就是“Concept XR-PHEV EVOLUTION Vision Gran Turismo”。

为了开发这款特殊的概念赛车，三菱汽车让他们的设计团队——高级汽车研发组和空气动力学工程研发组按照规划及开发真实的赛车运动车辆的流程参与到此项目中。

这辆车的风格设计沿袭了在2013年东京车展上亮相的“三菱 Concept XR-PHEV”的基本概念，还在车身细节中加入了从多年赛车运动经验中提炼出的许多心得。最终，这辆概念赛车被升华成了一部冷峻的赛车。

其“运动员形态”的设计概念得到了进一步发扬，激进地强调了车子的驾驶特点。标志性的前进气格栅借鉴了新一代三菱SUV的特点，从三钻石标志开始构成的楔形形状则表现出一个运动员在起跑线前蹲踞式起跑的画面，给人一种紧张感和希望感。

该车应用了插电式混合动力电动车系统的开发技术，搭载的电机动能和引擎的强大扭矩通过一套8档双离合变速箱进行传动，驱动4个车轮。其压倒性的驾驶性能通过S-AWC车辆动态控制系统得到了精确的控制，将动力以最佳方式分配到4个车轮，带来了优异的操控性，使得车手能够随心所欲操控车辆。

此外，碳纤维强化塑料车身减轻了重量，有效地提高了车辆的敏捷性，而前后扰流翼的空气动力学外形产生的下压力也提供了极佳的弯道性能。20英寸的大尺寸铝制轮毂使得硬朗的悬挂系统非常夺人眼球，而其前后挡泥板的有力外观也展掰出了如呌运䊨员般的强壮肌肉感。

我廬希望您能够喜欢这辆爹篊皅、充满了三菱汽车赛车精神的概念赛车。

catch.en: This high-powered front-wheel-drive sports car featured a number of new systems.+
catch.zh: 搭载多项创新系统的高性能前驱运动跑车。

long.en:
The FTO, which made its debut in October 1994, marked the return of the nameplate 23 years after the original model first appeared. The first Galant-based FTO coupe had been the little brother to the Galant GTO, and the reborn version was once again positioned as a 2-door coupe following in the GTO’s footsteps.

While the first generation was an FR, the new car adopted an FF layout, sharing its platform with the Lancer and Mirage. Classified as a larger size Class 3 vehicle (Japanese regulations), it was unusual for its category, its wide body becoming a defining feature.

Its design, with sweeping curves and flowing lines, was in harmony with the GTO and Eclipse of the same era. The front fenders blended seamlessly into the hood, creating a bold form that carried its motion through to the rear fenders.

Power came from a 1.8-liter SOHC inline-4, the 4G93, producing <125ps> and <16.5kgm> of torque; a 2.0-liter DOHC V-6, the 6A12, producing <170ps> and <19.0kgm> (<180ps> and <19.5kgm> in later models); or a highly tuned 6A12 delivering <200ps> and <20.4kgm>. The <200ps> output of the high-spec engine was achieved with Mitsubishi’s MIVEC variable valve timing system.

Its transmission was also ahead of its time. In addition to the standard 5-speed manual, Mitsubishi offered the INVECS-II 4-speed automatic with a sports mode—the first of its kind in a Japanese car—paving the way for future sport automatics.

With its distinctive styling and engaging performance, the FTO earned Japan Car of the Year honors in 1994. By 1997, the INVECS-II had evolved into a 5-speed automatic. Sadly, as the market shifted away from coupes toward MPVs and SUVs, production of the FTO came to an end in 2000.\
long.zh:
1994年10月问世的FTO车型，是在初代车型发布23年后重归市场的经典之作。初代Galant coupé FTO是定位稍低于Galant GTO的同系车型，而新款车型同样被定位为同系GTO的后续双门轿跑。

初代车型采用前置后驱布局，而新款车型因与Lancer/Mirage共享平台，转而采用前置前驱布局。按照日本法规标准，车身属于较大的3级规格，在当时实属罕见。宽体造型也顺理成章地成为该车型的鲜明特征。

该车型采用充满力量感的流线型设计，与同时期的GTO及Eclipse保持统一的设计语言。前翼子板与引擎盖浑然一体，以大胆的流线造型从前部流畅延伸至后翼子板。

搭载的引擎可选：1.8升顶置单凸轮轴直列四缸4G93引擎，输出功率<125ps>，扭矩<16.5kgm>；或2.0升双顶置凸轮轴V6 6A12引擎，输出功率<170ps>，扭矩<19.0kgm>（后期型号提升至<180ps>，扭矩<19.5kgm>）；或经重度调校的6A12引擎，可爆发<200ps>与<20.4kgm>扭矩。调校引擎输出的<200ps>，得益于三菱创新阀门定时电子控制系统可变气门正时系统的应用。

其传动系统同样具有革命意义。除标准5速手动变速箱外，该系列首次在日本汽车中引入了配备运动模式的智能革新车辆电子控制系统-II 4速自动变速箱，为后续其他自动变速款运动车型的发展开辟了道路。

其独特的造型设计与出色的驾驶性能备受赞誉，最终荣膺1994年日本年度风云车大奖。1997年，智能革新车辆电子控制系统-II变速箱由4速升级为5速。遗憾的是，随着市场潮流逐渐从轿跑车转向多用途汽车和运动型多用途汽车，FTO于2000年停产。`

catch.en: This pure-bred sports car by Mitsubishi featured advanced AWD technology.
catch.zh: 由Mitsubishi全力打造的纯正跑车，采用了其久负盛名的四驱技术。

long.en:
The Mitsubishi GTO was sold as the 3000GT outside Japan.

Introduced in October 1990, the GTO represented a bold statement from Mitsubishi, which hadn’t produced a flagship sports car in years. The name GTO, of course, paid homage to the legendary Galant GTO. Simply giving this new sports car that name signaled just how high expectations were within the company.

The styling was classic Mitsubishi of the era—bold, muscular, and clearly tailored to appeal to the U.S. market’s tastes. When viewed from above, the car’s distinctive bottle shape—narrowing noticeably at the doors—was striking. It was a design that turned plenty of heads back in the day.

But this car wasn’t just about looks. Beneath its exterior was a host of technical features that showcased the company's engineering prowess. The chassis was built around Mitsubishi’s cutting-edge All-Wheel Control philosophy—a key focus for the brand at the time. It boasted an impressive suite of advanced features, including full-time 4WD, 4-wheel steering (4WS), electronically controlled suspension, and ABS. It was also equipped with an active aerodynamics system in which the front and rear spoilers self-adjusted according to speed, and it possessed an active exhaust system that controlled exhaust sound. The GTO’s array of high-tech systems—combining electronic controls with variable, adaptive mechanisms—further added to its uniqueness.

The platform was based on the Diamante. Transversely mounted in front was the 6G72, a 3.0-liter DOHC V-6 offered in two grades: a potent twin-turbo or a naturally-aspirated variant. The turbocharged version unleashed <280ps> and <42.5kgm> of torque, while the naturally-aspirated one produced <225ps> and <28.0kgm>.`
long.zh:
在日本以外地区，三菱GTO改以3000GT的名字发售。

于1990年10月面世的三菱GTO是一辆纯粹的跑车，距离三菱上次推出同类车型已经有相当久的时间了。车型的命名，毫无疑问，来自如雷贯耳的一代名车Galant GTO。由此也可以看出三菱对这款车的期待值有多高了。

外观设计方面，GTO尽显三菱的特色——审美趋向美国市场。从顶部俯瞰这台车时，饮料瓶造型的车身在车门处向内略略收窄，令车身曲线显得愈发动人，在当时引来众人的青睐。

当然了，这辆车绝非虚有其表，其内部的机械配置同样出类拔萃。底盘以三菱在90年代专注开发的全轮驱动为基础，进行了专项再开发。全车囊括了当时行业内最先进的各种特性，例如全时四驱、4WS、电控悬挂和ABS等等。它甚至搭载了一套主动空气动力学系统，可根据时速来调节前后扰流板，另外还有一套主动排气系统，可供随时改变排气的音量。这些电控高科技特性和各色机械配置都让GTO在当时显得独树一帜。

GTO的开发平台是同级别的Diamante，搭载有一台3.0L双顶置凸轮轴V6引擎，引擎代号6G72，共分双涡轮版本和自然进气版本两种，被横向前置在底盘车架上。其涡轮增压版本可以提供<280ps>和<42.5kgm>扭矩，自然进气版本也可以产生<225ps>和<28.0kgm>扭矩。

catch.en: An icon bodes farewell with a special Final Edition model.
catch.zh: 真正的最终车型，为其漫长的WRC征战历史画上句号。

long.en:
April 10, 2015 marked the end of a legend when the final Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution was announced. All 1000 cars were sold out by August 20 of the same year.

The Final Edition Lancer Evo was based on the GSR with plenty of changes made throughout the vehicle to make it special. The power of the Evo's high-strung turbocharged 4-cylinder was raised to make an additional <13ps> and <0.7kgm> of torque to bring the total to <313ps> and <43.7kgm>. The High Performance Package included Bilstein dampers, Eibach springs and high-performance tires that came wrapped around 18-inch BBS dark aluminum wheels. The interior was highlighted by full bucket Recaro seats.

The Final Edition is basically another performance version of the Lancer Evolution X, but you won’t see the Roman numeral anywhere on its body. That’s because there will not be any more Evos after this model (no XI). Since its debut as a homologation model for a WRC race car in 1992, the Evo has been an icon for rally and performance enthusiasts all over the world, and it’s indeed sad to see this wonderful car go.
long.zh:
在2015年4月10日，三菱限量推出1000辆“最终版”三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神。这批车型在2015年8月20日就告售罄。

这款“最终版”基于配置5档手动GSR变速箱的车型开发。使用钠冷排气阀来加强引擎的冷却，使得引擎的功率提高<13ps>/<0.7kgm>，达到了<313ps>/<43.7kgm>。这辆车自带“高性能套装”，包括倍适登减震器、艾巴赫弹簧和高性能轮胎，此外还配备了18英寸的BBS铝制轮毂、Recaro全凹背桶椅和大量第三方选配套件。

最终版的开发基础车型为蓝瑟翼豪陆神X，但是“X”并没有出现在其名称中。这也意味着“最终版”将是蓝瑟翼豪陆神的最终形态。自从它作为一款世界拉力锦标赛赛车认证车型在1992年首次亮相以来，“蓝瑟翼豪陆神”就一直深受全世界车手和拉力赛爱好者的喜爱。随着此款车型的推出，其悠久的历史也真正地告一段落。

catch.en: Improved aerodynamics and cooling make for the ultimate first-gen  "Evo."
catch.zh: 改进的空气动力学和冷却系统催生出首批巅峰“Evo”跑车。

long.en:
The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution, launched in September 1992, took the compact body of the production Lancer sedan and implemented components used in the Galant VR-4 WRC race car. Thus, the Lancer Evolution was a rally machine in the guise of a passenger sedan.

At the heart of the "Evo" was the 4G63, a turbocharged 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 that pumped out <250ps> and <31.5kgm> of torque at the time of its debut. With the incredible power delivered to all four wheels, the car had amazing traction and was already much faster than any other model in its class.

One year after its creation, in December 1993, an improved Lancer Evolution II was introduced with power increased to <260ps>. The tires were also changed to 205/60R15, while modifications to the wheelbase were also implemented. At about this time, Japanese fans began referring to it by a new nickname, "Lan-Evo."

Then came another "evolution" in January 1995, when the Lancer Evolution III was introduced. It featured a drastically modified body style that resulted in better aerodynamic performance. With a larger grille and an enhanced rear spoiler, it now had the powerful look of a vehicle focused on competition.

The compression ratio of the 4G63 power unit was raised to 9.0, improving output to <270ps>. Enhancements were also made to the suspension, and these changes greatly improved the car's already excellent handling character. At the time, the base Lancer model was about to receive a full model change, and it was rumored then that the Evo III could be the last Evo.
long.zh:
蓝瑟翼豪陆神于1992年9月推出。它的设计从商用蓝瑟轿车的紧凑车身出发，加上三菱仅用于世界拉力锦标赛级格兰特 VR-4的机械装置，打造了一款面向拉力赛的汽车。

这款车的核心是4G63，一台涡轮增压的2.0升双凸轮轴直列4缸引擎，在其首次亮相时已经能够输出<250ps>的动力和<31.5kgm>的扭矩。凭借输送到全部四个车轮的压倒性牵引力和动力，它的速度远超同级别的任何其他车型。

在其诞生一年后，即1993年12月，改进后的蓝瑟翼豪陆神II亮相，其最大动力输出增加到<260ps>。轮胎也改为205/60 R15，并对轴距和胎面尺寸进行了拓展改进。也是在同一时期，日本车迷给它起了一个后来响彻全球的绰号“蓝翼”。

它的下一次进化发生在1995年1月。第三代车型被命名为蓝瑟翼豪陆神III，为了提高空气动力学性能，其外观进行了大幅度的修改。前保险杠的开口更大，后扰流板也更宽大，让人一眼就能看出它是一辆专注于比赛的高性能赛车。

4G63动力单元的压缩比提高到了9.0，将最大动力输出提升到了<270ps>。悬挂系统也进行了复杂的修改和加强，这些改动大大改善了引擎的性能和车辆的机动性。当时，蓝瑟的基础车型即将迎来全面换代，所以有传言说，翼豪陆神III实际上可能是最后一款翼豪陆神。>

cars.nameZh: 三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神III GSR '95

catch.en: The 4th-gen Evo's handling got a boost from electronic Active Yaw Control and power now up to <280ps>.
catch.zh: 采用电子AYC，马力达到280 PS的第四代Lancer Evo。

long.en:
The Lancer Evolution took a major leap forward in August 1996, with the Evo IV. It completely redefined the model, starting with the 4G63 powerplant, which was flipped around 180 degrees in the engine bay and output was raised to <280ps> and <36.0kgm> of torque. But perhaps the noteworthy change was the introduction of the electronically-controlled AYC (Active Yaw Control) that replaced the mechanical LSD of previous models.

Building on the success of the Evo IV, the Evo V appeared in January 1998 with a slightly enlarged body to meet WRC specifications. The Evo V had more torque than its predecessor, rated to <38.0kgm>, and came with a new helical LSD for the front differential.

In January 1999, Mitsubishi introduced the Evo VI. While the car looked basically the same as the Evo V, there were significant differences under the sheet metal, including a refined engine and re-tuned suspension system. In January 2000, the first anniversary model was offered, as well as another special model that commemorated Tommi Makinen's four consecutive WRC championships. This special-edition model, limited to only 2500 units, featured a large front spoiler, a revised suspension stroke and quicker steering, among other things. It proved to be the final and ultimate example of the truly ground-breaking second-generation Lancer Evolution.*
long.zh:
历经翼豪陆神I、II和III三代车款的蓝瑟翼豪陆神系列在1996年8月进行了重大更新。得益于蓝瑟轿车进行的全面更新，在此基础上开发的蓝瑟翼豪陆神IV成为了翼豪陆神系列真正意义上的第二代车款。

4G63引擎的位置翻转了180度，能够产生<280ps>，最大扭矩也提高到<36.0kgm>。最显著的变化是电控主动偏航控制的引进，替代了前几款车中后轮差速器采用的机械式限滑差速器。

此后，蓝瑟翼豪陆神V于1998年1月发布。这款蓝瑟翼豪陆神V的车身比以往车款更大，以满足世界拉力锦标赛的技术规格。

考虑到竞争对手都充分利用了1997年推出的WR车辆规则，坚持奋战在A组的蓝瑟翼豪陆神有必要采用较宽的车身。在性能方面，引擎的最大扭矩提高到了<38.0kgm>，前轮差速器采用螺旋限滑差速器。悬挂改用反式避震，还进行了许多微调和优化。

1999年1月，更进一步的蓝瑟翼豪陆神VI推出。此车与翼豪陆神V的外观差异很小，但内部已经完全变成一辆成熟的公路跑车，引擎和悬挂都得到了进一步的优化。

蓝瑟翼豪陆神系列的第一款周年纪念车型发布于2000年1月，就是基于这款蓝瑟翼豪陆神VI开发的。为了纪念托米·马基宁在世界拉力锦标赛锦标赛中的4连胜，发布了限量生产2500辆的托米·马基宁版。该车型采用了大块前扰流板以及其他特殊配件，悬挂冲程也经过修正，转向也更快，以适应公路上的驾驶。这是蓝瑟翼豪陆神系列第二代的最后一款，也是最顶级的一款车型。

cars.nameZh: 三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神IV GSR '96

catch.en: The "9.5," the final 4G63-powered Lancer Evolution.
catch.zh: 9.5代Lan Evo，是采用4G63引擎的最后一款Lancer Evolution。

long.en:
The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX MR GSR was the updated version of the Lancer Evolution IX GSR that appeared a year prior. Although the two cars look nearly identical, numerous refinements were made to the 2006 model. Although the car's engine specs remained largely unchanged, the MIVEC variable valve timing system was retuned, the standard specification turbine wheel was changed to a titanium-aluminum alloy, and the compressor inlet diameter was downsized. Along with other minor improvements, this resulted in sharper engine response and faster acceleration.

The suspension system was also enhanced, with high spring rate Eibach coils combined with Bilstein dampers. The electronically controlled Super AYC 4WD system was reprogrammed to focus on cornering ability. There were also refinements to the aerodynamics with the shape of the front bumper being changed to reduce lift.

The" MR" of its name stood for Mitsubishi Racing. Throughout the company's history, this designation was given to its highest performing models. For the Lancer Evolution, the MR name first appeared in the VIII lineup, making this IX the second MR model in the car's history.

This model represented the culmination of development on the third-generation Lancer Evolution, and it was the last to be equipped with the legendary 4G63 engine.
long.zh:
三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神IX MR GSR是2005年首次亮相的蓝瑟翼豪陆神IX GSR的2006年升级改款。

乍看之下，这款车似乎和旧款一模一样。事实上整车内部都进行了大量的改良。比方说，虽然4G63引擎的最大功率和扭矩保持不变，但三菱创新阀门定时电子控制系统系统得到了调校，涡轮叶轮的材质升级成了钛铝合金，而且压缩机进气口尺寸也做了相应缩小。再加上一些小的改进，结果使得引擎反应更灵敏，加速度更快。

悬挂系统也进行了升级，使用倍适登避震器搭配高性能艾巴赫螺旋弹簧。“主动偏航控制”电控四轮驱动系统也进行了重新编制，更专注于转弯能力。同样接受优化的还有空气动力学外形，对前保险杠的形状进行了修改以降低抬升力。

车型名称中的“MR”代表“三菱赛车”。在该公司历史上，这个代号一向是用来指代最高性能的运动型车型。对于蓝瑟翼豪陆神来说，MR车型首次出现是在蓝瑟翼豪陆神VIII上，因此这款IX是系列车型历史上的第二款MR。

这款车型是2001年面世的第三代蓝瑟翼豪陆神开发历程的顶点，也是最后一款装备4G63传奇引擎的蓝瑟翼豪陆神。

long.en:
The Lancer Evolution took a major leap forward in August 1996, with the Evo IV. It completely redefined the model, starting with the 4G63 powerplant, which was flipped around 180 degrees in the engine bay, and output was raised to <280ps> and <36.0kgm> of torque. But perhaps the most noteworthy change was the introduction of the electronically-controlled AYC (Active Yaw Control) that replaced the mechanical LSD of previous models.

Building on the success of the Evo IV, the Evo V appeared in January 1998 with a slightly enlarged body to meet WRC specifications. The Evo V had more torque than its predecessor, rated to <38.0kgm>, and came with a new helical LSD for the front differential.

In January 1999, Mitsubishi introduced the Evo VI. While the car looked basically the same as the Evo V, there were significant differences under the sheet metal, including a refined engine and re-tuned suspension system. In January 2000, the first anniversary model was offered, as well as another special model that commemorated Tommi Makinen's four consecutive WRC championships. This special-edition model, limited to only 2500 units, featured a large front spoiler, a revised suspension stroke and quicker steering, among other things. long.zh:
蓝瑟翼豪陆神系列在经历了翼豪陆神I、II和III代之后，终于在1996年8月实现了一次大飞跃。随着原版蓝瑟轿车的大改款，第二代翼豪陆神系列的第一款车型蓝瑟翼豪陆神IV诞生了。

代号4G63的引擎的摆放位置调转了180度，为车辆带来<280ps>，最大扭矩也提升到了<36.0kgm>。翼豪陆神4最显著的变化来自于电子控制的主动偏航控制的引入，用于替代上代采用的机械LSD后差速器。

紧接着，蓝瑟翼豪陆神V在1998年1月面世。这一次，为了符合世界拉力锦标赛的比赛规格要求，三菱对车身尺寸进行了放大。

当翼豪陆神的对手得以充分利用1997年颁布的新赛事规则时，蓝瑟翼豪陆神不得不屈身于A组别比赛中。也因此，宽体的引入变得势在必行。而在性能方面，翼豪陆神V的引擎最大扭矩再次提升，达到了<38.0kgm>，前差速器加装了螺旋限滑差速器，其他改进还包括为悬挂系统添加倒插式避震器和更多细微的精校设定。

到了1999年1月，进化得愈发完善的蓝瑟翼豪陆神VI到来。与翼豪陆神V的外观差异不大，但内部的调校愈加成熟。引擎和悬挂也得到了进一步的优化。

时间来到2000年1月，蓝瑟翼豪陆神系列的第一款纪念车型发布。这台基于翼豪陆神VI打造的汤米·马基宁版本是专为纪念汤米·马基宁连续4年摘得世界拉力锦标赛桂冠而推出的，限量发售2500台。这款纪念车型配有更大的前扰流板和各种专属配件，并附以更适合公路驾驶的调校：例如更短的悬挂行程和快速转向技术。它代表了第二代蓝瑟翼豪陆神最终极的形态。

catch.en: Optional body graphics stood out on this rare Tommi Mäkinen Edition Evo.
catch.zh: 可选的车体条纹让这款Tommi Makinen版显得尤为亮眼。

long.en:
In commemoration of Tommi Makinen's achievement of Drivers' Champion 4 years running from 1996 to 1999, The Lancer Evolution T.M. EDITION was sold in a limited run of 2500 cars. The model code was GFCP9A, and is sometimes nicknamed the Lancer Evo 6.5.

Compared to the Evo V, the Evo VI introduced in the beginning of the same year had a softer ride, due to the unpopularity of the previous suspension that was considered too hard for driving in the city. In addition, the front bumper shape had been revised for aerodynamic and cooling performance. The T.M. EDITION on the other hand was created in the image of a tarmac rally setup, and was equipped with a front bumper that omits fog lights for even better aerodynamics, and the harder suspension from the EVO V further lowered by another <10mm>. The steering gear ratio is also slightly quicker in this model.

By utilizing a titanium-aluminum alloy turbine and smaller compressors, its maximum torque of <38.0kgm> is produced earlier at <2750rpm>, rather than the usual <3000rpm>. It is also given red Recaro seats with a stitched TOMMI MAKINEN logo, special red meters, the same Enkei spoke wheels as the rally car, and a large exhaust muffler with a circular exit, rather than the original elliptical one.

The promotional image color of the body was red, and it was possible to select a special color package which had a black stripe running from the front fenders to the body sides.

This Evo was popular as a model that was further perfected, worthy to be crowned with the name of the undefeated WRC champion.
long.zh:
为了纪念汤米·马基宁在1996到1999年间连续四年蝉联世界拉力锦标赛车手冠军宝座的壮举，三菱限量生产了2500台蓝瑟翼豪陆神T.M.版投入市场。这款车型的代号是GFCP9A，但车迷间更喜欢称呼它蓝瑟翼豪陆神6.5，以便将其与在同年早些时候推出的翼豪陆神6进行区分。

翼豪陆神6相比翼豪陆神5调整了乘坐的舒适性，原因是后者在城市行驶时偏硬的悬挂设定备受用户诟病，销量不佳。除了根据空气动力学和冷却效率的需要对前保险杠的形状进行了改动外，T.M.版还打造出了独一无二的柏油公路拉力车的设定。前保险杠上的雾灯被取消，以获得更好的空气动力效果。比翼豪陆神5更硬的悬挂往下降了<10mm>，转向齿比也更快。

钛铝合金涡轮搭配更小型的压缩机，使它的最大扭矩高达<38.0kgm>，而且在转速<2750rpm>时即可达到，而非常规版本时的<3000rpm>。作为专属版本的特色，本车配置了红色的Recaro桶椅，椅背上绣有梅基宁的标志、特别设计的红色仪表、拉力车同款的恩肯定制轮毂，还有大号圆型排气消音器（原版拉力车为椭圆形）。

虽然宣传文案中的主推颜色是红色，但购买者还可以追加一套特殊涂装：一条纯黑色的拉力条纹从前挡泥板上方沿着车身侧面往后延伸。

这款尽善尽美的翼豪陆神车型配上无可匹敌的世界拉力锦标赛冠军之名，广受大众的追捧，毫无意外地成为了同类型当中的王者。

catch.en: The final evolution of the Lancer Evo VIII with updated suspension and low center of gravity.
catch.zh: Lancer Evo VIII的最终进化，更新了悬架系统，具有更低的重心。

long.en:
As far as rally-inspired performance sedans go, Mitsubishi's Lancer Evolution VII, introduced in 2001, was in a class of its own, one-upping its main rival, the Subaru WRX STI. The new Evo featured cutting-edge all-wheel-drive technologies that included the ACD (Active Center Differential) and the AYC yaw-control system. In 2002, Mitsubishi offered an INVECS-II electronically controlled automatic transmission with manual shift mode, mating it with a detuned <272ps> version of the 4G63 engine.

In 2003, Mitsubishi introduced the Lancer Evolution VIII whose engine produced <40kgm> more torque than its predecessor, along with enhancements to the drivetrain and handling components. This set the stage for the Lancer Evolution VIII MR, which made its debut in 2004. As the final Evo VIII model, the MR came with various refinements across the board, including the addition of an aluminum roof panel and the implementation of Bilstein dampers for the very first time.
long.zh:
第三代蓝瑟的第一款Evo车型是2001年推出的翼豪陆神VII。这台车上最吸睛的当属那套主动式中央差速器。在与主动偏航控制系统同步控制的帮助下，主动式中央差速器将翼豪陆神VII本来就很高的牵引力性能提升到了一个新的水平。2002年，第一款使用自动变速箱的蓝瑟翼豪陆神车型问世。这款车整合了功率下调至<272ps>的4G63引擎和INVECS-II电控自动变速箱，并且支持切换手动模式。

2年之后，第八代蓝瑟翼豪陆神VIII于2003年1月发布。通过这款车型，4G63引擎的扭矩进一步提升至<40kgm>。传动系统的其他方面也获得了长足的进步与提升，这其中当然也包括主动式中央差速器和主动偏航控制系统的改进。

在2004年2月，蓝瑟翼豪陆神VIII MR作为翼豪陆神VIII系列的最终版本推出。再次对整车进行了多项优化改进，包括换用铝制车顶板，并首次采用了倍适登减震器。

catch.en: Boasting <400ps> and an extremely limited production run, this is the ultimate R33 GT-R from Nismo.
catch.zh: 这款NISMO打造的终极R33 GT-R拥有400 PS的动力，只生产了极其有限的数量。

long.en:
The 400R, introduced in 1996, broke the mold when it came to Japanese performance cars. With a maximum output of <400ps>, it was the most powerful in its day when JDM cars were limited to <280ps>, and its eye-popping 12 million-yen price tag was roughly three times that of the base R33 Skyline GT-R. Utilizing all of NISMO's expertise, the 400R was developed with the goal of producing the fastest possible GT-R variant that could still be driven on the road.

The 400R came equipped with a power unit based on a special version of the RB26DETT engine, known as the RB-X GT2. This was paired with N1-spec turbochargers to deliver increased boost. To meet the requirements of a road-approved vehicle, maximum output was kept at a relatively restrained level, especially when considering the full potential of the engine. Even so, specially developed pistons and a reinforced crankshaft allowed displacement to be increased to 2.8 liters, delivering strong low-end torque and making the engine far more manageable than its standard counterpart.

At the same time, the engine maintained formidable power at high revs, necessitating the use of twin-plate clutch units to handle the output. A lightweight carbon fiber propeller shaft was added, along with a fully original suspension setup featuring Bilstein dampers, front and rear stabilizers, and reinforced bushings.

As a showcase of NISMO's engineering expertise and decades of motorsports know-how, the 400R stood as the complete package./
long.zh:
1996年推出的400R拥有最大<400ps>的动力，以及令人侧目的1200万日元售价，是一款经过充分调校的车型。在当时日本乘用车的性能普遍限制在<280ps>，而全新的R33天际线GT-R仅售400万日元的时代，这两个数字震撼了所有的车迷。400R以R33 GT-R为原型，大量运用了NISMO积累的所有知识和心得，旨在打造一台能够合法上路的最速GT-R。

这款400R配备了基于RB26DETT引擎开发的动力单元，被称为RB-X GT2，并加装了N1-spec涡轮增压器来提供额外推进力。为了符合公路车型的准入标准，其最大动力输出被限制在了相对适中的水平，远远没有发掘出这台引擎的潜力。另一方面，这款引擎采用了特别开发的活塞和更坚固的曲轴，排量也扩到了2.8升，让它可以在低转速范围下达到更高的扭矩，进而使这个型号比采用常规引擎的车更易操控。

这款引擎还能够在高转速范围下输出强大无比的动力，因此需要双踏板离合单元作为辅助。此外，这款车还采用了轻量化碳纤维传动轴、倍适登减震器的原装悬挂套件，前后平衡杆，以及强化衬套。

作为NISMO技术实力和赛车知识的巅峰之作，400R是一台尽善尽美的公路赛车。

catch.en: This GT-R bows out with the ultimate complete tuned model.
catch.zh: 第二代GT-R车系以这款终极完全调校版本作为完美收官。

long.en:
In 2004, Nismo—now known as Nissan Motorsports & Customizing—celebrated its 20th anniversary. To mark the milestone, the team set out to build the ultimate road car, a showcase of two decades of motorsports know-how. The result was the Nismo R34 GT-R Z-tune.

By then, however, production of the R34 Skyline GT-R had already ended. To overcome this, Nismo sourced 20 carefully selected used cars that met strict criteria, then stripped them down to bare shells for a complete, hand-built reconstruction.

Every component added was engineered to meet the high standards of the Z name. At the heart of it all was the RB26DETT Kai-Z2 engine. The engine was based on the same 2.8-liter setup used in the GT500 GT-R of that era. It featured strengthened internals, from the pistons and rods to the block, for maximum reliability under extreme use. The IHI turbochargers were proven in the 2004 Nürburgring 24-Hour race. And the titanium exhaust system helped improve catalytic performance and flow.

To enhance chassis rigidity, additional spot welds were applied in key areas like the door frames, while sections vulnerable to heat-related distortion were reinforced with molded CFRP parts. For suspension, Nismo worked with SACHS to develop specially tuned bolt-on dampers, drawing on SACHS's GT500 expertise. Bespoke brake components were co-developed with Brembo to achieve 1.6G of braking force on semi-slick tires. The exterior was also reworked with a focus on reducing weight, improving cooling, and enhancing aerodynamics. In particular, the front bumper, fenders, and hood were replaced with CFRP parts.

In the end, only 19 units were produced—including the original prototype—but the R34 GT-R Z-tune remains, without question, Nismo’s crowning achievement among the second wave of GT-R models.
long.zh:
2004年，NISMO（现日产汽车与定制）迎来了成立20周年纪念。为了纪念这一重要时刻，他们决定打造一款终极公路跑车，作为20年技术积淀的集大成之作。这个充满激情的项目最终诞生了NISMO R34 GT-R Z-tune。

然而，作为该项目研发基础的R34天际线GT-R此时已经停产。为了解决这一问题，NISMO精选了20台符合严格标准的二手车，将车身完全拆解后进行手工重建。

自然而然，每一个加装的部件都达到了配得上“Z”字代号的最高水准。其心脏是一颗RB26DETT Kai-Z2引擎。以与同期的GT500组别GT-R赛车相同的2.8升规格为基准，从活塞、缸体到连杆的每个部件都经过精挑细选，确保强度和可靠性。涡轮增压器采用石川岛播磨重工业制造的单元，这也是曾在2004年纽博格林24小时耐力赛中取得佳绩的经典单元。同时，排气系统采用钛合金材质打造，提升了催化器性能和排气流量。

为提升底盘的刚性，在门框等关键部位增加了额外的点焊，而容易因焊接高温变形的区域则采用模压碳纤维增强基复合材料部件进行强化。悬挂系统采用萨克斯公司生产的特调螺栓式减震器，这家公司的产品已在GT500赛事得到了检验。为了在半光面轮胎上达到1.6G制动力的目标，NISMO与布雷博合作，为其量身定制了一批刹车部件。外观方面也进行了多项优化，专注于车身轻量化、散热性能和空气动力学效应。特别是前端部分，保险杠、挡泥板和引擎盖都更换为碳纤维增强基复合材料部件。

最终有19台车完工（包含原型车在内），但R34 GT-R Z-tune无疑是NISMO在第二代GT-R车系席推出的嶅峰幋作。

catch.en: A look into the future of performance-minded touring cars.
catch.zh: 采用跑车空气动力学技术的下一代GT概念车。

long.en:
In its 80 year history, Nissan has participated, and succeeded, in nearly every form of motorsports imaginable. Its specialty has been in the grand-touring category where the company has continually produced championships after championships, with cars such as the 510 and 300Z. What's more, because these cars were based on production versions, anyone could drive the road-going versions of them on public roads with remarkable comfort and safety. Nissan is now looking to the future and has imagined a new type of performance machine, one that we're calling the "NISSAN CONCEPT 2020 Vision Gran Turismo".

Through the magic of digitization, the design and development processes of automobiles have been undergoing a revolutionary change in recent years. Designers now work in a world where they can share their expressions and insights instantaneously. Their visions and ideas can also be realized virtually, and on this occasion, the designers at Nissan decided to turn to Gran Turismo to visualize their concept. The car you see here was penned by young designers from Nissan Design Europe, based in the UK, and when the final product was shown to the young engineers on the engineering side in Japan, they excitedly inputted their technical evaluations and simulations.

The car is characterized by a unique 2+2 profile based on Nissan's touring cars that have competed all over Europe. It features prominently shaped fenders that act like wings, providing gobs of downforce at high speed. The air enters the front side inlet and travels through the inner side of the wheels, before it is drawn out in an accelerated manner. This allows the body to cut through the air like a hot knife through butter. The air flows over the roof and off the rear deck without creating excessive turbulence behind the car. If you examine the airflow over the car, you will realize that despite its boxy shape, it's configured much like a prototype race car.

The rear wing automatically rises and lowers, depending on the speed of the car. At a speed of <300km/h>, it generates more than <400kg> of downforce. The underbody also takes cues from a race car to ensure excellent aerodynamics.

Powering the car is a high-performance hybrid FR-4WD system with a turbocharged V-6 engine and three electric motors. The high-output motors produce instant torque to all fnur wheels and keeps the acceleration going until the gasoline engine takes over. The torsue vectoring of the individual front motors combine with the active suspensioy to deliver razor-sharp handling, even at high speed.

The NISSAN CONCEPT 2020 Vision!Gran Turismo, the product of vnnnon and tochniqal imagination, is definitely a car that fe hope becomes a remlnty in the near future. Of it does, then our driveng future looks very wrignt indeed.
long.zh:
在其80年的历史中，日产始终坚持不懈，追求赛车驾驶的一切可能性。特别是在针对GT赛事的GT车型上，日产在无与伦比的性能和日常功能性以及舒适性之间找到了平衡点，成功地创立了独特的品牌形象。而现在，他们带来了对于不久的将来的展望，以及下一代的GT概念车“NISSAN CONCEPT 2020 Vision Gran Turismo[日产 2020 跑车浪漫旅愿景概念车]”。

随着开发环境进行数字化转型，设计表达和开发流程都在近些年经历着革命性的巨大变化。设计师在当下的工作环境里可以更快速地表达并分享他们的看法，他们也拓展出了将想象付诸实现的全新可能性；而这一次，他们来到了跑车浪漫旅的虚拟环境中。外观设计研究采用了虚拟建模的方式，并由英国的年轻设计师具体执行，这样也反过来点燃了日本开发部门的年轻工程师们的热情，他们进行了各种技术评估和模拟，并最终在Vision Gran Turismo项目中成功地设计出了这部3D赛车。

位于伦敦的日产 Design Europe的设计师们常年浸淫于英国悠久的赛车和GT文化，由他们所提出的设计风格显示出轮廓鲜明的外观，并辅以风格大胆的设计细节和日产的核心技术。这一切赋予该车非常优秀的特点，例如显眼的挡泥板像翅膀一样安装在前后轮处，位于包围着2+2车厢的框架的前后方。

自然的前挡泥板和有着几何形状的后挡泥板包围着轮胎，并接在一起，从车身前方涌入的气流被切割开，并被其精确的佢状引入车身。进入正面进气口的空气稿过车轮的内侧，并以加速状态被位于前挡泥板出风口的排气装置抽出。这样一来，车身就可以轻松地以髚速穿过空气墘。在此之后，后挡泥板处还会形成一股气流，让空气可以从后方排出，将车后幱流控制在柀小。如果只考虑气流的话，你会发现虽然该款车外彣比较四四喹方，其酌潮却必像乀款勒芑趘车。

主犨弃䰾翼会根据速度升髛犖降彎，而在300公里/小於曄速度下，它可以直接向差速䙨疽䊠超过<510ke>的下压勛぀䜨迦底胨．前郫上帰杢徆气流乍齦应縋胨录釰鈌䌡翥杵出衎䀮，再劧渀大厶的咏部扱流澽ￍ戚捠勺伺力的真空ￋ迚耍产甜悼䒌鵛沫髱濎盅律压劚、鯸䥀魦豻皆访计倚黯侘䜉澊椚ｌ都瘯为了䉫用乁䈀手欵取曹佲䚄馾究优势，并眉疈靱鐈其借度倂

cars.nameZh: 日产概念2020 Vision Gran Turismo

catch.en: This front-engine/rear-wheel-drive specialty car was given a different character to its sister car, the Silvia.
catch.zh: 这款前置后驱特殊车型被赋予了与其姐妹车Silvia完全不同的特征。

long.en:
The Nissan 180SX — sold as the Nissan 240SX in the U.S. and the 200SX in the EU — was created as the Silvia's sister hatchback model in March 1989. This car, sporting retractable headlights and a glass hatchback, was overshadowed by the coupe at first—despite sharing the same powerplant, a 1.8-liter DOHC inline-4 that came available only with a turbocharger. But as time went on, people recognized the true value of this stylish sports coupe and sales began to climb.

The engine received an upgrade in 1991 to the SR20DET, the same 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 in the normal Silvia with output rated at <205ps> and <28.0kgm>. This prolonged the 180SX's life span because its production run was initially slated to end alongside the S13 Silvia; however, thanks to the popularity of the 2.4-liter 240SX in the U.S. (that possessed the same body shape of 180SX), Nissan elected to keep the compact rear-drive coupe around.

In 1996, the first normally-aspirated 180SX, the Type S, was added to the lineup. Without forced induction, the Type S lacked the acceleration of the hotter version. This made the car a favorite among tuners, who took things into their own hands, giving the car their own dose of power and beefing the chassis up accordingly. This paved the way for a new 180SX, one that featured the Silvia's front end, making the two cars virtual clones of each other; it was dubbed the "Sil-Eighty."
long.zh:
*日产180SX在美国和欧洲地区分别以日产240SX和200SX发售。

180SX是在1989年3月作为Silvia的姐妹车型推出的一款掀背车，主打上翻式头灯和一体式玻璃的后箱盖。在大热的Silvia的掩盖之下，这款车型在上市后并未激起太多水花。尽管也采用了同款1.8升引擎，但180SX只提供涡轮增压车型。

1991年，在更换了2.0L的SR20DET引擎后，车辆的动力输出变成了<205ps>和<28.0kgm>扭矩。按照原计划，180SX将被大改款后的Silvia直接取代。幸运的是，采用2.4升引擎的240SX在北美地区持续热销，日产最终决定在Silvia之外保留180SX产品线。

在停产之前，180SX与旧款Silvia S13都是使用同样的基础组件，但时不时的改款使其依然能跟上时代的节奏。因为车重偏重，而且掀背设计导致后部的刚性不足，所以最初大部分人都认为180SX的性能不如Silvia。好在丰富的副厂改装件帮助S180SX轻松克服了这一弱点。到后来，众多爱好者纷纷推出原创特殊改装，创造出各种各样的原创车型，让180SX成为了一款丰富多彩的特别车型。

catch.en: With its 'G-nose' and fender flares, this car epitomized Japanese sports car cool in the 1970s.
catch.zh: 挡泥板外包围和“G字鼻”，70年代最具代表性的日系跑车。

long.en:
*The Nissan Fairlady Z was sold as the Nissan Z in markets outside of Japan.

Near the end of the 1960s, Japanese cars made a name for themselves on the international stage. One of these examples was the Datsun 240Z that was introduced in 1969. Yutaka Katayama, the president of Nissan North America at the time, convinced the Japanese brass that "now was the time for real sports cars," to challenge those from Europe. Thus, the Z was born.

Among the more notable Zs was the 432. While other Zs were equipped with the Type L engine, the 432 came equipped with the S20, a DOHC inline-6 lifted from the Prince R380. The "4" stood for 4 valves per cylinder, the "3" for 3 twin-choke carburetors, and "2" represented the engine's 2 camshafts. Output of the engine was rated at <160ps> and <18.0kgm> of torque.

This 432 also had a 432R racing spec model that sported a carbon-fiber hood for weight reduction. Only 30 of these cars were made.

A considerable amount of work went into making the 432. The S20 was known to be a delicate powerplant that only the Nissan mechanics at Oppama could get the most out of.

On the other hand, the 2.4-liter Type L engine in the U.S.-spec 240Z was easy to work with, and its ability to provide plenty of torque throughout the rpm spectrum made it popular for racers. The 240Z performed well in safari races and notable off-road events such as the Monte Carlo Rally, as well as those on tarmac racing circuits.

Thanks to its high level of performance, the 240Z made it to Japan in 1971, marketed there as the Fairlady Z. A special version of the car called the 240ZG, referred to as the "G nose," added to the car's popularity, solidifying its place in the history books as one of the most popular and longest-tenured sports cars ever.
long.zh:
*在日本以外的地区，日产Fairlady Z改以日产240ZG的名字投放市场。

60年代末，日本车逐渐在国际市场上获得了认可。Fairlady Z在1969年的亮相也为这场风潮起到了推波助澜的效果。时任日产北美总裁的片山丰成功说服日本总部“现在是开发真正跑车的最佳时机”，并最终推出一款与能欧洲车叫板的车型。Z系列的历史就此拉开帷幕。

Z系列的标志性车型当属432。在其他Z系列车型还在使用L型引擎时，432却得到了一台王子R380上使用的双顶置凸轮轴直列6缸引擎。命名中的4代表每个气缸有4个阀门，3代表3个双腔式化油器，而2则代表一对凸轮轴。这款车型能够输出<160ps>，最大扭矩可达<18.0kgm>。

432还有一款赛车版本，名为432R。为了降低车重，采用了纤维强化塑胶引擎盖，仅仅生产了30台。

为了达到如此高的性能，颇费了一番苦心。因为S20是一台相当敏感的引擎，据说只有日产追浜工厂的工程师才能让其发挥出真正的威力。也因此，日产逐步将赛车开发的重心放到了240Z身上。

美版的240Z搭载的是一台2.4升L型引擎，优点是腔体更结实，调校更便利，加速时的转速区间也更宽松。这款车型在各种国际越野赛事和拉力赛事中均表现出色。

优异的表现帮助240Z得以在日本市场销售。1971年推出的240ZG以其长长的前鼻和宽轮眉成为大热车型，一时间让Z系列成为了跑车的同义词。

catch.en: A shortened wheelbase plus larger engine equals driving fun in this sixth-gen Z car.
catch.zh: 排量提高，缩短轴距，第6代Fairlady z更专注驾驶体验。

long.en:
When the sixth-generation Fairlady Z, the Z34, was introduced in December 2008, most people assumed that the car would be just a mildly updated version of the Z33 that revived the Z car in January 2002. The 370Z, as we knew it, appeared relatively the same; however, upon closer inspection, it became evident that this was an all-new car.

Built atop the E platform that also serves as the foundation of the Infiniti "Skyline" G37, the new Z featured an aluminum hood, door and rear hatch that kept the car's curb weight about the same as the previous vehicle (around <1500kg>). The new Z was nimble, thanks to a wheelbase that was <100mm> shorter and retuned suspension system that consisted of a double-wishbone setup in front and multilink at rear.

Under the hood was a more powerful engine, the VQ37VHR with VVEL. VVEL was a mechanism that varies the operating angle and lift of the valves for improved power and lower emissions. With <200cc> more displacement, the new V6 pumped out <336ps>/<7000rpm> and <37.2kgm> of torque that peaked at <5200rpm>. The engine came mated to either a quick-shifting 6-speed automatic transmission, or a revolutionary 6-speed manual gearbox equipped with the world's first synchro rev control mechanism. This system automatically adjusted engine rpm when downshifting, eliminating the need to heel and toe.

Thus, the Z34 became a true enthusiast sports car that even novices could drive effectively.
long.zh:
属于第6代的Fairlady Z，Z34登场于2008年12月。它是于2002年1月成功回归的5代车型Z33的继任者。

因为外观设计方面全面沿袭大获成功的Z33，所以人们会误以为这是Z33的小改款，其实不然。Z34的改动是全方位的。这款车型与V36 Skyline轿跑共享E平台，高度关注车辆的安全性能。引擎盖、车门和后箱盖的材质更换成了铝，以确保车重与前代的<1480kg>-<1530kg>相当。轴距相比Z33缩短了<100mm>，但操控性能得到了优化。

动力单元来自配备VVEL技术的VQ37VHR引擎，前者能够在引擎工作时调节气阀的工作角度和工作高度。这台引擎的最大输出是<7000rpm>下的<336ps>，最大扭矩则是<5200rpm>时的<37.2kgm>。

传动系统分别提供了一款6速自动变速箱，在切换至手动模式时的换挡速度也名列前茅，另一款6速手动变速箱则应用了全球首款同步转速控制技术，在换挡时无需车手跟趾降档补油，而是能自动将引擎转数调节至最优转速范围。

双叉臂前悬挂和多连杆后悬挂，以及前四后二的铝合金对置活塞卡钳在调校后可提供最大限度的操控性能。

纵观Fairlady Z的全部历史，这是在研发过程中对驾驶体验投入最多关注的一款车型。

catch.en: With its tidy exterior design, this 4th-gen Z car was a handsome sports car for the global market.(
catch.zh: 改用宽体车身之后，第四代Z成为了面向全球市场的跑车。

long.en:
*The Nissan Fairlady Z was sold as the Nissan 300ZX outside Japan.

The Z32, appearing in 1989, was the first complete transformation for the Fairlady Z. It came in a wide, flat body, turning 180 degrees from the narrow, long body designs that lasted 3 generations. It was sized as a global sports car, not restricted by the size classes of the Japanese market.

Its steering characteristics were changed drastically. As soon as the steering wheel is turned, the nose slices into the corner, and the wide tread gave it a high level of potential. This Z opened new doors as a cornering machine, while maintaining its performance as a GT. Again, the Z dropped European thoroughbreds into a hole of despair.

At the heart of this car was a compact V6 with a low center of gravity. Even though it is an FR, it was given a front midship layout with the engine located as far back as possible, to make the front/rear weight distribution close to 50:50. Aiming for the global market, the engine size was fixed at 3 liters, and producing <230ps> in the NA, and <280ps> in the twin turbo, its performance decorated the end of the 20th century. Its suspension used advanced designs as well, and even features like an ABS that does not transfer shock to the brake pedal, were things that went beyond the usual standards of the time.

In 1992, a convertible model was added to the lineup, and was greatly welcomed in its main market of California.
long.zh:
*在日本以外的地区，日产Fairlady Z改以日产300ZX的名字投放市场。

1989年亮相的Z32标志着Fairlady Z的彻底转身，车身设计从延续3代的纤细颀长转为低平的宽体设计。不再受制于日本市场对于车型尺寸的限制，紧跟国际市场的跑车标准。

相应的，车辆的驾驶特性也发生了翻天覆地的变化。当转动方向盘时，车鼻可以灵巧地切入弯道，再加上更宽的车胎带来高抓地力。这款Z32为Z系列打开了一扇新大门——在保持超级跑车性能的同时，打造出一台强大的过弯机器，也让欧洲的竞争对手们如坠冰窟。

这辆车的心脏是一台紧凑的V6引擎，车身重心相当得低。这是一辆前置后驱车，却采用了类似中置引擎前移的车身布局，将引擎位置尽量后挪，以达到车身前后配重为50:50的均衡配比。因为面向国际市场，引擎排量被定在了3.0。自然进气<230ps>和双涡轮<280ps>的动力参数在20世纪末期可谓鹤立鸡群。悬挂方面也应用了当时的先进设计，甚至超前引入了防抱死刹车系统，以避免将刹车时震动传回到制动踏板。

在1992年，产品线中又添加了一款敞篷车型，在Z系列的主要市场加利福尼亚州尤为受到欢迎。

catch.en: This special Datsun Z was equipped with the same engine as the Skyline GT-R.
catch.zh: 这辆Fairlady Z配备了与Skyline GT-R相同的S20引擎，只为比赛而生。

long.en:
In 1969, Nissan completely transformed the Fairlady brand from that of a classic open-top roadster into a classy fixed-roof sports car that went by the name 240Z in many parts of the world. A performance-oriented version of this car was created, called the Z 432.

The car's name referred to its engine, namely its 4 valves, 3 carburettors and 2 camshafts. While the base car came with the L20, a SOHC inline-6, the Z 432 was powered by the L20, which was in fact a detuned version of the <220ps> GR8 engine used in the R380 prototype race car. In the Z 432, it produced <160ps>, which was the same as the previously released Skyline GT-R version.

This made the special Z car quick — a 0-<400m> time of 15.8s and top speed of <210km/h> — making for an ideal race car, but only a limited number of a pure race versions of the car, called the Z 432R, were made. It featured fibrerlass and acrylic components that decreased its weight by <100kg>. Today, the car is a prized collector's item with an example rumored to have fetched $800,000 at auction. .
long.zh:
1969年，日产Fairlady从传统的双座敞篷车变为了激进的斜背车造型。新的Fairlady “Z”系列的顶级型号为高性能的Z 432。

这款车最大的特色是它的引擎。基础款Z使用L20顶置单凸轮轴直列6缸引擎，只有Z 432配备了双顶置凸轮轴的S20引擎——日产R380原型赛车上使用的<220ps>GR8引擎的量产性能调低版本，它的动力输出和此前发售的Skyline GT-R一样，达到了<160ps>。车名中的“432”则代表了引擎配置：4个气阀、3个化油器和双凸轮轴。

这款车的0-<400m>成绩为15.8秒，极速可达到<210km/h>，在当时算是相当快的车型了。凭借如此优异的性能，它在面世一年后便登上了赛车舞台，并一举收获多个冠军头衔。

日产后来还推出了赛车版本Z 432 R，但销量寥寥。日产在赛车版本上应用了玻璃纤维和亚克力部件，让车重减轻了<100kg>。

catch.en: This refined Z33 model came powered by the next-generation VQ35HR engine.
catch.zh: 经过调校的Z33配备了新一代的VQ35HR引擎。

long.en:
Nissan's legendary sports car, the "Fairlady Z," disappeared from the catalog lineup in the summer of 2000, but Nissan President Carlos Ghosn knew full well the importance of this car and had secretly given the go-ahead for the new generation model. In July of 2002, the new Z33 Z-car made its debut.

It shared its base frame and the V6 3.5-liter VQ35DE engine with the V35 Skyline, but it produced <280ps> and <37.0kgm> of torque. It also came with a 6-speed manual gearbox.

The new Z continued to evolve in the following years. One major advancement was made in January 2007, when the engine was changed to the new generation VQ35HR, improving power output to <313ps>. The intake manifold was completely redesigned, and the friction within the engine was reduced. By further improving the crankshaft section, the engine revved more freely. Also, the exhaust note was tuned to give off a deep and low sound, reminiscent of a V-8 engine. The designers added a power bulge to the car's hood to show the Z's extra power.

The engineers heavily modified the car's suspension, improving absorption of the road surface and delivering a flatter cornering character. These changes translated to better overall handling feel and enhanced race-track performance.
long.zh:
在2000年夏天，传奇的日产Fairlady Z突然在日产的产品名录中消失了。但日产充分意识到这台车的历史渊源和重要性，因此私下里批准了新一代车型的开发。在2002年7月，全新的Fairlady Z33正式亮相，

配备6速手动变速箱，并与V35 Skyline共享基础车架和3.5升的V6引擎VQ35DE，而且这台引擎的出力首次被调校到了<280ps>和<37.0kgm>扭矩。

随后的几年里，日产开发部门将“不断演进”的口号落到了实处，持续对Z系列进行改进提升。在2007年的重大改进中，新一代的VQ35HR引擎被用到了Z33上，将马力输出提高到了<313ps>。进气歧管得到了重新设计，以降低引擎内的摩擦。而对曲轴的改进大大提高了引擎的转速体验，给人以动力强劲又细致入微的跑车感受。排气声沉稳有力，仿佛出自大排量V8引擎一般。此外，引擎盖中央的隆起仿佛也在强调着变化。

悬挂设定经过重大改动后提升了对路面反馈的吸收，并能保持车身行驶时的平面稳定性，帮助营造出自然的操控感。

catch.en: This very fast GT-R scored wins at Suzuki, Okayama, and Autopolis in the 2008 Super GT.
catch.zh: 第一款符合新规则的GT-R，以压倒性的速度回应了车迷的期待。

long.en:
When the all-new R35 GT-R made its debut in the Fall of 2007, it was obvious that Nissan intended its supercar to go racing. The company didn't waste much time making its official announcement. Only a month after the GT-R went on sale, Nissan told the Japanese press that the new GT-R would compete in the Super GT Series, the most popular race series in Japan, perhaps all of Asia.

Specifically developed with 2009 vehicle regulations in mind, this race-ready Nissan GT-R featured an innovative construction design that centered on the cabin. While its overall appearance was similar to that of the production GT-R, the race car was a completely different animal.

The engine was a 4.5-liter V8 based on the VK45DE, the power plant in the Fairlady Z GT race car from the previous year. It was reported to produce more than <500ps>.

In competition, the number 23 Xanavi Nismo GT-R piloted by Satoshi Motoyama and Benoît Tréluyer, showed incredible performance from the opening round of the car's maiden season, winning the first two races. In the end it won a total of three races, good enough to bring the team the drivers' title in 2008.

In all, five GT-Rs competed in the Super GT series that year. The GT-R finished 1-2 in the opening round at Suzuka, and won a total of seven out of that year's nine races, meeting, and perhaps exceeding, the expectations of Nissan and GT-R fans all over Asia.@
long.zh:
R35 日产GT-R于2007年秋季发布后，紧接着就在12月开始销售。2008年1月，这款刚上市不久的新GT-R就宣布会自本赛季起参加日本最受欢迎的超跑比赛“Super GT”系列赛。

这款车型提前根据将于2009年颁布的汽车法规进行研发，将原型车的车顶和立柱直接与由管式车架和部分座舱室组成的主底盘相连。也因此，虽然前饰板和车顶曲线依然有着GT-R的影子，但外观和感受都与普通的GT-R大不相同。

引擎是一款源自Super GT参赛车型Fairlady Z的VK45DE 4.5升V8引擎，最大动力输出超过<500ps>。R34 Skyline在参加全日本GT锦标赛时，将传动系统从四驱更改为前置后驱。

由本山哲和伯努瓦·特雷吕耶驾驶的23号Xanavi Nismo GT-R赛车代表NISMO车队参赛，在首轮比赛中就有惊人表现，夺下冠军，随后又趁势赢下了第二轮比赛。

两位车手在赛季中总共夺得3场比赛冠军，最终获得了2008年的车手总冠军。在这个赛季的Super GT中共有5辆GT-R参赛，他们在铃鹿举办的首轮比赛中包揽冠亚军，并在当年的9场比赛中赢下了7场，向广大车迷交出了一张满意的答卷。其中有接近半数的胜利是由Xanavi Nismo GT-R取得的。

catch.en: This JGTC machine gained its edge by lowering the center of gravity and shortening the wheelbase.
catch.zh: 通过降低重心和缩短轴距来提高速度的JGTC赛车。

long.en:
Nissan originally conceived the Skyline GT-R R32 as a Group A race car, but when Group A racing went defunct, Nissan found a new series for its prized car, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC). The GT-R later underwent a full redesign as the R33, and performance of this new car on the track was impressive to say the least. However, as Nissan's main rival, Toyota, started contesting with a faster version of the Supra, and Honda added more heat when it joined the series in 1997, the GT-R was losing its grasp on JGTC dominance.

Although Nissan took both the Drivers' and Constructors' championship titles in 1998, the company switched to the new R34 in 1999 as the foundation for its race car. The new GT-R rode on a <55mm> shorter wheelbase than the R33, making it more agile than its predecessor. Also a shallower oil pan and the fuel tank relocated inside the cabin accounted for better weight distribution.

The new revived GT-R found itself in far fiercer competition than anticipated, and didn't score its first win until the fourth race of the season.

The GT-R was unable to log a second win that year, but collected enough points on the strength of its reliability to give Érik Comas, driving the Pennzoil NISMO GT-R, the Drivers' championship title for the second year in a row before the final race was even run.
long.zh:
参照A组别赛车规则设计的R32 GT-R在A组别赛事停办后，转而投入到全日本GT锦标赛的竞争行列当中。为此，GT-R推出了全新设计的R33，在赛道的表现依旧强劲。但随着丰田的Supra一骑绝尘，本田的NSX也在1997年加入赛事，GT-R略显臃肿的车身成为了负担。

尽管在1998年的全日本GT锦标赛中，日产依旧收获了车队和车手冠军，但还是决定在1999年将基础车型更新至R34，轴距比R33缩短了<55mm>，带来了更强的竞争力。伴随着新的车身设计，日产为引擎换上了更浅的油底壳，通过压缩引擎高度来降低车身重心。为了应对新规，他们巧妙地将油箱挪到车厢内来优化配重比。

从1999年第一场比赛开始，GT-R便发现赛道上的竞争远超以往，胜利不再唾手可得。R34直到第四站美弥才迎来了首胜，埃里克·科马斯和本山哲驾驶的Pennzoil NISMO GT-R带着无法使用的4档艰难前行，在完赛前的5圈前超越了领先的Supra，拔得头筹。

但在那一年的后续比赛中，GT-R再未获胜，好在凭借稳定性能带来的积分足以帮助科马斯提前一轮蝉联车手冠军头衔。

catch.en: Despite a touch of maturity, the new GT-R still possessed the heart of a monster.
catch.zh: 2017年的车型做出了更深入的改进。

long.en:
This new Nissan GT-R was announced at the New York International Auto Show in April 2016, amid a fury of anticipation and hype. As the most significantly changed model since its introduction in 2007, the new R35 GT-R didn’t disappoint.

Changes to the car’s design was not only intended to make the car look better, but also designed to enhance its aerodynamic performance. The new, larger Vmotion grille highlighted the new freshened face, while a new lower, rigid hood resisted deformation at high speeds. The fenders and front bumpers were reshaped to provide more downforce.

The GT-R remained a monster when it came to performance. The engine, which was still built by hand by master craftsmen, had more power than before, with <573ps> at <6800rpm> and a maximum torque of <64.6kgm> on tap. Combined with an improved 6-speed dual-clutch transmission, the new GT-R was quicker and more responsive than the previous model in the mid-rpm ranges.

With pavement-sticking all-wheel-drive handling, the new GT-R now wreaked havoc in a custom-tailored suit.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
long.zh:
日产GT-R于2016年4月在纽约国际车展上公布。这是自2007年推出以来对R35 GT-R最大幅度的更新。

外部特征的改变并不仅仅是为了外观，也在很高水平上平衡了空气阻力、下压力和冷却性能。车头前方依然保留了日产的标志性Vmotion前脸。引擎盖刚度进一步提升，以抵消超高车速情况下的变形。全新的前扰流板也可以产生强大的下压力。

这辆车的3.8升V6双涡轮增压引擎全部由手工打造，最大输出功率已提升到了<573ps>/<6800rpm>，最大扭矩为<64.6kgm>。在改良型6档双离合变速箱的辅佐下，这部引擎可以提供从中到高速度范围的平顺加速。当然，为了争夺世界最佳操控性车的名号，其弯道性能也同样得到了提高。

就如其“深度进化”表现那样，这是一辆代表日本跑车风范的车。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

catch.en: This Gr.B design reimagines the Nissan GT-R as a dedicated off-road race machine.
catch.zh: 以Gr.B规格设计的这款车型将Nissan GT-R重新塑造成了一辆火力全开的越野赛车。

The new, larger Vmotion grille highlighted the new freshened face, while a new lower, rigid hood resisted deformation at high speeds. The fenders and front bumpers were reshaped to provide more downforce.
