catch.en: Built by Tom Walkinshaw Racing, this sporty Lutecia featured a mid-mounted 3.0-liter V6.
catch.zh: 由TWR开发的极致小钢炮，搭载3升中置引擎。

long.en:
Renault wanted to build the ultimate hot hatch from the second-gen Clio, and to do so, the company wanted to install a V6 into the compact car. There wasn't enough room to accommodate such a large powerplant under the hood, so the rear seats were removed, and in its place sat a 3.0-liter V6 mounted amidships.

This car was marketed in Japan as the Lutecia Sport V6. This powerplant is the same one found in the company's upscale model, the Laguna. It produces <233ps>/<6000rpm> and an impressive <30.6kgm> of torque at <3750rpm>. Shifting is performed via a 6-speed manual gearbox. The big power made the Clio R.S. V6 the prototypical “point and squirt” car because it possessed both excellent acceleration, especially at the low end of the rpm spectrum, and remarkable nimbleness.

The suspension system consisted of specially designed struts, and when combined with the grip provided by its wide tires—205/50R17 up front and 235/45R17 at rear, the little Renault stuck to the road surface through corners. That the Lutecia performed as well as it did was amazing given that Renault transformed an FF (Front engine/Front drive) car into an MR (Mid-engine/Rear drive).

A slightly redesigned Clio R.S. V6 appeared at the Paris Motor Show in October 2002, featuring larger 18-in. wheels. Power for the engine was bumped up to <255ps>/<7150rpm> and <30.6kgm> of torque at <4650rpm>. The suspension geometry was also revised, and, when combined with an additional subframe at the rear, the car handled better than the original.
long.zh:
Clio R.S. V6（在日本命名为Lutecia R.S. V6）是一辆中置引擎跑车，它基于雷诺Clio改装，拆除了后座，并换上了一台原本用于高配车型如Laguna上的3升V6引擎。

这款车专为赛车运动打造，在F1进入欧洲前，它被用于单一车种比赛。我们看到的这一款是公路版本。据说它是在1980年代早期在世界拉力锦标赛比赛中打响名号的R5 Turbo的复刻车型。

其3升V6引擎能在<6000rpm>时输出<233ps>，最大扭矩为<3750rpm>下的<30.6kgm>。变速箱只有6速手动可选。

其悬挂系统前后都采用了专门设计的支撑臂，轮胎则分为前轮205/50R17，后轮235/45R17。为了配合宽轮胎，车身前后均安装了外扩挡泥板，但造型方面并没有R5 Turbo那样狂野，而是与车身构成了优美的线条。

在2002年10月举办的巴黎车展中，Clio R.S. V6的相位2小改款初次亮相。外观只有少量改动，但和标准款Clio一样，采用全新一代的雷诺家族设计。与此同时，其内饰也得到了全面升级，而且把轮胎尺寸加大到了18英寸。

虽然引擎排量没有变化，但最大输出动力增加到了<7150rpm>时的<255ps>。输出最大扭矩所需的转速也提高到了<4650rpm>。悬挂结构经过了改进，车身后部额外增加了一具副车架，使整体驾驶性能得到了提升。

catch.en: This limited-edition Renault set a lap record at the Nürburgring.
catch.zh: 这款限量版车型曾在纽博格林赛道上刷出了量产前驱车的圈速纪录。

long.en:
The 3-door model of the third-generation Mégane that was introduced in 2008 was on a totally different level from its 5-door hatchback stablemate.

The high-performance version of this 3-door coupe, tuned by Renault Sport Technologies, is the Mégane Renault Sport. It was first shown at the 2009 Geneva Auto Show, and reached the public in 2010.

Mounted in a body that wore special aerodynamic parts was a dedicated 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 with a twin-scroll turbocharger, producing <250ps> and <34.7kgm> torque. The engine was mated to a 6-speed manual gearbox.

The most notable component of this car was the chassis. Renault Sport, which develops cars for one-make and rally racing, created two different types of chassis for this car. One was tuned for road use, while the other was a “Chassis Cup” spec that also took into account on-track racing. Both utilize a double-axle strut system that allows load to remain at the centers of the front tires regardless of the up/down movement of the suspension. Because of this, the car’s cornering speed was said to be the quickest ever for a front-wheel drive.

In 2011, Renault introduced a 500-car limited edition model called the Mégane Renault Sport Trophy, featuring an increased power output of <265ps> as well as 19-inch wheels. This car was taken to the Nürburgring for a time trial, and set a front-engine/front-wheel-drive record of 8 minutes, 7.97 seconds!

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
long.zh:
2008年首次亮相的第三代3门版梅甘娜是一款有着赛车设计的跑车，和5门的掀背车完全不可同日而语。

而这辆三门跑车的高性能版本——梅甘娜R.S.，由雷诺运动技术进行调校，首次亮相是在2009年的日内瓦车展上，并于2010年开始交付。

这辆车搭载一部专用的2升双顶置凸轮轴直4双涡流涡轮增压引擎，可以输出<250ps>和<34.7kgm>的扭矩，并配有特别设计的空气动力学部件。传动方面，则采用了一款6档手动变速箱。

这辆车最吸引人的部分就是底盘。雷诺运动作为雷诺专门开发单一车种赛和拉力赛用车的部门，为这款车配置了两套不同类型的底盘。其中一种是针对公路进行调校的底盘，而另外一种“杯型底盘”则加入了赛道驾驶环境的考量。二者都使用了双轴支撑，这样一来，无论悬挂如何上下运动，都可以让载荷始终施加于前轮的中央。据称这款车的弯道速度是所有前轮驱动车里最快的。

在2011年，雷诺还推出了一款500辆的限量版本，称作梅甘娜R.S Trophy，其引擎功率提升到了<265ps>，还换用了19英寸轮毂。这款车于同一年在纽博格林赛道上进行了一场计时赛，并创下了前置引擎、前轮驱动车的记录——8分7.97秒。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

catch.en: This limited-edition Renault set a lap record at the Nürburgring.
catch.zh: 这款限量版车型曾在纽博格林赛道上刷出了量产前驱车的圈速纪录。

在2011年，雷诺还推出了一款500辆的限量版本，称作梅甘娜R.S. Trophy[梅甘娜 R.S 纪念版]，其引擎功率提升到了<265ps>，还换用了19英寸轮毂。这款车于同一年在纽博格林赛道上进行了一场计时赛，并创下了前置引擎、前轮驱动车的记录——8分7.97秒。/

catch.en: This safety car version of the Mégane RS Trophy was created to patrol the race track.
catch.zh: Mégane RS Trophy比赛的安全车版本，专为赛道而设计。

long.en:
Unveiled at the Geneva Motor Show in the spring of 2009, the Mégane RS was a high-performance model, tuned by Renault Sport Technologies, based on the third-gen 3-door Renault Mégane that was introduced in 2008.

The car's aerodynamics were significantly improved from the previous model, thanks to new body panels all over. Under the hood resided a specially-tuned 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 fitted with a twin-scroll turbocharger that produced <250ps>/<34.7kgm>. This engine came mated to a 6-speed manual transmission.

One of the most notable features of this car was that it was available with two different chassis options. The "Sport Chassis" was tuned for road use, while the "Cup Chassis" was meant to be enjoyed on the track. Both models came equipped with a double-axis strut suspension that placed load on the center of the front tires regardless of vertical suspension movement.

In 2011, the Mégane RS Trophy, a limited-edition version with <265ps>, was offered. Only 500 units were produced, and the car went on to set a record for front-wheel-drive production cars at the Nürburgring with a lap time of 8:07:79.

*This safety car version is an original model created by Gran Turismo.
long.zh:
2009年春天在日内瓦车展揭开面纱的梅甘娜RS是接受了雷诺运动调校的高性能车型。其开发原型是2008年才推出的第三代3门版雷诺梅甘娜。

车身上的改进相当多：独有的空力套件，加装了双涡流涡轮的2升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸引擎接受过特殊调校，可输出<250ps>和<34.7kgm>扭矩，与动力单元搭配的还有一台6速手动变速箱。

这台车型最引人注目的特点在于提供了两套完全不同的底盘。“运动底盘”针对道路驾驶调校，而“杯赛底盘”专为赛道而生。两种底盘同样采用双悬臂悬挂系统，无论悬挂的竖向行程长短，都能将重心集中在两只前胎的中央位置，主要差异之一在于对阻尼率的设定。得益于这套底盘系统的引入，梅甘娜RS实现了前驱车中最快的过弯速度。

2011年，动力提升至<265ps>的梅甘娜R.S Trophy上市，全球限量500台。也是在同一年，这款车型以8:07:79的成绩刷新了前驱量产车在纽博格林赛道上的圈速纪录。

*这款安全车是跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。

cars.nameEn: Renault Sport Mégane R.S. Trophy Safety Car
cars.nameZh: 雷诺运动梅甘娜R.S. Trophy安全车X

en.nameLong: Renault Sport Mégane R.S. Trophy Safety Car

zh.nameLong: Renault Sport Mégane R.S. Trophy Safety Car

catch.en: Aggressive looks topped off by gullwing doors highlight this Mégane Trophy.
catch.zh: Mégane Trophy车型，鸥翼车门为霸气外观更添魄力。

long.en:
This special edition to commemorate the 15th anniversary of Gran Turismo is based on the third-generation Renault Mégane. The concept car was unveiled at the Geneva show in the spring of 2008, and the official debut was at the Paris Motor Show in the autumn. Completely different from the second-generation model, and renewed with a stylish, sporty form, it was well received by enthusiasts from all over Europe. This latest generation of the one-make race machine was dubbed the Mégane Trophy V6.

As with all one-make Mégane race cars since the first generation, Renault Sport was in charge of machine development. The third-generation car adopted the same method as that of the second-generation machine, building it into the style of a DTM machine with significantly enlarged fenders that functioned as radical aerodynamic devices front and rear. The few parts shared with the production car include lamps, door mirrors and the emblem on the front. The designers performed a remarkable job retaining the general look of the base car, making it unmistakable as a Mégane from any angle.

The powerplant, mounted low in a vehicle weighing just <955kg>, is paired with a Renault Sport-tuned 3.5-liter Nissan V6 that delivers <360ps>/<39.8kgm> through a 6-speed, manual gearbox. Suspension is the classic coil and damper formula, the body is made of FRP, not carbon, in order to reduce the cost for racers – the only people who get to purchase this iconic machine.
long.zh:
雷诺自1960年代的8 Gordini起就以各种形式参与单一车种赛事。2005年，他们开始自行主办梅甘娜欧洲杯赛事，这也是雷诺世界系列赛的一部分。这款车型是为了参加2006年起的梅甘娜欧洲杯而开发的，梅甘娜也随之迈入了第三代。

该车的引擎中置于管式框架内，特殊车身外壳则采用梅甘娜专属设计。只有少数几个部件，如头灯和尾灯与量产型通用。由超宽的前车身和后尾翼等空气动力学组件塑造的造型，和足以让DTM赛车望而却步的庞大扩散器呈现出强烈的侵略感。就连车门也改为了鸥翼式，带来额外的感官刺激。

即便如此，原版梅甘娜的外廓和独特细节依然得到了全盘保留，使得整车外观与第三代梅甘娜轿跑非常相似。安装在仅重<955kg>的车身内的动力单元是一台调校到<360ps>的3.5升日产V6引擎，传动系统是6速双踏板手动变速箱，具备手自一体换挡功能。

悬挂与刹车均采用赛车标准配置，而且该车型只向参加赛事的车手提供。但你应该也猜得到，众多爱好者们已经向雷诺提出了推出风格类似的公路版车型的诉求。

catch.en: A French race car with a Japanese heart.
catch.zh: R.S.01，步入了运动赛车的世界。

long.en:
Renault Sport has been transforming Renault cars into exclusive high-performance machines for many years. The division created the R.S.01 in the summer of 2014 to participate in a one-make race series, especially for its fan base of hardcore enthusiasts.

The R.S.01 illustrates the deep working partnership between Renault and Nissan. Its carbon monocoque chassis was co-developed by Renault and Dallara, while the exterior styling was executed by a Nissan designer. The car measures <4710mm> from bumper to bumper and sits <2000mm> wide. It tips the scales at a lean <1100kg>, making it quick and agile. Nissan was also responsible for providing the power unit, a Nismo-tuned VR38DETT from the Nissan GT-R. The twin-turbocharged V-6 produced <550ps> in the R.S.01.

Renault Sport also produced another version of this race car called the R.S.01 GT3. As the name suggests, it met FIA's GT3 homologation rules. Because of this, the GT3 version wasn't as hardcore as its stablemate, with steel disc brakes rather than carbon and less engine power. However, because the GT3 category has become the most popular category in sports car racing, it presents an ideal opportunity for the R.S.01 to showcase its amazing potential for all the world to see.
long.zh:
雷诺运动多年来一直在为雷诺车型打造高性能版本。这家在法国赛车行业首屈一指的车厂在2014年夏天公布了他们的单一车种赛比赛用车R.S.01。

这部血统纯正的赛车展现了雷诺和日产的深度合作成果。碳纤维单体车壳底盘由雷诺和达拉拉合作开发，外观设计则由日本设计师负责，而引擎是一部来自日产GT-R、经过Nismo调校的VR38DETT。

车身长<4710mm>，宽<2000mm>，重量仅为<1100kg>。其轻量化的底盘由一具<550ps> V6双涡轮引擎驱动。雷诺运动的专业技能应用到了该车的空气动力学设计和冷却上，因此这辆赛车的实力毋庸置疑。

雷诺运动同时还另外制造了其衍生版本——R.S.01 GT3。这辆车经过改造，符合国际汽联GT3规范，同时又保留了原本R.S.01的精髓。经过改造之后，这辆车的性能甚至还略有下降。碳纤维刹车碟被换成了钢制刹车碟，引擎功率也受到了限制。不过，GT3是赛车运动领域最受欢迎的组别。如果R.S.01可以更频繁地在赛道上露面，那么这些改造就是非常值得的。

catch.en: Renault's special GT3 machine with Nismo power.
catch.zh: 参加雷诺世界系列赛的GT赛车，经由NISMO调试后重获新生。

long.en:
Created for a special one-make race series introduced in 2015 called the “World Series by Renault”—the successor to the Mégane Trophy—the Renault Sport R.S.01 was a limited-edition competition machine that defined the term “pocket rocket,” thanks in part to a power unit straight from the Nissan GT-R. itself.

Utilizing a carbon monocoque developed together with Italian race car constructor Dallara, the Sport R.S.01 was extremely lightweight, tipping the scales at a lean <1100kg>. Power was supplied by Nissan’s twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter V-6 found in the Nissan GT-R, which was further tuned by NISMO. The engine, mounted amidships, produced more than <500ps> and <61.2kgm> of torque. It came mated to an SADEV 7-speed sequential gearbox that helped the car reach a maximum speed of more than <300km/h>.

In November 2015, Renault introduced a GT3 version of this car at the Paul Ricard Circuit in France, developed for the FIA-GT Championships. The R.S.01 GT3 had to be tamed considerably to meet GT3 regulations, so a restrictor was added to the engine to decrease power. Also, the brakes were changed from carbon ceramic to steel discs. To meet the minimum weight specified by the FIA, more than <50kg> of ballast was added to the chassis, and the aerodynamics were also revised. All the changes just confirmed how potent the original was.[
long.zh:
雷诺运动 R.S.01是一部特殊的单一车种赛比赛用车，专为参加由雷诺运动主办的雷诺世界系列赛而少量生产。这辆车在2015赛季首次亮相，成为了梅甘娜Trophy的后继车型。

其车身使用了与意大利赛车生产商达拉拉共同开发的碳纤维单体车壳，全车重量控制在了<1100kg>以下。中置引擎采用日产GT-R的3.8升V6双涡轮增压引擎，并由日产的赛车运动部门Nismo调校。这辆车的输出功率超过<500ps>，最大扭矩超过<61.2kgm>，再搭配SADEV 7档序列式变速箱，其最大时速可以超过<300km/h>。

基于这辆R.S.01，雷诺运动还为参加国际汽联的GT锦标赛开发了R.S.01 GT3，并于2015年11月在法国保罗里卡德赛道上首次公布。为了符合国际汽联的GT3规范，R.S.01 GT3的性能有所下调。V6双涡轮增压引擎被加上了限速器，降低了功率，而刹车也从碳化陶瓷刹车碟改成了钢制刹车碟。为了满足国际汽联的最低重量要求，这辆车不得不增加超过<50kg>的配重，空气动力学外观也重新进行了设计。不过，由于这辆车原本以超高性能赛车为标准设计，所以在遭遇规范限制时也有很大的下调余地。

catch.en: Practical yet cute. A breath of fresh air for the A-segment.
catch.zh: 实用又可爱。为A级车市场注入清新活力。

long.en:
In 1990, Renault transitioned from the Super 5 to the Clio. The Clio’s increased size, however, left space in the lineup for a smaller model. The car developed to fill that role was the Twingo, an A-segment hatchback.

The Twingo became known for its 3-door monospace design, with a nearly continuous curve flowing from the truncated hood, over the roof and into the rear. This distinctive shape set it apart from contemporary rivals and made a strong impression at its 1992 debut. Its wheels were positioned at the extreme corners of the body, maximizing interior space despite compact dimensions of <3433mm> in length and <1423mm> in height.

At launch, the Twingo was equipped with a transversely mounted 1.2-liter inline-4 OHV engine. While modest in output, it complemented the lightweight body and delivered a lively, city-friendly driving experience. The car was also praised for bringing character to a practical design, with sliding rear seats that allowed for multiple seating and cargo configurations.

Over time, the first-generation Twingo received a series of mechanical and visual updates, remaining in production for 14 years until 2007. Practical yet distinctive, it remains one of the most influential models in A-segment history.
long.zh:
1990年，雷诺停产了Super 5，推出了其继任车型Clio。然而，由于Clio的车身尺寸加大，因此该公司的产品阵容中，仍然欠缺一款小型车来填补空白。为此，雷诺推出了Twingo，一款A级掀背车。

Twingo以其三门单厢式车身而闻名，其轮廓线条从短促的引擎盖开始，经车顶延伸至车尾，几乎一气呵成，流畅自然。这一设计使其与同时代的竞争对手区分开来，在1992年首次亮相时震撼了市场。四个车轮被极限排布在车身的四角，使其在仅<3433mm>长、<1423mm>高的紧凑车身尺寸下，仍然保证了超乎寻常的内部空间。

Twingo在问世之初，搭载了一台横置的1.2升直列四缸顶置阀门引擎。虽然这台引擎只能提供够用的动力，但与轻量化车身搭配得将将好，足以让它轻快灵动地在都市中穿行。此外，Twingo还配备了可滑动的后排座椅，从而实现数种空间布局，这种在实用车型中引入独特功能的设计受到了好评。

第一代Twingo在多年间历经多次引擎和外观升级，生产周期长达14年，直至2007年方才落幕。这是一辆实用又可爱的小车，堪称A级车发展史上最具革命性的车型之一。

catch.en: This 2014 GT Awards winner was a high-speed monster wearing the skin of a Camaro SS.
catch.zh: 2014年GT奖得主。披着Camaro SS外皮的高速怪物。

long.en:
For years, Gran Turismo handed out its "Best in Show" award at the SEMA show, a giant aftermarket convention that takes place annually in Las Vegas, Nevada. In 2014, the 12th Best in Show award went to the 1970 Chevrolet Camaro SS "Rampage," built by muscle-car chassis specialists Roadster Shop of Illinois, United States.

True to its name, the car looked mean from every angle. Bulging fender flares at both the front and rear gave it a wide, menacing stance, while a large front spoiler and rear wing hinted of the prowess underneath the hood, which was a 7.0-liter LS7 tuned to produce <750ps> and mounted <13cm> rearward to improve weight distribution.

Perhaps the most notable aspect of the car was its rebuilt chassis, which came with a roll cage and plenty of carbon-fiber and aluminum components. Also, the suspension was converted to an inboard cantilever design, which thoroughly impressed the Gran Turismo team and earned the car its distinct recognition.
long.zh:
在每年的美国汽车用品改装车展览会上，都会向最优秀的改装车授予GT大奖。在2014年的第12届展会上，这项大奖颁给了美国伊利诺伊州的肌肉车底盘专家“Roadster Shop”所打造的一辆名为“公羊”的1970年雪佛兰科迈罗SS。

这辆车采用了超大尺寸的前后挡泥板，还增加了大号的前扰流板和尾翼，呈现出极其富有侵略性的外观。但更惊人之处还在于它的内在。底盘完全重新打造，为了提高刚度增加了防滚架，而且整车的许多零件也替换为了碳纤维和铝制部件，极大地减轻了车重。

排量高达7L的LS7引擎也经过调校，可以输出<750ps>的动力，并在布局位置上后移了<13cm>，优化了前后配重比。不过我们底盘专家的拿手好戏还是将悬挂系统转换为了一套内侧悬臂设计。或许这辆车就是终极的现代化复古改装作品。

catch.en: Subaru's most aggressive sports car ever is potent yet civilized. R
catch.zh: Subaru历史上最激进的跑车，但依然易于操纵，驾驶充满乐趣。

long.en:
Vision Gran Turismo is a revolutionary project established for car enthusiasts all over the world. The car provided by Subaru for this dream project, where the world's car manufacturers and brands develop concept cars in the game world, is an ultimate sports car carrying Subaru's concept car motto "VIZIV"; Vision for Innovation. The car is called the "SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo".

Inheriting the design language of Subaru's "SUBARU VIZIV 2 Concept" revealed at the March 2014 Geneva show, the Subaru design team have added dynamic and solid shapes to the model. Its shoulder line extends from the front hexagonal grill all the way to the rear. Its tough-looking body seems as though it was carved from hard, solid metal. And with blister fenders extending its shape three dimensionally outward, it visually expresses Subaru's pursuit of a safe and enjoyable driving experience. Its large diffuser, the roof integrated rear spoiler, and its shooting brake silhouette, which accounts for aerodynamic performance, will surely stand out among others in the game.

Thorough weight reduction was a focus in the design of the body structure, and carbon materials have been utilized everywhere. As a result, the vehicle weight was held down to <1380kg> despite being equipped with heavy batteries and motors. And propelling the lightweight body is Subaru's legendary 2 liter horizontally opposed engine that has been fully tuned with years of motorsports experience. The direct injection turbocharged engine that has been powered up with revised restrictor diameters is combined with one high-power motor in the front and two in the rear, which achieves a total system power output of <600ps> and 800 Nm (<82kgm>) of maximum torque. By independently controlling each of the motor outputs, turning ability while cornering is drastically improved, while the torque vectoring lamps built into the fenders visualize its movement. Thus, as with any other Subaru, the car is made controllable for anyone driving it, regardless of its extremely high performance levels.

Experience the "SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo," a car that delivers Subaru's ideals of confidence and driving pleasure through an unprecedented aggressive design and extreme levels of performance.
long.zh:
跑车浪漫旅愿景是一项专为全世界赛车爱好者设立的革命性项目。全世界的汽车制造商和品牌会联合起来共同打造游戏内的概念赛车，而斯巴鲁为这项梦幻项目所提供的是一辆终极跑车。车名延续了斯巴鲁概念赛车座右铭 “VIZIV”：意为创新的愿景，因此这辆车被命名为“斯巴鲁VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo”。

这辆车沿袭了2014年3月日内瓦车展上公布的“斯巴鲁VIZIV 2 Concept”的设计语言，除此之外，斯巴鲁的设计团队还为这款车加入动感硬朗的造型。其肩部线条从车头六角形进气格栅一直延伸到车尾，硬朗风格的车身看起来就像是刚从一块坚硬、结实的金属上切削下来的一样。鼓起的挡泥板将车身横向扩展，完美展现了斯巴鲁对于安全和舒适驾驶体验的追求。这辆车有着大号的扰流翼、与车顶一体的后扰流板、以及考虑到空气动力学性能的猎装车外形，绝对可以在游戏里脱颖而出。

彻底的减重是车体结构设计的重点，因此碳纤维材料得到了广泛使用。因此，尽管装备了许多沉重的电池和电机，车重还是被控制在了<1380kg>。推动这套轻量化车身的是斯巴鲁传奇般的2升水平对置引擎，并使用多年的赛车运动经验进行了精心调校。直喷涡轮增压引擎的限制器直径得到了改良，再搭配上前部的一台和后部的两台大功率电机，总输出功率可达<600ps>，最大扭矩可达800 牛·米（<82kgm>）。通过对两部电机的输出功率进行独立控制，这辆车的弯道转向能力得到了大幅增强，而内置在挡泥板上的扭矩矢量控制灯让它的运动变得清晰可见。因此ｌ和斯巴鲀的儶他车款一样，虽然这辆车月着超高的性能，其设计䍵都诩每一个人都可以轻松驾驭。

“斯巴鲁VIZIV GT Wision Gran Turismo” 通过前所未有的冲击性鮾计和超强的性能展掰了斯巴鲁的自忡哌对詾驶乐趣皅扦行追求，快叻伓騌下这迆车呧

catch.en: A super sports car combining the heart of the Hayabusa with electric motors.
catch.zh: 用一颗Hayabusa的心脏加上多台电机综合打造的超级跑车。

long.en:
Suzuki is one of a small number of manufacturers to produce both cars and motorbikes. First introduced 20 years ago, the GSX-R/4 sports concept was developed as the amalgamation of its 2- and 4-wheeled sports vehicles. It featured the high-performance engine from the company's "Hayabusa" flagship sports bike mounted amidships on a lightweight aluminum-framed car body. The GSX-R/4 has also appeared in previous Gran Turismo titles.

And now, the latest rendition of the Hayabusa engine returns with Suzuki's latest developments in electrification and lightweight construction methods in the Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo.

The car sports a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout with the new Hayabusa <1340cc> engine mounted just aft of the front axle. The gasoline engine is combined with two electric motors that drive the front wheels and one that powers the rear. Total output is rated at 318kW (<432ps>) and 610 Nm (<62kgm>) of torque peaking at 3000 rpm. And thanks to Suzuki's lightweight construction methods, the 2-seat convertible tips the scales at a lean <970kg>.

The exterior design combines the DNA of Suzuki's sporting heritage seen on the Swift Sport. The GSX-R/4's long nose is reminiscent of the company's Cappuccino "kei car." The interior design possesses the aesthetics of a motorcycle and expresses the joy of driving in a modern pure sports fashion.
long.zh:
铃木是少数几家同时生产汽车和摩托车的制造商之一。在20年前首次推出时，GSX-R/4的开发理念是针对2轮与4轮运动车型混合开发。它将一颗来自铃木旗舰摩托车“隼”的高性能引擎安装在轻量化铝制框架车身的中部。这款GSX-R/4在之前的跑车浪漫旅作品中就亮过相了。

如今，隼引擎的进化版随着铃木在电动化和轻量化工程方案方面的最新进展一同回归，铃木Vision Gran Turismo应运而生。

这款车采用了前置引擎、后轮驱动布局，一台新款隼 1340cm³（即<1340cc>）引擎依然置于车身中部，附带前2后1的电机配置，形成全轮驱动系统。引擎和电机的混合动力输出让总功率达到了318kw（<432ps>）和3000转下610牛·米（<62kgm>）的最大扭矩。再配合铃木通过轻量化工程方案实现的<970kg>双座无顶紧凑车身，打造出一款超级跑车。

此车的外观设计继承了以速翼特运动版为代表的铃木运动基因，修长的前车头轮廓让人想起了经典的Cappuccino。内饰部分与GSX-R/4相近，拥有摩托车框架的美学表达，以现代、纯粹的运动风格展现驾驶的乐趣。

catch.en: This Gr.3 Vision Gran Turismo possesses Suzuki's racing spirit.
catch.zh: 这辆Gr.3 Vision Gran Turismo充满了Suzuki的不屈斗争精神。

long.en:
This car is the Gr.3 version of the Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo, a lightweight sports car combining the sporting philosophies of Suzuki's 2- and 4-wheel machines. This model highlights the company's racing prowess and has been extensively tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations.

The base Suzuki VGT features a hybrid powerplant, combining the <1340cc> Hayabusa engine with three high-powered electric motors. While the base car was all-wheel drive, the Gr.3 machine takes the form of a front-engine/rear-wheel driver with two 4-cyclinder Hayabusa engines bolted together, making it a <2680cc> V-8. With twin turbochargers providing extra muscle, this amazing engine produces <586ps> at an astoundingly high <10000rpm>.

Compared to the base model, the design aesthetics have been altered to provide increased downforce that comes via an enlarged front spoiler, rear wing, air ducting on the hood, and front and rear diffusers. Also, plenty of carbon fiber has been used to keep the car's weight minimal.

The livery represents a vivid representation of Suzuki's passion for motorsports, featuring graphics using Metallic Triton Blue and Metallic Mystic Silver, Suzuki's motorcycle race team colors.
long.zh:
这辆车是铃木Vision Gran Turismo的组别3版本，这款轻量级跑车结合了铃木在二轮和四轮车型上的运动理念，体现出了铃木在赛车运动上强大的实力，并经过大幅改装，以满足组别3规则的要求。

作为基础车型的铃木Vision Gran Turismo采用了1340 cm³（<1340cc>）的隼引擎，并在全轮驱动系统中与3台高功率电机相连。然而，这个组别3版本却采用了简化的前置引擎、后轮驱动布局，由两个隼引擎模块组成V8双涡轮增压动力组，总排量达2680 cm³（<2680cc>）。在此形态下，这台怪兽般的引擎能够在令人惊叹的<10000rpm>下产生最大<586ps>的强劲动力。

与基础车型相比，外观设计被稍作调整以增大下压力，加大了前扰流板，并增加了前后扩散器，GT尾翼和引擎盖上的风道。此外，车身通过换装多处碳纤维部件，极大地减轻了车重。

此车的涂装采用了铃木摩托车车队的官方配色：海神金属蓝和神秘金属银，旗帜鲜明地展现了铃木对赛车运动的激情。

catch.en: The unbeatable group C car marked the return of the Mercedes-Benz Works racing team.
catch.zh: 战无不胜的C组别赛车，重返赛场的Mercedes车队令人敬畏不已。

long.en:
Spearheaded by Swiss car constructor Sauber, the C9 appeared in 1988 as a Group C car. Beginning in 1986, Mercedes-Benz began supplying Sauber with Group C engines, and two years after that, Mercedes-Benz officially announced Sauber as its motorsports partner, forming a partnership committed to building GT race cars. This marked the first time since 1955 that Mercedes-Benz built GT race cars, ever since a big accident at the 24 Hours of Le Mans forced the company out of motorsports.

The Sauber Mercedes-Benz C9 met with success immediately, earning pole position in the opener for the 1988 WSPC (World Sportscar Championship) and going on to win five of 12 races that year. In 1989, Mercedes-Benz replaced the turbocharged 5.0-liter SOHC V-8 with a 4-valve version that increased power to <720ps>. The restyled C9 looked imposing, bathed in silver paint and was christened with the nickname "Silver Arrow," a reference to the legendary Mercedes-Benz (and Auto Union) Grand Prix cars during the Golden Age of Racing.

That year, the Silver Arrows finished 1-2 at the World Sportscar Championship at Suzuka Circuit and 2-3 at Dijon. At the 24 Hours of Le Mans, the Silver Arrows finished 1-2, and another car finishing 5th. In 1988, with seven wins in eight races, Jean-Louis Schlesser became the Drivers' Champion and Sauber took the team title.
long.zh:
索伯C9是瑞士车厂索伯于1988年开发的一款C组赛车，主要设计师为皮特·索伯。梅赛德斯-奔驰自1986年起开始向索伯供应C组引擎。1988年，梅赛德斯-奔驰宣布自1955年勒芒耐力赛后，首次重新参加赛车活动，索伯车队被宣布为他们的车厂车队。

这款车在铝质单体底盘上安装了一台5.0升的V8涡轮增压引擎。在1998年世界原型跑车锦标赛上，索伯梅赛德斯C9在首轮比赛中就从杆位发车并获胜，并在接下来的十二场比赛中获得五场胜利。1989年，梅赛德斯-奔驰将引擎更换为每缸4阀门的双顶置式凸轮轴引擎，将最大马力提升到令人震惊的<720ps>。这款大排量的V8引擎采用低压升压、注重扭矩的设计，目标只有一个：成为系列赛的冠军。

C9赛车在登场当年选择了全银色车身的全新形象。这个造型令许多人为之胆寒，被他们看作原来梅赛德斯厂车的归来，这些赛车当年有着“银箭”的赫赫威名。这一年，C9在世界跑车锦标赛开幕第一轮比赛的铃鹿赛道上展现出压倒性的力量，以1、2名获胜，并在后来第戎的比赛上获得了2、3名。

6月，C9参加了勒芒24小时耐力赛。第63号车获得了第一名的伟大战绩，61号车荣获第二，62号车位列第五。

此后C9在比赛中继续大发神威。1989年，施勒塞尔创下八场七胜的纪录，成为车手冠军，索伯也成为车队冠军。*

catch.en: Lightweight and powerful, the Cobra is an American sports car icon.
catch.zh: 美国跑车的典范，采用大排量引擎。

long.en:
The Shelby Cobra competed in the FIA Speed World Challenge, a world endurance championship that differed from GT-class racing as there was no limitation on engine displacement. To defeat its rival, Ferrari, in this series, Shelby American fitted a large displacement engine into its race car, which came in the form of the 7.0-liter 427 ci "Side Oiler," a pure custom-built racing engine. Thus, the development of the Shelby Cobra 427 was under way, starting near the end of 1964. The first prototype was completed in the spring of 1965.

One problem that immediately arose during development was the strength of the chassis, or lack thereof. In comparison to the <350ps> produced by the 289 engine, the 427 Side Oiler's <500ps> was simply too much power for the existing setup. Phil Remington, in charge of design at Shelby America, determined that the suspension was the car's weakest link, so the side-mounted leaf suspension was abandoned in favor of a conventional double wishbone with coil dampers. The Shelby Cobra 427 cleared its 100-unit minimum production requirement and acquired FIA homologation. The car first competed in the SCCA A Production class at the opening of the 1966 season. In the end, 348 Shelby Cobra 427s were built with 88 of them being competition spec models or test cars. The 427 S/C was a road-going model with competition spec equipment. Only 31 of these examples were built.
long.zh:
国际汽联世界速度挑战赛，即Shelby Cobra参加的世界耐力锦标赛，与GT类赛事不同，不对引擎排量进行限制。

为了在这个系列赛中击败对手法拉利，Shelby美国决定以大排量引擎参赛。当时，福特正好拥有一款7升427“侧置机油供给”引擎，这是一款专门用于原厂改装车比赛的引擎。Shelby决定在Cobra上安装这款引擎，Shelby Cobra 427的开发从1964年年底开始启动。其原型车于1965年春完成。

关键问题紧接着出现，与289动力单元提供的<350ps>相比，472侧置机油供给的马力约为<500ps>。谢尔比美国的设计主管菲尔·雷明顿发现现有的悬挂系统无法承受这么大的马力。因此放弃了标志性的侧边安装的钢板弹簧悬架，改用带线圈避震的常规双叉臂悬挂。

Shelby Cobra 427按照最低产量生产了100辆，并取得了国际汽协认证，此车自1966年赛季开始参加美国赛车俱乐部A级量产车比赛。最终，Shelby Cobra 427一共生产了348辆，其中88辆为比赛规格车款或测试用车。

此外还有配备了赛车规格装备的公路车款427S/C，仅有31辆车是最初就按此规格来制造的。

catch.en: Only 6 units of the legendary, and very successful, Shelby Daytona Coupe race car were ever made.
catch.zh: 成功改进了原版Cobra的空气动力学性能，是当时横扫各大比赛的传奇。

long.en:
The AC Cobra was the dominant force in the 1960s racing scene. It was a top contender virtually everywhere... that is, except on high-speed venues. The problem was that its open body was a detriment to aerodynamic efficiency. This blunted its advantage of having a lightweight body and large displacement American V8 on long, fast straights. Since Shelby American had already expanded its racing efforts into Europe, and had seen the AC Cobra lag on the lengthy straightaway of the Sarthe Circuit, home to the 24 Hours of Le Mans, the company knew it needed a Cobra with better aerodynamics.

Shelby American's solution was to put a lid on it. Thus, the Shelby Cobra Coupe was born. Its two-door, hardtop body, designed by famed designer Pete Brock, had a long nose that housed the car's 4.7-liter V8 and a short deck that ended behind the rear tires, a style referred to as "coda tronca." Unlike the roadster, the Coupe was full of cutting edge, aerodynamic designs, including the unique rear end design.

Thanks to this new body, the car, which shared the same specs as the original AC Cobra aside from some suspension improvements, achieved a top speed that was <30km/h> faster than the original. In its short two-year lifespan, the racing performance of the Cobra Coupe achieved incredible results in the big events held in North America, as well as in GT-class racing events in Europe.
long.zh:
AC Cobra在1960年代的赛车界占据了统治地位，Shelby Cobra是这辆车的双门轿车版本。

基本款AC Cobra的优势在于超轻量的车身和大排量的美式V8引擎。快速上手的操控和卓越的加速性能使得AC Cobra成为了赛车界的顶尖竞争者。然而，开放式的车身设计让空气动力学大大减分，在高速赛道上显得差强人意。在24小时勒芒拉力赛的长直道上，AC Cobra的表现特别糟糕。对于当时已经将赛车版图拓展至欧洲的Shelby美国来说，急需空气动力学性能更佳的Cobra车型。

由著名设计师皮特·布洛克设计的双门轿跑车型拥有较长的车鼻，容纳了一台4.7升的V8引擎。后轮之后的行李箱空间则略显局促。车辆全身上下都采用了最新的空气动力学设计，包括竖向切断造型的“断尾”尾部设计。

得益于全新车型设计，Shelby Cobra虽然使用与最初的AC Cobra车型相同的规格（除了悬挂系统有部分改进外），最高时速增加了<30km/h>。Shelby Cobra的赛道表现非常不俗，在短短两年间就在北美重大赛事和欧洲的GT级别赛事上大放异彩。

catch.en: This highly collectible Mustang earned a great track record in SCCA racing."
catch.zh: 这款Mustang在SCCA赛事中的表现尤为出色。

long.en:
The Ford Motor Company introduced the Mustang in 1964, a sporty coupe that would become an American icon. Back then, to raise its sporty image for better sales numbers, the folks in Dearborn, Michigan decided to enter the car in SCCA (Sports Car Club of America) racing.

According to the regulations, the homologation requirement for racing in the SCCA was 100, meaning that at least 100 units needed to be produced commercially to qualify for racing events; however, changes to the engine, suspension, or brakes were not allowed. In fact, the only thing that was permitted was weight reduction. Ford decided to create a special-edition production car with more power and performance than the base Mustang. It turned to Shelby American, led by legendary champion driver and automotive designer Carroll Shelby. Mr. Shelby delivered; in 1965, he presented Ford execs with the GT350, based on the Mustang Fastback.

Because the "production" car was built for the track, it included lots of racing technology, including a carbon-fiber hood replete with air intake, a stiff racing suspension, a performance limited-slip differential, and a transmission casing made from lightweight aluminum. What's more, it lacked rear seats, a heater, power steering, and sound proofing, making this pony car one lightweight yet loud and uncomfortable machine. The battery was mounted in the trunk for better weight distribution, and the spare tire was stored inside the passenger compartment for the same reason.

The engine was a tuned 4.7-liter OHV (289 cu in.) V-8 that was optionally available. It produced a whopping <306ps>/<45.6kgm>. This combination of brute force mixed with the agile chassis resulted in the car's domination of the SCCA, as the GT350 stood at the pinnacle of American road racing for three straight years.
long.zh:
1964年，福特Motor引入了紧凑型跑车Mustang。同时，为了打造品牌的运动形象，提升销量，他们决定让Mustang参加美国赛车俱乐部举办的赛事。
根据赛事规则，只要参赛车辆的产量超过100台，即可通过认证，但参赛车辆不允许更换引擎、悬挂和刹车，车厂唯一能调整的是车重，且必须基于市售车辆的规格配置进行减重。

最终，福特决定打造一台对外发售的高性能车款。为此，他们找到了由卡罗尔·谢尔比运营的Shelby美国一同开发和参赛。在随后的一年里，基于Mustang快背改装而成的G.T.350取得了年度第四的好成绩。

这款车型完全按照赛事要求研发制造，引擎盖采用了纤维强化塑胶材料，并加入了进气口，底盘搭载硬实的竞赛型悬挂和LSD限滑差速器，连变速箱壳体都是轻量化的铝制材料。这台纯正的竞速机器省略了后座、暖气、方向盘助力和隔音材料，甚至选择将电池安放在后行李厢处来平衡车重配比。出于同样的原因，备胎被挪到了副驾驶座舱。

这款车使用的是一台原厂可选的4.7升顶置气门高性能引擎289，但经过特殊调校，能够产生<306ps>及<45.6kgm>扭矩。这款性能无比强大的车型在美国赛车俱乐部的赛场上无人可敌，连续三年蝉联宝座。

catch.en: This BRZ competition machine was piloted by Formula Drift champion Daijiro Yoshihara in 2017.
catch.zh: 由2017年Formula Drift冠军吉原大二郎所驾驶的BRZ。

long.en:
Daijiro Yoshihara, aka “Daichan,” a Japanese drift driver who was crowned Formula D champion in 2011, chose the Falken Tire / Turn 14 Distribution BRZ ’17 race car as his mount for the 2017 Formula Drift series.

The body of the car was based on the Rocket Bunny V3 aero kit, with various parts replaced with carbon. Packed with technology to boost its performance as a competition drift machine, the car featured an engine that needed to be seen to be believed. A massive 7.0-liter turbocharged V-8 packed into the cramped engine bay. It produced about <1000ps> through a MoTeC M800, making this an extreme machine able to drift faster and further than the rest.

The car was mated to a custom 4-speed transmission, with upgraded brakes that had 6-pot calipers up front and 4-pot calipers at rear. Although he was unable to win the 2017 championship, Daichan still managed to place 6th overall in his No. 9 car, always delighting the crowds and fans that came to cheer him on.
long.zh:
吉原大二郎（又被称作阿大）是一位日本漂移车手，自漂移方程式2004年开赛以来，他就扎根于这项赛事，并于2011年登顶冠军宝座。这款飞劲轮胎/转向14分配BRZ ’17是他在2017年漂移方程式系列赛中驾驶的车辆。

车身基于火箭兔V3空气动力套件改造，许多部件被替换为碳纤维。该车加入了多种技术以提升其作为漂移赛车的性能——你绝对想象不到，在BRZ低调的外表之下，安装了一台7升涡轮增压V8引擎。马力约<1000ps>，通过MoTec M800 电子控制单元控制，使这台达到性能极致的跑车能够比其他对手漂移得更快更远。

为了更好地满足漂移所需的驾驶性能，车辆采用了4速变速箱。当然，传动和悬挂系统也得到了相应强化，前轮刹车采用6活塞卡钳，后轮采用4活塞卡钳。

虽然未能赢得2017年的冠军，但阿大在系列赛中驾驶9号车获得了总成绩第6名，为聚集在赛场上的观众们展现出了令人难以置信的表现和风采。

catch.en: Cornering better than ever before. A BRZ for the Super GT.
catch.zh: 为Super Gt系列赛开发的BRZ，弯道性能进一步增强。

long.en:
Subaru began competing with the original BRZ in the GT300 class of the Super GT series in 2012. In 2016, it was one of the top teams in its class with some incredible performances on track. However, in the fall of 2020, the second-generation BRZ premiered in North America, which meant that a brand-new race machine was developed for the 2021 season.

As with the previous model, the engine was developed by STi and the body by R&D Sports. The vehicle as a whole was developed as an orthodox evolution of the previous model, carrying over many elements such as the basic structure and EJ20 engine.

The already aerodynamically superior second-generation BRZ were further improved by adding details developed from the previous model. The car's cornering characteristics were also enhanced through an overhaul of the weight distribution that included changing the position of the third damper.

Takuto Iguchi and Hideki Yamauchi both continued their roles as the drivers for the new model for the 2021 season. The new BRZ showed incredible potential from the start, taking pole position in 4 of the 8 races for a glorious champtionship victory. Subaru had been competing in domestic GT racing since the 1997 All Japan Grand Touring Championship, but this was their first such achievement./
long.zh:
从2012年起，斯巴鲁开始使用初代BRZ参加Super GT系列赛的GT300级别比赛。在2016年，他们跻身争冠车队之一，在赛道上贡献出了一些精彩绝伦的表现。在2020年秋天，随着第二代BRZ在北美首发，并于2021年在日本本土推出。他们基于新车型开发了一台全新的赛车来参加2021赛季的征战。

与上一代车型一样，引擎由STi部门开发，车身设计则交给了研发运动。整体而言，它是前代车型的正统演化，继承了包括基础车身结构和EJ20引擎等众多元素。

在空气动力学优势明显的第二代BRZ的基础上加入从前代车型获取的细化改善，让车身的空气动力学效果得到进一步优化。通过调整第三个减振器的位置，对车重分配做出了全面革新，让赛车的过弯特性有所提升。

驾驶这款新车型参加2021赛季的依然是原班人马井口卓人和山内英辉。这款新BRZ从一开始就展现出了无与伦比的潜力，在8场比赛中豪取4个杆位，最终带回荣耀的冠军。虽然一直参与国内GT赛事的争夺，但从1997年的全日本GT锦标赛算起，这还是斯巴鲁夺得的首个冠军。`

catch.en: Subaru's first FR sports car featured a boxer engine, giving it a low center of gravity and excellent handling.
catch.zh: Subaru的首款前置后驱跑车，搭载水平对置引擎，重心降低，操控运动性十足。

long.en:
As the sports-car market waned globally, Toyota and Subaru decided that the world needed to be reminded of how much fun driving a sports car could be. So they joined forces and produced a front-engine/rear-drive two-door machine with a sleek body style and plenty of attitude. Toyota called its version the 86, while the Subaru went by the name BRZ.

The cars had slightly different visual cues both inside and out, but it was still obvious that they were essentially the same product. If anything, the BRZ felt slightly more upscale, designed to attract a slightly more mature buyer. Its name stood for Boxer (engine), Rear-wheel drive, and Zenith.

The BRZ fit the driver like a glove, with an overall length of <4240mm>, width of <1775mm>, and riding on a <2570mm> wheelbase. Under the hood was the company's 2.0-liter horizontally-opposed 4-cylinder engine that boasted an extremely low center of gravity. It came equipped with Toyota’s D-4S fuel injection technology that helped it produce an impressive <200ps>. While the engine provided plenty of pop, it was the car's handling that made it special, thanks in part to a rigid body structure and sport-tuned suspension system that consisted of struts up front and a double-wishbone setup at the rear.

After making its debut in 2012, Subaru refined the BRZ every year. In 2015, the car received a revised power-steering system and extra rigidity, making this jewel feel sharper through corners and even more fun to drive.
long.zh:
紧凑型跑车市场近年来一直动力不足，但丰田和斯巴鲁意图通过丰田86和斯巴鲁BRZ重振这个市场。

虽然这两辆车的前脸和内饰都不同，但在设计理念上却是同出一源。BRZ是斯巴鲁的第一款引擎前置后轮驱动车型，BRZ即为“水平对置引擎”、“后轮驱动”和“究极品质”的缩写。

BRZ的目的是打造一辆任何人都能惬意驾驶的跑车，采用长<4240mm>、宽<1775mm>的紧凑型车身，轴距仅为<2570mm>。外型上采用无框双车门斜背车身，突出动感并降低车身重心。

引擎是斯巴鲁标志性的2升水平对置引擎，使得重心降低，并结合了丰田的D-4S燃油喷射技术。使得这款自然吸气引擎能够产生出色的<200ps>输出。前轮采用支柱悬架，后轮采用双叉臂悬挂，悬挂的调校注重跑车的驾驶乐趣，使其易于控制。

发布于2012年的BRZ几乎每年都有多项改进，使其优化程度进一步提高。2015年的车型对电动转向的特征进行了改进，车身刚度加强，帮助转向手感和乘坐品质得到进一步提升。

catch.en: The second-gen FR sports car features a larger 2.4-liter engine.
catch.zh: 采用排量更大的2.4L引擎的第二代紧凑型前置后驱跑车。

long.en:
A collaborative effort between Subaru and Toyota resulted in the front engine/rear-wheel-drive Subaru BRZ and Toyota 86. In 2020, the second-generation versions (ZD8) of these identical twins were released.

A new platform was adopted, featuring a number of improvements from the previous models. The entire chassis adopted Subaru's inner frame construction, which provided more rigidity and reduced weight. The combination of Subaru's flat-4, also called a boxer engine, with Toyota's direct-injection technology was carried over from the previous car. One big change to the new car was that the engine's cylinder bore was enlarged, increasing displacement from 2.0 liters to 2.4 liters. As a result, output was raised to 173 kW (<235ps>)/250 Nm (<25.5kgm>), making the car faster and more pleasant to drive. The transmission was either a 6-speed manual or 6-speed automatic, with the automatic-equipped model coming with the EyeSight driver assistance system as standard equipment.

The car featured here is the "S," the high-end model with improved interior and exterior, including 18-inch wheels, ultra suede and leather combination seats and an 8-speaker car stereo.
long.zh:
斯巴鲁BRZ和丰田86跑车是斯巴鲁和丰田联合开发的水平对置、前置后驱跑车。在2020年，这对姊妹车款更新到了第二代（ZD8）。

新平台继承了上一代后期车型的改进，将斯巴鲁的内部框架结构应用于整个底盘。在增加刚性的同时减轻了车重。斯巴鲁的4缸水平对置引擎与丰田开发的直喷技术组合在新车型上得到了延续，最大的变化是扩大了汽缸孔径，使引擎排量从2升增加到2.4升。将动力输出提升到173千瓦（<235ps>）/250牛米（<25.5kgm>），改善了各种场景下的驾驶性能。排挡有6速手动或6速自动变速箱可供选择，自动档车型还标配眼镜驾驶辅助系统。

这里展示的BRZ S是一款高端豪华型号，内外部组件都有升级，如18英寸车轮、豪华麂皮和皮革座椅，以及配备8个扬声器的汽车音响。

catch.en: Numerous chassis performance and visual enhancements by STI gave the BRZ sports car unprecedented flair.
catch.zh: STI为BRZ开发的最高级别车型，进行了大量的底盘性能和外观改进。

long.en:
The top-of-the-line version of Subaru's popular BRZ sports car was the BRZ STI Sport, introduced in 2017. The STI in its name referred to the company's motorsports division, Subaru Tecnica International, which gave the BRZ plenty of special touches that distinguished it from the base model.

The exterior featured a unique front bumper and fender garnishes, providing more muscle to the compact rear-drive machine. In the cabin, more luxury and exclusivity was added, including a Bordeaux red color scheme, available only on STI Sports models, and leather and alcantara seats.

STI made no major engine tweaks, but it did add flexible V bars and draw stiffeners to enhance rigidity. Also, the suspension system was tuned with Sachs shocks and springs, which helped provide the car with razor sharp steering responses and excellent handling.
long.zh:
BRZ STI Sport于2017年面市，是BRZ系列中的最高端车型。如名称所示，它是与斯巴鲁国际技术部，也就是斯巴鲁的赛车研发团队合作开发完成的。

内饰和外观都进行了改动，以符合其顶级型号的形象。外观方面，STI Sport配备了独有的前保险杠和侧裙饰条，内饰则革新为版本独享的波尔多红。座椅使用了皮革和阿尔卡塔纳材料混搭，拥有更成熟和时尚的质感。

虽然动力单元和基础版并无不同，但STI Sport的最大卖点其实在于STI出品的性能科技套件。弹性V型稳定杆和防倾杆均用于强化车身刚性，提高响应速度和车身稳定性。萨克斯为其量身定制的避震和弹簧也有助于提高整车的操控性。

catch.en: Essentially a road-going version of Subaru's WRC car, this car’s production was limited to only 400 units (and sold out immediately).
catch.zh: 拥有与WR赛车完全相同外观的Impreza，限量400台。刚一上市就被抢购一空。

long.en:
In March 1998, Subaru introduced the Version 22B-STi, based on the Impreza WRX STi Version IV. The “22” in its name signified the size of the engine, which came in the form of a turbocharged 2.2-liter flat-4. With a larger turbo, this boxer pumped out <280 ps> and <37.0 kgm> of torque, making it as fast as many European sports cars costing twice as much. The car’s biggest draw was its styling that featured wide-body fenders, making it look very similar to the WRC race car. The 22B’s production was limited to 400 units, but all of them were snatched up in a matter of months, despite a price tag of 5 million yen or about $50,000.

Not long after the 22B, Subaru took the covers off the STi Version V in September 1998. In addition to new aerodynamic parts on the exterior, the new STi received a new sport ABS to help stopping power.

In September 1999, the STi Version VI appeared featuring only modest changes that included a new front under spoiler, a reshaped rear spoiler and redesigned 16-in. alloy wheels. The competition model, the RA, came complete with mirror shells on the doors and sheeted rear quarter panels, designed to save weight. The STi Version VI marked the end of the GC-platform. What made this car especially noteworthy was that in its eight-year span, the WRX’s body style stayed generally constant, staying true to the original.
long.zh:
1998年3月，一款基于翼豹WRX STi Version IV开发的特殊车款正式发售，这就是翼豹22B-STi，顾名思义，它搭载了一台2.2升涡轮增压水平对置四缸引擎，最大马力输出为<280ps>，最大扭矩可达到<37.0kgm>。

最吸睛的自然是它的外观。添加宽轮拱罩后，与WR拉力赛车型几乎一模一样。这款车型仅按照订单限量生产400台，尽管售价高达500万日元，却在几天内销售一空，随即成为车迷心中的梦想车款。

除22B-STi之外，同系列的翼豹WRX常规版本也获得了不少提升。到了1998年9月，STi Version V带着安装有新空气动力学外部套件的外观粉墨登场，应用新的运动型防抱死刹车系统以及部分细微的提升和改装，保持原样的惟有马力输出（<280ps>）和稍稍降低的扭矩（<36.0kgm>）。隐藏在其后的现状便是对这部底盘的开发已经走到了尽头。

待到1999年9月，基于GC平台开发的最后一个STi版本，STi Version VI发布。在外观方面，增加了前下侧扰流板，尾翼的截面也有所改动，并且重新设计了16寸的铝合金轮毂。作为竞赛版本的WRX STI Type RA还换用了尖锥形的后视镜。而在减重方面，针对两门版本的后窗厚度进行了削减。STi Version VI之后，翼豹的接力棒被交到了新一代GD平台的手中。八年间，翼豹不断演化改进，唯一不变的是经典的车身造型。

catch.en: After six years of evolution, this car represented the final form of the GC8 Impreza coupe.
catch.zh: 经过6年的发展，这款基于GC8平台的Impreza双门轿车终于问世。

long.en:
The Impreza WRX STi was first introduced in 1994 with the goal of winning the World Rally Chanpionships. Known as "GC8," which referred to its in-house chassis designation, the car met with success both on and off the track. In September 1999, the very last GC8, the WRX STi Version VI, made its debut.

Thanks to numerous improvements in the six years since the the GC8's debut, the engine's (EJ20) horsepower rating went from <250ps> to <280ps>, while the transmission, which was always considered a weak point of the car, was enhanced for quicker, more precise shifts and better durability. Aerodynamics, brakes and suspension were significantly upgraded, all maximizing the incredible potential of the GC8 chassis.

Of the three body types available for the Version VI, which included a sedan and station wagon, the most notable was the "Type R" coupe. Along with a rally-car styled exterior, it featured a driver-controlled central differential, an intercooler water sprayer, specially-tuned suspension system and an upgraded rear axle as standard equipment. The car was a virtual road rocket, weighing only <1260kg>, making it a fan favorite on the WRC circuit as well as a popular performance choice for enthusiasts. z
long.zh:
1994年，第一辆翼豹WRX STi问世，剑指世界拉力锦标赛拉力赛冠军。它另一个更广为人知的名字则来自它的底盘代号——“GC8”。1999年9月，最后一款GC8，也就是WRX STi Version VI推出市场。

自1994年Version I发布以来，六年间的持续改进从这台EJ20引擎中额外压榨出<30ps>，总输出达到了可观的<280ps>。被大家认为是弱项的变速箱也有长足的改进。空气动力学、刹车和悬挂系统的改进都非常大。全部结合到一起后成就了这款GC8的终极版本。
在Version VI可选的三类车型，双门、四门以及旅行车当中，最受关注的当属“Type R”两门车型：拉力车风格的造型、原厂标配的车手可控中央差速器、中冷水喷冷却系统、接受过特别调校的硬悬挂系统和超耐压后车轴。正如车迷所期待的，这款车型在赛道和泥地中都展现出了极高的潜力。而得益于其轻盈、紧凑的车身（重量仅<1260kg>，车宽<1690mm>），运动车型的纯粹特性也并未缺席，完美响应车手的每个动作。

catch.en: Subaru's triple race winning Impreza World Rally car from the 1998 season.
catch.zh: 在1998赛季中为Subaru三夺分站冠军的Impreza世界拉力赛车

long.en:
Subaru's Impreza has been a formidable contender in the World Rally Championship since 1993, securing the Manufacturers' Championship title in 1995 and 1996 under Group A regulations. In 1997, under the new WRC regulations, Subaru clinched the Manufacturers' Championship title yet again, achieving an impressive three-year consecutive streak.

The 1997 World Rally Car-specification Impreza, known as the WRC97, was based on the 2-door coupe model. The existing engine was tuned to deliver <300ps> and <48kgm> of torque. The suspension geometry was redesigned, and the body was widened to the regulatory maximum of <1770mm> to enhance handling performance.

The WRC98, introduced in 1998, featured further modifications, including computer-controlled active differentials in the front, rear, and center couplings.

Although Subaru missed out on the championship title in the 1998 season, the car demonstrated its prowess as a serious contender. Colin McRae drove it to victory in Round 4 (Portugal), Round 6 (Tour de Corse), and Round 8 (Acropolis), highlighting the vehicle's pure off-road tenacity.
long.zh:
斯巴鲁的翼豹自1993年起参加世界拉力锦标赛的争夺，并在A组别规则下于1995年和1996年连续赢得车队冠军头衔。此后在1997年，在转入“世界拉力赛车”规则后，他们再次勇夺冠军，创造了惊人的三连冠。

采用1997年“世界拉力赛车”规格的翼豹也被称为世界拉力锦标赛97，以原版双门轿跑车型为基础，通过调校现有引擎，使其得以输出<300ps>的动力和<48kgm>扭矩。悬挂几何结构也进行了重新设计，车身宽度在合规前提下尽可能扩展，达到了<1770mm>，为车辆提供最大限度的操控。

1998年推出的世界拉力锦标赛98在前一款车型基础上作了进一步的改进，增加了一块用于控制前、后和中央联轴器的主动差速器的微型电脑。

在1998赛季，斯巴鲁遗憾地与冠军头衔失之交臂，没能延续他们的连胜纪录。然而，这款车依然证明了其作为世界拉力赛车的真正价值——科林·麦克雷在第4轮葡萄牙站、第6轮法国环科西嘉岛站和第8轮雅典卫城站的比赛中驾驶着它登上了最高领奖台。

catch.en: The second-generation Impreza was developed alongside the rally spec model."
catch.zh: 第二代Impreza，与拉力赛规格车型同时开发。

long.en:
One year after the potent Spec C was introduced, Subaru wasted no time finessing the look of the new Impreza by taking a scalpel to the car's front end after only two years on the market. The round headlights were a bust as it alienated many loyal buyers, so the company replaced them with more conventional-looking tear-drop shaped ones.

The car's overall aerodynamics were also improved, thanks to developmental work performed by SWRT (Subaru World Rally Team). The team also improved the response of the boxer powerplant, raising peak torque to <40.2kgm>. The new exhaust system, which was originally developed for the 2003 Legacy, was more efficient, too. Of particular note was a new center differential that featured an automatic mode. This system managed the distribution of torque between the front and rear wheels through the center differential, allowing for maximum traction through all variety of corners.

The car's new handling prowess demanded more grip, so wider tires were used in 2004. This year also saw the torque figure of the flat-4 climb yet again, to <42.0kgm>. By this time, the Impreza WRX had caught the attention of performance enthusiasts everywhere, and in 2003, the car finally made its way to U.S. shores. Soon thereafter, Mitsubishi brought the Lancer Evolution to the U.S., and the two Japanese rally icons waged war on a new battleground, America.
long.zh:
在令人震惊的Spec C推出一年后，翼豹系列在2002年11月进行了全面改款。

尽管受到不少人的喜爱，但现实中市场反响不佳的圆形车头灯被替换成了水滴型。这一次，与斯巴鲁拉力车队的通力合作为车型带来了更出色的空气动力学特性。

在性能方面，为了提升线轴效率，这款车采用了全新的双涡流涡轮增压系统，并对应地调整了排气系统。它的曲轴、活塞和连杆也进行了强化，让引擎可以输出<40.2kgm>的扭矩——这在当时2升排量级别车型中是最高的扭矩规格。

在部分手动档版本上还配备了驾驶者可控并具备自动模式的中央差速器，前后扭矩可根据过弯情况自动分配，让这款车在赛道和曲折道路上都展现了出色的效率。

2004年6月，应日本超级耐力赛等赛事的比赛规则要求，斯巴鲁追加推出了大尺寸轮胎版本。并将最大扭矩再次提升到了<42.0kgm>。

至此，翼豹已成为了代表日本的高性能车款，并得到了全世界车手们的一致认可。2003年起，STi开始出口到美国，而随着三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神也开始出口，两位老对手在日本之外又一次展开了竞争。

catch.en: The WRX STI continues its tradition of delivering potent 4WD performance.
catch.zh: 源自Impreza，追求速度和驾驶的乐趣。

long.en:
While traditionally known as the Subaru Impreza WRX, the rally-inspired compact sports sedan became simply the Subaru WRX in the fall of 2013, but everything that made this model one of the most exciting machines in the world remained intact.

The WRX was built on the platform of the Levorg, a Japan-market-only station wagon. After seriously reinforcing the body structure, Subaru engineers went to work on the engine and chassis, putting much of their focus on the high-performance STI. They wanted to make sure that the WRX STI and the WRX S4 were completely different models, the former meant for the performance enthusiast, while the latter catered to grand touring fans. While the STI and S4 looked similar, everything from the engine to the steering mechanism was different.

For the STI, the engineers dropped the EJ20, a turbocharged 2.0-liter flat-4, into the engine bay. This powerplant produced <308ps> and <43.0kgm> of torque, routing the power to all four wheels via a 6-speed manual gearbox and Subaru’s excellent 4-wheel-drive system that featured a driver-controlled center differential. It was this 4WD system that made all WRX STIs so special. It included both an electronically-controlled and mechanical LSD—a Helical LSD controlled the front wheels, while a Torsen LSD was installed for the rear.

long.zh:
2013年秋季发布的斯巴鲁WRX是从翼豹系列独立出来的中档轿车。WRX这个车型等级过去曾被用来命名翼豹的高性能版本，现在则成为了一款新的车型，并且顺理成章地成为了翼豹 WRX的后继者，被发展为高性能的轿跑车。

这款车使用与斯巴鲁力狮运动相同的平台，但考虑到旅行车和轿车之间存在差别，两车预期的行驶条件也不相同，因此对WRX的车体进行了大幅强化。该车型包括跑车车型的STI和豪华旅行车版的S4。两个版本均为四轮驱动，动力单元为该厂标志性的水平对置4缸引擎。然而，STI与S4除了中央差速器不同外，动力转向结构也不相同，就算使用的都是2升水平对置4缸引擎，也并非是同一款。斯巴鲁坚持奉行差异化策略。

高性能的STI版本配有EJ20引擎，该引擎经过了彻底的改进，能够输出<308ps>和<43.0kgm>的动力。传动方面采用强化版的6档手动变速箱和车手可控中央差速器，同时配备了电子限滑差速器和机械限滑差速器，前轮装备了螺旋齿轮限滑差速器，而后轮则采用托森限滑差速器。方向盘也采用了提高驾驶手感的液向式动力转向系统。毫无疑问，悬挂也是专为这款车而独立开发的。总之，WRX在成为独立车型后，给予了设计师追求全面性能的自由度。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。

catch.en: This celebrated WRX set the lap record on the holy ground of motorcycle racing, the Isle of Man.
catch.zh: 这辆著名的WRX曾在摩托车赛事的圣地马恩岛上创下单圈纪录。

long.en:
In June 2016, a Subaru WRX STI set a new record for 4-wheeled vehicles in the Time Trials at the Isle of Man Tourist Trophy race.

The competition, which has been a part of the Isle of Man Tourist Trophy since 1907, gained notoriety for the daring motorcycle racers who ripped through the island's roads at reckless speeds. One lap of the course measures <60.7km>, with more than 200 corners and no escape zones. There are sections where vehicles reach speeds in excess of <200km/h>. With an elevation change of roughly <400m> and a slick tarmac, this is arguably one of the most dangerous courses in the world.

The record-setting WRX STI was prepared by Subaru of America, which had been participating in the event since 2011. In that first year, the company set the fastest speed record of 19 minutes 56 seconds in an Impreza WRX STI, and in 2014, it broke that record with run of 19 minutes 15 seconds using a VAB series WRX STI, a model that became separate from the Impreza.

For 2016, Subaru returned with VAB WRX STI, but this time, the car featured engineering from STI, Subaru’s motorsport division, and styling/manufacturing support from Prodrive of the UK; the very group who had dominated the World Rally Championships (WRC) with Subaru. The car's turbocharged 2.0-liter flat-4 turbo was tuned to produce more than <600ps>, with further refinements such as a DRS built into the rear wing.

As a result, with former rally driver Mark Higgins behind the wheel, Subaru cut two minutes off of its previous record, with a time of 17 minutes 35.139 seconds and an average speed of <207km/h>.
long.zh:
2016年6月，斯巴鲁WRX STI在每年举办的马恩岛旅行者大奖赛的计时赛中，刷新了4轮汽车的纪录。

这项赛事自1907年开始举办并延续至今，是马恩岛旅行者大奖赛的一个重要环节，并作为世界上最具挑战性的摩托车比赛之一而广为人知。在将部分公路关闭后，创造出单圈长度<60.7km>的赛道，该赛道有超过200个弯道，不设避险区，有数个路段的最大速度可超过<200km/h>，起伏高度变化接近<400m>，再加上远远低于专用赛道的道路摩擦力，使其成为了世界上最困难的公路比赛之一。

创下该纪录的WRX STI来自斯巴鲁美国。该车厂自2011年以来一直在向这个奖项发起挑战。2011年，他们通过翼豹WRX STI创下了19分56秒的最快速度纪录，2014年，他们使用一辆VAB series WRX STI创下了19分15秒的纪录，后来该车型从翼豹中独立出来，成为了一个车款。

2016年挑战赛沿用了去年使用的VAB WRX STI。这一年，他们得到了来自斯巴鲁赛车部门STI的工程支持，车辆则交给英国的普罗迪夫设计和制造。这家车厂正是与斯巴鲁合作，称霸世界拉力锦标赛多年的车厂。经过调校的2升水平对置4涡轮引擎能够产生超过<600ps>，此外还有其他改进，如在尾翼中加入空气阻力降低系统。

因此，在前拉力赛车手马克·希金斯的驾驶下，他们得以将现有的纪录缩减了将近两分钟之多，以<207km/h>的平均速度创下了17分35.139秒的新纪录。

catch.en: The rear-drive Cappuccino roadster kickstarted the two-seat kei-car trend.
catch.zh: 前置引擎、后轮驱动的敞篷小车，在日本掀起了双座轻型车的潮流。

long.en:
The Cappuccino was an instant hit when it was introduced by Suzuki in November 1991. Along with the other sporty kei-cars such as the Honda Beat and Mazda Autozam AZ-1, the Cappuccino provided unprecedented flair to the mainly economy-oriented kei-car category.

Like a traditional sport car, the Cappuccino adopted a 2-seat front-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout in a convertible body. In contrast, the Beat and the gull-winged AZ-1 featured mid-engine layouts. And although kei-cars often shared parts, the Cappuccino had an all-original body. Suzuki ensured that it was a capable handling machine, giving it a 51:49 front-to-rear weight distribution and a sport-tuned suspension system consisting of double wishbones at front and rear.

Another innovative element of the Cappuccino was its three-piece detachable roof. With all the pieces in place, the car was essentially a hard-top coupe, but depending on how you configured them, the car could be converted to a T-top, a targa-top or a full-on convertible, offering the owner four different body styles.

Under the hood was a <657cc> turbocharged DOHC 12-valve inline-3 based on the <64ps> powerplant of the Alto Works, the most powerful engine used in a kei model. Providing stopping power were disc brakes at all four corners with ventilated front discs.

In 1995, the car received a number of minor improvements including an a newly designed all-aluminum engine block. The engine control unit was also updated. An electronically controlled 3-speed automatic joined the 5-speed manual gearbox in the lineup, with the automatic transmission models equipped with power steering.

At the end of 1998, the production run for the Cappuccino ended at 26,500 units, but the car remains popular today with collectors and driving enthusiasts, and is still considered one of the greatest kei-cars of all time.
long.zh:
Cappuccino是铃木在1991年11月发布的轻型跑车。这是一款在当时收获海量人气的双座轻型车，与本田Beat和马自达Autozam AZ-1等车齐名。

Cappuccino的主要特点在于它是一款双座前置后驱敞篷车，具有和引擎中置的敞篷本田Beat和引擎中置、采用鸥翼车门的AZ-1截然不同的独特设计概念。有趣的是，虽然轻型汽车经常使用共享零件，但这台车的车身是专门为该车型设计的全原创车身。这样的做法自然是为了使其具有出色的操控特性，同时也说明铃木在开发Cappuccino时的认真程度。

Cappuccino的设计具有明显的前置后驱车特色，有一个长长的车头部分，并呈现出圆润的形态。另一项创新是车顶的结构，可以分三部分拆除。从硬顶开始，它可以转换为T型栏杆顶、TARGA顶，并且随着后窗的降低，可成为完全开放的车顶，使车主能够享受4种样式的变化。

其动力单元是一台<657cc>、双顶置凸轮轴 12气门直列3缸涡轮增压引擎。此引擎的规格与奥拓Works的<64ps>引擎相同，同时也是日本轻型汽车的最高规格。

从1995年起，引擎采用了全铝打造，使前后重量分配更接近理想的51:49。悬挂系统在前后都使用了新设计的双叉臂式，前部采用配备通风盘的四轮碟刹。变速箱最初只提供5档手动，但后来又增加了电子控制的3档自动。自动档车型还配备了动力转向系统。

截止1998年底，Cappuccino在停产时总共生产了26,500辆车。这是一款诞生于日本的经济泡沫时代、真真正正的梦幻轻型跑车。

catch.en: A quintessential example of the micro-truck trend that has become a hit all over the world.
catch.zh: 这款车是席卷整个世界的“微型卡车”风潮中的典范。

long.en:
Japan’s micro-car segment, known domestically as kei-cars, has become an essential part of daily life across the country. While the category includes everything from passenger vehicles and mini-SUVs to sports cars, it also plays a critical role in supporting infrastructure through a wide range of commercial vans and trucks. The Suzuki Carry stands as a quintessential example of the commercial kei truck.

First introduced in 1961, the Carry boasts a long and storied history. The tenth generation was introduced in 1999 following a full model change to comply with revised kei-car regulations introduced the previous year. The model shown here is from 2012, marking the final iteration of the tenth-generation model.

Compared to its predecessor, the new Carry featured a slightly larger footprint, measuring <3395mm> in length and <1475mm> in width. Its semi-cabover design placed the engine beneath the occupants' feet. Displacement remained within the kei-class limit at <658cc>, with early variants even offering turbocharged options.

To accommodate a variety of needs, the Carry was offered in several trim levels. The KC—its most well-equipped—came standard with power steering and air conditioning. While rear-wheel drive was standard, a 4-wheel-drive variant ensured that it was at home on snowy roads and rugged terrain as it was on the highway.

Beyond its utilitarian function, the Carry’s charming design and remarkable practicality garnered international attention. In the United States, pre-owned Carrys—eligible for road use 25 years after their original release—have become increasingly popular among farmers and hobbyists alike. Compact yet capable, the Carry is a testament to the ingenuity of Japanese design and its ability to resonate around the world.
long.zh:
时至今日，被称为“轻型车”的日系微型车已经发展成为了人们不可或缺的日常生活工具。日式轻型车类别中涵盖了多种客运车型，以及SUV和跑车，但此外还包含大量用于支持城市基础运行的商用小货车和卡车车型。铃木Carry就是一款这样的微型卡车，忠实地反映出了整个日式轻型车领域的特点。

Carry拥有悠久的历史，最远可追溯到其诞生的1961年。为了符合1998年引入的新版日式轻型车认证标准，系列在1999年进行了全面升级，推出了第10代车型。在那之后，第10代车型又进行了多次改款，而这里介绍的这辆2012款便是目前最新的车型。

与前代相比，它的车身得到了加大，长度和宽度分别达到了<3395mm>和<1475mm>。得益于半平头的车头设计，其引擎被置于乘客坐席的正下方，排量仅有<658cc>。在最初上市时，铃木也提供了涡轮增压版本作为选择。

为了满足不同的用途和价位，Carry提供了若干不同档次，其中配置最高的是标配动力辅助转向和空调的KC版本。除了后轮驱动版本之外，该车型还提供了四轮驱动选项，即便在雪地或崎岖不平的山路上也能发挥出全部性能。

这款日式轻型卡车拥有可爱的外表和优异的功能性，也帮助它在国外收获了广泛的关注。二手Carry在美国的农牧业领域拥有相当高的人气。在发布超过25年后，其右座驾驶版本已经自动获得了上路认证。Carry小小的身躯中蕴含着无限的潜力，是日系汽车设计在全世界赢得认可的又一个独特例证。

catch.en: A stouter Jimny with an eye on global success.>
catch.zh: 面向全球市场的“更强壮”的Jimny。

long.en:
While the Suzuki Jimny's diminutive stature allowed it to fit into Japan's kei-car regulations, under its skin was a tenaciously rugged off-road vehicle with a ladder-frame construction. The Jimny Sierra was a global-market variant that retained the Jimny’s off-road prowess while breaking free from its kei-car limitations.

Introduced in 2018, the JB74 chassis represented the third generation of the Sierra lineage, following the original that appeared in 1993. Compared to the previous chassis, called the JB43, the new one measured <50mm> shorter and <45mm> wider. The vehicle's revised dimensions were further emphasized by a bolder, more squared-off body, giving it a commanding presence.

Under the hood resided the K15B engine, a <1460mm> DOHC inline-4 that produced <102ps> and <13.3kgm> of torque. At first glance, these figures might not have appeared like much, but the sustained low-end torque made the Jimny Sierra ideal for off-road crawling.

Equipped with a mechanical transfer case, the Jimny Sierra's part-time 4WD system provided off-road capability when needed.
With rigid axles at both the front and rear, the fine-tuned suspension system helped the vehicle feel at home crawling over rocks or trudging through mud as it did cruising on paved roads.

The top-of-the-line version in Japan was the JC.
It came generously equipped with LED headlamps and 15-inch alloy wheels as standard fare, while also offering the option of a black roof panel for added style and contrast.
long.zh:
铃木吉姆尼小巧的车身使其符合日本“轻型汽车”的法规要求，但其内在是一款坚固耐用的越野车，拥有真正的边梁式车架结构。吉姆尼Sierra是面向全球市场发售的车型，不仅继承了原车强大的越野能力，同时摆脱了轻型车法规的限制。

JB74底盘于2018年推出，是该车型自1993年首次亮相以来的第三代产品。与之前的JB43底盘相比，新款车型的车身短了<50mm>但宽了<45mm>，让车身更加方正，线条更为大胆。

该车搭载了<1460cc>排量的“K15B”直列4缸双凸轮轴引擎，输出功率为<102ps>/<13.3kgm>。从数据上来看，这辆车的动力可能并不突出，但源源不断的低转速扭矩使其在越野攀爬中表现尤为出色。

这套分时四驱系统搭配机械分动箱。悬挂上采用前后刚性轴，让车辆无论是在岩石上爬行、泥泞中跋涉，还是在铺装道路上行驶，都得心应手。

JC车型是日本本土提供的最高配版本，标配LED大灯和15英寸合金轮毂，并可选配黑色车顶。

catch.en: Japan's mighty micro off-roader boasts amazing all-terrain ability beyond its size.
catch.zh: 超越其规格的惊人全地形能力。日本最强大的微型越野车。

long.en:
The Jimny is a cross-country style 4WD model that has been produced by Suzuki since 1970. While there have been variants in each generation that crossed over into the compact-car class, the mainstay of the series is the kei model.

The Jimny has continued to evolve over the years with a second-generation model introduced in 1981, a third-generation variant introduced in 1998 and a fourth-generation model in 2018. What remained constant throughout the entire series was its construction formula: a kei-size body on a ladder frame chassis with rigid axle suspension and oversized tires. The vehicle always came with part-time 4-wheel drive, but rear-wheel-drive-only models were offered as well.

This specialized off-road setup has gained widespread acclaim, not just in Japan but worldwide. It continues to serve as a versatile commercial vehicle in many regions with mountainous terrain, while appealing to outdoor enthusiasts seeking adventure, and even to race drivers as a foundational vehicle for rally competition.

The main features of the fourth-generation Jimny, introduced in 2018, were its overtly square body and its round headlamps that's reminiscent of the first-gen model. Also, driving stability and ride comfort at high speeds—a common weakness of off-road vehicles— were greatly improved.

The new Jimny's <660cc> turbocharged engine was specially tuned, and its classic part-time 4-wheel drive system once again featured a mechanical transfer case. To reduce wheel spin, the car came with electronically controlled brake LSD traction control as standard fare.

The most popular model in the line-up is the luxury "XC," which included a wide variety of extra features such as cruise control and steering wheel-mounted audio controls.
long.zh:
吉姆尼是一款铃木自1970年起便一直生产的越野四驱车型。尽管每一代都推出过各种改款，甚至跨界到紧凑型车类别中，但其主力产品依然是日式轻型车车型。

自诞生以来，这个系列便一直推陈出新，其第二代产品在1981年推出，第三代在1998年推出，而第四代也在2018年姗姗来迟。整个系列中一以贯之的便是其不变的架构，即将“轻型车”规格的车身外壳安装在梯形框架底盘上，并采用刚性车桥悬挂和超大尺寸轮胎。其传动系统始终采用分时四驱布局，不过也曾推出过后驱款。

不仅是在日本国内，这套纯正越野配置所提供的全地形能力为它在全球范围内也赢得了无数的赞誉。作为一款量产车，它在降雪量较大和山地环境较多的地区颇受欢迎，也成为了户外休闲驾驶爱好者的热门选择，甚至成为了越野赛车运动的基础车型。

2018年推出的第四代吉姆尼最主要的特点是它那鲜明的方形车身和圆形大灯等追根溯源的设计。此外，针对越野车的普遍弱项，它在高速下的稳定性和驾乘舒适性获得了极大的提升。

这一代吉姆尼还采用了特殊调校的<660cc>涡轮增压引擎，而其经典的分时四轮驱动系统也再次用回了机械式传动箱。为了减少车辆打滑的情况，这款车还标配电子控制限滑差速器牵引力控制系统。

这个产品族系中最受欢迎的车型便是主打豪华的“XC”级吉姆尼，额外配备了诸多进阶功能，如巡航控制系统和安装在方向盘上的音响控制器。

catch.en: Suzuki's fun-to-drive Swift Sport was made even more lively with a high-revving engine and close-ratio gears.
catch.zh: 改良版Swift Sport，拥有密齿轮比和高转速引擎。

long.en:
The Suzuki Swift Sport is a model that is based on the second-generation Swift, their model aimed for the global market. The European model is a 3-door body, but in Japan it is also offered in a 5-door body.

Its development was performed mainly in Europe, and was based on the production model rather than a prototype. Though this delayed the release timing to be later than the model change, this European development was imperative to perfect the level of tuning on the car. For the same reason, it was subjected to numerous tests, under a large variety of road conditions.

One merit for developing in Europe was that they gained the partnership and support of Teneco. Their knowhow gained from their Monroe brand helped to perfect the driving performance of the Swift Sport.

The engine is a 1.6-liter normally aspirated engine, combined with forged pistons and VVT, and tuned for driving in the high rpm range.

In a minor change in 2007, the maximum power did not change but the rev limit was increased from <7000rpm> to <7500rpm>. And by introducing cross ratio gears for the 5-speed MT, its power can now be more effectively applied and appreciated. It is also equipped with an ESP, a feature which is becoming more common among European cars, and the overall performance of the car has been improved. The interior also used to have many red accents, but this has been reduced for a more mature, chic atmosphere.
long.zh:
铃木速翼特运动版基于第二代速翼特开发，是针对全球市场推出的车款。面向欧洲的车型为3门版，但在日本也供应5门版。

这款车的开发主要在欧洲进行，且开发直接基于量产车，而非原型车。虽然这使得该车的发布晚于改款更新，但为了使得车辆调校更加完善，欧洲的开发工作相当关键。出于同样的原因，这款车在各种各样的道路条件下经受了无数次试验。

在欧洲开发的优势之一是能与天纳克合作并获得其支持。他们通过其蒙诺品牌积累的技术经验有助于完善速翼特运动版的驾驶性能。

引擎采用1.6升自然吸气引擎，同时配备锻造活塞和可变气门正时技术，专门针对高转速条件下的驾驶性能进行了调校。

在2007年的小升级中，最大马力没有变化，但转速上限从<7000rpm>提高到了<7500rpm>。5速手动变速箱中使用了双速比齿轮，从而更有效地利用和发挥了引擎的马力。与此同时，车辆上还配备电子稳定程序系统，该系统的应用在欧洲车中越来越普遍，同时提高的还有车辆的整体质量水平。在内饰方面，曾经占据主导的红色装饰件被删减，改为更加成熟和别致的配色。

catch.en: Superb handling was just one of the fortes of this high-performance Japanese hatchback. n
catch.zh: 这款纯粹的日系性能小钢炮展现出远超以往的操控性。

long.en:
The Swift has traditionally been one of Suzuki's most popular models, especially the Swift Sport, which has been touted as one of the most fun-to-drive compact sports coupes in Japan. When the fourth-generation Swift was introduced in 2016, the Swift Sport wasn't far behind, coming out a year later.

With a lower front end that enhanced the car's aerodynamics, the new Swift Sport wasn't simply better looking, but a better performer in every way. Under the hood was a turbocharged 1.4-liter engine that replaced the previous model's naturally aspirated 1.6-liter, putting out a respectable <140ps> and 230 Nm (<23.45 kgm>).

Also, because Suzuki engineers retuned the car's suspension system, while also widening the front and rear track by 30mm, the car handled better than ever. The car was <70kg> lighter than before, so it possessed a pronounced low- and mid-range punch.
long.zh:
2017年发布的速翼特运动版是2016年上市的第四代铃木 速翼特的高性能版本。

车身针对空气动力学性能进行了重新设计，尤其是车头比标准的速翼特略低。引擎也由之前车型上搭载的1.6升自然进气引擎缩减为1.4升涡轮增压配置。这款引擎此前曾应用在铃木的其他车型上，但针对运动性能接受了重新调校，得以在使用高辛烷值汽油的情况下产生<140ps>和230牛·米（<23.45>）的扭矩。

与以往速翼特运动版车型的另一个不同之处在于悬挂系统的设置，铃木不仅专门为该车型进行了特殊调校，而且还将前后轮距增加了<30mm>，以提高操控性。此外，车身比同款基础版本的速翼特既轻又硬，同时也比之前的速翼特运动版车型轻了70kg。

catch.en: A tuned up Gr. 4 version of the Swift Sport based on the 'KATANA Edition'.
catch.zh: 基于Swift Sport KATANA版调校的Gr.4级别赛车。

long.en:
Since its release in 2018, the ZC33 Swift Sport has been praised by automobile enthusiasts as an extremely sporty and fun-to-drive hatchback. The credit here went to the car's lightweight highly rigid body structure, a responsive turbocharged 1.4-liter engine and excellent handling character.

Unveiled at the 2020 Tokyo Auto Salon, the "KATANA Edition" concept offered a peek into what future Swift Sports may look like. The car borrowed the spirit of Suzuki's high-performance sports bike, the Katana. Because Suzuki specializes in building both cars and motorcycles, this is a vehicle that could be created by only a few manufacturers in the world.

The designers used the Suzuki Swift as a base, but added the front and rear bumpers that had design elements from the Katana. The exaggerated fender flares widened the car further. The interior featured burnt titanium-colored panels that simulated a hot exhaust to create the look and feel of a sports bike. Additionally, both the interior and exterior came with red accents and Katana logos throughout.

In addition to the two-tone silver-and-matte black design on the show car, five other color variations were added. "Candy Daring Red" was the same color as the limited-edition Katana bike that was sold in January 2021. Only 100 examples of that bike were made.

This special version featured in Gran Turismo has been slightly modified in design and specification to compete in Gr.4 racing. Among the changes were an enlarged front spoiler, a new unique GT wing designed to reflect the shape of the Katana's seat cowling and the addition of a roll cage.
long.zh:
自从ZC33 速翼特运动版在2018年首次亮相以来，这款紧凑的高性能掀背车就得到了所有汽车爱好者的广泛好评，大家都称赞它的轻量化高强度车身，响应速度灵敏的高扭矩1.4升涡轮增压引擎，和由欧洲工程师精心调校过的操控性。
这款“KATANA版”在2020年东京汽车沙龙上首次亮相，是对这个车型未来进化方向的完美示范。通过速翼特运动版的车身来充分体现高性能Katana摩托车的动力和美学。铃木是世界上为数不多同时生产摩托车和汽车的厂商，因此也只有充满运动理念的他们才能够拿出这样的创意。

这款车的设计采用铃木 速翼特作为基础车型，并如之前所说加入了包含Katana外观元素的前后保险杠。其夸张的外扩挡泥板进一步扩宽了车身，并着重强调了速翼特运动版那迷人的轮廓。其内饰采用烧灼钛合金配色的饰板，模拟出类似运动型摩托车的烧灼排气管以及其他元素，丰富主题体验。此外，其内饰和外观还采用了红色的次要配色和随处可见的Katana标志。
除了在东京汽车沙龙上看到的这种Katana银和磨砂黑的双色设计之外，这款车还提供另外5种配色版本。其中“糖果炽烈红”版本采用了2021年1月推出的100台限量版Katana摩托车的同款车身配色方案。

跑车浪漫旅中包含的这个特殊版本在设计和规格上进行了轻微的改动，以符合组别4级别的规范。其前置底部扰流器进行了扩大，并添加了一部独特的GT尾翼，与Katana的座椅整流罩形状遥相呼应。这款车还更改了轮胎的尺寸，减轻内饰重量，加入了防滚架，并换用了一部调校过的引瓎，已经弻底鿛化为了一台跑车浪漫旅专尞组别4规格比赛机器。

cars.nameEn: Suzuki Swift Sport KATANA Edition Gr.4
cars.nameZh: 铃木雨燕运动型KATANA版组别4

en.nameLong: Suzuki Swift Sport KATANA Edition Gr.4

zh.nameLong: Suzuki Swift Sport KATANA Edition Gr.4

catch.en: A monster made for the Pikes Peak Hillclimb.[
catch.zh: 为传奇爬坡赛而生的怪兽车。

long.en:
The world's largest hill climb race, the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb, is held every summer on Pikes Peak Highway near Colorado Springs in the United States.

The <20km> course covers an elevation difference of <1440m>, from <2862m> to <4302m> above sea level. It consists of 156 corners ranging from tight <60km/h> hairpins to <200km/h> sweeping high speed curves. Also, the temperature difference between the starting point and the finish line can be as much as 20 degrees. All these make for extremely harsh conditions for any race car.

The Suzuki V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special was a machine developed specifically to compete in this environment. It was built around a newly designed aluminum space frame,  with the engine relocated aft of the front axle line to improve the car's front/rear weight distribution. The engine itself was tuned dramatically; the 2.5-liter V-6 came fitted with twin turbochargers, enabling it to pump out <995ps> and <95kgm> of torque.

Plenty of mass was taken out of the car. It tipped the scales at a lean 800kg. Helping to keep this lightweight vehicle planted to the road surface was a massive front spoiler and rear wing, both developed through extensive wind-tunnel testing. These modifications changed the production Escudo into a fearsome beast.

The car was driven by Nobuhiro "Monster" Tajima, who boasted seven consecutive wins in the All-Japan Dirt Trial Championships.  He began competing at Pikes Peak in 1988, and in 1995, he became the first Japanese driver to take the overall title at Pikes Peak. His race car then was the Suzuki Twin-Engine Escudo.
long.zh:
全球最大的爬坡赛，派克峰国际爬坡赛每年夏天在美国科罗拉多泉附近的派克峰高速公路举行。

这条<20km>长的赛道海拔从<2862m>直冲<4302m>，高差变化达<1440m>。它拥有156个弯道，从<60km/h>的急发夹弯到时速<200km/h>的高速大弯道，不一而足。此外，起点和终点线的温差可达20度。在这样的条件下，每一台参赛车辆都要面临极端严峻的考验。

这辆铃木V6 Escudo派克峰特别版就是为了在这些条件下比赛而开发的怪兽——车架采用全新设计的铝合金空间车架。为了达到最大性能，动力系统接受了大幅改装，引擎布局从基础车型的前置改为中置。经过全面调校的2.5升V6引擎加装了两个涡轮增压器，使其能够产生高达<995ps>的最大动力和<95kgm>的扭矩。

车身仅重800千克，相对较轻。为了在湿滑路面上牢牢抓住地面，车身上安装了大型前扰流板和尾翼，且经过专门的风洞测试。这些改装将一台量产的Escudo变为了一辆动力凶兽。

这辆野兽由同样有“怪兽”之称的田岛伸博驾驶。他曾经在全日本越野锦标赛中获得7连胜，主宰了泥地比赛。他于1988年开始参加派克峰比赛。1995年，他驾驶一辆铃木双擎Escudo在派克峰获得了日本车手有史以来的首次全面胜利。

catch.en: The rebirth of the AE86, Toyota creates an exciting 21st-century version of the ideal sports car.
catch.zh: 新一代的86，21世纪前置后驱紧凑车型理念的发扬光大者。

long.en:
The FT-86 Concept was introduced in 2009 to the delight of Japanese sports car enthusiasts everywhere. The exciting front-engine/rear-drive sports car was developed by a collaborative effort between Toyota and Subaru, and it rekindled the spirit of the legendary Toyota AE86. In 2011, the production version of the FT-86 made its long-awaited debut at the Tokyo Motor Show.

The "FT" (Future Toyota) designation was dropped, going simply by the name Toyota 86. The new-generation "Hachi-Roku" (86 in Japanese) featured a profile similar to that of the FT-86 II Concept shown at the 2011 Geneva Motor Show. The sleek body adopted Toyota's "Aero Handling" concept, which was the company's advanced aerodynamic philosophy.

Under the hood was a naturally-aspirated 1998cc DOHC flat-4, or "boxer" engine, mounted aft of the front axle. It produced an even <200ps> at <7000rpm> and <20.9kgm> of torque at <6600rpm>. The power was transferred to the rear wheels via a 6-speed manual gearbox or a 6-speed automatic transmission with paddle shifters. Its ideal 53:47 front/rear weight distribution allowed for true sports car handling, with some models getting a limited-slip differential for even more precise cornering. Another reason for the car's amazing agility was because its center of gravity was located in the same place as many exotic supercars, sitting only <460mm> off the ground. The car was also lightweight, tipping the scales at <1230kg>.

Tuning firms, such as Modelista and TRD, offered plenty of customization for the 86, and they showed us that it made for a excellent starting point to build a race car. In sum, the 86 was a lightweight sports car that truly catered to the young car enthusiast of its day.
long.zh:
2009年发布的FT-86 Concept是一款令人惊艳的前置引擎、后轮驱动的紧凑型跑车，由丰田和斯巴鲁合作开发。这款车吸引了全世界车迷期待的目光。2011年，丰田版的量产车型终于在东京车展亮相。

名称中的未来丰田被去掉，正式命名为丰田86。这款新世代车型名称中的“86”源自其前辈，一款上世纪八十年代的超人气车型。其外形更接近2011年日内瓦车展上展出的FT-86 II Concept。这款车在设计上秉持“航天驾控”的理念，即通过卓越的空气动力学设计，使车身从来自各个方向的下压力中获得足够的抓地力。

前置自然吸气<1998cc>4缸双顶置凸轮轴水平对置引擎在<7000rpm>的转速下能够产生<200ps>，在<6600rpm>转速时可产生<20.9kgm>扭矩，然后通过短行程6档手动变速箱或带换挡拨片的6档自动变速箱传递到后轮。

前后配重比被设计为53:47，以增加车尾的可控性，并获得优秀的转向反馈。车辆的重心与超级跑车相当，距地面仅<460mm>。标准款的手动车型车重为<1230kg>，此外也有标配限滑差速器的车型。

新一代86的每一个细节都经过专门设计，以便驾驶者快速上手和操控，使得这辆跑车仿佛就是你手脚的延伸。在这辆车上，你可以享受到特别的操控体验，仿佛人车合二为一。

此外，丰田还计划开发更多的Modellista与丰田赛车开发中心定制套件，以及一款可定制的比赛用车型。这款新世代的轻量级跑车可以说是专为满足车迷而生。

catch.en: The "classic" Toyota 86 sports car takes on a more mature character.
catch.zh: 和Subaru联合研发的前置后驱跑车，有着较低的重心和极佳的前后配重比。

long.en:
The 86 signaled a return to the classic front-engine/rear-drive sports-car segment for Toyota. Introduced in 2012, the 86 was essentially a modern-day version of the classic Corolla/Sprinter AE86 from the 1980s.

Unlike its predecessor, the new 86 came equipped with a boxer-type engine - a 2.0-liter flat-4 - that gave the compact sports car a very low center of gravity, thus better agility and handling response on both road and track. In 2016, the 86 received its first minor update, which included more spot welds to enhance the rigidity of the body and a revised front spoiler for better aerodynamics. The power of the 6-speed manual version was raised to <207ps>/<21.6kgm>, while Sachs dampers were offered as optional equipment for all trim levels.

The GT "Limited" version is the top-of-the-line model, which featured high quality materials such as leather and alcantara in the cabin, resulting in a more mature overall character.
long.zh:
2012年发售的运动车型丰田86兼有相对紧凑的车身和后轮驱动布局。

灵敏且可控的特点沿袭自1980年代热门的卡罗拉/Sprinter AE86。在中置引擎前移的布局，压低的重心和一台2.0水平对置引擎的帮助下，让这样的特质体现得淋漓尽致，因而广泛受到驾驶爱好者的推崇。

在2016年，86进行了第一次小改款。除了外观升级外，还有不少改善驾驶体验的改进，包括增加多处焊点来提高车身刚性，改变前扰流板的形状来提升空气动力学效果等。其6速手动版本的动力被提高到了<207ps>/<21.6kgm>，并且全系增加了萨克斯的避震器作为可选配件。

限量发售的GT版本是86的顶级车型，也是产品线中最“成熟”的版本，高品质材料，如内饰部分的皮革和阿尔卡塔纳合成材料得到了大量的应用。

catch.zh: Toyota 86前置后驱跑车的越野版本，专为Gr.B而改装。
